title: Beam Transport Through a Quadrupole with Offsets in Both Transverse Planes
summary: In accelerator switchyards with shared magnets, a beam may traverse a quadrupole with offsets in both transverse planes, a configuration that cannot be represented by a single conventional horizontal or vertical combined-function bend. Such an off-axis quadrupole bends the reference trajectory and generates dispersion simultaneously in both planes. We derive a compact analytical $6\times6$ transfer matrix about the curved reference trajectory. The model is formulated in Bishop coordinates using a weak-curvature approximation that retains the longitudinal variation of both reference-curvature components and the resulting dispersion in both transverse planes. The analytical linear model is compared with a sliced representation based on conventional second-order combined-function bend maps and with direct numerical integration of the Lorentz equations in the ideal Cartesian quadrupole field.

AI.tldr: 针对共享磁铁加速器开关场中束流通过双向横向偏置四极铁的情形，作者在Bishop坐标下采用弱曲率近似，推导了围绕弯曲参考轨迹的紧凑6×6解析传输矩阵，并与切片化二阶组合函数弯转映射及洛伦兹方程直接数值积分进行对比。
AI.motivation: 在共享磁铁的加速器开关场中，束流可能以水平和垂直两个横向平面均有偏置的方式通过四极铁；这种离轴四极铁会弯曲参考轨迹并在两个平面同时产生色散，无法用单一常规水平或垂直组合函数弯转表示，因此需要相应的解析线性传输模型。
AI.method: 在Bishop坐标下建立模型，采用弱曲率近似，保留两个参考曲率分量随纵向的变化以及由此在两个横向平面产生的色散，推导围绕弯曲参考轨迹的紧凑解析6×6传输矩阵；随后将该解析线性模型与基于常规二阶组合函数弯转映射的切片表示，以及理想笛卡尔四极铁场中洛伦兹方程的直接数值积分进行比较。
AI.result: 摘要仅说明进行了上述模型对比，未给出对比的一致性、误差或具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 摘要未给出明确结论；可知作者提出了该离轴四极铁的解析线性传输模型并开展了数值对比验证，但对比结果与最终结论未在摘要中报告。

title: Report of the National Lab Accelerator Study Group for a Muon Collider
summary: The National Laboratory Accelerator Study Group (NLASG) was established to assess the accelerator research and development required to advance a future high-energy Muon Collider, with particular emphasis on opportunities for coordinated contributions from U.S. national laboratories. This report examines the principal accelerator subsystems, their technical maturity, and the critical challenges that must be addressed before proceeding to a technical design. Topics include the proton driver, target and capture system, muon cooling, acceleration, collider ring, and machine-detector interface. The study identifies priority R&D activities, evaluates opportunities to leverage existing laboratory capabilities and accelerator infrastructure, and outlines a staged approach to technology demonstrations and integrated system validation. Particular emphasis is placed on developing a coordinated national research strategy that complements international efforts and establishes a technically credible path toward a future Muon Collider.

AI.tldr: 美国国家实验室加速器研究组（NLASG）评估了推进未来高能缪子对撞机所需的加速器研发，重点是美国国家实验室的协同贡献；报告梳理关键子系统、技术成熟度与挑战，提出优先研发活动、分阶段技术演示和集成系统验证路径。
AI.motivation: 评估推进未来高能缪子对撞机所需的加速器研发，并特别关注美国国家实验室开展协同贡献的机会。
AI.method: 报告考察质子驱动器、靶与俘获系统、缪子冷却、加速、对撞机环及机器-探测器接口等主要加速器子系统，分析其技术成熟度和进入技术设计前必须解决的关键挑战；同时识别优先研发活动，评估利用现有实验室能力与加速器基础设施的机会，并勾勒分阶段技术演示与集成系统验证方案。
AI.result: 研究识别了优先研发活动，评估了利用现有实验室能力和加速器基础设施的机会，并提出了分阶段技术演示与集成系统验证的路径；摘要未提供具体定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 需要制定协调的国家研究战略，与国际化努力互补，并为未来缪子对撞机建立技术上可信的发展路径。

title: High-transformer-ratio plasma-based afterburner for extending X-ray free-electron laser photon energies to $\gtrsim$50 keV
summary: Bright coherent X-rays in the $\gtrsim$50 keV range are highly desirable for applications in materials science, high-energy-density physics, and nuclear physics, but are difficult to obtain from present X-ray free-electron laser (XFEL) facilities. Plasma-based afterburners offer a compact route to increasing the electron-beam energy, yet high transformer ratio (TR) operation is vulnerable to hosing instability, which can severely degrade the witness beam quality. We propose using a transversely elliptical driver beam to excite an elliptical nonlinear plasma wake with an axially varying focusing gradient, thereby suppressing the witness beam hosing through betatron decoherence. Three-dimensional particle-in-cell simulations show that, for a 3 kA driver and a 2.35 kA witness beam with an rms length of 4 $\mathrmμ$m and a beam separation of 94 $\mathrmμ$m (TR $\approx 3$), this scheme can accelerate an 8 GeV witness beam to $\sim30$ GeV while nearly half of the electrons meet the XFEL requirements. Start-to-end simulations show that the resulting beam can drive $\gtrsim50$ keV XFEL radiation with peak powers of $\sim10$ GW and durations of $\sim10$ fs, even when quantum diffusion is included, offering a compact route to extend existing XFEL facilities to higher photon energies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用横向椭圆驱动束激发具有轴向变化聚焦梯度的椭圆非线性等离子体尾场，通过 Betatron 退相干抑制见证束的 hosing 不稳定性，从而在等离子体后燃器中实现高变压器比电子束加速，并经由全程模拟证明可产生约 10 GW、约 10 fs 的 \gtrsim50 keV XFEL 辐射。
AI.motivation: \gtrsim50 keV 的明亮相干 X 射线对材料科学、高能量密度物理和核物理很有价值，但现有 XFEL 设施难以直接提供；等离子体后燃器可紧凑地提高电子束能量，然而高变压器比运行易受 hosing 不稳定性影响，导致见证束品质严重退化。
AI.method: 采用横向椭圆驱动束激发椭圆非线性等离子体尾场，形成轴向变化的聚焦梯度，并利用 Betatron 退相干抑制见证束的 hosing。通过三维粒子网格模拟评估加速与束流品质，并进行全程模拟检验 XFEL 输出；具体参数包括 3 kA 驱动束、2.35 kA 见证束、4 μm 均方根束长、94 μm 束间距和约 3 的变压器比。
AI.result: 三维 PIC 模拟显示，该方案可将 8 GeV 见证束加速到约 30 GeV，且近一半电子满足 XFEL 要求；全程模拟表明，即使考虑量子扩散，该束流仍可驱动 \gtrsim50 keV XFEL 辐射，峰值功率约 10 GW、持续时间约 10 fs。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为将现有 XFEL 设施扩展到更高光子能量提供了一条紧凑途径，并表明椭圆驱动束与 Betatron 退相干可在高变压器比下维持见证束品质；摘要未提供实验验证、具体 facility 参数或进一步应用评估。

title: Estimation of Very High Energy Electron (VHEE) beam parameters using an in-air screen
summary: Very high energy electron (VHEE) beams offer several promising properties for radiotherapy. Accurate beam delivery requires a beam model that accounts for scattering along the beam propagation path. This work develops and validates a beam model incorporating Multiple Coulomb Scattering (MCS) to estimate beam parameters. MCS is incorporated as an additive term to the covariance matrix transformation for a drift space, allowing conventional quadrupole scans to estimate beam parameters in the presence of a downstream scatterer. The scattering correction factor is fitted to Monte Carlo (MC) simulations for a range of materials and thicknesses. The model is then validated by recovering the initial beam parameters from simulated quadrupole scans of a realistic beamline. Finally, the method is applied to in-air screen measurements at the Pulsed Energetic Electrons for Research (PEER) end station of the Australian Synchrotron. After fitting the correction factors, the mean and standard deviation of the estimation errors for the final emittance, diameter, divergence, and mean kinetic energy were $(-0.06 \pm 3.17)\%$, $(0.15 \pm 0.66)\%$, $(0.18 \pm 2.18)\%$, and $(-0.03 \pm 0.06)\%$, respectively. Simulated quadrupole scans successfully recovered the initial beam parameters, with errors of at most $13\%$. PEER measurements yielded emittance estimates ranging from $0.238$ to $1.753~\mathrm{mm\,mrad}$ across scans, which were within the expected range. Following an initial quadrupole scan, the method allows the in-air beam size to be estimated for other quadrupole configurations. Further work is required to improve the consistency and reliability of the experimental estimates.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出并验证了一种在束流传输模型中引入多重库仑散射（MCS）的方法，用于超高压电子（VHEE）放疗束流参数估计；模拟验证最大误差不超过13%，PEER实验中的发射度估计在预期范围内，但实验估计的一致性和可靠性仍需改进。
AI.motivation: VHEE束流在放疗中具有潜力，而精确的束流配送需要能够考虑束流传播路径上散射的束流模型；因此需要发展包含MCS的束流参数估计方法。
AI.method: 将MCS作为漂移空间协方差矩阵变换的附加项，使常规四极铁扫描在下游存在散射体时仍可估计束流参数；将散射修正因子针对多种材料和厚度拟合到蒙特卡罗模拟；用真实束线的模拟四极铁扫描恢复初始束流参数进行验证；并应用于澳大利亚同步辐射装置PEER终端的空气中屏幕测量。
AI.result: 拟合修正因子后，最终发射度、直径、发散度和平均动能的估计误差均值±标准差分别为(-0.06±3.17)%、(0.15±0.66)%、(0.18±2.18)%和(-0.03±0.06)%；模拟四极铁扫描成功恢复初始束流参数，误差至多13%；PEER测量得到的发射度在各次扫描中为0.238至1.753 mm mrad，处于预期范围内；首次四极铁扫描后，该方法可估计其他四极铁配置下的空气中束流尺寸。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该含MCS的束流模型可用于VHEE束流参数估计并得到模拟与实验支持，但实验估计的一致性和可靠性仍需进一步工作改进。

title: High-Efficiency Wakefield Acceleration of Positrons via a Slit Plasma Channel
summary: Although plasma-based wakefield acceleration has achieved remarkable success for electrons, efficient positron acceleration remains a long standing challenge, as positrons suffer severe defocusing in the accelerating phases of such structures. Here, we propose a slit plasma wakefield acceleration (SPWA) scheme, in which a relativistic electron beam propagating through a slit channel formed by two parallel plasma slabs excites crossing plasma-electron filamentary structures within the slit, generating intense wakefields tailored to simultaneously provide longitudinal acceleration and transverse focusing for a trailing positron bunch. A theoretical model is developed to characterize the wakefield structure responsible for positron acceleration and focusing. Three-dimensional particle-in-cell simulations validate the model, and demonstrate that the SPWA scheme achieves a positron trapping efficiency of nearly 100%, while maintaining low emittance growth and narrow energy spread for an injected positron beam. These findings establish a new and robust approach to high-efficiency positron acceleration, with promising implications for future compact electron-positron colliders and high-energy positron applications.

AI.tldr: 该文提出狭缝等离子体尾场加速（SPWA）方案：利用相对论电子束在双平行等离子体板形成的狭缝通道中激发交叉的等离子体电子丝状结构，产生同时具备纵向加速和横向聚焦作用的尾场，并通过理论建模与三维PIC模拟验证其对尾随正电子束的高效加速。
AI.motivation: 等离子体尾场加速在电子加速方面已取得显著成功，但正电子加速仍是长期挑战，因为正电子在加速相中会遭受严重散焦。
AI.method: 提出SPWA方案：相对论电子束穿过由两块平行等离子体板构成的狭缝通道，在狭缝内激发交叉的等离子体电子丝状结构并产生定制尾场，为尾随正电子束同时提供纵向加速和横向聚焦；建立理论模型刻画用于正电子加速与聚焦的尾场结构，并用三维粒子网格（PIC）模拟进行验证。
AI.result: 三维PIC模拟验证了理论模型，并表明SPWA方案对注入正电子束可实现接近100%的俘获效率，同时保持低发射度增长和窄能散；摘要未提供具体加速梯度或能量增益数值。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一种稳健的高效正电子加速新途径，对未来紧凑型电子-正电子对撞机和高能正电子应用具有潜在意义。

title: Hydrogen Electron Cyclotron Resonance Dissociator Demonstrator for the Project 8 Experiment
summary: Project 8, a neutrino mass experiment, employs the novel frequency technique of cyclotron radiation emission spectroscopy (CRES) to perform a model independent measurement of neutrino mass via tritium beta decay. Our pioneering experiment will consist of a beamline that dissociates molecular tritium, surface cools atoms through accommodation, evaporatively cools and slows atoms, and traps them in a CRES resonant cavity to advance towards our sensitivity goal of 40 meV/c^2 for our final electron-weighted neutrino mass measurement. We are prototyping an electron cyclotron resonance (ECR) dissociator that uses a tunable 1 kW 2.45 GHz RF generator and electromagnets to ignite a hydrogen plasma in an aluminum resonant cavity. Our ECR source is designed to produce a high atom flux (~10^19 atoms/second) near room temperature. We present the engineering development, gas diagnostics, and spectroscopy data from our hydrogen plasma.

AI.tldr: Project 8 采用 CRES 频率技术，通过氚 β 衰变开展不依赖模型的中微子质量测量；本文介绍用于产生氚原子束的 ECR 解离器原型、工程研制、气体诊断和氢等离子体光谱数据。
AI.motivation: 利用氚 β 衰变和 CRES 技术实现不依赖模型的中微子质量测量，并推动最终电子加权中微子质量灵敏度达到 40 meV/c^2。
AI.method: 设计包含分子氚解离、表面冷却（ accommodation）、蒸发冷却与减速、以及 CRES 共振腔捕获的束流线；原型 ECR 解离器使用可调 1 kW、2.45 GHz 射频发生器和电磁铁，在铝制共振腔中点燃氢等离子体，目标是在接近室温下产生约 10^19 atoms/second 的高原子通量；展示工程开发、气体诊断和氢等离子体光谱数据。
AI.result: 摘要给出了 ECR 解离器的工程研制、气体诊断及氢等离子体光谱数据，但未提供具体测量结果、达到的原子通量或灵敏度数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过 ECR 氢等离子体源原型推进 Project 8 氚原子源与束流线所需解离技术的发展；摘要未给出该原型是否已达到设计通量或最终灵敏度目标的结论。

title: Single-pass stochastic cooling for electron microscopy
summary: Scientific applications of free electrons, such as in electron microscopes and particle accelerators, are limited by the brightness of available electron sources. Accelerators can use phase space cooling to surpass these source limitations, whereas electron microscopes can only rely on particle filtering to increase beam coherence at the cost of reduced brightness. We show that strong electron-light coupling in nanophotonic structures makes it possible to achieve single-pass stochastic cooling inside an electron microscope for a lossless improvement of longitudinal emittance. This approach is laser-free and compatible with normal CW operation of electron microscopes. We derive a fully quantum mechanical model of stochastic cooling valid in the strong coupling regime, finding an analytic asymptotic formula for the optimal cooled energy spread $σ_{E_f}\simeq0.88(\hbarω)^{2/3}σ_{E_0}^{1/3}$, with $\hbar ω$ the cooling photon energy and $σ_{E_0}$ the initial energy spread. Numerical simulations confirm that the energy spread reduction is reflected in an increase in the purity of the electron's quantum state and a reduction of the longitudinal phase space area. Our work paves a path towards even brighter beams for electron microscopy, promising higher image quality, enhanced spectral resolution, and a route to reaching fundamental quantum limits on electron beam phase space area.

AI.tldr: 该文提出利用纳米光子结构中的强电子—光耦合，在电子显微镜内实现单程随机冷却，从而无损改善纵向发射度；并给出强耦合区全量子模型、最优能量展宽渐近公式及数值验证。
AI.motivation: 自由电子的科学应用受电子源亮度限制；加速器可用相空间冷却突破源限制，而电子显微镜只能通过粒子筛选提高相干性，但会牺牲亮度。因此需要一种兼容电子显微镜常规连续波运行、无需激光且能无损提高亮度的冷却机制。
AI.method: 在纳米光子结构中利用强电子—光耦合，在电子显微镜内实现单程随机冷却；建立适用于强耦合区的全量子力学随机冷却模型，并推导最优冷却能量展宽的解析渐近公式。
AI.result: 得到最优冷却能量展宽的渐近公式 σ_{E_f}≃0.88(ℏω)^{2/3}σ_{E_0}^{1/3}，其中 ℏω 为冷却光子能量，σ_{E_0} 为初始能量展宽。数值模拟表明，能量展宽降低体现为电子量子态纯度提高和纵向相空间面积减小；该方法无需激光，并兼容电子显微镜常规连续波运行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为电子显微术获得更亮电子束提供了路径，有望提升图像质量和光谱分辨率，并为达到电子束相空间面积的基本量子极限提供途径。

title: Impact of Rapid Acceleration on Beam Dynamics in the Rapid-Cycling Synchrotrons of a Muon Collider
summary: Circular muon colliders offer a promising route to multi-TeV centre-of-mass energies with high luminosity. The baseline design for the high-energy complex includes a chain of four Rapid-Cycling Synchrotrons (RCSs) accelerating the beam from \qty{63}{\GeV} to \qty{5}{\TeV}. The chain combines a conventional synchrotron with three hybrid synchrotrons, which use fixed-field superconducting dipoles and rapidly ramped normal-conducting dipoles. The short muon lifetime (\qty{2.2}{\micro\second} in the rest frame) imposes stringent constraints on the acceleration process: achieving the target luminosity requires a muon survival rate of up to \qty{70}{\percent} throughout the acceleration chain, with the full acceleration completed in approximately \qty{10}{\milli\second}. These demanding acceleration conditions raise several beam-dynamics challenges, investigated in this work. First, the impact of the RF cavity distribution on transverse emittance growth is studied. Second, the mismatch between the discretely increasing beam energy and the continuously ramped fields of the pulsed dipoles and quadrupoles is modelled analytically, and its impact is evaluated through tracking simulations. Finally, the sensitivity of the beam trajectory, optical functions, and emittance growth to magnetic-field ramp jitter is assessed.

AI.tldr: 面向从63 GeV加速到5 TeV的四台RCS μ子加速链，在2.2 μs静止寿命、约10 ms完成加速和最高70%存活率约束下，分析RF腔布局、能量与脉冲磁铁场爬升失配及磁场抖动引起的束流动力学问题。
AI.motivation: 圆形μ子对撞机有望以高亮度实现多TeV质心能量；但μ子寿命极短，加速链须在约10 ms内完成加速并维持高存活率，因此需要研究RCS加速方案中的束流动力学限制。
AI.method: 基线高频复合体由四台快速循环同步加速器组成，包括一台常规同步加速器和三台采用固定场超导二极磁铁与快速爬升常规导体二极磁铁的混合同步加速器。工作研究RF腔分布对横向发射度增长的影响；对离散增加的束流能量与脉冲二极/四极磁铁连续爬升场之间的失配进行解析建模，并通过跟踪模拟评估其影响；评估磁场爬升抖动对束流轨迹、光学函数和发射度增长的敏感性。
AI.result: 摘要仅说明开展了上述三类研究，未给出定量结果或明确性能指标；具体包括RF腔分布对横向发射度增长的影响、能量与场爬升失配的解析建模与跟踪评估，以及磁场抖动对轨迹、光学函数和发射度增长的敏感性分析。
AI.conclusion: 论文将RF腔分布、能量-场爬升失配和磁场抖动识别为满足μ子存活率与快速加速要求的关键束流动力学挑战，并采用解析建模与跟踪模拟进行评估；摘要未给出最终可行性或是否达到70%存活率等结论。

title: Cryogenic suppression of correlated loss in Rydberg atom arrays
summary: Blackbody radiation (BBR) poses a central challenge for quantum science with Rydberg atoms. By driving transitions to nearby opposite-parity states, BBR shortens Rydberg lifetimes and has long been suspected to trigger "avalanche" events known to cause correlated atom loss. Here, we suppress avalanche decay and establish BBR as its dominant trigger using a Rydberg atom array that operates either cryogenically or at room temperature. A $45~\text{K}$ radiation shield reduces ambient BBR, extending Rydberg $nS$ lifetimes for $n$ ranging from 50 to 75. BBR-induced decay rates are suppressed by 30%-50%, corresponding to an effective blackbody temperature $T_{\rm eff}\approx190~\text{K}$. This enables controlled comparisons of Rydberg-dressed atom arrays operating in different BBR environments. Arrays of up to 70 atoms demonstrate cryogenically suppressed avalanche rates, tracking the suppression in BBR-induced decay, for both $n=50$ and $n=60$ dressing. A parameter-free rate model agrees with the measured avalanche rates after accounting for frequency-dependent cryogenic shielding, photoionization-triggered avalanches, laser phase noise, BBR decay channels, and Rydberg interaction effects. We demonstrate a quantitative description of avalanche decay and show that improved BBR shielding should further suppress correlated loss to the $T_\text{eff}=45~\text{K}$ achievable in the current apparatus. Our results establish a route to mitigating correlated errors that otherwise impede fault-tolerant operation in neutral-atom quantum processors.

AI.tldr: 该文利用可在低温或室温运行的里德伯原子阵列，抑制雪崩衰变并确认黑体辐射是其主导触发因素；45 K辐射屏蔽降低了环境黑体辐射，使n=50至75的里德伯nS态寿命延长、黑体辐射诱导衰变率降低30%–50%（有效黑体温度约190 K），并在最多70个原子的阵列中实现雪崩率的低温抑制及与无参数速率模型的定量吻合。
AI.motivation: 黑体辐射是里德伯原子量子科学的核心挑战：它通过驱动至邻近相反宇称态的跃迁缩短里德伯寿命，并长期被认为会触发导致关联原子损失的“雪崩”事件。抑制这类关联错误对于中性原子量子处理器的容错运行至关重要。
AI.method: 采用可低温或室温运行的里德伯原子阵列，使用45 K辐射屏蔽降低环境黑体辐射，测量n=50至75的里德伯nS态寿命及黑体辐射诱导衰变率；在最多70个原子、n=50和n=60里德伯缀饰的阵列中比较不同黑体辐射环境下的雪崩率，并建立无参数速率模型，纳入频率相关低温屏蔽、光电离触发雪崩、激光相位噪声、黑体辐射衰变通道和里德伯相互作用效应。
AI.result: 45 K屏蔽使里德伯nS态寿命延长，黑体辐射诱导衰变率被抑制30%–50%，对应有效黑体温度约190 K；最多70个原子的阵列表现出低温抑制的雪崩率，且该抑制与黑体辐射诱导衰变的抑制同步。无参数速率模型在纳入上述机制后与实测雪崩率一致，实现了对雪崩衰变的定量描述；改进屏蔽有望将关联损失进一步抑制至当前装置可达到的T_eff=45 K。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了黑体辐射作为雪崩衰变主导触发因素，并给出了雪崩衰变的定量描述；改进黑体辐射屏蔽是抑制关联错误、推进中性原子量子处理器容错运行的可行路线。

title: LADA: A differential algebra-based simulation package for arbitrary-order charged-particle and light optics
summary: LADA computes charged-particle and light-optical transfer maps by differential algebra in Python, with run-time order selection validated through order nine. It combines these established map methods with ATIMA-based stopping, straggling and scattering, the GLOBAL, CHARGE and ETACHA charge-state models, EPAX fragmentation, six-dimensional integration through measured or computed RF fields with reference-energy rebasing, and section-wise particle tracking with aperture and RF-window losses. Maps retain analytic dependence on external parameters; contraction with input moments gives beam observables and their sensitivities without particle tracking at each setting. Lattice import from COSY, MAD-X, Xsuite and MIRKO provides per-record status and comparisons with available codes. NumPy is the only required dependency. On the HHT benchmark, the optional compiled DA kernel on eight cores matches COSY in performance at orders 3 and 5 and is 1.8 and 2.9 times faster at orders 7 and 9. Applications include the SIBAF irradiation facility through CALINA, proton microscopy and beam-line studies at GSI and FAIR.

AI.tldr: LADA 是一个以 NumPy 为唯一必需依赖的 Python 程序，用微分代数计算带电粒子与光学传输图，支持运行时选择阶数并验证至九阶；它集成束流与物质相互作用、RF 场六维积分、分段跟踪及多种 lattice 导入，在 HHT 基准上可选编译 DA 内核性能与 COSY 相当或更快，并已用于 SIBAF/CALINA、质子显微及 GSI/FAIR 束线研究。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确陈述研究动机；从内容看，工作是提供一套 Python 工具，把传输图方法与 ATIMA 阻止/能散/散射、电荷态模型、EPAX 碎裂、RF 场积分和分段粒子跟踪结合，并利用传输图对参数的解析依赖，在无需逐设置粒子跟踪的情况下获得束流可观测量及其灵敏度，同时支持从常用 lattice 程序导入。
AI.method: LADA 在 Python 中用微分代数计算带电粒子与光学传输图，支持运行时选择阶数并验证至九阶；集成 ATIMA 的阻止、能散和散射，GLOBAL、CHARGE、ETACHA 电荷态模型，EPAX 碎裂，基于实测或计算 RF 场的六维积分与参考能量重基，以及带孔径和 RF 窗损失的分段粒子跟踪。传输图保留对外部参数的解析依赖，与输入矩收缩可给出束流可观测量及灵敏度。程序支持从 COSY、MAD-X、Xsuite、MIRKO 导入 lattice，提供逐记录状态及与可用代码的比较；NumPy 是唯一必需依赖，另有可选编译 DA 内核。
AI.result: 摘要未给出除 HHT 基准和应用案例外的定量结果。HHT 基准上，八核可选编译 DA 内核在 3、5 阶性能与 COSY 相当，在 7、9 阶分别快 1.8 和 2.9 倍；应用包括经 CALINA 的 SIBAF 辐照设施、质子显微以及 GSI 和 FAIR 的束线研究。
AI.conclusion: 综合摘要，LADA 将微分代数传输图、束流-物质相互作用、RF 场积分、分段跟踪和 lattice 导入整合为仅需 NumPy 的 Python 工具；其可选编译内核在高阶计算中相对 COSY 具有性能优势，并已用于多个设施和束线研究。摘要未给出更一般的结论或适用性限制。

title: Nuclear recoil with electron vacuum polarization in muonic atoms
summary: Using the heavy-particle QED approach, we derive the last missing $α\,(Zα)^5\,m^2/M$ nuclear recoil correction in muonic atoms, which originates from the combination of the $(Zα)^5\,m^2/M$ recoil with the electron vacuum polarization. Numerical results are presented for the $1S$, $2S$, and $2P$ states of $μ$H, $μ$D, $μ^3$He$^+$, and $μ^4$He$^+$. For the $2P-2S$ Lamb shift in muonic helium ions, our results are of opposite sign and about four times smaller in magnitude than the previous logarithmic estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文采用重粒子QED方法，推导出μ子原子中此前缺失的α(Zα)^5 m^2/M核反冲修正项；该修正项由(Zα)^5 m^2/M反冲与电子真空极化共同产生。文中给出了μH、μD、μ^3He^+和μ^4He^+的1S、2S、2P态数值结果，并指出μ子氦离子2P-2S Lamb位移与以往对数估计符号相反、量级约小四倍。
AI.motivation: 补全μ子原子中最后一个缺失的α(Zα)^5 m^2/M核反冲修正，并评估该修正对μH、μD、μ^3He^+和μ^4He^+相关能级及μ子氦离子2P-2S Lamb位移的影响。
AI.method: 采用重粒子QED方法，推导由(Zα)^5 m^2/M反冲与电子真空极化组合产生的α(Zα)^5 m^2/M核反冲修正，并对μH、μD、μ^3He^+和μ^4He^+的1S、2S和2P态进行数值计算。
AI.result: 给出了μH、μD、μ^3He^+和μ^4He^+的1S、2S、2P态的数值结果；对于μ子氦离子的2P-2S Lamb位移，结果与先前的对数估计符号相反，且幅度约小四倍。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 所推导的修正补全了μ子原子中缺失的α(Zα)^5 m^2/M核反冲项，并表明μ子氦离子2P-2S Lamb位移的先前对数估计需要修正。

title: OPALX: A performance-portable framework for particle accelerator simulations
comment: 23 pages, 15 figures. Further benchmarking is planned before submission to Physical Review Accelerators and Beams
summary: Accurate charged-particle beam simulations require self-consistent collective fields and realistic accelerator models, while their computational cost motivates efficient use of heterogeneous computing systems. We present OPALX, a performance-portable accelerator simulation framework that builds on the beam-dynamics capabilities of OPAL. Its modular architecture uses the Independent Parallel Particle Layer (IPPL) and Kokkos to support distributed-memory execution on multicore CPUs and GPUs from a common codebase. The framework combines relativistic particle tracking with prescribed accelerator fields, particle-in-cell space charge calculations, and spin tracking. We describe the physical and numerical models and their integration into the simulation workflow. The implementation is assessed using disorder-induced heating and frozen-spin test cases, together with comparisons of spin evolution with G4Beamline and beam transport with TraceWin. A three-dimensional space charge benchmark evaluates throughput on CPU and GPU systems, reaching approximately $10^9$ macroparticles per second on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU for this benchmark. These results provide initial verification of the implemented models and demonstrate CPU and GPU execution of self-consistent space charge calculations. OPALX provides a common foundation for extending accelerator models and numerical methods across heterogeneous computing platforms.

AI.tldr: OPALX 是一个基于 OPAL 光束动力学能力、利用 IPPL 与 Kokkos 实现性能可移植的加速器模拟框架，可在多核 CPU 和 GPU 的分布式内存系统上运行；它集成相对论粒子跟踪、指定加速器场、PIC 空间电荷计算和自旋跟踪，并通过测试与基准初步验证。
AI.motivation: 精确的带电粒子束模拟需要自洽集体场和真实加速器模型，但计算成本高，因此需要高效利用异构计算系统。
AI.method: OPALX 采用模块化架构，基于独立并行粒子层 IPPL 和 Kokkos，从同一代码库支持多核 CPU 与 GPU 的分布式内存执行；框架结合相对论粒子跟踪与指定加速器场、基于 PIC 的空间电荷计算以及自旋跟踪，并描述了物理与数值模型及其在模拟工作流中的集成。
AI.result: 使用无序诱导加热和冻结自旋测试案例进行评估，并将自旋演化与 G4Beamline、束流传输与 TraceWin 进行比较；三维空间电荷基准测试评估 CPU 和 GPU 吞吐量，在该基准下单块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 达到约 10^9 个宏粒子每秒。结果初步验证了所实现模型，并展示了自洽空间电荷计算的 CPU 与 GPU 执行；其他平台的具体性能数据未提供。
AI.conclusion: OPALX 为在异构计算平台上扩展加速器模型和数值方法提供了共同基础。

title: The two-loop Lamb shift: the final missing contribution
summary: The last significant unknown contribution to the two-loop Lamb shift, namely the electron self-energy with vacuum-polarization insertion into the photon line, is determined including higher-order effects in the parameter $αZ$, with $α$ being the fine-structure constant and $Z$ the nuclear charge number. Our calculation improves the accuracy of theoretical predictions for energy levels and transition energies in heavy hydrogen-like and lithium-like ions by up to one order of magnitude, enabling more stringent comparisons between theory and available experimental results. These results pave the way for more precise tests of quantum electrodynamics in the strong-field regime, as well as for accurate determinations of nuclear charge radii.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了双圈兰姆位移中最后一个重要的未知贡献，即光子线插入真空极化的电子自能，并计入αZ高阶效应；该计算将重氢类与锂类离子能级和跃迁能量理论精度提高最多一个数量级，有助于更严格的QED检验和核电荷半径测定。
AI.motivation: 补全双圈兰姆位移中最后一个重要的未知贡献，并提高重氢类与锂类离子能级及跃迁能量的理论预测精度，从而支持与实验的更严格比较、强场区域量子电动力学的精确检验以及核电荷半径的准确确定。
AI.method: 计算光子线中插入真空极化的电子自能对双圈兰姆位移的贡献，并在参数αZ中纳入高阶效应；其中α为精细结构常数，Z为核电荷数。摘要未给出更具体的计算技术细节。
AI.result: 该计算将重氢类与锂类离子能级和跃迁能量的理论预测精度提高最多一个数量级，使理论结果与现有实验结果的比较更为严格。
AI.conclusion: 该工作补足了双圈兰姆位移的重要未知项，为进一步在强场区域精确检验量子电动力学以及准确确定核电荷半径奠定了基础。

title: Discovering like a scientist: Literature-informed dimensionless learning for physical closure of data-driven equations
summary: Data-driven methods can recover compact equations, yet the physical dependence of their coefficients across operating conditions often remains unresolved. Dimensionless groups can explain this variation, but selecting relevant groups from the many dimensionally admissible combinations remains challenging. Here, we introduce a knowledge-guided framework for dimensionless learning, called π-former. It learns patterns of variable association and exponent assignment from a corpus of 1,288 established dimensionless groups. Under exact dimensional constraints, the model proposes interpretable basic groups whose combinations are optimized against observations. Across seven physical problems, the framework identifies predictive dimensionless coordinates within seconds. Integration with equation discovery further expresses condition-dependent coefficients through these coordinates, recovering established physical scalings in multi-condition simulations. Applied to experimental measurements of evaporation-driven wetting, the framework discovers dimensionless coordinates and uses them to construct a unified trajectory equation. The resulting model generalizes to held-out conditions across liquids and initial volumes, outperforming existing empirical models. These results establish dimensionless learning as a transferable bridge between accumulated scientific knowledge and data-driven equation discovery, enabling artificial intelligence to uncover physically meaningful laws from observations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出知识引导的无量纲学习框架π-former，从1,288个已有无量纲群中学习变量关联与指数分配规律，在严格量纲约束下生成并优化可解释基本群；在七个物理问题中数秒内找到预测性无量纲坐标，并与方程发现结合，将条件依赖系数表示为这些坐标的函数，成功恢复多工况模拟中的物理标度；在蒸发驱动润湿实验中构建统一轨迹方程，并泛化到不同液体和初始体积的留出条件，优于现有经验模型。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动方法虽能恢复紧凑方程，但其系数随工况变化的物理依赖性常未解决；无量纲群可解释这种变化，但从大量量纲允许的组合中选取相关群仍很困难。
AI.method: 提出知识引导的无量纲学习框架π-former。该框架从1,288个已建立的无量纲群语料中学习变量关联模式和指数分配，在精确量纲约束下提出可解释的基本群，并针对观测数据优化其组合；进一步与方程发现集成，用所学习的无量纲坐标表达条件依赖系数，并应用于蒸发驱动润湿的实验测量。
AI.result: 在七个物理问题中，框架可在数秒内识别具有预测能力的无量纲坐标；与方程发现结合后，可在多工况模拟中恢复已有物理标度关系；在蒸发驱动润湿实验中，发现无量纲坐标并构建统一轨迹方程，模型可泛化到不同液体和初始体积的留出条件，且优于现有经验模型。摘要未提供具体定量误差或加速倍数。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，无量纲学习可作为连接积累的科学知识与数据驱动方程发现的可迁移桥梁，使人工智能能够从观测中揭示具有物理意义的规律。

title: Inverse modelling of a laser-plasma accelerator
summary: The electron beams of a laser-plasma accelerator depend non-linearly on the laser and gas settings. This dependence is explored using particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations, and machine-learning models trained on these simulations predict the beam from the settings. Here we address the reverse problem: given a measured beam, which settings produced it? We infer three of them: the gas pressure $p\_1$, the normalised vector potential $a\_0$ and the nitrogen concentration $c\_{N\_2}$. The solution is not guaranteed to be unique. We train an ensemble of mixture density networks that, for each beam, output several possible sets of settings with their probabilities and uncertainties, and test them on simulated beams with realistic measurement noise. On average, the predictions are accurate ($R^2 = 0.91$), yet for about two-thirds of the beams the inferred distribution has two competing solutions. These share nearly the same value of $a\_0^2 p\_1$, which controls how strongly the laser focuses itself in the plasma and, in earlier PALLAS studies, when electrons start to be injected. Keeping this quantity fixed gives beams that are practically indistinguishable with realistic diagnostics. A forward model used as a check removes unphysical solutions but cannot choose between the two plausible ones. We then test two ways to resolve the ambiguity. Adding the full electron energy spectrum improves the mean prediction ($R^2 = 0.94$), mostly through $a\_0$. It changes the weights of the two solutions but does not move them. A second measurement at a deliberately different plasma density is more effective. In paired PIC simulations, it reduces the error on $a\_0$ by a factor of 2.6, whereas repeating the measurement at the same density brings almost no gain.

AI.tldr: 该文研究激光等离子体加速器的逆向问题：利用PIC模拟训练混合密度网络集成，从带真实噪声的电子束反推气压、归一化矢势和氮浓度；平均预测准确（R²=0.91），但约三分之二束流存在两个竞争解，它们近似共享a₀²p₁；全电子能谱仅有限改善，换等离子体密度进行第二次测量更有效。
AI.motivation: 电子束对激光与气体设置呈非线性依赖；已有机器学习模型可由设置正向预测束流，本文关注反向问题，即给定测量到的束流推断产生它的设置，并且该逆问题的解不保证唯一。
AI.method: 使用粒子网格（PIC）模拟生成数据，训练混合密度网络集成，对每个束流输出多组可能设置及其概率和不确定性，并在加入现实测量噪声的模拟束流上测试；用正向模型剔除不合理解；再测试加入完整电子能谱，以及在刻意不同的等离子体密度下进行第二次测量，并通过配对PIC模拟比较不同密度与相同密度重复测量的效果。
AI.result: 平均预测准确度为R²=0.91；约三分之二的束流推断分布有两个竞争解，二者a₀²p₁几乎相同，该量控制激光在等离子体中的自聚焦强弱，并在早期PALLAS研究中关联电子注入起始；固定该量得到的束流在现实诊断下几乎不可区分。正向模型可去除不合理解，但不能在两个合理解间选择。加入完整电子能谱将平均R²提高至0.94，主要改善a₀，只改变两个解的权重而不移动其位置；在刻意不同的等离子体密度下第二次测量，使a₀误差降低2.6倍，而在相同密度重复测量几乎无增益。
AI.conclusion: 该逆问题因参数组合a₀²p₁的近简并性而本质多解，单次束流测量和正向模型不足以唯一确定设置；全电子能谱提供有限改善，而在不同等离子体密度下增加一次测量是更有效的消歧手段。

title: Sympathetic Cooling of Ionic Fullerenes with Ultracold Atoms to Millikelvin Temperatures
summary: Cooling complex molecular ions to millikelvin temperatures remains a major challenge because their intricate internal structures prevent laser cooling. Here, we propose to use an ultracold gas of Cd atoms to efficiently cool C$_{60}^+$ ions to average kinetic energies of approximately 20 mK, following an initial precooling stage with He buffer gas. Our approach is based on full molecular dynamics simulations using accurate ion-atom interaction potentials derived from high-level electronic structure methods. Furthermore, using a Monte Carlo approach, we predict the formation of C$_{60}^+$ Coulomb crystals supported solely by collisions with the buffer gas. The probability of reaching these cold states shows a pronounced dependence on the number of trapped ions, revealing the competition between neutral-atom cooling and many-ion dynamics in radio-frequency traps.

AI.tldr: 该文提出先用He缓冲气体预冷，再用超冷Cd原子将C60+离子冷却至约20 mK平均动能；基于高精度离子-原子势的分子动力学模拟和蒙特卡罗方法，预测可形成仅由缓冲气体碰撞支持的C60+库仑晶体，且达到冷态的几率显著依赖囚禁离子数。
AI.motivation: 复杂分子离子内部结构复杂，难以采用激光冷却，因此将其冷却至毫开尔文温度仍是重大挑战；本文旨在探索利用超冷Cd原子高效冷却C60+离子的可行途径。
AI.method: 先以He缓冲气体对C60+进行预冷，再引入超冷Cd原子冷却；采用由高等级电子结构方法导出的精确离子-原子相互作用势开展全分子动力学模拟，并用蒙特卡罗方法预测C60+库仑晶体的形成。
AI.result: 模拟表明可将C60+离子冷却至约20 mK的平均动能；预测可形成仅由与缓冲气体碰撞支持的C60+库仑晶体；达到冷态的概率随囚禁离子数显著变化，体现中性原子冷却与射频阱中多离子动力学之间的竞争。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明该超冷Cd原子冷却方案在模拟层面可行，并可预测冷C60+库仑晶体的形成；但摘要未提供实验验证、具体最优离子数或更详细的结论性数据。

title: Quantum Spin Wave Theory with Multi-Spin Interactions for Magnetic Materials Modeling
summary: In the field of magnetism within condensed matter physics, magnetic systems are microscopically described by a spin Hamiltonian. Its parameterization is accessible through both ab initio calculations and fits to experimental data. Frequently, this is achieved via multi-stage calculations that either relate the parameters to observable material properties or map a Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian onto an effective spin model. In this realm, accurate and flexible methods are essential for simulating the physical properties of the latter. The present study focuses on one such method: spin wave theory. The approach is applied to a new formulation of the spin Hamiltonian, named polynomial localized spin model (PLSM), which includes terms of arbitrary order in the spin operators. This enables the direct application of linear spin wave theory (LSWT) to the analysis of the energy landscape and spin-wave spectrum of arbitrary collinear and non-collinear phases in any realistic magnetic material. Moreover, the classical and quantum parts of the PLSM are cleanly separated. Finally, an open-source implementation of LSWT, named Magnopy, is presented. It interfaces with modern parameterization software, supports arbitrary collinear and non-collinear systems, and is designed for both scripting and standalone use.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将线性自旋波理论（LSWT）应用于新式多项式局域自旋模型（PLSM），以实现对实际磁性材料中任意共线及非共线磁相的能量景观和自旋波谱分析，并发布开源实现 Magnopy。
AI.motivation: 磁学中磁性系统需用自旋哈密顿量微观描述，其参数化可通过第一性原理计算或拟合实验数据获得，且常涉及多阶段计算或将 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量映射到有效自旋模型；因此，需要准确且灵活的方法来模拟有效自旋模型的物理性质。
AI.method: 采用自旋波理论，特别是线性自旋波理论（LSWT），并将其应用于新提出的多项式局域自旋模型（PLSM）。PLSM 包含自旋算符的任意阶项，可干净分离经典部分与量子部分；同时实现开源 LSWT 软件 Magnopy，支持任意共线及非共线系统，可与现代参数化软件接口，并兼顾脚本调用和独立使用。
AI.result: 该方法可直接用 LSWT 分析任意实际磁性材料中任意共线及非共线相的能量景观和自旋波谱；摘要未提供定量验证、性能对比或具体材料案例结果。
AI.conclusion: PLSM 与 LSWT 的结合为有效自旋模型提供通用分析框架，并通过开源软件 Magnopy 实现，支持任意共线及非共线磁性系统、现代参数化软件接口以及脚本和独立使用。

title: Numerical Study of Two-Frequency Heating in ECR Ion Source
summary: The two-frequency heating (TFH) method is widely used to improve the performance of electron cyclotron resonance (ECR) ion sources, yet its physical mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. In this work, the TFH regime in the DECRIS-PM ECR ion source is studied numerically using the NAM-ECRIS code. Single-frequency heating at 14.51 GHz (500 W) is compared to two-frequency heating at 14.51 GHz and 13 GHz (450 W + 50 W) at equal total power. It is found that while the global plasma parameters remain largely unchanged, the peak density of highly anisotropic electrons (E > 1 keV, Vperp/Vlong > 10) decreases by ~20% and their distribution broadens radially in the TFH regime. This reduction in electron anisotropy is attributed to the randomizing effect of the lower-frequency wave on electron gyromotion, which suppresses plasma micro-instabilities and leads to improved ion production.

AI.tldr: 该文用NAM-ECRIS代码数值研究DECRIS-PM ECR离子源的双频加热（TFH）机制：在总功率相同条件下比较14.51 GHz单频与14.51 GHz+13 GHz双频加热，发现全局等离子体参数基本不变，但高各向异性电子峰值密度降低约20%且径向分布展宽，归因于低频波对电子回旋运动的随机化作用。
AI.motivation: 双频加热被广泛用于提升电子回旋共振（ECR）离子源性能，但其物理机制仍认识不足，因此需要数值研究TFH对电子动力学及离子产生的影响。
AI.method: 采用NAM-ECRIS代码对DECRIS-PM ECR离子源中的TFH regime进行数值模拟，并在总功率相同条件下比较14.51 GHz（500 W）单频加热与14.51 GHz+13 GHz（450 W+50 W）双频加热。
AI.result: 模拟显示TFH下全局等离子体参数基本不变；能量E>1 keV、Vperp/Vlong>10的高各向异性电子峰值密度下降约20%，其分布沿径向展宽。该电子各向异性降低被归因于低频波对电子回旋运动的随机化效应。摘要未提供离子产额提升的定量数据或实验验证结果。
AI.conclusion: TFH通过低频波随机化电子回旋运动，降低高各向异性电子密度并展宽其径向分布，从而抑制等离子体微观不稳定性并改善离子产生；但摘要未给出离子产生改善的定量指标及实验验证。

title: Photoionization rates of oxygen and nitrogen at 800 nm measured by Thomson coherent microwave scattering
summary: In this study, we report on the use of Thomson coherent microwave scattering (CMS) to characterize photoionization rates in oxygen and nitrogen at 800 nm over a range spanning approximately three orders of magnitude, from about mid-10$^9$ s$^{-1}$ range to the to mid-10$^{12}$ s$^{-1}$ range, corresponding to laser intensities in the vicinity of 10$^{13}$-10$^{14}$ W/cm$^2$, a range of significant practical relevance to filamentation physics.

AI.tldr: 该文利用汤姆逊相干微波散射（CMS）表征800 nm激光下氧气和氮气中的光电离速率，覆盖约三个数量级、对应约10^13–10^14 W/cm^2激光强度。
AI.motivation: 光电离速率在约10^13–10^14 W/cm^2强度区间对成丝物理具有重要实际意义，因此需要对该区间内O2和N2的光电离速率进行表征。
AI.method: 采用汤姆逊相干微波散射（CMS）技术，在800 nm条件下表征氧气和氮气的光电离速率。
AI.result: 在氧气和氮气中获得了从约10^9 s^-1中段到约10^12 s^-1中段、跨越约三个数量级的光电离速率表征，对应激光强度约为10^13–10^14 W/cm^2。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明CMS可用于覆盖与成丝物理相关的强度区间并对O2和N2的光电离速率进行表征；摘要未提供定量误差、理论对比或更具体的结论。

title: Energy-Guided Transport for Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching
summary: Deep generative models, particularly Flow Matching frameworks, have emerged as powerful tools for synthesizing complex physical systems. However, standard architectures remain purely statistically driven and agnostic to the underlying governing equations, often violating fundamental physical constraints during inference. Existing zero-shot approaches designed to enforce these constraints typically rely on rigid algebraic projections. While effective for sparse boundary conditions, applying such discrete geometric corrections to dense, full-domain PDEs may disrupt the probability path, \rev{potentially deviating from the learned manifold and introducing substantial computational overhead}. To address these challenges, we introduce Energy-Guided Transport, a novel training-free framework that formulates non-linear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy landscape. Rather than interrupting the ODE integration, our method applies a continuous dissipative force directly to the intermediate generative states, steering them toward the physical manifold. By evaluating this force implicitly via reverse-mode automatic differentiation, our framework preserves the natural dynamics of the flow while maintaining an efficient $\mathcal{O}(N)$ algorithmic complexity. We extensively evaluate our framework across various 1D and 2D physical systems, including the chaotic Navier-Stokes equations. Our method achieves stable generation without structural divergence, significantly improves the stability-accuracy trade-off compared to state-of-the-art methods, and substantially accelerates inference with respect to exact projection strategies. Code available at: https://github.com/ispamm/Projection-free-energy-guided-flow-matching.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的 Energy-Guided Transport 框架，将非线性物理约束转化为平滑势能景观，并在 Flow Matching 的生成过程中施加连续耗散力，使中间状态趋向物理流形，从而避免刚性投影带来的路径破坏与高开销。
AI.motivation: 标准深度生成模型尤其是 Flow Matching 虽能合成复杂物理系统，但纯数据驱动且不感知控制方程，推理时可能违反基本物理约束；现有零样本约束方法多依赖刚性代数投影，虽适用于稀疏边界条件，但对稠密全域 PDE 可能破坏概率路径、偏离已学流形并引入显著计算开销。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的 Energy-Guided Transport 框架，将非线性物理约束表述为平滑势能景观；不中断 ODE 积分，而是对中间生成状态施加连续耗散力以引导其趋向物理流形；该力通过反向模式自动微分隐式评估，在保持流自然动力学的同时维持 O(N) 算法复杂度。
AI.result: 在包括混沌 Navier-Stokes 方程在内的多种 1D 和 2D 物理系统上评估；方法实现无结构发散的稳定生成，相比最先进方法显著改善稳定性-精度权衡，并相对于精确投影策略大幅加速推理；代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: Energy-Guided Transport 通过连续能量引导而非离散刚性投影来施加物理约束，为 Flow Matching 生成物理系统提供了一种无需训练、保留流动力学且计算高效的投影-free 方案。

title: FlowReconBench: Accuracy, calibration and cost of learned and classical flow reconstruction from sparse sensors
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Supplementary material (16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables) is included as an ancillary file
summary: Reconstructing full flow fields from sparse sensors requires prior assumptions about unmeasured regions and physical variables. Yet it remains unclear when learned models outperform classical estimators and which aspects of their predictions can be trusted. FlowReconBench evaluates ten learned and five classical methods on three regimes: a laminar cylinder wake across Reynolds numbers, two-dimensional Kolmogorov turbulence and a large-scale three-dimensional (3D) isotropic turbulence. Methods share leakage-controlled splits and sensor draws and are scored on per-channel error, ensemble spread, calibration, spectra and cost. The leading method changes for each regime. Classical methods perform strongly in low-order and dense-sensing regimes. On the cylinder wake, linear stochastic estimation and gappy proper orthogonal decomposition lead, including for unobserved pressure. In 3D, inverse-distance weighting matches the best learned methods on observed channels. Data-driven methods become superior at decreasing sensor density or poor sensor observability. On Kolmogorov flow, continuous ranked probability score and error yield different method rankings: generative models offer broader but underdispersed ensembles, while deterministic models prioritize pointwise error. Generative models balance this tradeoff through their sampler budget, with a larger budget improving ensemble quality at higher computational cost. In 3D, scaling tests demonstrate that queryable methods are flat in memory, while full-grid construction methods run out of memory. Observing only 2 of 4 fields leaves the problem kinematically underconstrained, yet a latent model can reproduce structural similarities to the ground truth.

AI.tldr: FlowReconBench 在层流圆柱尾迹、二维 Kolmogorov 湍流和大规模三维各向同性湍流三类场景中，用统一的泄漏控制数据划分与传感器采样，对比 10 种学习方法和 5 种经典方法，并从逐通道误差、集合离散度、校准、频谱和成本评估稀疏传感器全流场重构；结果显示最佳方法随场景变化，经典方法在低阶或密集传感条件下很强，学习方法在传感器稀疏或可观测性差时更优。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏传感器重构完整流场需要对待测区域和物理变量作先验假设；目前尚不清楚学习模型何时优于经典估计器，也不清楚其预测的哪些方面可信，因此需要一个跨流态、控制数据泄漏并综合评估误差、不确定性校准、频谱与计算成本的基准。
AI.method: 提出 FlowReconBench，评估 10 种学习方法和 5 种经典方法，覆盖跨雷诺数的层流圆柱尾迹、二维 Kolmogorov 湍流和三维各向同性湍流；各方法共享泄漏控制的数据划分与传感器采样，并按逐通道误差、集合离散度、校准、频谱和成本评分。摘要还提到三维内存 scaling 测试，以及仅观测 4 个场中的 2 个场时动力学欠约束的设置。
AI.result: 领先方法因场景而异。经典方法在低阶和密集传感场景表现强：圆柱尾迹中线性随机估计和 gappy proper orthogonal decomposition 领先，包括未观测压力；三维中反距离加权在已观测通道上匹配最佳学习方法。传感器密度降低或可观测性差时数据驱动方法更优。Kolmogorov 流中连续排名概率分数与误差给出不同排名：生成模型集合更宽但欠离散，确定性模型侧重逐点误差；生成模型可通过采样预算平衡该权衡，更大预算提升集合质量但增加成本。三维 scaling 测试中可查询方法内存占用平坦，全网格构建方法会内存耗尽；仅观测 2/4 个场时问题运动学欠约束，但潜变量模型能再现与真值的结构相似性。
AI.conclusion: 没有单一方法在所有场景占优；方法选择应依据流态、传感器密度与可观测性、评价指标及计算成本。经典估计器仍是低阶和密集传感场景的强基线，学习方法在稀疏或差可观测条件下更具优势。评估不能只看逐点误差，还需考虑集合校准与频谱等性质；生成模型可用更高采样预算换取更好集合质量。摘要未提供具体数值结果或普适理论保证。

title: SensOFormer: Foundation Models for Particle Accelerators
summary: Large-scale scientific facilities, such as particle accelerators, are complex systems composed of thousands of interacting components that must operate collectively to support diagnostics and control, and ensure safe, reliable operation. These facilities rely on extensive sensor networks that generate large volumes of heterogeneous, incomplete, and noisy telemetry, often sampled at different rates across subsystems. In this paper, we adopt the foundation-model paradigm to learn general-purpose sensor representations from historical accelerator data through self-supervised pretraining. We introduce SensOFormer, a denoising masked transformer with a Perceiver-style encoder-decoder architecture designed to handle variable sensor sets, accommodate heterogeneous sampling rates, and learn robust representations from noisy measurements. The model is pretrained on multiple particle-accelerator datasets and transferred to downstream tasks, including missing-data imputation, anomaly detection, cavity identification, and fault identification. Through extensive evaluations and comparisons, we demonstrate that a single self-supervised model can learn reusable representations for diverse operational tasks in large-scale scientific facilities. Project page: https://mahindrautela.github.io/sensoformer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SensOFormer，一种基于 Perceiver 式编码器-解码器的去噪掩码 Transformer，通过自监督预训练从历史加速器传感器数据中学习通用表示，并迁移到缺失数据填补、异常检测、腔体识别和故障识别等任务，验证了单一自监督模型的可复用性。
AI.motivation: 大型科学设施由成千上万个相互作用的组件构成，依赖广泛传感器网络运行；其遥测数据规模大、异构、不完整、含噪且各子系统采样率不同，因此需要学习可复用的通用传感器表示以支持多种运维任务。
AI.method: 采用基础模型范式，对多个粒子加速器数据集进行自监督预训练；提出 SensOFormer，使用 Perceiver 式编码器-解码器架构的去噪掩码 Transformer，以处理可变传感器集合、异构采样率和噪声测量；随后将模型迁移至缺失数据填补、异常检测、腔体识别和故障识别等下游任务。
AI.result: 通过广泛评估与比较，研究表明单一自监督模型能够学习可复用表示并支持大型科学设施中的多种运维任务；摘要未提供具体定量指标或各任务性能数值。
AI.conclusion: 自监督基础模型方法可用于从复杂加速器遥测中学习通用传感器表示，并以一个模型支持多类下游任务；但摘要未给出模型局限、部署成本及详细实验结论。

title: Collectively pumped superradiant laser with coherence scaling beyond the standard quantum limit
comment: 36 pages, 16 figures. Submitted to Physical Review X
summary: For more than half a century, the standard quantum limit (SQL) was thought to limit the laser coherence $\mathfrak{C}$ -- the number of photons emitted from the laser into the beam in one coherence time -- to a scaling $Θ(μ^2)$, where $μ$ is the mean number of optical-frequency excitations stored inside the laser. However, recently it has been shown [Baker et al., Nat. Phys. 17, 179 (2021)] that the Heisenberg limit -- an achievable ultimate limit set by quantum mechanics for the task of producing a beam with the standard properties of a laser beam -- is $\mathfrak{C}=Θ(μ^4)$, a quadratic enhancement. So far, proposals to demonstrate beyond-SQL scaling of $\mathfrak{C}$ have been limited to circuit QED, at microwave frequencies (i.e., a maser). Here, we introduce a class of generalized far-above-threshold (FAT) laser models, obtained by replacing the ordinary bosonic lowering operator $\hat{a}$ by a general lowering operator $\hat{L}$ in the superoperators appearing in the master equation that governs the FAT laser dynamics. We then show that an optical-frequency superradiant laser in the bad-cavity limit, with feedback-controlled collective pumping, realizes one such model, in which $\hat{L}$ is identified with the collective superradiant lowering operator $\hat{J}$. This model can surpass the SQL scaling, with the coherence exhibiting a scaling as large as $\mathfrak{C}= Θ(μ^{8/3})$ in the optimal parameter regime. Here, in the bad-cavity limit, $μ\approx N/2$, where $N$ is the number of superradiant atoms.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一类广义远高于阈值（FAT）激光模型，通过将主方程超算符中的常规玻色降算符替换为一般降算符，证明在坏腔极限下采用反馈控制集体泵浦的光频超辐射激光可实现超越标准量子极限（SQL）的相干性标度，最高达 ℭ=Θ(μ^{8/3})。
AI.motivation: 长期以来SQL被认为将激光相干性ℭ限制为Θ(μ^2)，而Heisenberg极限可给出Θ(μ^4)的二次增强；但此前超越SQL的演示方案仅限于微波频段的电路QED（maser），因此需要探索光频段实现超越SQL相干性标度的方案。
AI.method: 作者引入广义FAT激光模型：在描述FAT激光动力学的主方程超算符中，用一般降算符L̂替代普通玻色降算符â；并证明在坏腔极限下，具有反馈控制集体泵浦的光频超辐射激光可实现其中一个模型，其中L̂对应集体超辐射降算符Ĵ。
AI.result: 该光频超辐射激光模型能够超越SQL标度，在最优参数区间相干性可达ℭ=Θ(μ^{8/3})；在坏腔极限下μ≈N/2，N为超辐射原子数。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明光频超辐射激光可在坏腔极限和反馈控制集体泵浦条件下实现超越SQL的相干性标度，最高为Θ(μ^{8/3})，但摘要未表明其达到Heisenberg极限Θ(μ^4)，也未提供具体实验参数或实现细节。

title: A coupled lattice Boltzmann model for pore-scale mushy-layer dynamics with application to sea ice
summary: A pore-scale lattice Boltzmann model is developed for reactive transport in phase-changing porous media, coupling solute transport in the liquid with conjugate heat transfer across the solid and liquid phases. Two methodological developments are introduced: a novel link-based Volume-of-Pixel formulation for direction-dependent interface motion, and a generalized Robin boundary treatment for solute redistribution at moving interfaces. The phase-change formulation is validated against thermal benchmarks, while the Robin treatment is assessed through literature test cases, exhibiting convergence rates between first and second order. The coupled model is then applied to a local pore-scale segment of a sea ice brine channel in a purely diffusive regime. The simulations recover the expected ideal mushy-layer behaviour under appropriate scale separation. At sea-ice-relevant concentration ratios, thermal perturbations produce relatively large variations in brine salinity, causing freezing rather than melting to reshape the pore geometry in a non-uniform way. The resulting framework provides a pore-scale numerical tool for resolving coupled temperature, solute redistribution, and phase-boundary dynamics in mushy layers.

AI.tldr: 本文建立孔隙尺度格子Boltzmann模型，耦合液相溶质输运与固液共轭传热，提出基于link的Volume-of-Pixel界面运动格式和广义Robin边界处理，经热学基准与文献算例验证后，用于模拟海冰卤水通道局部孔隙段，揭示热扰动下卤水盐度变化及非均匀冻结导致的孔隙重塑。
AI.motivation: 摘要未单独给出研究背景式动机；其明确需求是构建能够解析糊状层中温度、溶质再分配与相界动力学耦合的孔隙尺度数值工具，并应用于海冰卤水通道。
AI.method: 开发孔隙尺度格子Boltzmann模型，将液相中的溶质输运与固液两相的共轭传热耦合；提出基于link的Volume-of-Pixel公式以描述方向相关的界面运动，并提出广义Robin边界处理以刻画运动界面处的溶质再分配。相变公式用热学基准验证，Robin处理用文献算例评估；随后将耦合模型应用于纯扩散 regime 下海冰卤水通道的局部孔隙尺度片段。
AI.result: 相变公式通过热学基准验证；Robin处理在文献算例中表现出介于一阶与二阶之间的收敛率。耦合模拟在适当尺度分离下重现预期的理想糊状层行为；在海冰相关浓度比下，热扰动引起卤水盐度较大变化，冻结而非融化以非均匀方式重塑孔隙几何。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为糊状层中耦合温度、溶质再分配和相界动力学提供了孔隙尺度数值工具；摘要未提供定量实验验证或更大尺度外推结论。

title: Odd Capillarity
summary: Capillarity governs interfacial relaxation and hydrodynamic motion in binary fluids through parity-even mechanical stresses. Here, we introduce \emph{odd capillarity}, a parity-breaking interfacial mechanical response, by incorporating a symmetric, nonvariational, parity-odd capillary stress into the Cahn--Hilliard--Navier--Stokes (CHNS) equations. This stress generates forces along interfaces, transverse to ordinary capillary forces, and performs mechanical work that is not balanced by changes in the composition free energy. Direct numerical simulations reveal that odd capillarity arrests domain coarsening while sustaining turbulent fluid motion without a conventional inertial energy cascade, as energy injection is predominantly balanced by viscous dissipation. In asymmetric mixtures, odd capillarity driven deformation and breakup interrupt droplet growth, producing dynamically arrested emulsions with composition hyperuniformity and suppressed large-scale vorticity fluctuations. These findings establish odd capillarity as a distinct interfacial mechanism for controlling phase separation and sustaining nonequilibrium fluid motion.

AI.tldr: 该文在 Cahn--Hilliard--Navier--Stokes 方程中引入对称、非变分、宇称奇的毛细应力，提出“奇毛细性”，并用直接数值模拟研究其对相分离、畴粗化及流体湍动的影响。
AI.motivation: 常规毛细作用通过宇称偶的力学应力支配二元流体中的界面松弛与流体动力学运动；作者希望引入宇称破缺的界面力学响应，即奇毛细性，以探究其对相分离和非平衡流体运动的作用。摘要未提供更广泛的应用动机。
AI.method: 将对称、非变分、宇称奇的毛细应力项加入 Cahn--Hilliard--Navier--Stokes（CHNS）方程，使界面产生横向于常规毛细力的力，并做不由组分自由能变化平衡的机械功；随后采用直接数值模拟进行研究。
AI.result: 直接数值模拟显示，奇毛细性会阻止畴粗化，同时在无常规惯性能量级联的情况下维持湍流运动，能量注入主要由黏性耗散平衡；在非对称混合物中，奇毛细性驱动的变形与破裂会打断液滴生长，形成动力学受阻乳液，并伴随组分超均匀性和大尺度涡量涨落受抑制。
AI.conclusion: 奇毛细性是一种独特的界面机制，可用于控制相分离并维持非平衡流体运动。

title: LH$μ$C Concept: Energy-Frontier Antimuon-Proton Collisions at CERN
comment: To be published in Acta Phys.Pol.B - contribution to the proceedings of Workshop on "Ultra-cold Muons for the LHC", Sep 24-26, 2026, at AGH University of Kraków - 10 pages, 5 figure and 2 table
summary: The concept of the LH$μ$C, an energy-frontier antimuon-proton collider based on the HL-LHC, is presented. After recalling why energy-frontier lepton-hadron colliders are indispensable as QCD explorers and reviewing the history of muon-proton collider proposals, two ways of realising $μp$ collisions at the LHC are compared: with muon-collider beams and with ultra-cold $μ^+$ beams as proposed for $μ$TRISTAN. For the latter, a $μ$TRISTAN-type booster and the re-use of the LHeC energy-recovery-linac tunnel are discussed; colliding 1 TeV antimuons with 7 TeV protons gives $\sqrt{s}=5.3$ TeV and peak luminosities of $8.8\times10^{33}$ and $7.2\times10^{33}$ cm$^{-2}$s$^{-1}$, respectively. The detector concept and the physics potential, including searches for colour-octet muons and R-parity-violating squarks, are discussed together with the main challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于HL-LHC的能源前沿反μ子-质子对撞机LHμC概念，比较利用μ子对撞机束流与μTRISTAN型超冷μ+束流两种实现μp对撞的路径，并讨论探测器、物理潜力及主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 能源前沿的轻子-强子对撞机被视为不可或缺的QCD探索工具；文中回顾μ子-质子对撞机提案历史，并推动在LHC上实现μp对撞。
AI.method: 提出LHμC概念，并比较在LHC实现μp对撞的两种方式：使用μ子对撞机束流，以及使用为μTRISTAN提出的超冷μ+束流。针对后者，讨论μTRISTAN型助推器和复用LHeC能量回收直线加速器隧道；设定用1 TeV反μ子与7 TeV质子对撞。
AI.result: 1 TeV反μ子与7 TeV质子对撞给出质心能量√s=5.3 TeV，两个方案对应的峰值亮度分别为8.8×10^33和7.2×10^33 cm^-2s^-1；文中还讨论探测器概念、物理潜力（包括色八重态μ子和R宇称破坏超对称夸克搜索）及主要挑战。
AI.conclusion: 摘要给出了LHμC的概念设计、两种实现路径、亮度参数和物理潜力，并指出仍存在主要挑战；未提供更明确的最终结论。

title: Search for the 229Pa Parity Doublet via Internal-Conversion Spectroscopy at FRIB
summary: The radioisotope $^{229}$Pa is predicted to possess a nearly degenerate ground-state parity doublet. Previous $γ$-ray and conversion-electron spectroscopy suggests a splitting of $ΔE = (60\pm 50)~\mathrm{eV}$, although the doublet's existence remains unconfirmed. Such a small splitting would give $^{229}$Pa an exceptionally large enhancement of symmetry-violating nuclear properties. However, the splitting, and with it the sensitivity of $^{229}$Pa to CP-violating physics, remains uncertain by orders of magnitude. We propose an experiment to measure this splitting with sub-eV precision within a few days of measurement time by using delayed-coincidence internal-conversion spectroscopy of $^{229}$Pa ions produced by the electron-capture decay of $^{229}$U$^{+}$ ions stored in a Penning trap at the Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB). This measurement would provide the key nuclear-structure input needed to establish $^{229}$Pa as a leading candidate for next-generation atomic and molecular electric-dipole-moment (EDM) experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用FRIB彭宁阱中储存的²²⁹U⁺离子经电子俘获衰变产生²²⁹Pa离子，并通过延迟符合内转换谱学，在数天测量时间内以亚电子伏特精度测定²²⁹Pa基态宇称双峰能级劈裂，从而为将其发展为下一代原子/分子电偶极矩实验候选体系提供关键核结构输入。
AI.motivation: ²²⁹Pa被预测具有近简并的基态宇称双峰；此前γ射线和转换电子谱学暗示劈裂为ΔE=(60±50) eV，但双峰是否存在尚未确认。若劈裂确实如此小，将极大增强对称性破缺核性质；然而该劈裂及²²⁹Pa对CP破坏物理的灵敏度仍存在数量级不确定性，因此需要精确测量。
AI.method: 提出在稀有同位素束流装置（FRIB）的彭宁阱中储存²²⁹U⁺离子，利用其电子俘获衰变产生²²⁹Pa离子，并对这些离子开展延迟符合内转换电子谱学测量，以确定基态宇称双峰的能级劈裂。
AI.result: 摘要报告的是实验提案而非已完成的测量结果：预计可在数天测量时间内达到亚电子伏特精度；摘要未给出实际测量数据或已实现的精度。
AI.conclusion: 该测量将提供建立²²⁹Pa作为下一代原子和分子电偶极矩（EDM）实验领先候选体系所需的关键核结构输入。

title: Controls on the deformation and reorientation of mafic enclaves during magma mingling: A computational study
summary: Mafic microgranular enclaves in granitic plutons record magma mingling, and their shapes are often interpreted as a record of the flow that deformed them. We investigate how a dense, low-viscosity droplet deforms in a lighter, much more viscous host under shear and gravity, using 96 two-dimensional Level-Set simulations. The viscosity ratio ($μ_r$) spans $10^{-6}$ - $10^{-3}$, the capillary number ($\mathrm{Ca}$) ranges from $10^{6}$ to $8\times10^{9}$, the Bond number ($\mathrm{Bo}$) takes values of $3.5\times10^{6}$ and $9.8\times10^{6}$, and the Reynolds number ($\mathrm{Re}$) remains below $10^{-2}$, with a fixed density contrast ($Δρ$) of $400~\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$. Two broad regimes identified- sinking and non-sinking which spread over six outcomes like sinking, edge, mid and multiple break-up, rotation, and retraction. The ratio $\mathrm{Ca/Bo}$ separates sinking from shear-dominated behaviour near unity, although the transition spans a range of $\mathrm{Ca/Bo}$ values that shifts with confinement. In the shear-dominated regime, a lower viscosity ratio promotes stretching. Multiple pinch-off occurs mainly at viscosity ratios of $10^{-6}$ - $10^{-5}$, rotation occurs only at the higher vertical confinement, and retraction occurs only at the lower vertical confinement. The strain at maximum stretch averages 1.1 - 1.4 and increases with $\mathrm{Ca/Bo}$, with a stronger increase at higher confinement. The orientation of the major axis decreases by approximately $10^\circ$ per unit strain and is lowest for rotating droplets. Because the capillary number exceeds conventional critical values for breakup for droplets, breakup is interpreted in terms of accumulated deformation rather than capillary stability alone. Enclave shape therefore reflects the flow regime and is not a direct measure of finite strain.

AI.tldr: 通过96组二维Level-Set模拟研究高密度、低黏度液滴在较轻、高黏度宿主中受剪切与重力作用的变形，识别出下沉与非下沉两大体制及六类结果，并指出镁铁质微粒包体形状主要反映流动体制，不能直接作为有限应变的量度。
AI.motivation: 花岗质岩体中的镁铁质微粒包体记录岩浆混合，其形状常被用来解释使包体变形的流动；本文旨在检验致密低黏度液滴在剪切和重力下的变形行为，从而厘清包体形状与流动体制及应变之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用96组二维Level-Set数值模拟，研究致密低黏度液滴在较轻且黏度更高的宿主中的剪切-重力变形；粘度比为10^-6–10^-3，毛细数为10^6–8×10^9，邦德数为3.5×10^6和9.8×10^6，雷诺数低于10^-2，密度差固定为400 kg m^-3，并分析下沉/非下沉体制、六类结果、最大拉伸应变和主轴方向。
AI.result: 识别出下沉与非下沉两大体制，涵盖下沉、边缘、中部与多次断裂、旋转和回缩六类结果；Ca/Bo约等于1可区分下沉与剪切主导，但转变区间随约束变化。剪切主导下较低粘度比促进拉伸；多次夹断主要发生在粘度比10^-6–10^-5，旋转仅见于较高垂向约束，回缩仅见于较低垂向约束。最大拉伸时平均应变为1.1–1.4，随Ca/Bo增大而增加且高约束下增幅更强；主轴方向每单位应变约减小10°，旋转液滴最低。由于毛细数超过常规临界值，断裂被解释为累积变形而非仅由毛细稳定性控制。
AI.conclusion: 包体形状反映流动体制，并不是有限应变的直接量度；液滴断裂应结合累积变形理解，而不能仅依据毛细稳定性判据。

title: Experimental evaluation of Kolmogorov's first similarity hypothesis for shear-dependent viscosity fluids
summary: We experimentally investigate the applicability of Kolmogorov's first similarity hypothesis to shear-dependent viscosity fluids. We assess whether dissipative range statistics exhibit a self-similar behavior in nearly homogeneous and isotropic turbulence, using stereo particle image velocimetry in aqueous Carbopol solutions across two concentrations and a range of forcing conditions. We observe that, when normalized by the mean viscosity and mean dissipation rate, second- and third-order structure functions collapse across the different experimental conditions and exhibit functional forms compatible with classical Newtonian results. These observations are in general agreement with the recent numerical results of Rosti [J. Fluid Mech. 1012, R5 (2025)], who proposed that Kolmogorov's similarity hypotheses can be extended to shear-thinning fluids by considering dissipation scales based on the mean viscosity, the mean dissipation rate, and the flow index.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验检验Kolmogorov第一相似假设对剪切依赖黏性流体的适用性，发现耗散区二阶和三阶结构函数在按平均黏度与平均耗散率归一化后可跨实验条件塌缩，并与经典牛顿流体结果相容。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在检验Kolmogorov第一相似假设能否推广到剪切依赖黏性流体，并评估近均匀各向同性湍流中耗散区统计是否表现自相似行为。
AI.method: 采用立体粒子图像测速（stereo PIV）测量两种浓度的Carbopol水溶液，在多种强迫条件下研究近均匀各向同性湍流；将二阶和三阶结构函数按平均黏度和平均耗散率归一化，分析其跨条件塌缩及函数形式，并与Rosti（2025）的数值结果进行比较。
AI.result: 归一化后的二阶和三阶结构函数在不同实验条件之间塌缩，其函数形式与经典牛顿流体结果相容；这些观察总体上与Rosti（2025）的数值结果一致，即通过采用基于平均黏度、平均耗散率和流动指数的耗散尺度，可将Kolmogorov相似假设扩展到剪切变稀流体。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持在适当归一化下将Kolmogorov相似假设应用于剪切依赖黏性流体；摘要未提供定量参数、误差或更详细的标度指数信息。

title: 3D Printed Monolithic Optomechanical Chassis for an Unbalanced Field-Widened Interferometer
summary: Additive manufacturing is increasingly being explored as an approach for producing complex structures for optical hardware. In this work, we present a fully monolithic optomechanical chassis fabricated using laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing. The structure was fabricated from thermally stable Invar36, a low-thermal-expansion alloy that enables high dimensional stability under varying environmental conditions. Our monolithic design incorporates embedded optical mounts, flexures, and alignment features directly into the chassis geometry that exceed the practical limits of conventional subtractive manufacturing. By integrating the optomechanical support structure into a single compact unit, the system achieves a reduced footprint compared to traditional optomechanical assemblies. The results demonstrate the potential of additive manufacturing to produce lightweight, and highly customized optical systems, opening the possibility of new pathways for next-generation quantum sensors and optical instrumentation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用激光粉末床熔融增材制造技术，以低热膨胀合金Invar36制备了一体化光机底盘，将光学安装座、柔性结构和对准特征直接集成到几何结构中，实现了相比传统光机组件更小的占位面积，并展示了增材制造用于轻量化和高度定制化光学系统的潜力。
AI.motivation: 增材制造正日益被视为制造复杂光学硬件结构的一种途径；研究旨在构建具有高尺寸稳定性、紧凑占位面积和高度定制化能力的一体化光机支撑结构。
AI.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融增材制造技术，使用热稳定的Invar36低热膨胀合金，制备完全一体化的光机底盘；该设计将嵌入式光学安装座、柔性结构和对准特征直接集成到底盘几何中，其结构超出传统减材制造的实用限制。
AI.result: 成功制备了一体化光机底盘，并将光机支撑结构集成为单一紧凑单元，使系统相比传统光机组件具有更小的占位面积；摘要未提供定量光学性能、稳定性或重量数据。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明增材制造有潜力用于生产轻量化和高度定制化的光学系统，并为下一代量子传感器和光学仪器开辟新的实现路径。

title: Ultracold polar molecules for quantum science and technology
comment: Tutorial review article. Author's original manuscript that has since been through peer review and published in Contemporary Physics. 26 pages, 20 figures
summary: Ultracold polar molecules present a rich platform for experimental quantum science leveraging their unique properties. Of particular relevance is the intrinsic electric dipole moment of the molecule, which results in strong coupling to microwave fields and can be used to engineer long-range, anisotropic, and tunable dipole-dipole interactions. Such interactions can generate entanglement between molecules and enable the study of novel quantum many-body phenomena in parameter regimes inaccessible in other systems. Modern experiments in optical tweezers and optical lattices have demonstrated controlled interactions between molecules in coherent quantum states, and recently bulk gases of molecules have been cooled to quantum degeneracy. Motivated by these landmark advances, we present this article to explain many of the key concepts relevant to current research in the field.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇综述性文章，旨在基于超冷极性分子研究的最新进展，解释当前该领域研究中的关键概念；摘要未提供具体实验数据或新结果。
AI.motivation: 超冷极性分子具有固有电偶极矩，可强耦合微波场并产生长程、各向异性、可调的偶极-偶极相互作用，从而用于产生分子间纠缠和研究其他系统难以达到的量子多体现象；光镊和光晶格实验已实现相干态分子的受控相互作用， bulk 分子气体也已达量子简并，这些进展推动了本文的写作。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性综述与原理讲解的方式，围绕超冷极性分子的偶极相互作用、微波耦合、纠缠和量子多体研究等关键概念进行阐述；摘要未说明具体的实验方法、理论模型或数据分析方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告新的实验结果或定量发现；所述结果是领域背景性进展，包括光镊和光晶格中相干量子态分子的受控相互作用，以及 bulk 分子气体冷却至量子简并。
AI.conclusion: 超冷极性分子为实验量子科学提供了独特而丰富的平台；本文作为一篇概念性文章，旨在帮助读者理解该领域当前研究的关键概念，摘要未给出更具体的结论或未来展望。

title: Remap for ALE Hydrodynamics via Direct Interpolation and Constraint Optimization
summary: This work presents an optimization-based remap approach for arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE) hydrodynamics that preserves sharp features and physical bounds while conserving global quantities such as volume, mass, momentum, and total energy. Achieving these properties is the main challenge in remap methods. The presented approach is well-suited for high-order finite element (FE) discretizations and ALE methods that allow for large, purely Lagrangian displacements between successive remeshing and remapping steps. Recent advances in parallel, GPU-capable interpolation routines enable the initial transfer of all fields via direct physical-space interpolation, avoiding computationally costly and diffusive pseudo-transient PDE-based advection. The interpolation produces bounded fields with minimal numerical diffusion. However, it may violate the desired conservation of global properties. Thus, a subsequent optimization step restores conservation while preserving physical bounds. The presented method provides minimally diffusive remapping of finite element fields of arbitrary order. Moreover, it directly remaps quantities defined at integration points, eliminating the need for projection onto finite element spaces. The approach also mitigates typical challenges associated with synchronizing primal variables and conserved quantities in advection-based remap methods. The proposed optimization-based remap method is evaluated using standard two- and three-dimensional remap benchmarks and full ALE hydrodynamics simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于任意拉格朗日-欧拉（ALE）流体动力学的基于优化的重映射方法：先通过物理空间直接插值实现低扩散、保界的高阶有限元场传输，再用优化步骤恢复全局守恒，并在二维/三维基准和完整ALE模拟中评估。
AI.motivation: 重映射方法的主要挑战是在保持尖锐特征和物理界的同时，守恒体积、质量、动量和总能量等全局量；现有基于伪瞬态PDE的对流重映射计算昂贵且扩散较强，并存在原始变量与守恒量同步等问题。
AI.method: 面向高阶有限元离散及允许大纯拉格朗日位移的ALE流程，利用并行、GPU可用的插值例程对所有场进行物理空间直接插值，避免伪瞬态PDE对流；随后通过优化步骤在保持物理界的同时恢复全局守恒。方法可直接重映射定义在积分点上的量，无需投影到有限元空间，并可重映射任意阶有限元场。
AI.result: 摘要称插值产生的场有界且数值扩散最小，但可能破坏全局守恒，优化步骤可恢复守恒并保持物理界；方法在标准二维和三维重映射基准及完整ALE流体动力学模拟中进行了评估。摘要未给出定量误差、收敛阶或性能数据。
AI.conclusion: 该基于优化的重映射方法能够实现高阶有限元场的低扩散重映射，在保持尖锐特征和物理界的同时恢复全局守恒，并缓解对流型重映射中原始变量与守恒量同步的典型困难；其有效性通过标准基准和完整ALE模拟得到评估。

title: Interscale energy transfer in a propeller-driven homogeneous and isotropic turbulence generation device
summary: We investigate the interscale energy dynamics of nearly homogeneous isotropic turbulence (HIT) generated in a spherically forced, propeller-driven device. From a spatial perspective, by employing the Kármán-Howarth-Monin (KHM) framework, we analyze the scale-by-scale energy transfer without isotropy assumptions. In contrast to other forcing strategies, where regions with inverse and forward cascades often coexist in scale space, we show that spherical forcing produces a purely forward energy cascade across the entire scale space. While the energy distribution remains highly isotropic and orientation-averaged structure functions align with Kolmogorov's two-thirds law, the energy flux exhibits a directional dependence, suggesting a higher sensitivity to residual forcing asymmetries. Regarding the temporal dynamics, the reduced mean flow generated by this device allows us to investigate the temporal variability in conditions where Taylor's frozen turbulence hypothesis does not apply. Our results provide experimental validation of Tennekes' Eulerian frequency spectrum, where intermediate scales evidence an inertial-convective range with statistics determined by the integral velocity scale and the dissipation rate. Finally, we adopt a global approach to investigate whether the main turbulent scales can be linked to external experimental parameters. We propose a framework that captures the propeller frequency dependence of the main turbulent variables obtained in our measurements and those of previously reported HIT chambers. These findings contribute to the understanding of how external forcing influences the complex interscale energy dynamics of turbulent flows from a spatial, temporal, and global perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究球面强迫、螺旋桨驱动的近均匀各向同性湍流的跨尺度能量动力学：采用KHM框架从空间上分析逐尺度能量传输，从时间上检验Tennekes欧拉频率谱，并提出联系主要湍流变量与实验外部参数的全局框架。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解外部强迫如何影响湍流的复杂跨尺度能量动力学，特别是不同强迫策略下正、逆级串共存的问题，以及球面强迫下的空间能流特征；同时研究Taylor冻结湍流假设不适用时的时间统计，并建立主要湍流尺度与实验参数之间的联系。
AI.method: 在球面强迫、螺旋桨驱动的近均匀各向同性湍流装置中开展测量；采用Kármán-Howarth-Monin（KHM）框架，在不假设各向同性的情况下进行逐尺度能量传输分析；分析能流的方向依赖性；针对时间动力学分析欧拉频率谱并检验Tennekes谱；采用全局方法建立主要湍流变量与螺旋桨频率及已有HIT腔体数据的关联框架。
AI.result: 球面强迫在整个尺度空间产生纯正向能量级串；能量分布保持高度各向同性，方向平均结构函数符合Kolmogorov二分之三定律；但能量通量表现出方向依赖性，说明其对残余强迫不对称更敏感。装置产生的平均流较弱，使Taylor冻结假设不适用的条件下仍可研究时间变异性；实验结果验证了Tennekes欧拉频率谱，中间尺度出现惯性-对流区，其统计由积分速度尺度和耗散率决定。所提出的全局框架能够刻画主要湍流变量对螺旋桨频率的依赖，并适用于此前报道的HIT腔体测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 外部强迫方式深刻影响湍流的跨尺度能量动力学；球面强迫可实现纯正向级串，且方向性能流比能量分布对残余不对称更敏感；时间统计可由Tennekes谱描述；全局框架将主要湍流尺度与实验强迫参数联系起来。摘要未提供具体实验参数范围、定量误差及框架的详细数学形式。

title: Photonic and Electronic Interaction of TMD-Hybridized ZnO Nanowire Lasers
summary: Semiconductor nanowire lasers are promising on-chip coherent light sources for photonic integrated circuits, but integration inevitably places them in contact with other materials, thereby changing their properties upon hybridization. In this study, we examine the photonic and electronic coupling between single ZnO nanowire lasers and TMDs. Using deterministic nanomanipulation, we first hybridized the same nanowire first with a WS$_2$ monolayer and then with a MoS$_2$ monolayer. The respective lasing threshold rises, the emission is strongly quenched at high pump power densities, and the mode envelope blueshifts. Upon hybridization with bilayer, trilayer, and bulk MoS$_2$, lasing is fully suppressed. Finite-Difference Eigenmode simulations show that the TMD absorbs part of the evanescent field. Because this absorption is wavelength dependent, it also removes modes from the low-energy flank of the envelope, which accounts for small difference between the two monolayers, while the blueshift itself follows the increase of the carrier density at threshold. Density functional theory calculations that include the interface dipole predict a type-I alignment at the ideal ZnO(10$\bar{1}$0)/TMD interface, which turns into type~II for a moderately reduced dipole, as expected for hydroxylated facets in air. In both cases, holes are transferred from the nanowire into the TMD and removed from the gain medium. Evanescent absorption and hole transfer thus jointly suppress lasing, and both must be accounted for when integrating nanowire lasers with 2D materials.

AI.tldr: 该文研究单根ZnO纳米线激光器与TMD材料杂化后的光子与电子耦合：单层WS2/MoS2使阈值升高、高泵浦下发射强烈淬灭并出现模式包络蓝移，双层及以上MoS2完全抑制激光；倏逝场吸收与空穴转移共同导致抑制。
AI.motivation: 半导体纳米线激光器是光子集成电路中有前景的片上相干光源，但集成时不可避免与其他材料接触并发生杂化，从而改变其性质，因此需要理解纳米线激光器与TMD之间的光子和电子耦合。
AI.method: 采用确定性纳米操纵，将同一根ZnO纳米线先与WS2单层、再与MoS2单层杂化，并进一步与双层、三层和体相MoS2杂化；测量激光行为，使用有限差分本征模模拟分析倏逝场吸收，并用包含界面偶极的密度泛函理论计算ZnO(10\bar{1}0)/TMD界面能带对齐。
AI.result: 与单层TMD杂化后，激光阈值升高，高泵浦功率密度下发射强烈淬灭，模式包络蓝移；两种单层间差异较小，归因于波长依赖的倏逝场吸收移除包络低能侧模式，而蓝移跟随阈值处载流子密度增加。与双层、三层和体相MoS2杂化后激光完全被抑制。模拟显示TMD吸收部分倏逝场；DFT预测理想界面为type-I对齐，界面偶极适度降低时转为type-II，符合空气中羟基化晶面的情形；两种情况下空穴均从纳米线转移到TMD并从增益介质中移除。摘要未给出具体阈值、淬灭比例等定量数值。
AI.conclusion: 倏逝场吸收和空穴转移共同抑制纳米线激光，因此在将纳米线激光器与二维材料集成时必须同时考虑这两种机制。

title: Wavefront engineering with atomic Huygens' surfaces made simple
summary: Atomic arrays provide a cooperative platform for light-mediated interactions in nonlocal metasurfaces which can operate in the quantum regime without nanofabricated optical elements or intrinsic material absorption. We present a minimal atomic implementation to harness wavefront engineering and create a near-ideal intrinsic atomic Huygens' surface. A simple bilayer square lattice with a two-atom unit cell, not limited to small lattice spacings, provides near-unity reflectionless transmission and a full $2π$ phase control of transmitted light without the localized site-dependent level shifts of previous proposals. This simplification is achieved through nonlocal radiative excitations that provide the familiar electric-dipole response with even radiation parity as well as an odd-parity radiation channel whose leading multipolar interpretation combines magnetic-dipole and electric-quadrupole contributions in atoms exhibiting only electric dipole transitions. This eliminates the need to simultaneously excite pure electric-dipole and magnetic-dipole responses with exactly matched radiation. We derive a two-mode model for this response and show that it accurately captures full coupled-dipole simulations near the optimal lattice spacings. Because of the wide applicability of coupled-dipole models, the relevance of our microscopic analysis extends beyond atomic physics to nanostructured metasurfaces. Moreover, the same platform also connects directly to established subradiance-protected single-photon storage protocols, suggesting a route toward combining wavefront engineering, storage, and retrieval in a simple atomic bilayer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种极简原子双层方案，利用非局域辐射激发构建近理想的本征原子Huygens超表面，实现无反射近单位透射和透射光全2π相位调控，并用两模模型解释耦合偶极模拟。
AI.motivation: 原子阵列可在量子区间提供光介导的非局域相互作用，且无需纳米加工光学元件或本征材料吸收；已有方案存在局域位点相关的能级移动，或需同时激发并精确匹配纯电偶极与磁偶极响应，因此需要更简单的波前工程实现。
AI.method: 采用仅含两个原子单胞的双层方晶格，不限制于小晶格间距；通过非局域辐射激发获得具有偶辐射宇称的常规电偶极响应，以及一个奇宇称辐射通道，其主导多极解释在原子上仅具电偶极跃迁时结合磁偶极与电四极贡献；推导两模模型，并与完整耦合偶极模拟比较。
AI.result: 该结构给出近单位且无反射的透射和透射光完整2π相位控制，并避免先前方案中的局域位点相关能级移动；两模模型在最优晶格间距附近能准确复现完整耦合偶极模拟。摘要未提供实验验证或具体效率、带宽等定量数据。
AI.conclusion: 该双层原子平台可简化本征原子Huygens超表面的实现，并因耦合偶极模型的广泛适用性而可启发纳米结构超表面；其还与亚辐射保护的单光子存储协议直接衔接，提示在简单原子双层中集成波前工程、存储与读取的途径。

title: ConvexAD: differentiable phase retrieval with geometric regularization for high-strain, low-signal Bragg coherent diffraction imaging
summary: Bragg Coherent Diffraction Imaging (BCDI) relies on phase retrieval (PR), a non-convex, ill-posed inverse problem whose conditioning is degraded by factors like noise, partial coherence, and strain or crystallographic defects in the imaged nanocrystal. Conventional approaches, including alternating projections and deep learning methods, represent the object on a dense voxel grid, which is prone to amplitude-phase mixing and becomes increasingly ill-posed under these factors, often preventing reliable three-dimensional mapping of the particle's shape and strain. Here we present ConvexAD, a gradient descent PR model that parametrizes the object shape as a convex polyhedron, built by the intersection of half-spaces and enforces flat amplitude within it by construction. This geometric regularization eliminates amplitude-phase mixing and reduces the number of trainable parameters, hence facilitating the convergence of the PR. Implemented in JAX for native GPU acceleration and forward-model flexibility, ConvexAD is validated on simulated and experimental BCDI data, where it outperforms conventional and deep learning assisted PR at high strain, low signal, and reduced coherence, extending the conditions under which quantitative BCDI reconstruction is achievable.

AI.tldr: 提出 ConvexAD：一种将 BCDI 相位恢复中的物体形状参数化为半空间交集构成的凸多面体、并按构造强制其内部振幅平坦的梯度下降模型，用于改善病态反演并提升三维形状与应变重建可靠性。
AI.motivation: BCDI 依赖非凸、病态的相位恢复；噪声、部分相干性以及纳米晶体中的应变或晶体学缺陷会恶化问题条件。现有交替投影和深度学习方法采用稠密体素网格表示物体，易发生振幅-相位混叠，并在上述因素下更加病态，常难以可靠地三维映射颗粒形状和应变。
AI.method: ConvexAD 是梯度下降相位恢复模型，将物体形状参数化为由半空间交集构建的凸多面体，并通过构造在其内部强制平坦振幅。该几何正则化消除振幅-相位混叠并减少可训练参数，从而促进相位恢复收敛；模型在 JAX 中实现，支持原生 GPU 加速和前向模型灵活性，并在模拟与实验 BCDI 数据上验证。
AI.result: 在模拟和实验 BCDI 数据上，ConvexAD 在高应变、低信号和降低相干性的条件下优于传统相位恢复和深度学习辅助相位恢复，扩展了可实现定量 BCDI 重建的条件范围。
AI.conclusion: 以凸多面体形状参数化和内部平坦振幅约束为核心的几何正则化，可缓解 BCDI 相位恢复的振幅-相位混叠与病态性，并在不利成像条件下实现更稳健的定量重建。

title: A Drift-Diffusion Approach for Pearson Type IV Heavy-Tail Distributions
summary: Non-Gaussian stationary fluctuations with heavy tails and finite-order moment cutoffs are ubiquitous in non-equilibrium systems. Here, we derive the Pearson type IV distribution as the stationary solution of a standardized Fokker-Planck equation with linear drift and quadratic diffusion. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for its emergence and show that the linear-quadratic structure, although sufficient, is not necessary. We also give explicit closed expressions for the cumulative distribution function, a moment recurrence relation, skewness, kurtosis, and mode. From a physical perspective, our results reveal that heavy tails and asymmetry originate from distinct features of state-dependent diffusion: its local nonlinear curvature and gradient, respectively. In particular, asymmetric stationary fluctuations can emerge even in the presence of a symmetric linear restoring drift. This framework provides a general stochastic description of asymmetric heavy-tailed fluctuations in non-equilibrium systems, including space plasma turbulence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非平衡系统中重尾、有限阶矩截断的非高斯平稳涨落，证明Pearson IV分布可作为标准化Fokker-Planck方程（线性漂移、二次扩散）的平稳解，并给出其出现条件、显式统计表达式及重尾与不对称性的物理来源。
AI.motivation: 非高斯平稳涨落普遍存在于非平衡系统中，常表现为重尾和有限阶矩截断；作者希望建立一个通用随机描述框架，用以解释此类涨落，尤其是空间等离子体湍流中的不对称重尾涨落。
AI.method: 作者求解具有线性漂移和二次扩散的标准化Fokker-Planck方程，推导Pearson IV分布作为其平稳解；建立该分布出现的必要与充分条件，并论证线性-二次结构虽充分但非必要；同时给出累积分布函数的闭式表达、矩递推关系、偏度、峰度和众数，并从状态依赖扩散的局部非线性曲率和梯度解释重尾与不对称性。
AI.result: 研究得到Pearson IV分布的显式累积分布函数、矩递推关系、偏度、峰度和众数表达式；表明重尾来源于状态依赖扩散的局部非线性曲率，不对称性来源于其梯度；即使线性恢复漂移是对称的，也可能出现不对称平稳涨落。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了重尾与不对称性可由状态依赖扩散的不同特征分别产生，提供了非平衡系统中不对称重尾涨落的通用随机描述框架，并可应用于空间等离子体湍流等情形；摘要未提供具体实验验证或定量适用范围的细节。

title: Geometric Pumping of Optical Work in Coherent Wave Scattering
summary: Optical work exchanged between light and time-varying matter underlies a wide range of emerging photonic technologies, yet a general geometric theory describing its generation and control has been lacking. Here we establish such a theory for coherent electromagnetic scattering. We show that the net optical work accumulated during an adiabatic modulation cycle is a geometric quantity determined by the Berry curvature of the outgoing field in parameter space. Nonzero optical work can thus be generated by cyclically modulating two or more independent system parameters. In contrast to conventional adiabatic pumping between incoherent reservoirs, optical work pumping vanishes under maximally mixed illumination. Greater illumination coherence increases the maximum work attainable through wavefront shaping. For fully coherent illumination, we derive the optimal incident wavefront and modulation trajectory that maximize the optical work per cycle. Our framework unifies time-varying photonics, optomechanics, and geometric transport within a common scattering formalism.

AI.tldr: 论文建立了相干电磁散射的几何理论，表明绝热调制循环中的净光功是由出射场在参数空间中的Berry曲率决定的几何量，并分析了相干照明与波前整形对光功的影响。
AI.motivation: 光与时间变化物质之间的光功交换是多种新兴光子技术的基础，但此前缺乏描述其产生与控制的通用几何理论。
AI.method: 作者针对相干电磁散射建立几何理论，将绝热调制循环中累积的净光功与出射场的Berry曲率联系起来，并分析两个及以上独立系统参数的循环调制、照明相干性以及波前整形；在全相干照明下推导最大化每周期光功的最优入射波前和调制轨迹。
AI.result: 净光功是几何量，由出射场在参数空间中的Berry曲率决定；循环调制两个或更多独立系统参数可产生非零光功；在最大混合照明下，光功泵浦消失；照明相干性越高，通过波前整形可达到的最大光功越大；对于全相干照明，给出了最优入射波前和调制轨迹。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将时间变化光子学、光力学和几何输运统一在共同的散射形式中，为光功的产生与控制提供了通用几何理论。

title: Influence of Laguerre-Gaussian pulse mode purity on positron acceleration in nonlinear wakefields
summary: The acceleration of positrons in wakefields remains a crucial challenge. One proposal has been to use Laguerre-Gaussian laser pulses as drivers, which provide corresponding accelerating and focusing regions due to their inherent field structure. Here, we study the effect of mode order and mode purity on the acceleration process by means of particle-in-cell simulations. We find that some mode impurities can be mitigated during the propagation of the wake through the plasma, but also that phase difference between the modes that the total pulse is composed of can strongly affect the acceleration process.

AI.tldr: 该文利用粒子网格（PIC）模拟研究拉盖尔-高斯（LG）激光脉冲驱动尾场中模式阶数和模式纯度对正电子加速的影响，发现部分模式杂质可在尾场于等离子体中传播时得到缓解，但组成总脉冲的各模式之间的相位差会强烈影响加速过程。
AI.motivation: 正电子在尾场中的加速仍是关键挑战；已有方案提出用LG激光脉冲作为驱动器，其固有场结构可提供相应的加速和聚焦区域，因此需要考察模式阶数和模式纯度对加速过程的影响。
AI.method: 采用粒子网格（PIC）模拟，研究LG激光驱动尾场中模式阶数和模式纯度对正电子加速过程的作用；摘要未提供具体模拟参数、等离子体条件或模式配置等细节。
AI.result: 研究发现，部分模式杂质可在尾场通过等离子体传播的过程中得到缓解；同时，组成总脉冲的模式之间的相位差会强烈影响加速过程。摘要未给出定量加速结果或具体模式纯度阈值。
AI.conclusion: LG激光驱动尾场正电子加速受模式阶数、模式纯度及模式间相位差影响；部分模式杂质可在传播中缓解，但模式间相位差对加速过程影响显著，提示需关注脉冲模式组成与相位控制。摘要未提供进一步的定量优化结论。

title: Bayesian optimization enhanced magnetic field gradient detection based on spin-orbit coupled Bose-Einstein condensates
summary: Magnetic field detection is of great significance in modern fields such as medical diagnostics, geological exploration, inertial navigation, and space physics. We have previously investigated the expansion dynamics of a spin-orbit-coupled Bose-Einstein condensate. Building on these results, here we propose a scheme for magnetic-field-gradient detection by establishing a quantitative relationship between the condensate's rotational deflection angle and the magnetic-field gradient. In this work, we present the parameter dependence of this scheme and perform a systematic optimization. We introduce a Bayesian optimization algorithm to automatically and efficiently search for the optimal combination of key parameters, thereby significantly enhancing the sensitivity of the magnetic field gradient measurement. The results show that the optimized gradiometer improves the sensitivity by a factor of five. This work not only provides a new approach for magnetic field gradient measurement but also serves as a reference for machine learning-empowered quantum precision measurement.

AI.tldr: 基于自旋轨道耦合玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的膨胀动力学，提出通过建立凝聚体旋转偏转角与磁场梯度之间的定量关系来检测磁场梯度，并利用贝叶斯优化关键参数，使优化后的梯度计灵敏度提升5倍。
AI.motivation: 磁场检测在医学诊断、地质勘探、惯性导航和空间物理等领域具有重要意义；作者希望在此前关于自旋轨道耦合玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体膨胀动力学的研究基础上，发展一种磁场梯度检测方案。
AI.method: 建立凝聚体旋转偏转角与磁场梯度之间的定量关系；分析该方案的参数依赖性并进行系统优化；引入贝叶斯优化算法自动、高效地搜索关键参数的最优组合，以提高磁场梯度测量灵敏度。
AI.result: 结果表明，优化后的梯度计将灵敏度提高5倍；摘要未提供具体灵敏度数值、实验参数、噪声水平或误差指标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为磁场梯度测量提供了新途径，也可为机器学习赋能的量子精密测量提供参考。

title: On flow unsteadiness in strongly separated high-speed ramp flows using kinetic and data-driven methods
comment: Accepted manuscript. Published in Phys. Fluids 37, 096136 (2025). 38 pages, 11 figures
summary: The gas dynamics of high speed flows over several compression-expansion ramp geometries with large separation regions were investigated using a particle kinetic approach and data driven methods. These large separation regions allow study of the role of scaled angle predicted by triple deck theory on recirculation strength, separation size, and appearance of secondary recirculation regions, all of which lead to flow unsteadiness. Examining four different free stream conditions for the same geometry using the direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) approach, we show that the stability of single recirculation in the separation region is more sensitive to wall temperature and free stream velocity than physical ramp angle. Stability in this context refers to appearance of secondary separation regions. In addition, configurations with similar types of recirculation regions from literature considered, we find that general trends regarding unsteadiness, such as appearance of secondary recirculation regions, mostly hold; however, the flows are too complex to be characterized by only scaled angle. Thus, stochastic flowfields generated by DSMC were investigated using data driven methods, namely spectral proper orthogonal decomposition and dynamic mode decomposition. We found that both methods yield similar frequency components and mode shapes for spatio-temporal coherent structures of unsteady DSMC flows. With the help of these structures, the main mechanisms of unsteadiness were identified as oscillations of the reattachment shock, Kelvin-Helmholtz like instability of the shear layer, and c-shaped mode of the separation bubble. This is the first time SPOD has been applied to a DSMC generated flowfield and compared with DMD.

AI.tldr: 采用DSMC粒子动理学方法并结合SPOD和DMD，研究大分离区高速压缩-膨胀斜坡流动的回流稳定性、二次回流与非定常机制，发现缩放角不足以单独表征复杂流动。
AI.motivation: 研究大分离区高速压缩-膨胀斜坡流动，检验三重层理论预测的缩放角对回流强度、分离尺寸、二次回流区及非定常性的作用，并利用数据驱动方法识别随机DSMC流场中的时空相干结构。
AI.method: 对同一几何的四个自由来流条件采用直接模拟蒙特卡洛（DSMC）方法，并与文献中具有类似回流区类型的构型进行比较；对DSMC生成的随机流场应用谱本征正交分解（SPOD）和动态模态分解（DMD），比较二者的频率成分与模态形状。
AI.result: 单回流稳定性对壁面温度和自由来流速度比物理斜坡角更敏感，稳定性在此指二次分离区是否出现；类似回流构型的一般非定常趋势大多成立，但流动过于复杂，不能仅由缩放角表征。SPOD与DMD得到相似的频率成分和时空相干结构模态形状；非定常主要机制为再附激波振荡、剪切层Kelvin-Helmholtz类不稳定性和分离泡的C形模态。摘要称这是首次将SPOD应用于DSMC流场并与DMD比较；未提供具体定量数据。
AI.conclusion: 缩放角不足以单独刻画此类大分离高速流动；壁面热条件和自由来流速度对回流稳定性具有重要影响；SPOD和DMD可有效提取DSMC非定常流场的时空相干结构并识别主要不稳定性机制。

title: A Finite Element Model for Fluid--Poroelastic Structure Interaction with Dissipative Interface
