summary: This paper extends our prior work on interface conditions between two poroelastic domains to the case when a poroelastic domain interacts with a pure fluid. The porous medium is assumed to be deformable and modeled following mixture theory. When not in a mixture, each constituent of the porous domain is assumed to be incompressible. An arbitrary Lagrangian--Eulerian formulation is developed for both the fluid and porous domains. The fluid velocity and pressure fields are allowed to be discontinuous across the pure fluid/porous domain interface. A globally continuous displacement field is defined to represent both the deformation of the solid skeleton of the poroelastic medium and the mesh motion in the pure fluid domain. As an interface condition, the continuity of the normal component of the filtration velocity is enforced via a Lagrange multiplier. The mixture momentum jump condition is implemented so as to transfer the traction from the fluid side to the porous domain. A dissipative behavior is attributed to the interface, and the jump condition for the fluid momentum, derived from Hamilton's principle, incorporates this prescribed behavior. The model implementation is verified using the method of manufactured solutions, and a sample problem is solved to compare an inert interface with a fully dissipative one. The results show satisfactory convergence rates, while the proposed model successfully reproduces the analytical solution of a benchmark problem using conventional jump conditions. Furthermore, the findings highlight the significant influence of the selected interface model on the behavior of the system.

AI.tldr: 本文将先前针对两个多孔弹性域之间界面条件的工作推广到多孔弹性域与纯流体相互作用的情形，建立了纯流体与多孔域的任意拉格朗日--欧拉（ALE）格式，并通过拉格朗日乘子施加过滤速度法向分量连续性、实现动量跳跃与界面耗散行为，最后用制造解法和基准问题验证模型并比较不同界面模型的影响。
AI.motivation: 论文的动机是将作者此前关于两个多孔弹性域之间界面条件的研究推广到多孔弹性域与纯流体相互作用的场景，并处理可变形多孔介质与纯流体耦合时的界面条件、牵引力传递和耗散行为。
AI.method: 采用混合理论建模可变形多孔介质，并假设各组分在不处于混合物中时不可压缩；为流体域和多孔域建立ALE格式；允许流体速度与压力在纯流体/多孔域界面两侧不连续；定义全局连续位移场表示多孔介质固体骨架变形和纯流体域网格运动；以拉格朗日乘子强制过滤速度法向分量连续；采用混合物动量跳跃条件将流体侧牵引力传递到多孔域；赋予界面耗散行为，并由哈密顿原理推导包含该指定行为的流体动量跳跃条件。
AI.result: 采用制造解法验证模型实现，并获得令人满意的收敛率；所提模型成功复现了使用传统跳跃条件的基准问题的解析解；通过算例比较惰性界面与完全耗散界面，结果表明所选界面模型对系统行为有显著影响。摘要未提供具体收敛阶数或定量误差数据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将界面条件扩展至多孔弹性域与纯流体相互作用问题，验证了ALE耦合模型及界面条件实现的正确性，并表明界面模型的选择会显著影响系统响应，因此界面耗散与跳跃条件的建模不可忽略。

title: Phase matching and mode coupling in photonic-crystal ring resonators
summary: Photonic-crystal ring resonators, in which periodic refractive-index modulations couple counter-propagating modes, have become a widely used platform for nonlinear photonics, offering mode-by-mode dispersion engineering. When several modulation components are superimposed, their relative angular alignment (phase) is an additional degree of freedom whose impact on the nonlinear dynamics has remained unclear. Here we show that the relative phases between the modulation patterns have a decisive impact. Through the interference of the nonlinear processes in forward and backward direction, they add a phase and mode selection rule to the established phase-matching conditions, which can fully suppress nonlinear coupling. They also impose a relative spectral chirp between forward- and backward-propagating waveforms. We illustrate these effects for parametric oscillation and dissipative Kerr solitons. Our results extend the concept of phase matching to resonators with interfering nonlinear pathways and establish the alignment of index gratings as a design dimension for nonlinear microresonators.

AI.tldr: 光子晶体环形谐振器中，多个折射率调制图案之间的相对相位会通过前向与后向非线性过程的干涉，决定非线性耦合能否发生，并引入相位和模式选择规则及前向与后向波形间的相对光谱啁啾。
AI.motivation: 光子晶体环形谐振器可通过周期折射率调制耦合反向传播模式，并实现逐模式色散工程；但当多个调制分量叠加时，其相对角向对准（相位）对非线性动力学的影响尚不明确，论文旨在揭示这一自由度的作用。
AI.method: 论文分析前向与后向非线性过程之间的干涉，在既有相位匹配条件之外引入由调制图案相对相位决定的相位与模式选择规则，并以参量振荡和耗散克尔孤子为例说明该效应；摘要未给出具体数值仿真或实验实现细节。
AI.result: 相对相位对非线性动力学具有决定性影响：相关选择规则可完全抑制非线性耦合，并会在前向与后向传播波形之间施加相对光谱啁啾；这些效应在参量振荡和耗散克尔孤子中得到展示。
AI.conclusion: 研究将相位匹配概念扩展到具有相互干涉非线性路径的谐振器，并把折射率光栅的对准确立为非线性微谐振器的一个设计维度。

title: First ray-tracing simulations of mode conversion using metaplectic geometrical optics
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to Physical Review E
summary: Advanced scenarios of radiofrequency power deposition into magnetically confined fusion plasmas, particularly those using electron Bernstein waves, involve linear mode conversion (energy transfer between separate dispersion branches) in regions where the waves experience reflection. Full-wave simulations of this conversion are time-consuming, and geometrical-optics (GO) modeling is problematic because it is typically restricted to single waves and leads to spurious singularities at cutoffs. Here, we report the first reduced simulations that overcome these limitations without resorting to approximate analytical formulas for the conversion efficiency. The algorithm is based on the recently developed metaplectic geometrical optics (MGO), which eliminates GO's spurious singularities by metaplectic transformations, provided that the symplectic curvature of the rays $R^{-1}$ is small. To prove the concept, we simulate one-dimensional O--X mode conversion caused by the plasma-density gradient near the critical density, a problem for which an approximate analytical solution is available and can be compared with. Numerical MGO demonstrates good agreement with said theory. This opens a way for fast and accurate ray-tracing modeling of any linear mode conversion at $R^{-1} \ll 1$.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于元plectic几何光学（MGO）的约化模拟方法，用于聚变等离子体中线性模式转换的快速建模；在一维O–X模式转换算例中，数值结果与近似解析理论吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 先进射频功率沉积场景（尤其涉及电子伯恩斯坦波）需要在波反射区域处理线性模式转换，但全波模拟耗时，传统几何光学（GO）建模受限于单一波并在截断处产生虚假奇点，因此需要一种无需近似解析转换效率公式的快速模拟方法。
AI.method: 采用近期发展的元plectic几何光学（MGO），通过元plectic变换消除GO的虚假奇点，前提是射线的辛曲率R^{-1}较小；作为概念验证，对由等离子体密度梯度在临界密度附近引起的一维O–X模式转换进行数值模拟，并与可用的近似解析解比较。
AI.result: 数值MGO与近似解析理论吻合良好；摘要称这是首次报道的、无需借助近似解析转换效率公式即可克服上述限制的约化模拟。摘要未提供定量误差或计算加速比。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在R^{-1}≪1条件下，MGO可用于快速且准确地 ray-tracing 建模任意线性模式转换；当前验证限于一维O–X模式转换的概念验证。

title: Accurate representation of the continuum orbital in a Gaussian basis set: application to Auger decay rates
summary: Many processes in chemistry and physics, such as autoionization, photoionization, or electron-impact collisions, involve unbound electrons. Despite their importance, theoretical methods for modeling continuum electrons remain significantly less developed than those for purely bound electronic states. Here we present a novel approach for treating continuum electrons within Gaussian-based quantum chemistry. The method represents continuum orbital in a discrete basis of standard Gaussian-type orbitals (GTOs), where the continuum wave function is obtained by solving the Lippmann-Schwinger equation with proper boundary conditions using an analytical representation of the Green's function in an auxiliary GTO basis set. The resulting continuum orbital is multicentered and multichannel, providing a rigorous description of scattering states. As an initial application of the new methodology, we compute Auger decay rates for several atomic and molecular systems, including Ne, H$_2$O, CO$_2$, and Ar. We demonstrate a consistent improvement of the results with increasing the quality of the continuum representation. We show also that higher-order electron-correlation effects in the bound domain are essential for an accurate treatment of satellite transitions. The present formalism therefore provides a systematically improvable Gaussian-based framework for continuum-electron problems that is fully compatible with standard quantum chemistry methods.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种在标准高斯型轨道量子化学框架内处理连续电子的新方法，并用它计算Ne、H2O、CO2和Ar的Auger衰变率，证明结果可随连续态描述质量系统性改进。
AI.motivation: 化学和物理中的自电离、光电离、电子碰撞等过程涉及非束缚电子，但连续电子的理论建模方法明显不如纯束缚态电子结构方法成熟，因此需要发展可与标准量子化学兼容的连续电子处理方法。
AI.method: 将连续轨道用标准高斯型轨道（GTO）的离散基组表示；通过求解具有适当边界条件的Lippmann-Schwinger方程获得连续波函数，其中Green函数利用辅助GTO基组中的解析表示构造；所得连续轨道为多中心、多通道，可严格描述散射态。
AI.result: 作为初步应用，计算了Ne、H2O、CO2和Ar等原子和分子体系的Auger衰变率；结果表明，随着连续态表示质量提高，结果一致改善；同时，束缚域中的高阶电子相关效应对卫星跃迁的准确处理至关重要。摘要未给出具体数值误差或实验对比数据。
AI.conclusion: 该形式体系提供了一个可系统性改进、基于高斯的连续电子问题框架，并与标准量子化学方法完全兼容。

title: SCANO: Restoring Boundary-Condition Completeness in Sampled Meshes with a Sliced-Cross-Attention Neural Operator for 3D Thermal Fields
summary: Training neural operators on million-cell meshes can exceed GPU memory limits. Models are therefore trained on subsamples and deployed on whole meshes or selected regions. However, subsampling can distort boundary information, degrading accuracy. We ask when boundary conditioning under sampling stays consistent with whole-mesh training, and how to aggregate and inject boundary data. Representing the solution as an integral of boundary data against type-dependent measures, we show that subsampling distorts this conditioning in three ways: incomplete boundary coverage or a sample-dependent global state, face weighting by count rather than area, and compression of boundary inputs into a low-dimensional vector. This analysis yields four measurable consistency conditions checkable before training. We satisfy them with two backbone-agnostic modules. Boundary Quadrature Attention (BQA) aggregates all boundary faces, typed and area-weighted, into slice tokens that every query point reads at every layer. Anchored Global State (AGS) estimates the global state from anchors independent of the sampled points. Adding both to a scalable message-passing and slice-attention backbone yields SCANO. We evaluate the approach on controlled and public benchmarks and a data-centre thermal simulation dataset (DCTS) containing million-cell meshes. On both benchmarks, BQA improves every backbone, reducing whole-mesh error up to 15-fold. On all three datasets, AGS aligns regional with whole-mesh predictions, cutting regional error at least tenfold for most backbones on the public benchmark. Together, the modules nearly halve the best original backbone's whole-mesh error on both benchmarks. SCANO predicts a room-scale field in under one second, over 100 times faster than whole-room anchor self-attention.

AI.tldr: 针对百万单元网格训练神经算子受GPU显存限制、子采样会扭曲边界信息的问题，作者提出边界条件一致性的四条可测条件，并设计BQA与AGS两个与骨干无关的模块，组成SCANO，在多个基准和DCTS上显著降低整网格与区域误差并实现快速推理。
AI.motivation: 训练神经算子时需对百万单元网格进行子采样以适配GPU显存，但模型最终用于整网格或选定区域；子采样可能破坏边界信息并降低精度。论文旨在回答边界条件在采样下何时与整网格训练保持一致，以及如何聚合和注入边界数据。
AI.method: 将解表示为边界数据对类型相关测度的积分，分析子采样对边界条件的三类扭曲：边界覆盖不完整或全局状态依赖样本、按面数量而非面积加权、边界输入被压缩为低维向量；由此给出训练前可检查的四条可测一致性条件。提出Boundary Quadrature Attention（BQA），按类型和面积加权聚合所有边界面为slice tokens，供每个查询点在每层读取；提出Anchored Global State（AGS），从anchors估计与采样点无关的全局状态；二者加入可扩展的message-passing与slice-attention骨干形成SCANO。
AI.result: 在受控与公开基准以及包含百万单元网格的数据中心热仿真数据集DCTS上评估。两个基准上BQA改善每个骨干，整网格误差最多降低15倍；三个数据集上AGS使区域预测与整网格预测对齐，公开基准上多数骨干的区域误差至少降低十倍；两模块结合使两个基准上最佳原始骨干的整网格误差近乎减半。SCANO不到1秒预测房间尺度场，比whole-room anchor self-attention快100倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过边界条件一致性分析提供了训练前可检查的条件，并以BQA和AGS满足这些条件；SCANO作为与骨干无关的方案，在百万单元网格上同时提升整网格与区域预测精度和推理效率。

title: Quantitative infrared absorption imaging of vapor concentration fields during evaporation
summary: Quantitative full-field measurements of vapor concentration remain challenging near receding liquid-gas interfaces. We develop and quantitatively assess an infrared absorption imaging method for measuring vapor mole-fraction fields during evaporation. Broadband mid-infrared attenuation is converted into mole fraction using a spectrally weighted absorption coefficient. A vertical Hele-Shaw cell provides a controlled, nearly one-dimensional evaporation benchmark, with calibrated object-plane sampling of $30.5\,μ\mathrm{m/pixel}$. Small transverse concentration variations in the central measurement region justify reducing the two-dimensional fields to axial profiles. Five profiles spanning different retained gas-phase interval lengths and three hydrocarbon liquids are compared with Stefan predictions using only measured interval lengths and endpoint concentrations, without fitting interior concentration data. At the higher vapor loading of n-pentane, the measurements resolve the nonlinear Stefan concentration profile and distinguish it from the linear diffusion limit. At the lower vapor loadings of n-hexane and n-heptane, the profiles progressively approach that dilute limit. The profiles agree with Stefan predictions, with normalized root-mean-square deviations of 0.0055-0.0185, and collapse onto the predicted identity relation after the logarithmic Stefan transformation. These results demonstrate quantitative recovery of both the magnitude and spatial structure of vapor concentration fields under the tested conditions. The method provides a full-field, tracer-free diagnostic for investigating evaporating flows in geometries and regimes where analytical concentration fields are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并定量评估一种红外吸收成像方法，用于测量蒸发过程中液-气界面附近的蒸气摩尔分数全场分布，并以Hele-Shaw池中的近一维蒸发实验验证其对Stefan浓度剖面的定量重建能力。
AI.motivation: 在后退的液-气界面附近，蒸气浓度的定量全场测量仍然具有挑战性；研究旨在发展一种无示踪剂、可给出全场浓度场的诊断方法，用于解析蒸发流动中的浓度幅值与空间结构。
AI.method: 采用宽带中红外衰减成像，并通过光谱加权吸收系数将衰减转换为摩尔分数；使用垂直Hele-Shaw池提供受控的近一维蒸发基准，标定物面采样为30.5 μm/pixel；因中心测量区横向浓度变化很小，将二维场简化为轴向剖面；对五种不同保留气相区间长度和三种烃类液体的剖面，仅用实测区间长度与端点浓度与Stefan预测比较，不对内部浓度数据拟合。
AI.result: 在较高蒸气负载的正戊烷中，测量分辨出非线性Stefan浓度剖面，并区别于线性扩散极限；在较低蒸气负载的正己烷和正庚烷中，剖面逐渐接近稀薄极限；测量剖面与Stefan预测一致，归一化均方根偏差为0.0055–0.0185，并在对数Stefan变换后折叠到预测的恒等关系上。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在所测试条件下可定量恢复蒸气浓度场的幅值和空间结构；该方法提供了一种全场、无示踪剂的诊断手段，适用于解析浓度场不可得的几何构型与蒸发流态。

title: Directional Control of Chiral Polymer Emission Dissymmetry by Plasmonic Metasurfaces
comment: Main manuscript (4 figures, 10 pages) and appended to it supplementary information (with 14 supplementary figures)
summary: Circularly polarized (CP) emission is central to next-generation photonic and optoelectronic technologies, yet simultaneously controlling its directionality, intensity, and handedness remains a major challenge. Advances in molecular and materials design have enabled strong chiral light-matter interactions and large dissymmetry between opposite CP states. However, conventional thin-film architectures provide limited control over the angular distribution of CP emission and often exhibit strongly angle-dependent chiral emission. Metasurfaces, on the other hand, offer powerful control over emission directionality and polarization, but have predominantly been explored with intrinsically achiral emitters. For the first time, we integrate organic chiral polymer thin films with planar chiral plasmonic metasurfaces to enhance chiral light-matter interactions while controlling the directionality and angular dependence of chiral emission. Using angle-resolved Stokes Fourier polarimetry, we show that metasurface coupling produces directional emission, near-normal dissymmetry factors exceeding 0.7, and, remarkably, direction-dependent reversal of the emission handedness at fixed molecular stereochemistry.

AI.tldr: 该工作首次将有机手性聚合物薄膜与平面手性等离激元超表面集成，利用角度分辨斯托克斯傅里叶偏振测量，实现定向圆偏振发射、近法向不对称因子超过0.7，并在固定分子立体化学下观察到发射手性随方向反转。
AI.motivation: 圆偏振发射应用需要同时调控方向性、强度和手性，但传统薄膜对圆偏振发射角分布控制有限，且手性发射强烈依赖角度；超表面虽能调控方向性与偏振，却多与内禀非手性发射体结合。因此作者希望将手性发射体与手性超表面结合，增强手性光-物质相互作用并控制手性发射的方向性与角度依赖。
AI.method: 将有机手性聚合物薄膜与平面手性等离激元超表面集成，并采用角度分辨斯托克斯傅里叶偏振测量表征其圆偏振发射的方向性、不对称因子和手性。摘要未提供具体材料组成、结构参数、工作波长及制备细节。
AI.result: 超表面耦合产生定向发射，近法向不对称因子超过0.7；在固定分子立体化学条件下，发射手性随方向发生反转，表明超表面可调控手性发射的角度依赖。摘要未给出具体增强倍数、效率或器件稳定性数据。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，有机手性聚合物薄膜与平面手性等离激元超表面集成可增强手性光-物质相互作用，并同时调控圆偏振发射的方向性、不对称因子及方向依赖的手性，为手性光子与光电子应用提供了一种可行策略。

title: Spontaneous Enhancement of Inward Impurity Pinch during Massive Impurity Injection in Tokamak Plasmas
summary: A spontaneous enhancement of inward impurity pinch is identified prior to the fast quench under massive impurity injection on the EAST tokamak. The transition is marked by a rapid shift of the magnetic-island rotation frequency toward the electron diamagnetic direction within a few hundred microseconds. An extended KDG model shows that the impurity-induced increase in bulk ion collisionality can drive a transition across banana regime, nonlinearly modifying the parallel viscosity and producing a radial electric field excursion of approximately -10 kV/m, consistent with experiment. The associated self-organized response of the plasma flow and electrostatic potential can modify the parallel friction and further strengthen the neoclassical inward impurity pinch. Projections for ITER disruption mitigation suggest that this mechanism is expected to enhance impurity penetration, thereby improving the overall effectiveness of mitigation.

AI.tldr: 在EAST托卡马克的大规模杂质注入实验中，快淬灭前出现了自发增强的向内杂质 pinch。扩展KDG模型表明，杂质导致主离子碰撞率升高，使等离子体跨越香蕉区，并非线性改变平行粘性，产生约-10 kV/m的径向电场，与实验一致；等离子体流和静电势的自组织响应会改变平行摩擦，进一步增强新经典向内杂质 pinch。ITER破裂缓解投影显示，该机制有望增强杂质穿透并改善缓解效果。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确给出研究动机；所述工作关注大规模杂质注入下快淬灭前自发增强的向内杂质 pinch 的识别与机制解释，并评估其对ITER破裂缓解中杂质穿透和缓解有效性的潜在影响。
AI.method: 基于EAST托卡马克大规模杂质注入实验观测，识别快淬灭前磁岛旋转频率在数百微秒内向电子抗磁方向的快速移动；采用扩展KDG模型分析杂质引起的体离子碰撞率增加、香蕉区跨越、平行粘性的非线性修正以及径向电场变化，并与实验对比；最后给出ITER破裂缓解的投影。
AI.result: 实验发现快淬灭前向内杂质 pinch 自发增强，伴随磁岛旋转频率在数百微秒内快速转向电子抗磁方向。扩展KDG模型显示，杂质引起的体离子碰撞率增加可驱动跨越香蕉区的转变，非线性修改平行粘性，并产生约-10 kV/m的径向电场偏移，与实验一致。等离子体流和静电势的自组织响应可修改平行摩擦，并进一步增强新经典向内杂质 pinch。
AI.conclusion: 杂质诱导的碰撞率增加、平行粘性非线性修正及自组织流场与静电势响应共同强化新经典向内杂质 pinch；ITER破裂缓解投影表明该机制预计会增强杂质穿透，从而提高破裂缓解的整体有效性。

title: Renormalisation of Hydrogen Partition Function and Saha Ionisation Equation
summary: An important physical quantity that is part of the Saha ionisation equation is the partition function of the neutral hydrogen atoms. An immense uncertainty is caused by the divergency of the neutral atom partition function arising due to the fast growing degeneracy factor of its excited n-state. We suggested a regularisation and renormalisation procedure for the partition function of the neutral hydrogen atoms. The renormalised partition function is well defined and allows to calculate the population of the energy levels and the ionisation state of the hydrogen plasma as a function of its temperature and pressure. In the low-temperature limit the behaviour of these functions smoothly transforms to the Saha equation, which is used in the description of the low-temperature plasma. At higher temperatures the renormalised ionisation equation describes the deviation from the Saha equation. The application of the renormalised ionisation equation to the solar core and atmosphere is considered.

AI.tldr: 针对中性氢原子配分函数因激发态简并度快速增长而发散、进而给Saha电离方程带来巨大不确定性的问题，作者提出正则化与重整化方案，使配分函数良定义，并据此计算氢等离子体能级布居和电离态随温度、压强的变化；低温度极限回到Saha方程，高温度则给出偏离，并讨论太阳核心与大气中的应用。
AI.motivation: 中性氢原子配分函数是Saha电离方程的重要组成部分，但其激发n态的简并因子快速增长导致配分函数发散，从而造成极大的不确定性，因此需要对该配分函数进行正则化和重整化以消除发散并获得可靠计算。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种针对中性氢原子配分函数的正则化与重整化程序，得到良定义的重整化配分函数，并用其计算氢等离子体的能级布居数和电离状态随温度与压强的变化；随后将重整化电离方程应用于太阳核心和太阳大气。
AI.result: 重整化配分函数良定义，可计算氢等离子体能级布居和电离态随温度、压强的函数关系；在低温极限下这些函数平滑过渡到低温度等离子体描述中使用的Saha方程，在较高温度下重整化电离方程描述对Saha方程的偏离；摘要还指出考虑了其在太阳核心和大气中的应用，但未给出定量结果或具体偏离幅度。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的正则化与重整化方案使中性氢原子配分函数良定义，并给出可随温度和压强计算氢等离子体电离态与能级布居的重整化电离方程；该方程在低温下与Saha方程衔接、在高温下描述其偏离，并可用于太阳核心与大气等情形。摘要未提供定量验证或具体应用结果。

title: samQEq: universal charge equilibration for molecules and conductors
summary: Charge equilibration assigns atomic charges by equalizing an atomic chemical potential built from electronegativity, hardness and the Coulomb interaction. Under one global constraint it lets charge flow without limit between molecules, which fluctuating-charge models prevent with one neutrality constraint per molecule. A metal needs the opposite: a global constraint and a hardness near zero, and there the charge operator becomes indefinite unless it includes each charge's own self-energy. Here, we present samQEq (solids-and-molecules QEq), a unified charge-equilibration package for LAMMPS that combines the two constructions in one energy functional and one matrix-free solve. An orthogonal projector imposes one neutrality constraint per molecule, and the finite-width self-energy of a Gaussian charge on designated conductor types, narrower than the conductor's own Gaussian, keeps the conductor's part of the operator positive definite at any hardness. On a gold slab carrying a water film, the operator stays definite down to the conductor limit of the model, the metal screens a point charge by a constant amount at every height beyond 4 Å, and the film's charges stay bounded under dynamics. Reciprocal-space electrostatics is evaluated inside the matrix-vector product, and three distinct shielding kernels are run-time settings. We verify the implementation by reproducing a published fluctuating-charge water model without refitting, and the native ReaxFF charge-equilibration step to approximately $10^{-9}\,e$. On a single four-V100 node the largest tested systems run at approximately twice the throughput of a 128-core CPU node. samQEq thus provides one charge-equilibration layer for molecules, conductors and the interfaces between them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了 samQEq：一个面向 LAMMPS 的统一电荷平衡（charge equilibration）软件包，将分子体系的逐分子中性约束与导体体系所需的近零硬度、自能修正统一到同一个能量泛函和无矩阵求解框架中，并验证了其跨分子、导体及界面体系的适用性。
AI.motivation: 传统 QEq 在单一全局约束下允许电荷在分子间无限制流动； fluctuating-charge 模型虽以每个分子一个中性约束来限制电荷转移，但金属需要相反的构造，即全局约束和接近零的硬度。此时若不包括每个电荷自身的自能，电荷算符会变得不定。因此需要一种能统一处理分子、导体及其界面的电荷平衡方法。
AI.method: samQEq 在 LAMMPS 中把两类电荷平衡构造合并到一个能量泛函和一次无矩阵求解中：用正交投影算子施加每个分子一个中性约束；对指定导体类型引入有限宽度的 Gaussian 电荷自能，其宽度窄于导体自身 Gaussian，从而使导体部分在任意硬度下保持正定；倒空间静电在矩阵-向量乘积内部计算；提供三种不同的屏蔽核作为运行时设置。
AI.result: 在带水膜的金板体系上，算符在模型导体极限下仍保持正定；金属对点电荷在 4 Å 以上各高度给出恒定屏蔽量；动力学下水膜电荷保持有界。实现无需重新拟合即可复现已发表的 fluctuating-charge 水模型，并将原生 ReaxFF 电荷平衡步复现到约 10^-9 e。单个四 V100 节点上，最大测试体系的吞吐约为 128 核 CPU 节点的两倍。
AI.conclusion: samQEq 为分子、导体及其界面提供了一个统一的电荷平衡层。摘要未提供最大测试体系的规模、三种屏蔽核的具体形式以及更广泛的材料或界面验证细节。

title: Microdroplet Generator Surrogate Enhancement and Inverse Design Through an Uncertainty-Guided Framework
summary: Microfluidic droplet generation is critical for many applications, yet efficient device design in high-dimensional parameter spaces remains computationally prohibitive due to complex multiphase flow dynamics. This work presents a unified methodology that couples adaptive surrogate enhancement with simulation-driven inverse design. High-fidelity Volume-of-Fluid simulations provide ground-truth data, while neural network ensembles predict flow regimes and droplet diameters. Ensemble-based uncertainty quantification identifies epistemic uncertainty using consensus levels for regime classification and the coefficient of variation for diameter prediction, revealing that uncertainty concentrates near regime transition boundaries where physics is highly sensitive to parameter perturbations. A physics-informed enrichment strategy targets these critical zones and addresses class imbalances by deploying additional targeted simulations and retraining the surrogates forming the ensembles. A framework that integrates Particle Swarm Optimization for constrained inverse design, balancing accuracy with predictive confidence and physical consistency is therefore proposed. Validation on independent test datasets demonstrates that the enriched ensembles achieve higher accuracy, with the fraction of predictions within the 0-3% error range on droplet diameter nearly doubling, and high-error cases (above 10%) dropping substantially. The inverse design procedure reliably identifies physically realizable configurations meeting target droplet sizes. This approach significantly reduces computational costs while ensuring reliable predictions, offering a framework with potential applicability to the optimization of a broad range of microfluidic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将自适应代理模型增强与仿真驱动逆向设计相结合的统一方法，用于微流控液滴生成的高维参数优化：以VOF仿真提供真值，用神经网络集成预测流型与液滴直径，通过集成不确定性定位流型转变边界并定向补充仿真，再结合粒子群优化完成约束逆向设计。
AI.motivation: 微流控液滴生成应用广泛，但多相流动力学复杂，在高维参数空间中进行高效器件设计计算代价过高，因此需要降低仿真成本并保证预测与设计可靠性。
AI.method: 采用高保真Volume-of-Fluid仿真生成真值数据；构建神经网络集成预测流型和液滴直径；基于集成共识水平评估流型分类的认知不确定性，基于变异系数评估直径预测不确定性，发现不确定性集中于物理对参数扰动高度敏感的流型转变边界；实施物理信息驱动的富集策略，在关键区域补充定向仿真并重新训练集成成员，同时缓解类别不平衡；提出集成粒子群优化的约束逆向设计框架，兼顾精度、预测置信度和物理一致性。
AI.result: 独立测试集验证表明，富集后的集成模型精度提高：液滴直径预测落在0–3%误差范围内的比例接近翻倍，误差高于10%的高误差案例显著减少；逆向设计流程能够可靠识别满足目标液滴尺寸且物理可实现的配置。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在降低计算成本的同时提供可靠预测，并可望推广到更广泛的微流控系统优化；摘要未提供具体数据集、参数维度、误差指标数值及计算成本降幅等细节。

title: Evanescent-Depth-Engineered High-Q topological Cavities for Strong Photon-Exciton Coupling
summary: Due to the inherent scattering in topological edge states, the topological resonant cavity (TRC) formed by their interference exhibits a relatively low quality factor (Q). To address this issue, we propose the mechanism of engineering the transverse evanescent depth of edge states to achieve high-Q in irregular shaped TRCs, which further enables strong photon-exciton coupling at the single-quantum level. By adjusting the intra- and inter-cell coupling strengths in the pseudo-spin topological photonic crystal, the transverse evanescent depth of edge states is greatly reduced, thereby suppressing the scattering of TRCs. Consequently, the Q of various shaped TRCs with 2 ~ 3 um size is up to 10^5 ~ 10^6 in the visible, so that the strong photon-exciton coupling is achieved. The high-Q topological cavities hold promising application in integrated lasers, sensors, cavity quantum electrodynamics, and quantum photonics.

AI.tldr: 针对拓扑谐振腔因边缘态散射导致Q值偏低的问题，作者提出通过调控边缘态横向倏逝深度来抑制不规则拓扑谐振腔散射，从而在可见光波段实现10^5~10^6的高Q值，并实现单量子级强光子-激子耦合。
AI.motivation: 拓扑边缘态本身存在散射，由其干涉形成的拓扑谐振腔Q值相对较低；论文旨在解决该问题并进一步提升光与物质相互作用强度。
AI.method: 在赝自旋拓扑光子晶体中调节胞内与胞间耦合强度，以工程化边缘态的横向倏逝深度，显著减小该深度并抑制拓扑谐振腔的散射。
AI.result: 尺寸为2~3 μm的多种形状拓扑谐振腔在可见光波段的Q值可达10^5~10^6，并由此实现强光子-激子耦合；摘要称可达到单量子级。
AI.conclusion: 高Q拓扑谐振腔有望应用于集成激光器、传感器、腔量子电动力学和量子光子学；摘要未提供具体结构参数、材料体系及实验验证细节。

title: Electron Kinetics in the Sheath of Atmospheric Pressure Plasmas in Helium and Helium:H$_2$O Vapor
comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, supporting information in ancillary files
summary: The electron energy distribution function (EEDF) plays a central role in determining the rates of electron-induced reactions in the bulk plasma, the sheath, and at the plasma-surface interface. However, the electron kinetics within the sheath and near the surface are generally not well described by conventional Boltzmann solvers, which neglect the sheath electric field and electron losses to the surface. In this study, we investigate electron kinetics in atmospheric pressure plasmas in pure helium and helium-water vapor mixtures using a hybrid model that combines a fluid description of the collisional sheath with a particle kinetic Monte Carlo model for electrons. The floating wall potential is determined taking into account electron diffusion through the sheath and the non-Maxwellian EEDF. Our results demonstrate that electron kinetics within the sheath can exhibit both local and nonlocal behavior, even at atmospheric pressure. The transition between these regimes is governed primarily by the ratio of the electron energy relaxation length to the sheath thickness. At high plasma densities, where the sheath thickness becomes smaller than the electron energy relaxation length, the EEDFs approach the nonlocal limit, exhibiting significant changes in electron kinetic energy toward the wall. The addition of water vapor reduces the energy relaxation length and shifts the electron kinetics toward the local regime. In the nonlocal regime, the electron mean kinetic energy decreases substantially toward the wall, accompanied by reductions of more than an order of magnitude in electron-impact excitation and ionization rate coefficients. These findings demonstrate that modeling of electron-induced processes in the sheath and at plasma-surface interfaces requires accounting for nonlocal electron kinetics and electron losses to the surface, even at atmospheric pressure.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用鞘层流体模型与电子粒子动力学Monte Carlo相结合的混合模型，研究大气压纯氦及氦-水汽等离子体中的鞘层电子动力学。结果表明，鞘层电子动力学可呈局部或非局部行为，主要由电子能量弛豫长度与鞘层厚度之比控制；水汽使动力学趋向局部，非局部条件下壁面附近电子平均动能及电子碰撞激发、电离速率系数显著降低，因此大气压鞘层及等离子体-表面界面建模需考虑非局部电子动力学和表面电子损失。
AI.motivation: 电子能量分布函数（EEDF）决定体等离子体、鞘层及等离子体-表面界面中电子诱导反应的速率，但常规Boltzmann求解器忽略鞘层电场和电子向表面的损失，难以准确描述鞘层及表面附近的电子动力学，因此需要针对大气压等离子体研究鞘层电子动力学。
AI.method: 采用混合模型：对碰撞鞘层进行流体描述，对电子采用粒子动力学Monte Carlo模型；在确定悬浮壁电位时考虑电子通过鞘层的扩散以及非Maxwellian EEDF；研究对象为纯氦和氦-水汽混合物大气压等离子体，并分析鞘层内电子动力学的局部与非局部行为及其与电子能量弛豫长度和鞘层厚度比值的关系。摘要未提供具体气压、几何结构及定量参数。
AI.result: 鞘层内电子动力学在大气压下仍可表现出局部和非局部行为，其转变主要由电子能量弛豫长度与鞘层厚度之比决定。高等离子体密度下，鞘层厚度小于电子能量弛豫长度时，EEDF趋于非局部极限，电子动能向壁面发生显著变化；加入水汽会降低能量弛豫长度，使电子动力学向局部区域转变。在非局部区域，电子平均动能向壁面显著下降，电子碰撞激发和电离速率系数降低超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 大气压等离子体鞘层及等离子体-表面界面中的电子诱导过程建模必须考虑非局部电子动力学和电子向表面的损失，而不能仅依赖忽略鞘层电场与表面损失的常规方法。

title: Dual-Space Analysis of Vortex Configurations and Rotational Energy in a 2D Optical Lattice
summary: We investigate the effects of a stationary two-dimensional periodic optical lattice on a rotating Bose--Einstein condensate confined by an isotropic harmonic trap. Within the mean-field description, the condensate is modeled by the two-dimensional Gross--Pitaevskii equation in the rotating frame and solved numerically using an imaginary-time split-step Crank--Nicolson method to obtain stationary vortex states. We examine how the lattice depth, lattice wave vector, particle number, and angular velocity influence the vortex configurations, real-space density, momentum-space density, and energetics of the condensate. We find that the stationary periodic lattice significantly modifies vortex nucleation and spatial organization: vortices emerge progressively with increasing angular velocity and, for sufficiently strong lattice strength, undergo rearrangement and merging. Importantly, changes in the vortex configuration are directly reflected in the momentum-space density, demonstrating that vortex nucleation and rearrangement produce pronounced modifications of the condensate momentum distribution. We further analyze the energy per particle and rotational energy as functions of the angular velocity and find that the presence of the optical lattice substantially alters the rotational response of the condensate. In particular, the rotational energy is progressively reduced at higher angular velocities as the lattice strength is increased. These results demonstrate how a stationary periodic optical lattice modifies vortex formation, momentum-space structure, and rotational energetics of a rotating trapped Bose--Einstein condensate.

AI.tldr: 本文用二维旋转框架 Gross–Pitaevskii 方程和虚时间分裂步 Crank–Nicolson 数值方法，研究各向同性谐振势中旋转玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体在静态二维周期光学晶格作用下的稳态涡旋、实空间/动量空间密度及能量学。
AI.motivation: 研究静态二维周期光学晶格如何影响旋转 trapped Bose–Einstein condensate 的涡旋成核、空间组织、动量分布和旋转能量响应；摘要未提供更具体的应用动机或背景需求。
AI.method: 在平均场框架下，将凝聚体建模为旋转框架中的二维 Gross–Pitaevskii 方程，采用虚时间分裂步 Crank–Nicolson 方法数值求解稳态涡旋态；考察晶格深度、晶格波矢、粒子数和角速度对涡旋构型、实空间密度、动量空间密度及能量学的影响。
AI.result: 静态周期晶格显著改变涡旋成核和空间组织：涡旋随角速度增加逐步出现，晶格强度足够强时发生重排与合并；涡旋构型变化直接反映在动量空间密度上，导致凝聚体动量分布明显改变。能量分析表明，光学晶格显著改变旋转响应，随晶格强度增加，较高角速度下的旋转能量逐步降低。摘要未给出具体参数范围或定量数值。
AI.conclusion: 静态二维周期光学晶格能够调控旋转 trapped Bose–Einstein condensate 的涡旋形成、动量空间结构和旋转能量学；摘要未提供超出上述结果的定量结论或实验验证信息。

title: Identifying the Shear Piezoelectric Coefficient using Physics-Informed Neural Networks under Exact Boundary and Initial Constraints
summary: The shear piezoelectric coefficient $e_{15}$ governs the shear-mode electromechanical coupling in piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducers (PMUTs) and surface acoustic wave (SAW) devices, but measuring it typically requires destructive resonance testing on dedicated specimens. On simulated data, $e_{15}$ can instead be recovered non-destructively from sparse, noisy subsurface wavefield observations using a constrained physics-informed neural network (PINN). By building exact spatial distance functions and temporal multipliers directly into the network output, the clamped, grounded boundaries and resting initial state hold automatically, leaving the loss with only the interior equations of coupled electro-elastodynamics and the data misfit. Non-dimensional scaling brings all governing coefficients within one decade of O(1), and the setup removes the boundary and initial-condition penalty weights that soft-constraint methods must tune. In a six-way comparison (plane-strain PZT-5H, manufactured wavefield, 30 dB noise), a soft-penalty baseline with adaptive weights converges to an erroneous $e_{15}$ in four of the five runs (51.7% mean error), and fixed penalties reach an error of 0.85% only after a second-order optimization stage. The constrained formulations reach mean $e_{15}$ errors between 0.15% and 0.51% with held-out displacement errors below 1%. Within these variants, the spatial multiplier gives rapid first-order convergence, and the quadratic temporal multiplier lowers the early-time electrostatic residual by a factor of 6.8 versus a linear one. On finite-element data along one subsurface line, the full formulation recovers $e_{15}$ with 1.19% mean error at 30 dB and keeps it between 0.65% and 2.71% across a 40 to 0 dB noise sweep. Finally, training on displacements alone still recovers $e_{15}$ with mean errors of 0.45% on finite-element and 1.64% on manufactured data.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种约束型物理信息神经网络（PINN），可从稀疏、含噪的次表面波场观测中非破坏性地反演压电剪切系数 e15；该方法通过把边界条件和初始条件直接嵌入网络输出，避免了软约束方法中需要调节惩罚权重的问题，并在多组模拟数据与有限元数据上验证了其精度和噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 剪切压电系数 e15 决定 PMUT 和 SAW 器件中的剪切机电耦合，但通常需要在专用试样上进行破坏性共振测试才能测量；作者希望利用稀疏、含噪的次表面波场观测，以非破坏性方式恢复 e15。
AI.method: 构建约束型 PINN：将精确的空间距离函数和时间乘子直接嵌入网络输出，使夹紧、接地边界和静止初始状态自动满足；损失函数仅包含耦合电弹性动力学内部方程和数据失配。采用无量纲缩放，使所有控制系数落在 O(1) 的一个数量级内，并去除软约束方法需调的边界和初始条件惩罚权重。开展六路比较，包括带自适应权重的软惩罚基线和固定惩罚；考察空间乘子与二次时间乘子；在一条次表面线上的有限元数据和 40 至 0 dB 噪声扫描下测试；并评估仅用位移训练的效果。
AI.result: 软惩罚自适应权重基线在五次运行中有四次收敛到错误的 e15，平均误差为 51.7%；固定惩罚需在二阶优化阶段后才达到 0.85% 误差。约束形式将平均 e15 误差降至 0.15% 至 0.51%，留出位移误差低于 1%。空间乘子实现快速一阶收敛；二次时间乘子相比线性时间乘子，使早期静电残差降低 6.8 倍。在有限元数据的一条次表面线上，完整方法在 30 dB 下平均误差为 1.19%，在 40 至 0 dB 噪声范围内保持在 0.65% 至 2.71%。仅用位移训练时，在有限元和制造数据上的平均 e15 误差分别为 0.45% 和 1.64%。
AI.conclusion: 约束型 PINN 可在模拟数据上从稀疏、含噪的次表面波场中高精度、非破坏性地反演 e15，并避免软约束惩罚权重调参，且表现出噪声鲁棒性；文中验证主要基于模拟、制造波场和有限元数据，未报告实验测量结果。

title: Boundary Layers, Displacement Flow, and the High-Frequency Response of Porous Media: Beyond the Viscous and Thermal Characteristic Lengths, Order by Order
summary: The Johnson-Koplik-Dashen viscous characteristic length $Λ$ and its thermal analogue $Λ'$ introduced by Champoux and Allard govern the leading $O(ω^{-1/2})$ boundary-layer behaviour of fluid-saturated porous media, but omit higher microgeometric effects associated with interface curvature and field gradients. We develop the asymptotic high-frequency expansions of dynamic tortuosity and dynamic compressibility beyond the leading boundary-layer terms. By resolving the oscillatory Stokes and heat conduction problems in the thin boundary-layer limit, we establish a recursive hierarchy, which can be continued to any order, defining successive microgeometric parameters, given by wall integrals. Each order requires transport equations of WKB type across the boundary layer, closed by a non-secularity condition, together with one Neumann problem for the potential displacement flow that the boundary layer induces. Applied to the values fitted on highly absorbing foams, these expressions show that the negative surface parameter is consistent with strong in-parallel disorder of the pore sizes, whereas the large positive third-order term points to strong constrictions or enlargements along part of the flow paths. The thermal parameters reduce to geometrical quantities: the integral mean curvature of the pore walls, a Willmore-type measure of their departure from umbilicity and, at the next order, this measure weighted by the mean curvature. Using the Avellaneda-Torquato relaxation-mode representation, we show that all these parameters are spectral data of the distribution of relaxation times. For isolated sharp edges across which the fluid flows, the singular terms of the formal expansion cancel, and the description persists with apparent, logarithmically varying values of the parameters.

AI.tldr: 该文将流体饱和多孔介质的高频动态曲折度和动态压缩性展开到Johnson-Koplik-Dashen/Champoux-Allard特征长度之外，建立可递推到任意阶的边界层渐近层级，并用壁面积分定义新的微几何参数；对高吸声泡沫拟合值给出孔隙尺寸并联无序、局部缩颈或扩径等解释，并把这些参数联系到热弛豫时间谱及尖锐边缘下的对数变化表观参数。
AI.motivation: Johnson-Koplik-Dashen黏性特征长度Λ及Champoux-Allard热学类似量Λ'只控制O(ω^{-1/2})领头边界层行为，忽略界面曲率和场梯度引起的高阶微几何效应；论文旨在发展超越领头边界层项的高频渐近理论。
AI.method: 在薄边界层极限下求解振荡Stokes问题与热传导问题，构造动态曲折度和动态压缩性的高阶渐近展开；建立可继续到任意阶的递推层级，每阶由壁面积分定义微几何参数，需要跨边界层的WKB型输运方程并用非久期条件封闭，同时求解边界层诱导势位移流的一个Neumann问题；将表达式用于高吸声泡沫拟合值，并采用Avellaneda-Torquato弛豫模式表示分析参数。
AI.result: 得到一系列高阶微几何参数：负的表面参数与孔隙尺寸强并联无序一致，大的正三阶项指示流路局部强缩颈或扩径；热学参数化为孔壁积分平均曲率、偏离脐性的Willmore型度量及其下一阶的平均曲率加权形式；这些参数均为弛豫时间分布的谱数据；对于流体流过的孤立尖锐边缘，形式展开的奇异项相消，描述仍成立但参数表现为随对数变化的表观值。摘要未给出具体定量误差或实验验证数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把经典黏性与热学特征长度理论推广为可递推到任意阶的高频边界层框架，为多孔介质微几何、声学弛豫谱和尖锐边缘效应提供统一描述；摘要未提供具体应用验证或定量预测精度。

title: A Design Rule for Passive Reconfigurable Microwave Devices
comment: 42 pages total (11 pages main manuscript, 31 pages supplementary information); 9 figures
summary: Every reconfigurable microwave device places a tuning element - a varactor, a diode, transistor, microelectromechanical or phase-change switch, a ferroelectric or liquid-crystal load - inside a fixed passive network. The network can make a small change of the element produce a large change of the response, and design practice often credits it with the device's tuning capability. This paper shows that a fixed, linear, passive network cannot add to that capability. Each tuning element carries a tuning budget, a dimensionless length computed from its own impedance trajectory, and a fixed passive network can transmit that budget or lose part of it, never enlarge it. The unit of the budget is the hyperbolic distance of the Smith chart: the distance from a match is the logarithm of the voltage standing-wave ratio, and the distance between two states sets their mutual mismatch and is the logarithm of their commutation quality factor. From one inequality we derive closed-form, ready-to-use limits for analog and digital phase shifters, true-time-delay lines, switches, attenuators, vector modulators, impedance tuners, tunable filters, reconfigurable antennas, metasurface cells and multiport networks; the two-state and attenuation limits are attained by explicit circuits, and the phase limit by a constant-loss trajectory. We introduce the $Λ$-chart, a Smith-chart companion on which budgets and requirements are read graphically, and apply it to four published microwave case studies.

AI.tldr: 该文证明固定、线性、无源网络不能放大调谐元件的调谐能力，只能传输或损耗其“调谐预算”；以Smith圆图双曲距离为度量，推导多类可重构微波器件的闭式极限，并引入Λ-chart及四个已发表案例的应用。
AI.motivation: 可重构微波器件通常将变容管、二极管、晶体管、MEMS或相变开关、铁电或液晶负载等调谐元件置于固定无源网络中，设计实践常把器件的调谐能力归功于该网络。作者旨在澄清这一认识，建立固定无源网络不能放大调谐能力的基本限制，为器件设计提供性能边界。
AI.method: 将每个调谐元件的阻抗轨迹定义为一个无量纲“调谐预算”，其单位取Smith圆图的双曲距离：离匹配点的距离为电压驻波比的对数，两状态间距离由二者失配决定，并等于其commutation quality factor的对数。通过一个不等式推导模拟与数字移相器、真延时线、开关、衰减器、矢量调制器、阻抗调谐器、可调滤波器、可重构天线、超表面单元及多端口网络的闭式极限；用显式电路验证双态与衰减极限，用恒损耗轨迹验证相位极限，并引入Λ-chart进行图解读取，应用于四个已发表微波案例。
AI.result: 得到上述多类器件的闭式、可直接使用的调谐极限；双态极限和衰减极限可由显式电路达到，相位极限可由恒损耗轨迹达到；提出用于图形化读取预算与要求的Λ-chart，并在四个已发表微波案例中应用。摘要未给出具体数值极限、电路参数或案例的定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 固定、线性、无源网络不能增加调谐元件的调谐预算，只能全部或部分传输该预算，因此不能凭空提升器件的调谐能力；器件可实现的调谐范围受调谐元件自身预算的根本约束。所导出的极限和Λ-chart可作为可重构微波器件设计与评估的边界工具。摘要未提供实验验证细节及量化性能数据。

title: A trust layer for fast pedestal-stability surrogates: calibrated error bars, out-of-distribution alarms and few-shot recalibration
summary: Machine-learning surrogates of linear peeling-ballooning stability now run in milliseconds, but they are mostly deployed as point estimators: they do not say how wrong they may be, or when a query lies outside what they were trained on. For a fusion company designing a new device, every equilibrium of interest is outside the training data of existing surrogates, so this is the case that matters. We describe a model-agnostic trust layer for stability surrogates, made of conformal error bars, out-of-distribution alarms that route doubtful cases to the physics code, and recalibration from a few simulations of a new design, and we test it with pre-registered hypotheses. On a large public dataset of JET-like equilibria with ideal-MHD growth rates, the error bars hold their nominal coverage in distribution and fall short under a shift in plasma shape; a few dozen simulations of the new shape, or routing the cases the alarms flag, restore it. On resistive BOUT++ surrogates, the bars stay calibrated on held-out runs, the alarm flags tokamaks absent from training, and a scenario scan is screened in seconds instead of hours. Across equilibria from the SPARC library and the DIII-D coil set, a surrogate trained on our own graded BOUT++ labels beats the baseline on unseen equilibria, while a surrogate trained elsewhere ranks the same cases backwards and its alarm declines them. Building our own neural-operator surrogate, the harness exposed two input defects whose fix closed its gap to a simple network. For every surrogate tested, the trust layer keeps coverage near target, with a bar width set by that surrogate's own error. Not every pre-registered hypothesis held, and we report those results and the limits of all of them.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模型无关的稳定性代理模型“信任层”，由共形误差条、分布外警报和少样本重校准组成，并在JET类理想MHD、BOUT++、SPARC/DIII-D等数据上检验。
AI.motivation: 机器学习剥离-气球模稳定性代理已能毫秒级运行，但多作为点估计器，不提供误差大小或查询是否超出训练分布的信息；对新装置设计而言，关注的平衡态通常都在既有代理的训练数据之外，因此可信度评估尤为关键。
AI.method: 构建模型无关信任层：用共形预测给出误差条，用分布外警报将可疑案例路由到物理代码，并用新设计的少量模拟进行重校准；以预注册假设测试。评估覆盖JET类平衡态的理想MHD增长率、电阻性BOUT++代理、SPARC库与DIII-D线圈集，并自建神经算子代理。
AI.result: 在分布内误差条达到名义覆盖率，但等离子体形状偏移时覆盖不足；用数十次新形状模拟或按警报路由可恢复。BOUT++代理在留出运行上保持校准，警报能标记训练中未见的托卡马克，场景扫描由小时级降至秒级。SPARC/DIII-D上，自标注BOUT++代理优于基线，外部训练代理排序相反且被警报拒绝；自建神经算子暴露出两个输入缺陷，修复后缩小与简单网络差距。所有测试代理的覆盖率接近目标，条宽由各自误差决定。
AI.conclusion: 该信任层可为聚变稳定性代理提供接近标称的不确定性覆盖和分布外处理，从而支持新设计快速筛选；但形状偏移会削弱覆盖，需要重校准或路由，且并非所有预注册假设都成立，论文报告了未成立结果及各方法局限。

title: Universal Threshold Memory in Bound-State Recapture
summary: Driven slowly, a quantum system forgets how it was driven. We show that a bound state taken slowly to its continuum threshold and back does not. The recaptured fraction depends on the ratio of the approach and return rates, however slow both are. The two rates set the sizes of two threshold packets whose phase-sensitive overlap fixes recapture. Common slowing preserves their size ratio. A factorized treatment of approach and return misses this dependence. For a short-range $s$-wave state whose inverse scattering length touches zero quadratically in time, we obtain the dependence in closed form, with the maximum $1/\varphi^2$ at matched rates, where $\varphi$ is the golden ratio. A ratio of three recaptured fractions makes this threshold memory accessible with finite pulses. For radio-frequency-dressed $^{85}$Rb halo dimers with half-pulse widths of 30 and $120~μ$s, coupled-channel calculations give this ratio within $0.5\%$ of its slow-limit value.

AI.tldr: 将束缚态缓慢调至连续谱阈值再返回时，重新俘获比例不会因驱动足够慢而遗忘历史；它由接近与返回速率之比决定。在短程 s 波、逆散射长度随时间二次过零的模型中可得到闭式结果，最大值为匹配速率时的 1/φ²。
AI.motivation: 通常认为量子系统被足够缓慢地驱动时会忘记驱动方式；本文检验这一直觉在束缚态缓慢到达连续谱阈值并返回的过程中是否成立，并寻求可实验访问的阈值记忆信号。
AI.method: 分析接近与返回两个阈值波包的大小及其相位敏感重叠对重新俘获的约束；对逆散射长度随时间二次过零的短程 s 波态推导闭式依赖；提出用三个重新俘获比例的比值在有限脉冲下探测该记忆；并对半脉冲宽度为 30 和 120 μs 的射频缀饰 85Rb 晕二聚体进行耦合通道计算。
AI.result: 重新俘获比例取决于接近/返回速率之比，即使两者都很慢；共同减慢保持两波包大小比；因子化处理会遗漏该依赖。闭式结果在速率匹配时取最大值 1/φ²（φ 为黄金比例）。对上述 85Rb 晕二聚体，耦合通道计算给出的三比例之比在慢极限值的 0.5% 以内。
AI.conclusion: 慢速驱动并不必然抹去阈值历史；重新俘获体现相位敏感的阈值记忆，且可通过有限脉冲下的三个重新俘获比例之比访问；因子化的接近—返回处理不足以描述该效应。

title: Fracture-Bench: A Controlled Benchmark Suite for Machine Learning Surrogates in Phase-Field Fracture Mechanics
summary: Machine-learning surrogates are increasingly proposed to replace phase-field fracture simulations in many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification, inverse analysis and design. Little controlled evidence shows which architectures are reliable, for which fracture problems and how far beyond their training data. We introduce Fracture-Bench, an open benchmark of two phase-field datasets with fixed splits, common test metrics and a description of each dataset's physical regime. Dataset~1 contains 1,000 AT2 simulations of multiple cracks growing from a notched hole in a hyperelastic plate under random non-uniform biaxial boundary displacements (44 load steps, $128\times128$ grid). Dataset~2 contains 4,000 PF-CZM simulations of a pre-cracked plate with two inclusions, each ten times stiffer or more compliant than the matrix ($128\times256$ grid). We train a Fourier neural operator (FNO), DeepONet, Latent DeepONet, a UNet and a conditional diffusion model on identical splits and compare one test metric per dataset, training time, inference time and model size. On Dataset~1, FNO and Latent DeepONet attain mean test errors of order $10^{-6}$, about ten times lower than UNet and DeepONet. On Dataset~2, the diffusion model is most accurate, with about one sixth of the UNet error, but requires \SI{706}{s} per prediction versus \SI{6}{ms} for UNet. For all architectures, most of the error occurs in the final load steps, after crack localization. Dataset~2 contains initial cracks less than one grid cell apart that produce qualitatively different paths. Architecture rankings therefore depend on the task, and errors averaged over densely sampled inputs reveal little about near-bifurcation cases. Data, codes, splits, regime descriptors and generalization splits are public, with a protocol for adding under-represented regimes such as mixed-mode, three-dimensional and experimentally paired fracture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开放基准 Fracture-Bench，用两个相场断裂数据集、固定数据划分和统一测试指标，在相同条件下比较 FNO、DeepONet、Latent DeepONet、UNet 与条件扩散模型的精度、训练/推理时间和模型大小；结果显示架构排名依赖具体任务，误差主要集中在裂纹局部化后的最后载荷步。
AI.motivation: 机器学习替代模型被越来越多地用于替代相场断裂模拟，以支持不确定性量化、反演分析和设计等多次查询任务；但目前缺乏受控证据说明哪些架构可靠、适用于哪些断裂问题，以及能在训练数据之外推广多远。
AI.method: 构建 Fracture-Bench：数据集1含1000个AT2模拟，研究对象为超弹性板中缺口孔多裂纹在随机非均匀双轴边界位移下的扩展，44个载荷步、128×128网格；数据集2含4000个PF-CZM模拟，研究对象为含两个夹杂的预裂纹板，夹杂刚度至少为基体的10倍或柔度至少为基体的10倍，128×256网格。在相同划分上训练FNO、DeepONet、Latent DeepONet、UNet和条件扩散模型，并比较每个数据集的一个测试指标、训练时间、推理时间和模型大小。
AI.result: 数据集1上，FNO和Latent DeepONet平均测试误差约为10^-6量级，比UNet和DeepONet低约十倍。数据集2上扩散模型最准确，误差约为UNet的六分之一，但每次预测需706 s，而UNet仅需6 ms。所有架构的大部分误差出现在裂纹局部化后的最后载荷步。数据集2包含间距小于一个网格单元的初始裂纹，可产生定性不同的扩展路径。架构排名因此依赖任务，密集采样输入上的平均误差难以反映近分叉情形。数据、代码、划分、物理区域描述和泛化划分均已公开，并提供加入混合模式、三维及实验配对断裂等欠代表区域的协议。
AI.conclusion: 不存在跨任务普遍最优的替代架构；基准表明架构排名具有任务依赖性，评估应关注近分叉样本和具体物理区域，而不能仅依赖密集采样输入上的平均误差。公开的数据、代码、划分和扩展协议为受控比较及补充欠代表断裂区域提供了基础。

title: A plea for Miles' approach to wind-wave interaction
summary: Although the phenomenon of wave growth under the effect of wind still holds many open questions, the approach initiated by Miles [1] is a cornerstone of the current comprehension. This theory is based on physical arguments, keeping phenomenological input to a minimum, but it can be perceived as intimidating, especially in view of concrete applications. Here we argue that Miles' results can be summarised in terms of a simple functional form, which provides an easy-to-use expression to work with. We furthermore show that Miles' predictions do not, as is often stated, underestimate growth rates, once the presence of a whole wave spectrum is accounted for. Finally, we illustrate that the generalisation of Miles' original result to complex hydrodynamic situations can be quite straightforward. Our hands-on summary should make it heretofore very easy to exploit Miles' approach in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文将Miles风浪增长理论概括为简单、易用的函数形式，澄清在考虑完整波谱时该理论并不会低估增长率，并说明其可较直接地推广到复杂水动力情形，从而降低实际应用门槛。
AI.motivation: Miles理论以物理论证为基础、经验输入很少，是理解风作用下波浪增长的重要基石，但其表述对具体应用而言较为艰深、令人望而生畏；作者希望提供便于使用的总结，使该理论更易在实际中应用。
AI.method: 采用理论分析与结果整理的方式：用简单函数形式概括Miles的结果，讨论考虑整个波浪谱时对增长率预测的影响，并展示将Miles原始结果推广到复杂水动力情境的思路。摘要未提供具体数值方法、实验方案或参数设置。
AI.result: 作者给出了Miles结果的易用函数表达式；指出一旦考虑完整波谱，Miles的预测并不像通常所说的那样低估增长率；并表明将原始结果推广到复杂水动力情形可以相当直接。摘要未给出定量增长率数值或验证数据。
AI.conclusion: 对Miles理论的实用化总结有助于在实际问题中更方便地使用该方法，同时纠正了关于增长率被低估的常见说法，并说明该方法可推广至更复杂的水动力条件。

title: Hyperbolic Nanocavities for Single-Molecule Vibrational Strong Coupling
summary: Hyperbolic phonon polaritons (HPhPs) in low-loss anisotropic materials such as hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) provide extreme sub-diffractional field confinement in the mid-infrared, making them attractive for enhancing the interaction of light with molecular vibrations. Collective vibrational strong coupling between molecular ensembles and HPhPs has already been demonstrated in extended slabs. Reaching this regime with a single molecule, however, remains a major challenge, and would provide a platform for investigating how vacuum electromagnetic fields influence molecular dynamics and chemical reactivity. Here, we show theoretically that single-molecule vibrational strong coupling can be reached in hBN nanocavities that laterally confine HPhPs within a finite volume. Combining full-wave electromagnetic simulations with the few-mode quantization approach, we find that these nanocavities support a rich set of asymmetric resonances that strongly enhance the local spectral density, with frequencies that follow from simple HPhP ray trajectories and can be tuned through the cavity aspect ratio. We identify resonances with quality factors of about $600$ and effective mode volumes of $|V_{\mathrm{eff}}| \sim 10^{-7}λ^{3}$, sufficient for single-molecule strong coupling with vibrational transitions with dipole moments on the order of $1\,\mathrm{D}$. These results establish hyperbolic nanocavities as a promising platform for single-molecule vibrational strong coupling and open new routes toward the local control of vibrational dynamics and molecular energy flow.

AI.tldr: 该文从理论上证明，在横向限制双曲声子极化激元的六方氮化硼纳米腔中，可实现单分子振动强耦合；所设计的腔支持高品质因子和极小有效模式体积。
AI.motivation: 六方氮化硼等低损耗各向异性材料中的双曲声子极化激元可在中红外提供极端亚衍射场限制，有望增强光与分子振动的相互作用；扩展平板中的集体振动强耦合已实现，但单分子尺度仍具挑战，且该平台可用于研究真空电磁场对分子动力学和化学反应性的影响。
AI.method: 采用全波电磁模拟结合少模量子化方法，研究横向限制双曲声子极化激元的六方氮化硼纳米腔；分析其非对称共振、局域谱密度增强、共振频率与双曲声子极化激元射线轨迹及腔纵横比的关系。
AI.result: 纳米腔支持丰富的非对称共振并显著增强局域谱密度，共振频率可由简单双曲声子极化激元射线轨迹给出，并可通过腔纵横比调谐；识别出品质因子约600、有效模式体积约10^-7 λ^3的共振，足以与偶极矩约1 D的振动跃迁实现单分子强耦合。
AI.conclusion: 双曲纳米腔是单分子振动强耦合的有前景平台，并为局域调控振动动力学和分子能量流开辟新途径；本文为理论研究，未报道实验验证。

title: Single-crystal X-ray diffraction of BC8 carbon near terapascal pressures
summary: Whether carbon forms crystalline structures beyond diamond at terapascal pressures remains unresolved. Predicted for nearly four decades, the denser BC8 phase has lacked direct crystallographic evidence. Here we report the first direct crystallographic identification of BC8 carbon, formed as a single crystal from molten carbon during laser-driven decaying-shock compression of [100]-oriented diamond following loading above 1.1 TPa. Using in situ orientation-resolved single-crystal X-ray diffraction, we observe discrete Bragg spots whose spacings and angular relationships are reproduced by a common orientation matrix within each indexed BC8 reflection group, providing constraints beyond powder peak matching. Our single-crystal formation strategy and direct diffraction evidence resolve the decades-long quest for a post-diamond carbon structure, demonstrating how dynamic loading pathways can make predicted high-pressure phases experimentally accessible.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了在激光驱动的衰减冲击压缩下，以[100]取向金刚石为起始材料，在超过1.1 TPa的加载条件下，从熔融碳中形成单晶BC8碳，并通过原位取向分辨单晶X射线衍射首次获得其直接晶体学证据。
AI.motivation: 碳在太赫兹压强下是否还能形成金刚石以外的晶态结构仍未解决；BC8相虽已被预测近四十年，但一直缺乏直接晶体学证据。
AI.method: 对[100]取向金刚石施加高于1.1 TPa的激光驱动衰减冲击压缩，使熔融碳形成单晶BC8；采用原位取向分辨单晶X射线衍射，观测离散布拉格斑点，并用各索引BC8反射组内共同的取向矩阵复现其间距和角度关系，超越了粉末峰匹配的约束。
AI.result: 首次直接晶体学识别出BC8碳单晶；离散布拉格斑点的间距与角度关系可由共同取向矩阵再现，提供了超出粉末峰匹配的直接衍射证据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作解决了延续数十年的后金刚石碳结构难题，并表明动态加载路径可使预测的高压相在实验上变得可及。

title: Coherent heat-bath configuration interaction with many-body perturbation theory for multivalent atoms
summary: Combinatorial growth of configuration-interaction spaces limits accurate calculations as the valence-electron number and orbital space increase. To reduce the size of the configuration-interaction space, we develop coherent heat-bath configuration interaction in a configuration-state-function basis and combine it with many-body perturbation theory. Configurations are selected by thresholding their coherent couplings to target wave functions, and a perturbative correction recovers residual valence correlation. For Al, a stringent threshold gives about 16-37 fold compression with excitation-energy deviations from the uncompressed calculations below 0.74 /cm; a looser threshold gives 63-113 fold compression with a maximum deviation of 18.22 /cm. For Si and P, roughly threefold to eightfold compression is achieved with maximum relative deviations of approximately 0.70% and 0.32%, respectively, for optical excitation energies. The perturbative correction improves the accuracy of all calculated total energies. These results support extending the method to high-precision calculations in more complex atomic systems.

AI.tldr: 该文开发了基于组态态函数基的相干热浴组态相互作用方法，并结合多体微扰理论，通过阈值筛选组态与微扰修正残余价电子相关，从而压缩组态相互作用空间；在Al、Si和P上的测试表明该方法可在一定误差范围内显著降低计算规模，并支持推广至更复杂原子体系的高精度计算。
AI.motivation: 价电子数和轨道空间增大时，组态相互作用空间的组合式增长限制了精确计算，因此需要减小组态相互作用空间的规模。
AI.method: 开发了在组态态函数基下的相干热浴组态相互作用方法，并将其与多体微扰理论结合；通过对组态与目标波函数之间的相干耦合进行阈值筛选来选择组态，并用微扰修正恢复残余价电子相关。
AI.result: 对Al，严格阈值实现约16–37倍压缩，激发能偏差低于0.74 /cm；较宽松阈值实现63–113倍压缩，最大偏差为18.22 /cm。对Si和P，实现约3–8倍压缩，光学激发能的最大相对偏差分别约为0.70%和0.32%。微扰修正提高了所有计算总能量的精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该方法有潜力扩展到更复杂原子体系的高精度计算。

title: Noise-resilient collective order through temporal memory in self-propelled particles
summary: Temporal memory can stabilise collective motion by filtering noisy local observations, but persistent information can also impede adaptation when the collective state changes. We investigate this competition in Vicsek-type systems using two distinct alignment rules: a finite buffer of past observations and a recursive update of an internal directional state. In both models, increasing effective memory shifts the loss of polar order to stronger noise and can restore ordered motion under conditions for which the corresponding memoryless Vicsek model is disordered. The stationary responses of the two models show an approximate correspondence when parameterised by a kernel-based effective memory, consistent with temporal averaging playing a common role in their ordering behaviour rather than from the details of the memory implementation. Their transient dynamics, however, are not determined by effective memory alone. Following a collective perturbation, recovery is fastest at an intermediate memory depth and becomes slower when outdated observations are retained too strongly. Temporal integration therefore produces a trade-off: deeper memory improves noise resilience, whereas excessive persistence reduces responsiveness. These results identify memory depth as a control parameter that separates the optimisation of stationary order from that of dynamical recovery in noisy active systems.

AI.tldr: 该文研究Vicsek型集体运动中时间记忆的双重作用：记忆能滤除噪声、稳定极化序，但过度保留旧信息会削弱对集体状态变化的适应；文章比较有限历史缓冲与递归内部方向状态两种对齐规则，发现稳态有序性可由核式有效记忆近似统一描述，而瞬态恢复并非仅由有效记忆决定，存在最佳记忆深度。
AI.motivation: 探究时间记忆在集体运动中的竞争性作用：一方面过滤局部噪声观测以稳定集体运动，另一方面在集体状态改变时，持续保留的信息可能阻碍适应；并在Vicsek型系统中检验这种竞争。
AI.method: 采用两种不同的对齐规则：有限的历史观测缓冲区，以及内部方向状态的递归更新；以基于核的有效记忆对模型进行参数化，并比较两种模型的稳态响应与集体扰动后的瞬态恢复动力学。
AI.result: 两种模型中，增加有效记忆都会使极化序的丧失移到更强的噪声处，并能在无记忆Vicsek模型无序的条件下恢复有序运动；以核式有效记忆参数化时，两模型的稳态响应近似对应，提示时间平均在其有序行为中起共同作用，而非由记忆实现细节决定。瞬态动力学则不由有效记忆单独决定：集体扰动后，恢复在中等记忆深度最快，而过强保留过时观测会使其变慢。
AI.conclusion: 时间积分产生权衡：更深的记忆提高噪声鲁棒性，但过度持久会降低响应能力；记忆深度可作为一个控制参数，将稳态有序性的优化与动力学恢复的优化区分开来。

title: Finite-time mixing and reaction in packed bed reactors
summary: We investigate mixing dynamics in porous media at finite times, using pore-scale lattice-Boltzmann simulations combined with Lagrangian particle tracking. We compute fluid deformation in randomly packed beds based on the moving Protean frame approach introduced by Lester 2018. From the extracted Lagrangian kinematics, we construct a mixing model based on lamellar aggregation that well predicts the Eulerian scalar fields obtained from simulations. Our results reveal an early time mixing regime dominated by shear-driven fluid deformation, where solute mixing arises from the random overlap of diffusive concentration elements. In this regime, mixing proceeds slowly and follows a temporal decay of concentration variance, $σ_c^2 \sim Pe^{-α/(2α+1)} t^{-1/2}$, where Pe is the Peclet number and $α$ the exponent characterizing shear deformation. This dynamic arises when the Peclet number is small relative to the ratio between the exponential-mixing and shear-deformation timescales. This analysis also demonstrates that shear-induced mixing govern the homogenization of early-stage reactions at the fluid-solid interface in finite-size random packed beds, typically operating at moderate Peclet numbers $Pe =O(10^2)$.

AI.tldr: 本文利用孔隙尺度格子玻尔兹曼模拟与拉格朗日粒子追踪，研究有限时间下多孔介质中的混合动力学；基于Protean框架提取随机填充床中的流体变形，并构建层状聚集混合模型预测欧拉标量场，揭示由剪切主导的早期混合机制及其标度规律。
AI.motivation: 研究有限时间下多孔介质中的混合动力学，重点关注随机填充床中早期混合的形成机制，以及剪切变形如何控制有限尺寸填充床内流体-固体界面早期反应的均匀化。
AI.method: 采用孔隙尺度格子玻尔兹曼模拟结合拉格朗日粒子追踪；基于Lester 2018提出的移动Protean框架计算随机填充床中的流体变形；从拉格朗日运动学信息构建基于层状聚集的混合模型，并与模拟得到的欧拉标量场进行对比。
AI.result: 层状聚集混合模型能较好预测模拟得到的欧拉标量场。结果识别出由剪切驱动流体变形主导的早期混合区制：溶质混合源于扩散浓度元素的随机重叠，混合进行较慢，浓度方差呈 σ_c^2 ∼ Pe^{-α/(2α+1)} t^{-1/2} 的时间衰减，其中Pe为Peclet数、α为表征剪切变形的指数；该动力学出现在Pe相对于指数混合时间尺度与剪切变形时间尺度之比很小的情形。分析还表明，剪切诱导混合控制有限尺寸随机填充床中流体-固体界面早期反应的均匀化，典型工况为中等Peclet数 Pe=O(10^2)。
AI.conclusion: 随机填充床有限时间混合存在剪切驱动的早期区制，其浓度方差具有与Pe和剪切变形指数α相关的幂律衰减；层状聚集模型可连接拉格朗日运动学与欧拉标量场，并说明剪切诱导混合对中等Peclet数下流体-固体界面早期反应的均匀化具有控制作用。

title: Spatial structure of surface plasmon resonance under narrow-beam illumination and its implications for sensing
summary: The reflection of light on a surface plasmon resonance structure can be understood as the interference between the direct Fresnel reflection and the light radiated back by the plasmon as it propagates along the metal film. When the beam waist is only an order of magnitude larger than the surface plasmon propagation length, these two contributions separate spatially, and their destructive interference localizes into a dark fringe within the reflected beam. We develop an analytical model of this effect, design a realistic setup based on off-the-shelf components to observe it, and simulate the complete experiment, from illumination to detection, with an open-source framework. In the regime where the interference is maximized, the spatial structure of the reflected beam becomes extremely sensitive to the outer medium. This allows us to define an observable more than an order of magnitude more sensitive than amplitude-based measurements, and we expect a comparable improvement in resolution.

AI.tldr: 该文将表面等离激元共振结构上的反射解释为直接菲涅耳反射与沿金属膜传播的表面等离激元回辐射光之间的干涉；当束腰仅比传播长度大约一个量级时，两者在空间上分离，并在反射光束内形成暗条纹。作者建立解析模型、设计基于现货器件的实验方案，并用开源框架进行从照明到探测的全流程仿真，提出对外部介质更灵敏的观测量。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解和观测表面等离激元回辐射与直接反射之间的空间干涉及暗条纹效应，并利用干涉最大化时反射光束空间结构对外部介质的高度敏感性实现更灵敏的测量；摘要未进一步说明具体应用场景。
AI.method: 建立该干涉效应的解析模型；基于现货组件设计可观测该效应的现实实验装置；使用开源框架对从照明到探测的完整实验进行仿真。
AI.result: 当束腰仅比表面等离激元传播长度大约一个量级时，两种贡献在空间上分离，其相消干涉在反射光束内局域为暗条纹；在干涉最大化条件下，反射光束的空间结构对外部介质极为敏感。作者据此定义了一个比基于振幅的测量灵敏一个数量级以上的观测量，并预计分辨率可获得相当程度的提升。
AI.conclusion: 该空间干涉效应可被建模、实验设计并全流程仿真，其暗条纹及反射光束空间结构提供了比振幅测量更灵敏的观测途径，并有望带来分辨率的可比提升；摘要未给出具体实验测量数据或定量分辨率数值。

title: Modeling runaway electron mitigation via passively driven plasma instabilities in a high-current tokamak
summary: A critical challenge for tokamak-based fusion power plants is the formation of high-current, relativistic runaway electron (RE) beams during abrupt confinement loss events called disruptions. RE beams may significantly damage machine components if left unmitigated, jeopardizing the operational and economic viability of fusion power plants. We present the first self-consistent extended magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) computational study of RE mitigation with a passively driven RE mitigation coil (REMC) in a high-current tokamak. RE generation and transport are coupled with REMC-driven MHD activity in a 3D simulation that models the thermal and current quench phases of a mid-plane disruption, together with the vertical displacement and final termination of the plasma and RE beam on SPARC -- a high-field, high-current tokamak designed to achieve a fusion gain Q > 1. We demonstrate that REMC-driven magnetic stochasticity can reduce the RE current by over an order-of-magnitude when compared to unmitigated disruptions. The final termination is mediated via a post-thermal-quench "cold" vertical displacement of the plasma, which, together with magnetic stochasticity, increases RE losses via scrape-off once the plasma contacts the first wall. These results demonstrate a viable mechanism for RE mitigation using passively driven plasma instabilities on high-current tokamaks.

AI.tldr: 该文首次用自洽扩展MHD三维模拟研究高电流托卡马克中被动驱动REMC对逃逸电子束的缓解；在SPARC上模拟中平面破裂的熱淬灭与电流淬灭、垂直位移及最终终止，发现REMC驱动的磁随机性可将RE电流降低一个数量级以上，并提出一种可行的被动缓解机制。
AI.motivation: 托卡马克聚变电厂在突然约束丧失的破裂事件中会形成高电流、相对论性逃逸电子束，若未缓解可能严重损坏机器部件，威胁聚变电厂运行与经济可行性，因此需要研究有效的RE缓解方案。
AI.method: 开展首个自洽扩展磁流体力学计算研究，在高电流托卡马克中用被动驱动的RE缓解线圈（REMC）缓解RE；在SPARC上建立三维模拟，将RE产生与输运同REMC驱动的MHD活动耦合，模拟中平面破裂的热淬灭和电流淬灭阶段，以及等离子体和RE束的垂直位移与最终终止。
AI.result: REMC驱动的磁随机性相比未缓解破裂可将RE电流降低一个数量级以上；最终终止由热淬灭后的“冷”垂直位移主导，并且当等离子体接触第一壁后，磁随机性叠加该垂直位移会通过刮削层增加RE损失。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，利用被动驱动的等离子体不稳定性在高电流托卡马克上实现RE缓解是可行的机制；摘要未提供实验验证或更详细的定量预测。

title: $^{85}$Rb electromagnetically induced transparency and absorption on two collinear $5S_{1/2}\rightarrow5P_{1/2}\rightarrow5D_{3/2}\rightarrow 25F_{5/2}$ three-photon cascade schemes
comment: 11 pages and 7 figures in the main text; 3 pages of Supplemental Material
summary: We present a comprehensive study of three-photon electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) and absorption (EIA) in room-temperature Rb vapor. Using the cascade system $5S_{1/2}\rightarrow5P_{1/2}\rightarrow5D_{3/2}\rightarrow 25F_{5/2}$ in $^{85}$Rb, we explore two collinear laser-beam configurations. The detunings of the upper two lasers of the cascade system are varied. In both configurations, the probe transmission maps contain rich sets of EIT/EIA features and substructures. To explain these, we utilize a dressed-atom and a quantum Monte Carlo trajectory method. The latter includes 108 relevant fine- and hyperfine-structure levels and their magnetic substates, accounting for coherent optical drives, optical pumping, atom recycling, electromagnetic decays via the $5P_{J}$ levels, and velocity-changing and hyperfine collisions. We find quantum-trajectory solutions of the Lindblad master equation, which show good agreement with experimental data and aid in finding physical explanations for the observed spectra. To further explore collision-induced spectral features, collisional loss of EIT/EIA visibility, velocity-changing and hyperfine collisions, we acquire spectra in Rb cells with 50 and 500~mTorr of Ar gas. Our work is of interest to studies of multi-level EIT systems that underpin emerging quantum technologies, where accurate accounting of internal atomic structure, laser beam geometry, optical pumping, transit time, and collisional effects is critical.

AI.tldr: 本文在室温铷蒸气中系统研究三光子电磁诱导透明（EIT）与电磁诱导吸收（EIA），利用85Rb级联能级和两种共线激光配置获得丰富的EIT/EIA光谱结构，并用缀饰原子与量子蒙特卡罗轨迹方法解释实验，还通过充Ar气池研究碰撞效应。
AI.motivation: 为深入理解多能级EIT系统中的复杂光谱特征及其在新型量子技术中的应用，需要准确考虑原子内部结构、激光几何、光泵浦、渡越时间和碰撞效应；本文据此研究室温Rb中的三光子EIT/EIA。
AI.method: 采用85Rb的5S1/2→5P1/2→5D3/2→25F5/2级联系统，在两种共线激光束配置下改变级联系统上两束激光的失谐，测量探针透射映射；使用缀饰原子模型和量子蒙特卡罗轨迹方法求解Lindblad主方程的量子轨迹解，模型包含108个相关精细/超精细结构能级及其磁子能级，并考虑相干光驱动、光泵浦、原子再循环、经5PJ能级的电磁衰变、速度改变碰撞和超精细碰撞；另在充有50和500 mTorr Ar气的Rb池中测量光谱以研究碰撞诱导特征。
AI.result: 实验映射呈现丰富的EIT/EIA特征及子结构；量子轨迹解与实验数据吻合良好，并有助于解释观测光谱。充Ar气实验用于进一步研究碰撞导致的EIT/EIA可见度损失、速度改变碰撞和超精细碰撞等光谱特征。摘要未给出具体定量性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作有助于研究支撑新兴量子技术的多能级EIT系统，表明准确计入内部原子结构、激光束几何、光泵浦、渡越时间和碰撞效应对相关研究至关重要；具体应用性能结论摘要未提供。

title: Site-orbit masked twin-branch Transformer for symmetry-constrained crystal generation
summary: Generative models for crystal structure prediction (CSP) have expanded the search space for novel materials and improved screening efficiency. However, simultaneously generating stable and novel structures remains challenging because of the complex structural and physical constraints governing crystals. To address this challenge, we propose site-orbit masked twin-branch Transformer model (ST2M), a symmetry-guided discrete--continuous diffusion framework incorporating degree-of-freedom masks and conditioned on Wyckoff patterns. ST2M represents crystal structures as sequences of independent occupied Wyckoff orbits and employs a twin-branch Transformer to jointly denoise discrete and continuous variables. In our experiments, ST2M achieves a structural validity of 96.37\%. For known patterns in dataset, 23.86\% of generated structures simultaneously satisfy stability, uniqueness, and novelty criteria, representing a relative improvement of 68.15\% over the best-performing baseline. First-principles calculations identify a total of 21 previously unreported stable structures among selected candidates with low predicted energies. These results demonstrate that ST2M can generate chemically viable crystal candidates under prescribed crystallographic constraints and generalize to unknown Wyckoff patterns, providing a practical route to accelerated materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ST2M——一种以Wyckoff模式为条件、结合自由度掩码的对称性引导离散-连续扩散框架，用双分支Transformer联合去噪晶体结构的离散与连续变量。实验结构有效率达96.37%；已知Wyckoff模式下23.86%的生成结构同时满足稳定、唯一和新颖，较最佳基线相对提升68.15%；第一性原理计算确认21个此前未报道的稳定结构。
AI.motivation: 晶体结构预测的生成模型虽扩展了新材料搜索空间并提升筛选效率，但受复杂结构与物理约束影响，同时生成稳定且新颖的晶体结构仍具挑战。
AI.method: 将晶体结构表示为独立占据的Wyckoff轨道序列，以Wyckoff模式为条件，引入自由度掩码，构建对称性引导的离散-连续扩散框架ST2M，并采用双分支Transformer联合去噪离散变量和连续变量。
AI.result: ST2M结构有效率为96.37%；在数据集的已知模式中，23.86%的生成结构同时满足稳定性、唯一性和新颖性，较最佳基线相对提升68.15%；第一性原理计算在低预测能候选结构中识别出21个此前未报道的稳定结构。
AI.conclusion: ST2M能够在指定晶体学约束下生成化学可行的候选晶体，并可泛化至未知Wyckoff模式，为加速材料发现提供了实用路径。

title: Rheology and Velocity Distribution of Couette Flow for Protoplasmic Streaming
summary: We investigate two-dimensional Couette flow between parallel plates as a model of protoplasmic streaming in plant cells using a combined Langevin and Navier?Stokes simulation. The interaction between the fluid and biological materials is implemented using a Finsler geometry (FG) modeling technique, in which the interaction strength, represented by quantities such as relative viscosity, effectively varies with an internal degree of freedom (IDOF) associated with the biological materials. The simulations demonstrate that the Couette flow exhibits a linear velocity profile along the vertical direction perpendicular to the plates, as well as a peak structure in the velocity distribution consistent with reported experimental observations obtained by laser light scattering. The simulations also demonstrate that the model exhibits shear-thinning behavior typical of non-Newtonian fluids, with the viscosity minimized in the boundary region. Additionally, we find that the rheological properties are connected to the conformal transformation of the interaction between the fluid and the IDOF. Within the FG modeling framework, the conformally flat configuration of the IDOF, which is neither anisotropic nor randomly isotropic, is introduced as a minimum-energy state that characterizes the shear-thinning rheological properties of two-dimensional Couette flow.

AI.tldr: 该文以平行板间二维库埃特流为植物细胞原生质流动模型，采用朗之万与纳维-斯托克斯联合模拟及芬斯勒几何建模，发现线性速度剖面、速度分布峰结构、剪切变稀行为，并将流变性质与流体-内部自由度相互作用的共形变换及共形平坦最小能量态联系起来。
AI.motivation: 研究植物细胞中原生质流动的物理机制，并以平行板间二维库埃特流作为简化模型，重点考察流体与生物材料之间的相互作用及其对流变性质的影响。
AI.method: 采用朗之万动力学与纳维-斯托克斯方程相结合的模拟方法；用芬斯勒几何建模技术描述流体与生物材料的相互作用，使相对黏度等相互作用强度随生物材料的内部自由度变化；并分析流体-内部自由度相互作用与共形变换的关系。
AI.result: 模拟得到垂直于平行板方向的线性速度剖面，以及速度分布中的峰结构，与激光光散射实验观察一致；模型表现出非牛顿流体典型的剪切变稀行为，且黏度在边界区域最小；流变性质与流体-内部自由度相互作用的共形变换相关。
AI.conclusion: 在芬斯勒几何建模框架内，内部自由度的共形平坦构型被引入为最小能量态，该构型既非各向异性也非随机各向同性，并可表征二维库埃特流的剪切变稀流变特性；摘要未提供定量参数、实验对比细节及更广泛的适用性验证。

title: Closed-form dyadic Green functions for transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars
summary: A transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars was conceived by Weiglhofer in 1994. Using the scalar factorization method, he concluded that the dyadic Green functions of this medium could not be found in closed form. That conclusion is incorrect. The essentials of the derivation are reproduced here, and closed-form expressions are given for all four dyadic Green functions of the unbounded medium, linking the electric and magnetic fields to electric and magnetic source current densities.

AI.tldr: 本文指出 Weiglhofer 1994 年关于横向单轴双各向异性介质（磁电标量相等）无法获得闭式并矢格林函数的结论有误，并给出无界介质中四个并矢格林函数的闭式表达式。
AI.motivation: 纠正 Weiglhofer 基于标量分解法得出的“无法闭式求解”结论，并补全该介质中电场、磁场与电、磁源电流密度之间关系的闭式格林函数描述。
AI.method: 复现原推导的关键步骤，并针对磁电标量相等的横向单轴双各向异性无界介质，推导并给出四个并矢格林函数的闭式表达式。
AI.result: 得到了无界介质中全部四个并矢格林函数的闭式表达式，这些函数将电场和磁场与电流源密度和磁流源密度联系起来。
AI.conclusion: Weiglhofer 关于该介质并矢格林函数不能以闭式形式得到的结论不正确；本文表明其闭式表达式是存在的。

title: Eddy currents and error fields in the toroidally segmented shell configuration aka Armadillo
summary: A stream function formulation for the calculation of the eddy current distribution in a toroidally segmented conducting shell (Armadillo) is presented and verified. The governing Poisson-like equation is solved spectrally via a Discrete Sine Transform, which enforces the zero-current boundary condition at each gap exactly by construction, and the related radial magnetic field at the plasma surface is obtained by Biot-Savart integration. The toroidal eddy current flows in the same direction on every sector with a cosine-like poloidal distribution, while the poloidal return current, required by current continuity, peaks near each gap and reverses sign between adjacent sectors. The scaling of both components with the number of gaps is governed by the competition between the poloidal geometric scale of the shell and the toroidal segmentation scale. The transition between the two regimes is set by the aspect ratio of the device, around eight gaps for an RFX-mod2-like geometry, as predicted by the analytical wall time model of the Armadillo configuration. At the gap, the poloidal return current produces a radial field of opposite sign to the value far from the gap; the resulting non-axisymmetric error field peaks near this transition and becomes negligible for highly segmented shells. These results provide a first characterisation of the eddy currents and error fields of the Armadillo configuration, needed for future resistive wall mode and tearing mode stability analyses.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证了用于环向分段导体壳（Armadillo）涡流分布的流函数模型：以离散正弦变换谱方法求解类泊松方程并严格满足各间隙零电流边界，再用Biot-Savart积分求等离子体表面径向磁场；分析了环向与极向电流分量随间隙数的标度及非轴对称误差场，指出过渡由装置纵横比决定，RFX-mod2类几何约为8个间隙。
AI.motivation: 针对Armadillo配置，需要计算环向分段导体壳中的涡流分布及其在等离子体表面产生的径向磁场，为未来阻性壁模和撕裂模稳定性分析提供该配置涡流与误差场的首次表征。
AI.method: 采用流函数表述建立类泊松控制方程，并通过离散正弦变换进行谱求解；该离散化在构造上精确满足每个间隙处的零电流边界条件。等离子体表面的相关径向磁场由Biot-Savart积分获得。分析中考察环向涡流与由电流连续性要求的极向回流随间隙数的标度，并用Armadillo配置的解析壁时间模型预测两种标度区间的过渡。摘要未给出具体的数值验证设置和误差量化细节。
AI.result: 环向涡流在每个扇区沿同一方向流动，极向分布呈类余弦形式；满足电流连续性的极向回流在每个间隙附近达到峰值，并在相邻扇区之间改变符号。两类分量随间隙数的标度由壳体的极向几何尺度与环向分段尺度之间的竞争决定，过渡由装置纵横比设定，RFX-mod2类几何约为8个间隙，与Armadillo配置的解析壁时间模型预测一致。在间隙处，极向回流产生的径向场与远离间隙处的值符号相反；由此形成的非轴对称误差场在过渡附近达到峰值，并在高度分段壳体中变得可忽略。摘要未提供误差场幅值等定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了Armadillo配置涡流与误差场的首次表征，表明环向与极向电流分量及误差场行为受极向几何尺度、环向分段尺度和装置纵横比共同控制，约8个间隙对应RFX-mod2类几何的过渡点，高度分段时非轴对称误差场可忽略。这些结果为后续阻性壁模和撕裂模稳定性分析提供了基础；摘要未给出验证细节和定量误差场幅值。

title: Nuclear Charge Radii from Precision Bound-Electron g-Factor Measurements
summary: An efficient method to determine absolute nuclear charge radii from high-precision bound-electron g-factor measurements in hydrogenlike ions is put forward. Assuming that a nuclear model independent radius determination is possible, we demonstrate that this method can improve the precision of the nuclear radius for several poorly known heavy isotopes by up to two orders of magnitude compared to current literature values, by utilizing recent breakthroughs in the quantum electrodynamics (QED) theory of the bound-electron g-factor [B. Sikora, V. A. Yerokhin, C. H. Keitel, and Z. Harman, Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 123001 (2025)]. This opens a new, independent pathway for testing nuclear structure models and resolving nuclear structure anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用氢样离子中高精度束缚电子g因子测量来确定绝对核电荷半径的高效方法；在假设可实现不依赖核模型的半径提取的前提下，可显著提高若干重同位素的核半径精度，并开辟检验核结构模型的新途径。
AI.motivation: 若干重同位素的核半径精度不足，且需要独立于核结构模型的半径确定途径，以检验核结构模型并解析核结构异常。
AI.method: 基于氢样离子中高精度束缚电子g因子测量，结合近期束缚电子g因子量子电动力学理论的突破，在假设可进行核模型无关半径确定的条件下提取绝对核电荷半径；摘要未给出具体离子、实验参数或数据处理细节。
AI.result: 摘要称，对若干精度较差的重同位素，该方法相较当前文献值可将核半径精度提高最多两个数量级；摘要未列出具体同位素及数值误差。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为绝对核电荷半径测量提供了独立于核模型的新途径，有望用于检验核结构模型和解决核结构异常；其实际适用范围与实验可行性需由全文进一步验证。

title: Maximal correlation and optimal transformations of probability distributions in tensor-train format: a variational algorithm
summary: The correlation between two subsystems $A$ and $B$ of a many-body system is usually measured through a pair of observables chosen in advance. The Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi maximal correlation removes the choice: it is the largest correlation coefficient between any function of the configuration of $A$ and any function of the configuration of $B$, and the two functions that reach it, the optimal transformations, are the observables that carry the correlation. Both follow from a singular value decomposition (SVD) of the joint distribution normalized by its marginals, a matrix whose dimension is the number of configurations. We show that this SVD can be computed variationally for a classical distribution of discrete variables, such as the Boltzmann distribution of a spin model, given in the tensor-train (matrix-product) format, without ever forming the matrix. The optimal transformations are sought as tensor trains; each step updates a single core in closed form, and the inverse of a small matrix contracted from the distribution and the remaining cores performs the division by the marginals core by core. Every iterate is a feasible pair, so the objective is a lower bound on the maximal correlation that increases monotonically, and the cost grows linearly with the number of variables. The algorithm reproduces the exact SVD on small systems, recovers the known nonlinear optimal transformations of synthetic distributions of up to ten angular variables ($10^{15}$ configurations), and, for the bipartite antiferromagnetic model with $2^{32}$ configurations, returns an optimal transformation that is a function of the group magnetization, linear above the transition and sign-like below it: the staggered order parameter is read off from the distribution instead of being postulated.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种在张量列（矩阵乘积）格式下变分计算离散变量联合分布SVD的方法，无需显式构造大矩阵即可获得HGR最大相关及对应的最优变换。
AI.motivation: 通常用预先选定的观测量衡量子系统A与B的相关性；HGR最大相关通过在所有函数对中取最大相关系数来消除观测量的选择，但其计算依赖按边际归一化联合分布的SVD，矩阵维度等于配置数，直接计算在大系统中不可行。
AI.method: 将两个最优变换参数化为张量列，逐核进行闭式更新；利用由分布与其余核收缩得到的小矩阵之逆，逐核完成对边际分布的除法；每次迭代均得到可行函数对，因此目标值是最大相关的单调递增下界，计算成本随变量数线性增长。
AI.result: 算法在小系统上复现精确SVD；在最多十个角度变量、10^15个配置的合成分布上恢复已知的非线性最优变换；对具有2^32个配置的二分反铁磁模型，得到的最优变换是集团磁化的函数，在相变以上呈线性、以下呈符号型，从而由分布直接读出交错序参量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可扩展的变分方法，在不形成完整矩阵的情况下计算HGR最大相关和最优变换，并能从分布中直接识别序参量。

title: A physics-informed neural network method for pressure-driven turbine-blade optimization
summary: We develop a physics-informed method for aerodynamic shape optimisation of turbine blades, treating the flow field and blade geometry as coupled unknowns. The method translates prescribed surface-pressure distributions into geometric modifications through pressure-target continuation and alternating flow-geometry updates. A differentiable representation of the blade surfaces allows their positions and orientations to be optimised within the current flow field, followed by flow re-adaptation to the modified boundaries. The inverse formulation uses the two-dimensional steady compressible Euler equations as physics constraints and is evaluated on the LS89 turbine cascade using 28 pressure-target points derived from experimental data. Starting from a modified profile and a warm-started flow network, the final pressure-side and suction-side root-mean-square fitting errors are 1.13% and 2.21% of inlet total pressure, respectively. Independent forward verification with SharC reproduces the principal surface-pressure trends of the experimental measurements, with remaining differences near the trailing edge. These results demonstrate the translation of experimental-origin loading data into geometric blade modifications through coordinated optimisation of the flow field and moving boundaries.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种以二维定常可压缩Euler方程为物理约束的物理信息反设计方法，通过压力目标延拓和流场-几何交替更新，将实验来源的表面压力分布转化为LS89涡轮叶片的几何修形；压力面与吸力面均方根误差分别为进口总压的1.13%和2.21%。
AI.motivation: 将给定的表面压力分布转化为涡轮叶片几何修改，并把流场与叶片几何作为耦合未知量处理，从而利用实验来源的载荷数据进行气动外形优化。
AI.method: 采用物理信息反设计框架，以二维定常可压缩Euler方程为物理约束；通过压力目标延拓及流场-几何交替更新求解。利用可微的叶片表面表示，在当前流场中优化叶片位置与姿态，随后对修改后的边界重新适配流场。在LS89涡轮叶栅上使用由实验数据得到的28个压力目标点进行评估，并从修改型线和热启动流网络开始迭代。
AI.result: 最终压力面和吸力面的均方根拟合误差分别为进口总压的1.13%和2.21%。使用SharC进行独立正向验证，可复现实验测量的主要表面压力趋势，但尾缘附近仍存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过流场与移动边界的协同优化，可将实验来源的载荷数据转化为几何叶片修改；尾缘附近的剩余差异表明该反设计方法仍有改进空间。

title: BIC-Engineered Silicon Nitride Microring Resonators Enabled by an Etch-Free Laser-Writing Approach
summary: We report the initial experimental demonstration of a complementary, etch-free approach with fewer fabrication steps, in useful SU-8 ridges written by direct ultraviolet laser lithography on an unpatterned silicon nitride film define waveguides and microring resonators. Because the nitride film is never patterned, scattering at patterned nitride sidewalls does not arise, and the remaining radiative loss is engineered by design. The guided transverse-magnetic mode lies within the continuum of transverse-electric slab modes, and we use bound states in the continuum (BICs) as a design tool to control this radiation. Coupled-mode analysis and full-vectorial simulations show that radiation from the two ridge sidewalls cancels by destructive interference at discrete widths, with a first BIC at 2.25 micron and radiation below 1 dB/cm over a 0.3 micron width window and about 200 nm of bandwidth, and that curvature confines this cancellation to discrete bands of bending radius and width. Laser-written waveguides follow the predicted width dependence of the loss, reaching approximately 1.5 dB/cm near the BIC, where non-radiative loss dominates. A microring designed on a radius-selected BIC band exhibits loaded quality factors up to 1.6 \times 10^4 and, under the over-coupled assignment supported by a coupler model, an intrinsic quality factor of 3.3 \times 10^5. Because radiation is set by a patterned low-index layer on an unetched film, the same approach could be extended to other nanostructures. Optimization of the writing conditions and materials is ongoing.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实验演示了一种互补的免刻蚀、少步骤方案：在未图案化的氮化硅薄膜上用直接紫外激光光刻写出的SU-8脊形结构定义波导与微环谐振器，并利用连续域束缚态（BIC）控制辐射损耗；实验波导损耗约1.5 dB/cm，微环负载品质因子最高1.6×10^4，在过耦合判定下本征品质因子为3.3×10^5。
AI.motivation: 为提供一种互补、免刻蚀且 fabrication steps 更少的实现途径，避免对氮化硅薄膜进行图案化，从而消除图案化氮化硅侧壁引起的散射，并通过设计调控剩余辐射损耗。
AI.method: 在未图案化的氮化硅薄膜上，用直接紫外激光光刻写入SU-8脊形结构，以此定义波导和微环谐振器；由于氮化硅薄膜不被刻蚀，利用BIC作为设计工具控制位于TE平板模式连续谱中的导引TM模式的辐射；采用耦合模分析和全矢量仿真预测宽度与弯曲半径相关的辐射抵消，并实验测量激光写入波导的宽度依赖损耗及微环谐振特性。
AI.result: 仿真表明两个脊侧壁的辐射在离散宽度上因相消干涉而抵消，首个BIC出现在2.25 μm宽度处，并在0.3 μm宽度窗口和约200 nm带宽内实现低于1 dB/cm的辐射；曲率将该抵消限制在离散的弯曲半径与宽度带内。激光写入波导的损耗随宽度变化与预测一致，在BIC附近达到约1.5 dB/cm，此时非辐射损耗占主导。按半径选择的BIC带设计的微环，其负载品质因子最高达1.6×10^4；在耦合器模型支持的过耦合判定下，本征品质因子为3.3×10^5。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在未刻蚀薄膜上由图案化低折射率层设定辐射，可作为一种可扩展的免刻蚀方法用于其他纳米结构；写入条件和材料的优化仍在进行中。

title: The preplasma origin of the plasma-mirror reflectivity response
summary: Plasma mirrors (PM) enhance the temporal contrast of high-power lasers, but declining reflectivity at subrelativistic intensities limits their energy throughput. Here we show that prepulse-generated preplasma drives this decline in p polarization primarily through absorption. Particle-in-cell simulations using a measured prepulse profile reproduce the reflectivity decrease, with near- and far-field energy accounting showing a weak contribution from scattering. Optical-cycle-resolved electron tracking reveals successive electron bunches extracted from the plasma surface, supporting a vacuum-heating interpretation. Under the simulated conditions, s-polarized absorption remains weak and no comparable decline occurs. Applying the model to two representative double-plasma-mirror (DPM) systems, BELLA and CoReLS, it captures both the p-polarized and s-polarized reflectivity responses across the operating range. Yet, the model still misses the high-fluence s-polarized reflectivity rollover, and further investigation of the scattering channel might be needed.
