These findings connect prepulse history to polarization-dependent energy loss, informing the choice of plasma-mirror operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 该文研究等离子体镜在亚相对论强度下反射率下降的机制，指出预脉冲产生的预等离子体主要通过吸收导致p偏振反射率降低，散射贡献较弱；模型可描述BELLA与CoReLS双等离子体镜系统的偏振反射率响应，但仍未解释高注量s偏振反射率滚降。
AI.motivation: 等离子体镜可提升高功率激光的时间对比度，但其在亚相对论强度下反射率下降，限制能量吞吐；因此需要厘清预脉冲历史、预等离子体与偏振相关的能量损失机制，为等离子体镜工作条件选择提供依据。
AI.method: 采用实测预脉冲剖面驱动的粒子网格（PIC）模拟复现反射率下降；通过近场和远场能量核算评估散射贡献；利用光学周期分辨的电子追踪分析电子束团；并将模型应用于BELLA和CoReLS两个代表性双等离子体镜系统。
AI.result: 模拟表明p偏振反射率下降主要来自吸收，散射贡献较弱；光学周期分辨电子追踪显示等离子体表面连续抽取电子束团，支持真空加热解释；在所模拟条件下s偏振吸收较弱且无相当程度的反射率下降；模型捕捉了两个DPM系统在工作范围内的p偏振和s偏振反射率响应，但未捕捉高注量s偏振反射率滚降，散射通道仍需进一步研究。
AI.conclusion: 研究将预脉冲历史与偏振相关的能量损失联系起来，可为等离子体镜工作条件的选择提供参考；高注量s偏振反射率滚降及散射通道机制尚未完全解决。摘要未提供具体数值参数。

title: Finesse evolution in a bichromatic cavity under blue and red resonant illumination in vacuum
summary: The long-term performance of high-finesse optical cavities depends on the stability of their mirror coatings under vacuum and under continuous exposure to high circulating power. In cavities supporting multiple wavelengths, a central question is whether degradation at one wavelength compromises performance at another. Understanding this interplay is essential for those cavity quantum electrodynamics experiments that need diverse optical fields for cavity stabilization, trapping, and light--matter coupling. Here, we investigate wavelength-dependent degradation and recovery of a bichromatic cavity with high-reflectivity coating at 455 nm and 671 nm in vacuum. Cavity ring-down measurements reveal a decrease in the 455 nm finesse from 7.7*10^3 to 1.9*10^3 after 11 hours of continuous exposure to high circulating power. Simultaneous measurements show no measurable degradation at 671 nm. Continuous operation at 671 nm, instead, produces no measurable degradation at either wavelength under the tested conditions. Comparison of oxygen depletion and Avrami-type loss models indicates kinetics compatible with nucleation and growth, without uniquely identifying the microscopic mechanism. We demonstrate partial recovery of the finesse with illumination at 455 nm in air. Our results indicate a wavelength dependence of laser-induced optical damage in bichromatic cavities and provide an estimate of the blue light intensity that can be safely used in such cavities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双色高精细度光学腔在真空和高循环功率下，455 nm与671 nm高反涂层的波长相关退化与恢复；455 nm精细度在连续11小时高功率暴露后显著下降，而671 nm无可测退化，并可在空气中以455 nm光照部分恢复。
AI.motivation: 高精细度光学腔的长期性能取决于镜面涂层在真空及连续高循环功率下的稳定性；对于支持多波长的腔，需要理解一个波长处的退化是否会损害另一波长的性能，这关系到需要多种光场进行腔稳定、 trapping 和光—物质耦合的腔量子电动力学实验。
AI.method: 对具有455 nm和671 nm高反涂层的双色腔在真空中开展腔衰荡测量，连续施加高循环功率并同时监测两个波长的精细度；比较氧耗尽模型与Avrami型损耗模型的动力学，并在空气中用455 nm光照测试恢复。
AI.result: 连续高功率暴露11小时后，455 nm精细度由7.7×10^3降至1.9×10^3；同时测量显示671 nm无可测退化。连续在671 nm运行在测试条件下未造成任一波长可测退化。模型比较表明损耗动力学与成核和生长相容，但未唯一确定微观机制；空气中455 nm光照可实现精细度部分恢复。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明双色腔中激光诱导光学损伤具有波长依赖性，并给出了此类腔中可安全使用的蓝光强度估计；但摘要未给出具体安全强度数值。

title: Quantum simulation of dissipative acoustic and elastic waves by Schrödingerisation: absorbing boundaries and explicit polynomial-size circuits
summary: Explicit quantum circuits for the acoustic and elastic wave equations, obtained by Hamiltonian simulation of their first-order forms, conserve energy and therefore describe closed domains: an outgoing wave reflects off the edge of the computational region or, with periodic boundaries, wraps around and re-enters from the opposite side. We open the domain with the simplest physical absorber, a graded sponge layer in which every wave field is damped at a rate that grows towards the outer edge, and implement the resulting dissipative dynamics on a quantum simulator by Schrödingerisation, which turns a non-unitary linear evolution into a family of unitary ones by means of a single auxiliary variable. We derive the whole chain from the partial differential equation to the circuit, in one, two and three dimensions. An independent finite-difference solver confirms that damping all wave fields absorbs far better than the common velocity-only damping mask. For the sponge the quantum analysis is sharp: recovery is exact on the whole non- negative half of the auxiliary axis at every time; that axis can be truncated periodically at a length set by the largest damping rate and the simulated time; and the success probability is a fixed constant, about 0.4, times the fraction of the energy not yet absorbed, with only one or two auxiliary qubits measured. On the circuit side, the damping step, which generic synthesis compiles into a number of controlled-NOT gates exponential in the number of qubits, factorises exactly into polynomially many multi-controlled phase gates. Gate-level simulations on up to 25 qubits agree with the classical solutions of the damped wave equations.

AI.tldr: 论文针对声波与弹性波方程一阶形式的哈密顿模拟只能描述闭域的问题，引入所有波场向外缘递增阻尼的分级海绵层，并用Schrödingerisation在量子模拟器上实现耗散动力学；推导一、二、三维从偏微分方程到电路的完整链路，证明阻尼步骤可精确分解为多项式数量的多控相位门，并用最多25量子比特的门级模拟与经典解对照验证。
AI.motivation: 显式量子电路通过哈密顿模拟守恒能量，因此只描述闭域：出射波会在计算区域边缘反射，或在周期边界下绕回另一侧。为模拟开放域中的吸收/无反射传播，需要一种可在量子模拟器上实现的简单物理吸收体，并处理由此产生的非幺正耗散动力学。
AI.method: 采用分级海绵层作为吸收体，使每个波场按向外缘增大的速率被阻尼；基于一阶形式方程，利用Schrödingerisation通过单一辅助变量把非幺正线性演化转化为一族幺正演化；给出一、二、三维从偏微分方程到量子电路的完整推导；用独立有限差分求解器比较“所有波场阻尼”和常见的“仅速度阻尼掩膜”；分析海绵层的辅助轴截断与成功概率，并将阻尼步骤精确分解为多项式数量的多控相位门，避免通用合成中随量子比特数指数增长的受控非门。
AI.result: 有限差分数值验证表明，阻尼所有波场比仅速度阻尼掩膜吸收效果好得多。量子分析给出：在辅助轴整个非负半轴上、任意时刻恢复均精确；该轴可按最大阻尼率和模拟时间周期截断；成功概率为约0.4的固定常数乘以尚未被吸收的能量比例，且只需测量一或两个辅助量子比特；阻尼步骤可精确分解为多项式数量的多控相位门。最多25量子比特的门级模拟与阻尼波方程的经典解一致。
AI.conclusion: 海绵层结合Schrödingerisation为开放域声波和弹性波耗散动力学提供了可实现的量子电路方案，具备精确恢复、可周期截断的辅助轴、常数级成功概率和多项式门分解等性质，并得到最多25量子比特门级模拟的支持；摘要未提供实际量子硬件实验或完整资源开销估计。

title: On the role of grazing atmospheric particles in hypersonic boundary-layer receptivity
summary: The role of small atmospheric particulates in the initiation of the laminar-turbulent transition is investigated for the HIFLIER vehicle during Mach 6 ascent condition. High-fidelity simulations are used to examine the disturbance wavepackets generated by particles following either grazing trajectories through the boundary layer or trajectories that lead to impact and rebound at the cone surface. Grazing particles that penetrate less than halfway through the boundary layer are found to generate wavepackets with amplitudes comparable to those produced by wall-impinging particles. To identify the receptivity mechanisms responsible for this behaviour, a multiple-scales asymptotic formulation is developed that accounts for the extended streamwise region over which a particle interacts with the boundary layer. The analysis shows that a grazing particle can generate a strong disturbance response when crossing the critical layer, where the streamwise-momentum component of the adjoint mode is largest and the boundary layer is most receptive. Thus, direct surface impact is not required for atmospheric particulates to excite dynamically significant instability waves. Root-mean-square disturbance estimates for submicron grazing particles predict transition-onset locations close to those measured in flight, suggesting they may have contributed significantly to the onset of transition on HIFLIER at the trajectory condition considered.

AI.tldr: 针对 HIFLIER 飞行器 Mach 6 上升条件，研究小型大气颗粒对层流-湍流转捩起始的作用；结合高保真模拟与多尺度渐近分析，发现掠射颗粒穿过临界层即可激发显著扰动波包，亚微米颗粒预测的转捩起始位置接近飞行测量。
AI.motivation: 阐明大气中的小型颗粒物在 HIFLIER 飞行器 Mach 6 上升过程中引发层流-湍流转捩的机制，尤其区分沿边界层掠射轨迹与撞击-反弹轨迹颗粒所产生的扰动作用。
AI.method: 采用高保真数值模拟分析颗粒在边界层内掠射或撞击锥面后产生的扰动波包；并建立多尺度渐近公式，以刻画颗粒与边界层发生相互作用的较长流向区域，识别感受性机制。
AI.result: 穿透边界层不足一半的掠射颗粒可产生与壁面撞击颗粒幅值相当的波包；渐近分析表明，掠射颗粒穿越临界层时可产生强扰动响应，该处伴随模态的流向动量分量最大、边界层感受性最强；对亚微米掠射颗粒的均方根扰动估计给出的转捩起始位置接近飞行测量值。
AI.conclusion: 大气颗粒无需直接撞击壁面即可激发具有动力学意义的不稳定波，直接表面撞击并非必要条件是核心结论；亚微米掠射颗粒可能对所选轨迹条件下 HIFLIER 的转捩起始有显著贡献。摘要未提供具体定量仿真参数、误差范围及更多飞行条件细节。

title: Colloidal 2D WS2 nanosheets exhibiting high-purity single photon emission
summary: The search for quantum emitters, delivering single photons "on demand" at cryogenic and elevated temperatures for photonic technologies is ever progressing. For example, micrometer-sized WS2 monolayers exhibit single photon emission by elaborated local defect or strain engineering. Here, we show that wet-chemically synthesised monolayered two-dimensional (2D) WS2 nano sheets (NSs) with lateral sizes of 14 (+/- 6 nm) readily emit single photons from exciton recombination without the need for substrate-induced patterning, strain/defect engineering or spectral filtering. Single particle spectroscopy of 70 individual NSs shows photoluminescence from excitons (2.02 eV), trios (1.94 eV) and defect-localized states (1.85 eV) with fast emission (t1<0.2 ns, t2=3.2 ns), allowing highly frequent excitation cycles. Pulsed at 80 MHz, colloidal WS2 NSs exhibit limited spectral diffusion, no blinking and distinct photon antibunching (g2(0)=0.07 at 5 K), thereby tackling challenges of established colloidal quantum dot systems (blinking, longer emission cycles), while retaining high single photon purity as key quality of deterministic quantum emitters.

AI.tldr: 湿化学合成的单层二维WS2纳米片（横向尺寸14±6 nm）无需衬底图案化、应变/缺陷工程或光谱过滤即可产生单光子发射；70个纳米片的单粒子光谱显示2.02 eV激子、1.94 eV trios和1.85 eV缺陷局域态发光，寿命t1<0.2 ns、t2=3.2 ns；80 MHz脉冲激发下5 K时谱扩散有限、无闪烁，g2(0)=0.07。
AI.motivation: 面向光子技术对可在低温及高温工作的按需单光子源的需求；现有微米级WS2单层需复杂的局域缺陷或应变工程，而已有胶体量子点体系存在闪烁和较长发射周期等问题，因此需要无需复杂工程、高纯度且可高频激发的确定性单光子发射器。
AI.method: 采用湿化学法合成单层二维WS2纳米片，横向尺寸为14±6 nm；对70个单个纳米片进行单粒子光谱表征，测量发光峰、时间分辨发光、谱扩散、闪烁及光子反聚束；在80 MHz脉冲激发和5 K下评估单光子特性；未使用衬底诱导图案化、应变/缺陷工程或光谱过滤。
AI.result: 观察到激子（2.02 eV）、trios（1.94 eV）和缺陷局域态（1.85 eV）发光，衰减快（t1<0.2 ns，t2=3.2 ns），支持高频激发循环；80 MHz脉冲激发下胶体WS2纳米片谱扩散有限、无闪烁，5 K时g2(0)=0.07，显示明显光子反聚束和高单光子纯度。
AI.conclusion: 胶体WS2纳米片可在无复杂图案化、应变/缺陷工程和光谱过滤条件下作为高纯度单光子源，兼具快速发射循环和低闪烁，针对胶体量子点的闪烁与较长发射周期问题；摘要未提供高温工作或真正按需触发性能的数据。

title: Conceptual Design of Pumping Systems up to 1000 m3/s Based on Non-Evaporable Getters in a Gas-Dynamic Magnetic Trap
summary: The Gas-Dynamic Magnetic Trap (GDMT), a new linear magnetic facility for confining high-temperature hydrogen plasma, is currently under development at the Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics (BINP SB RAS). The total hydrogen flow that must be removed from the end expanders by the vacuum system is approximately 10^22 molecules/s, which corresponds to a required pumping speed on the order of 500 m3/s. Non-evaporable getters (NEG) are considered as a possible pumping method for this application. This article presents experimental studies of Ti-Zr-Al getters manufactured by Polema LLC. The pumping speed, sorption capacity, and sticking factors of the getter surface were measured. The sticking factors for hydrogen and deuterium are 2.23% and 1.54%, respectively. The getter pumping speed is maintained over 60 air-vent/reactivation cycles. Based on these results, a conceptual design of a NEG-based pumping system for the GDMT end expanders is proposed, providing a specific pumping speed of 74 m3/(m3s) for the getter panel. The proposed pumping system design and the required heating power are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Polema公司Ti-Zr-Al非蒸散型吸气剂（NEG）用于GDMT端部扩张器氢抽气的性能，测量抽速、吸附容量和粘附系数，并据此提出NEG抽气系统概念设计。
AI.motivation: GDMT是BINP SB RAS正在开发的高温氢等离子体线性磁约束装置，其端部扩张器需由真空系统移除约10^22分子/s的氢，对应约500 m3/s抽速，因此评估NEG作为可能抽气方案。
AI.method: 对Polema LLC制造的Ti-Zr-Al吸气剂开展实验研究，测量抽速、吸附容量及表面对氢和氘的粘附系数，并进行空气暴露/再激活循环测试；基于结果提出GDMT端部扩张器的NEG抽气系统概念设计，并讨论所需加热功率。
AI.result: 氢和氘的粘附系数分别为2.23%和1.54%；吸气剂抽速在超过60次空气暴露/再激活循环后仍保持；概念设计中吸气剂面板的比抽速为74 m3/(m3s)。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明NEG是GDMT端部扩张器抽气的可行方案，本文给出了相应概念设计并讨论了系统方案与所需加热功率。

title: Brillouin comb line amplifiers for optical atomic clocks
summary: Optical atomic clocks outperform the microwave clocks at the heart of current timing and navigation infrastructure by orders-of-magnitude, and recent progress in on-chip integration provides the opportunity to widely deploy them. Conventionally, a narrow linewidth laser interrogates the atomic transition, and an optical frequency comb divides its stabilised frequency (hundreds of terahertz) down to a microwave that is electronically countable. The laser(s) impose a significant size, weight, power and cost penalty, which is a current barrier to low-cost, scalable, fully on-chip optical clocks. Here, we position the frequency comb as the central engine of the clock by using Brillouin-amplified comb lines for atomic spectroscopy, which eliminates the need for stable clock lasers. Amplified comb lines reach an ultra-low frequency noise floor of $6\,\mathrm{Hz^2/Hz}$ at $30\,\mathrm{kHz}$ offset, an order-of-magnitude below a high-end commercial fibre laser. We realize a clock based on the $\mathrm{5S}_{1/2}\rightarrow\mathrm{5D}_{5/2}$ transition in $^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$ with competitive fractional frequency stability of $2\times10^{-13}$ at $τ= 1\,\mathrm{s}$, averaging to $9\times10^{-15}$ at $τ= 1000\,\mathrm{s}$. Lastly, we demonstrate a photonic chip-integrated Brillouin amplifier with a record 62.9 dB gain and up to 40 dB transferred noise suppression when pumped with a simple, low-cost diode laser. This opens a new route to compact optical clocks and enables use of atomic transitions lacking low-noise lasers by broadening a comb to the required wavelength and amplifying single lines.

AI.tldr: 该文提出以光学频率梳为时钟核心、利用布里渊放大的梳齿直接进行原子光谱 interrogation，从而去除稳定时钟激光器；在87Rb的5S1/2→5D5/2跃迁上实现1 s处2×10^-13、1000 s平均至9×10^-15的频率稳定度，并演示芯片集成布里渊放大器。
AI.motivation: 光学原子钟性能远超当前授时与导航基础设施中的微波钟，片上集成进展使其具备广泛部署可能；但传统方案中窄线宽激光器用于 interrogating 原子跃迁，光频梳将稳定频率下分至可电子计数的微波，激光器带来显著尺寸、重量、功耗和成本负担，是低成本、可扩展、全片上光学时钟的主要障碍。
AI.method: 将频率梳置于时钟中心，使用布里渊放大的梳齿进行原子光谱探测，以消除对稳定时钟激光器的需求；放大的梳齿在30 kHz偏移处达到6 Hz^2/Hz的超低频率噪声底，比高端商用光纤激光器低一个数量级；构建基于87Rb 5S1/2→5D5/2跃迁的时钟；并演示光子芯片集成布里渊放大器，在使用简单低成本二极管激光器泵浦时获得62.9 dB增益和最高40 dB转移噪声抑制。
AI.result: 实现基于87Rb 5S1/2→5D5/2跃迁的光学时钟，分数频率稳定度为τ=1 s时2×10^-13，并在τ=1000 s时平均至9×10^-15；放大梳齿频率噪声底为30 kHz偏移处6 Hz^2/Hz；芯片集成布里渊放大器获得创纪录的62.9 dB增益和最高40 dB转移噪声抑制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为紧凑型光学时钟提供新路径，并通过将频率梳展宽至所需波长并放大单根梳齿，使缺乏低噪声激光器的原子跃迁也可用于光学时钟；摘要未提供完全片上时钟的系统级尺寸、功耗或长期运行数据。

title: Variational learning of energy-stable macroscopic flow equations from microscopic laws
summary: We present a generalized variational approach for constructing energy-stable macroscopic partial differential equations (PDEs) directly from microscopic physical laws. Rather than fitting the PDE evolution for prescribed variables from macroscopic trajectories, we construct an extendable variational structure by adjoining auxiliary variables to seek autonomous reduced dynamics in an enlarged state space. By defining these variables as micro--macro encoders with explicit microscopic counterparts, we cast the learning problem as the sample-wise joint identification of the reduced state representation and the variational ingredients from time-discrete data, enabling systematic law-level transfer across scales. The resulting PDEs preserve frame indifference, physical constraints, and energy stability by construction, and admit a fluctuation--dissipation-consistent stochastic extension. Numerical results for the non-Newtonian hydrodynamics of polymeric fluids show that the learned models capture the viscoelastic responses induced by nonlinear and heterogeneous molecular interactions beyond empirical closures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种广义变分方法，可直接从微观物理规律构建能量稳定的宏观偏微分方程。该方法通过引入辅助变量和微-宏观编码器，在增广状态空间中联合识别约化状态与变分要素，并在聚合物流体的非牛顿流体力学中验证了能够捕捉经验闭合之外黏弹性响应的能力。
AI.motivation: 传统方法通常针对给定宏观变量、从宏观轨迹拟合PDE演化，难以保证物理一致性，也难以实现跨尺度、法则层面的迁移；本文希望直接从微观物理规律构建可扩展且能量稳定的宏观PDE。
AI.method: 构建含辅助变量的可扩展变分结构，在增广状态空间中寻求自主约化动力学；将辅助变量定义为具有显式微观对应量的微-宏观编码器，并把学习问题表述为基于时间离散数据的样本级联合辨识：同时识别约化状态表示与变分要素；所得PDE在构造上保持框架不变性、物理约束和能量稳定性，并可给出满足涨落-耗散一致性的随机扩展。
AI.result: 所得模型在构造上保持框架不变性、物理约束与能量稳定性，并具有涨落-耗散一致的随机扩展；针对聚合物流体的非牛顿流体力学数值结果表明，学习模型能够捕捉由非线性和非均匀分子相互作用诱导的黏弹性响应，覆盖经验闭合之外的行为。摘要未提供定量误差或计算效率指标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，借助增广变分结构和微-宏观编码器，可从微观规律学习具有物理一致性、能量稳定性及跨尺度法则迁移能力的宏观PDE，并在聚合物黏弹性流动中展示出超出经验闭合描述能力的潜力；更广泛的定量验证与适用边界未在摘要中给出。

title: Coupled Effects of Biofilm Dynamics and Flow on Hydrogen Transport in a Hydrogen-Generating Fracture
summary: Biofilm growth in hydrogen-generating fractures modifies fluid flow and hydrogen transport, while microbial activity consumes hydrogen. These coupled processes influence hydrogen recovery in stimulated geologic hydrogen systems. We use high-fidelity simulations to investigate flow, biofilm dynamics, and hydrogen transport in a rough fracture with reactive walls. Flow rate and biofilm permeability were varied to quantify changes in fracture permeability, biomass accumulation, and outlet hydrogen concentration. Biofilm growth reduced apparent fracture permeability by up to 65\% as biomass occupied the aperture. Two hydrogen concentration regimes are identified. For highly permeable biofilms (Type I), outlet concentration evolved non-monotonically as roughness-induced vortices initially restricted hydrogen transport before biofilm growth suppressed them. Low-permeability biofilms (Type II) result in an approximately monotonic outlet concentration decrease dominated by transport resistance and microbial consumption. The regimes were distinguished by a Darcy-scale Reynolds number ($Re_D=u\sqrt{K_0}/ν$). Temporal hydrogen concentration variations in field studies may help determine intrinsic biofilm permeability.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过高保真模拟分析粗糙裂隙中生物膜生长、流体流动与氢气传输的耦合过程，发现生物膜可使表观裂隙渗透率降低最多65%，并识别出由Darcy尺度雷诺数区分的两种出口氢气浓度演化机制。
AI.motivation: 产氢裂隙中的生物膜生长会改变流体流动和氢气传输，同时微生物活动消耗氢气；这些耦合过程会影响刺激型地质氢系统的氢气采收，因此需要量化流动、生物膜动力学与氢气传输之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用高保真模拟研究具有反应性壁面的粗糙裂隙中的流动、生物膜动力学和氢气传输；通过改变流速和生物膜渗透率，量化裂隙渗透率、生物量积累和出口氢气浓度的变化。
AI.result: 生物膜生长占据裂隙开度后使表观裂隙渗透率最多降低65%。识别出两种氢气浓度状态：高渗透性生物膜（Type I）下，出口浓度呈非单调演化，粗糙度诱导涡旋先限制氢气传输，随后生物膜生长抑制涡旋；低渗透性生物膜（Type II）下，出口浓度近似单调下降，主要由传输阻力和微生物消耗控制。两种状态由Darcy尺度雷诺数 Re_D=u√(K0)/ν 区分。
AI.conclusion: 生物膜渗透性、裂隙粗糙度和流动条件共同控制氢气传输与采收表现；现场观测中的氢气浓度随时间变化可能有助于判断固有生物膜渗透率。摘要未提供具体参数范围及现场或实验验证细节。

title: Millimeter-Wave Gaussian-to-Flat-Top Beam Shaping Using a Single-Curvature Lens: A Novel Approach
summary: This paper presents a novel method for converting the divergent Gaussian intensity distribution of a millimeter-wave source into a uniform (flat-top) distribution using a single curved surface. The proposed method combines the surface profile of a collimator with that of a beam shaper. To validate the method, the profile of a single-sided (plano-convex) lens is derived and placed 52 mm in front of a conical horn antenna operating at 100 GHz. The lens transforms the Gaussian radiation of the horn, with an incident beam radius of 11.9 mm, into a uniform beam with a radius of 400 mm at a distance of 3 m. The lens surface profile is optimized using a full-wave-simulation-based procedure, and the resulting output beam is compared with that of a previously designed double-sided (concave-convex) lens. Simulation results show that, within the desired field of view, the optimized single-sided lens produces a flat-top intensity distribution with satisfactory ripple and roll-off. Finally, the sensitivity of the optimized lens to frequency variation is investigated. The proposed lens is suitable for generating uniform illumination in active stand-off millimeter-wave imaging systems.

AI.tldr: 提出并仿真验证一种单曲面透镜设计，将100 GHz锥形喇叭天线的发散高斯波束整形为3 m处半径400 mm的平顶光束；优化后的单面平凸透镜在目标视场内具有可接受的纹波和滚降，并与双面透镜比较，适用于主动驻留式毫米波成像的均匀照明。
AI.motivation: 将毫米波源的发散高斯强度分布转换为均匀平顶分布，以满足主动驻留式毫米波成像系统的均匀照明需求；摘要未详细说明现有方法的具体局限。
AI.method: 提出用单一曲面同时实现准直与光束整形，将准直器表面轮廓与光束整形器轮廓结合；推导单面平凸透镜轮廓，并将其置于100 GHz锥形喇叭天线前52 mm；采用基于全波仿真的流程优化透镜表面轮廓；将输出光束与既往双面凹-凸透镜进行比较，并研究透镜对频率变化的敏感性。
AI.result: 在入射束半径为11.9 mm、透镜距天线52 mm的条件下，优化单面透镜在3 m处产生半径为400 mm的均匀光束；仿真结果显示，在目标视场内获得平顶强度分布，具有令人满意的纹波和滚降；摘要未给出与双面透镜比较的具体数值，也未给出频率变化敏感性的具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 优化后的单面平凸透镜可在目标视场内形成具有可接受纹波和滚降的平顶强度分布，适用于主动驻留式毫米波成像系统的均匀照明；摘要未提供实验测量结论或频率敏感性的具体结论。

title: A Two-Dimensional Physics-Informed Neural Network Model of a Hall Effect Thruster Plasma: Self-Consistent Electrostatics and Physical-Consistency Diagnostics
summary: We present a two-dimensional axisymmetric physics-informed neural network (PINN) of the discharge channel of the P5 Hall thruster at 300 V and 5.4 A, which solves eleven coupled plasma fields and assimilates 145 internal probe measurements per field reconstructed from the data of Haas and Gallimore. The electric potential is obtained from Poisson's equation in charge-separation form, n_e = n_i(1+eta), with eta bounded by construction, which keeps the stiff electrostatic constraint active and trainable. The reference solution agrees with the training profiles to relative L2 errors of 0.017, 0.073 and 0.205 for the potential, electron temperature and ion density, and held-out tests show the potential to be far more robust than the ion density to the withdrawal of measurement lines. We then test the solution against requirements the data fit does not reveal: global particle and current balances, the electron current implied by the momentum equation, the field-aligned electron force balance and the axial ion momentum budget. These expose a neutral inflow six times the measured flow, a bound in the potential representation, and a momentum-implied electron current, more than 99% field-aligned, exceeding the discharge current by orders of magnitude. Correcting these, with a divergence-free magnetic field fitted to measured data, uncertainty-weighted data, the electron pressure gradient and progressively imposed field-aligned and current constraints, yields a solution that conserves particles to within 3%, holds the current between 5.1 and 5.4 A and places 97% of the potential and 88% of the temperature measurements within their uncertainties. Within the tested single-velocity fluid formulation, however, the ion density, potential and ion velocity could not be matched together, and the field-aligned electron balance remains the main obstacle to electron self-consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文构建二维轴对称PINN，用于P5霍尔推力器放电通道的11个耦合等离子体场求解与145组内部探针测量同化；在数据拟合较好后，进一步用粒子/电流守恒和动量/力平衡检验并修正解，揭示了数据拟合无法发现的非物理性及单速度流体 formulation 的自洽性限制。
AI.motivation: 旨在利用物理信息神经网络从霍尔推力器内部稀疏测量中重构多等离子体场，并检验数据同化解是否不仅拟合测量，还满足全局守恒、电流平衡和场向电子力平衡等物理要求。摘要未单独明确陈述研究动机。
AI.method: 采用二维轴对称PINN求解P5霍尔推力器在300 V、5.4 A下的11个耦合等离子体场，并同化由Haas和Gallimore数据重构的每个场145条内部探针测量；电势由电荷分离形式的泊松方程给出，n_e=n_i(1+eta)且eta受构造约束。随后进行留出测量线测试，并用全局粒子与电流平衡、动量方程隐含电子电流、场向电子力平衡和轴向离子动量预算检验解；修正时采用拟合实测数据的无散磁场、不确定性加权数据、电子压力梯度以及逐步施加场向和电流约束。
AI.result: 参考解对电势、电子温度和离子密度的相对L2误差分别为0.017、0.073和0.205；留出测试中电势比离子密度对测量线撤除更稳健。物理检验暴露中性气体流入为实测流量的6倍、电势表示存在界限、动量隐含电子电流超过99%场向且比放电电流高数个量级。修正后解在3%以内守恒粒子，电流保持在5.1–5.4 A，97%的电势测量和88%的温度测量落在不确定度内；但在所测试的单速度流体表述内，离子密度、电势和离子速度无法同时匹配，场向电子平衡仍是电子自洽性的主要障碍。
AI.conclusion: PINN可较好地同化霍尔推力器内部测量，但仅靠数据拟合不足以保证物理自洽；守恒与力平衡检验能揭示非物理解，并通过约束修正显著改善粒子守恒、电流范围和测量一致性。然而在所测试的单速度流体框架内仍无法同时匹配离子密度、电势和离子速度，场向电子力平衡是实现电子自洽的主要障碍。

title: Inducing cooperative dynamics in an inhomogeneous many-emitter ensemble with a pulse sequence
summary: Driving a many-particle quantum system with an appropriately tuned external field can give rise to features in its nonequilibrium dynamics that are absent in the equilibrium counterpart. Cooperative dynamics in a dense ensemble of quantum emitters manifested through superradiance, a burst in the emission intensity as a function of time, is typically suppressed by spectral disparities among emitters in the ensemble. We demonstrate the enhancement of cooperative dynamics in a spectrally inhomogeneous ensemble of quantum emitters when it is driven by a periodic pulse sequence. Using both a semi-analytical mean-field solution and a digital quantum simulation, we examine the coherence of the pulse-driven ensemble and the intensity of the emitted radiation as a function of the spectral disparity in the ensemble, as a function of time, the number of atoms in the system, and as a function of the inter-pulse delay. We identify clear signatures of the enhanced cooperative dynamics for the pulse-driven inhomogeneous ensemble when dephasing in the dynamics of the ensemble is suppressed by a sufficient number of pulses during the individual emitter lifetime. These results demonstrate a post-fabrication tuning knob based on externally applied control fields for the dynamics of the many-emitter ensemble.

AI.tldr: 该文研究用周期性脉冲序列驱动光谱非均匀的量子发射体集合，以增强通常被光谱差异抑制的超辐射等合作动力学；采用半解析平均场解和数字量子模拟，发现当足够多脉冲在单个发射体寿命内抑制退相时，会出现增强合作动力学的清晰特征，并提出以外场作为制备后调控手段。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
AI.motivation: 驱动多粒子量子系统的合适外场可产生平衡态不存在的非平衡动力学。密集量子发射体集合中的合作动力学可表现为超辐射，即发射强度随时间出现爆发，但集合内发射体的光谱差异通常会抑制这种合作效应。作者希望证明并刻画周期性脉冲驱动能否增强光谱非均匀集合中的合作动力学，并据此获得制备后可用的调控手段。
AI.method: 采用半解析平均场解和数字量子模拟两种方法，研究脉冲驱动集合的相干性以及发射辐射强度，并考察其随集合光谱差异、时间、系统原子数以及脉冲间延迟的变化。
AI.result: 在脉冲驱动的不均匀集合中观察到增强合作动力学的清晰特征；当单个发射体寿命期间施加足够数量的脉冲从而抑制集合动力学中的退相时，该增强出现。摘要未提供具体定量数值或实验参数。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于外部控制场的周期性脉冲序列可作为制备后调控旋钮，用于调控多发射体集合的动力学；摘要未进一步给出材料平台或实验实现细节。

title: Quantum HHL Algorithm for Solving 1D Linear Advection Equation Using Explicit and Implicit Finite Difference Schemes
comment: quantum computing, HHL algorithm, CFD, finite difference, advection equation, NISQ, Qiskit
summary: This study develops and implements a Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd (HHL) quantum algorithm for solving a one-dimensional linear advection equation with periodic boundary conditions. The governing equation is first discretized using a classical finite difference (FD) scheme to obtain a linear system suitable for quantum solution. We present a newly designed, circuit-level implementation of HHL assembled from Qiskit circuit components and exploit the circulant structure of the periodic discretization matrices through Fourier-based matrix evolution. The HHL algorithm is benchmarked with three explicit schemes and one implicit scheme. The implicit scheme requires a nontrivial linear solve arising from the discretized PDE on progressively finer grids, whereas the explicit schemes provide different input fields for testing state preparation and reconstruction with identity coefficient matrices. HHL solution states are validated against direct classical solves in noiseless simulation. For hardware execution, the periodic matrix structure permits a Fourier implementation that applies reciprocal eigenvalues without phase estimation. Results on the IBM Rensselaer Nighthawk processor are compared at a shared final time. Noiseless reconstructed fields approach the transported profile on resolved grids, while substantial hardware errors remain for both explicit and implicit schemes. Crank-Nicolson remains exceptionally well-conditioned and utilizes similar circuit re sources to the explicit controls, proving that hardware degradation in our tests was not driven by poor matrix conditioning. Ultimately, this study shows new means for HHL algorithms to study quantum CFD problems involving advection equations with implicit time integrations, while demonstrating how state preparation and measurement affect the practical performance of quantum solvers on current devices.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并实现基于Qiskit电路组件的HHL量子算法，用于求解一维周期边界线性平流方程；采用有限差分离散，利用循环矩阵的Fourier结构，在无噪声模拟和IBM Rensselaer Nighthawk处理器上与三种显式及一种隐式格式进行基准比较。结果表明无噪声重建场接近输运剖面，但硬件误差仍显著，且性能退化并非由矩阵条件数差导致。
AI.motivation: 探索HHL算法求解含隐式时间积分的量子CFD平流问题的可行性，并评估态制备与测量对当前量子硬件上求解器实际性能的影响。
AI.method: 先用经典有限差分格式离散控制方程以获得适合量子求解的线性系统；设计并实现电路级HHL算法，利用周期离散矩阵的循环结构，通过基于Fourier的矩阵演化处理，并在硬件执行中采用无需相位估计、直接施加倒数特征值的Fourier实现；以三种显式格式和一种隐式格式为基准，将HHL解与经典直接求解在无噪声模拟中验证，并在IBM Rensselaer Nighthawk处理器上于共享最终时刻比较。
AI.result: 无噪声模拟中，重建场在已解析网格上接近输运剖面；硬件执行对显式和隐式格式均存在显著误差。Crank-Nicolson格式条件数很好，且所用电路资源与显式对照相近，表明测试中的硬件性能退化并非由矩阵条件数差驱动。摘要未提供具体误差数值或量子加速量级。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明HHL算法可用于研究含隐式时间积分的平流方程量子CFD问题，同时揭示态制备和测量是影响当前量子设备上量子求解器实用性能的重要因素。

title: Improving the performance of regularized Stokeslet simulations using Rosenbrock time integration methods
summary: The method of regularized Stokeslets (MRS) is widely used to model fluid-structure interactions of microscopic bodies in viscous environments. Specifically, MRS computes the fluid velocity generated by regularized forces distributed on an immersed body, which in turn defines a system of ordinary differential equations with which to evolve the body so that the no-slip condition is enforced. To accurately model material properties such as elasticity and bending rigidity, the resulting ODE system is often stiff and, therefore, computationally expensive to solve with explicit time-integration methods. Here we demonstrate the potential of linearly implicit Rosenbrock (ROS) time integration methods to greatly reduce the computational time required to solve such ODE systems. We focus on the classic model problem of the swimming of a flexible filament driven by preferred curvature forcing. Our findings indicate that, compared to previous MRS simulations, the increased stability of ROS methods allows for speed-ups between twenty and two thousand times over explicit Runge-Kutta (ERK) methods. Moreover, we present approximate scaling laws for this speedup as a function of the key model parameters (bending rigidity and slenderness) at the root of numerical stiffness. Lastly, beyond the basic ROS approach, we discuss several additional strategies that further improve performance.

AI.tldr: 该文研究用线性隐式 Rosenbrock（ROS）时间积分方法加速正则化 Stokeslets 方法（MRS）所生成的刚性 ODE 系统，并以柔性 filament 在水中游动这一经典模型为例验证。结果表明，与显式 Runge-Kutta（ERK）方法相比，ROS 因稳定性更高，可实现约 20 至 2000 倍的加速；文中还给出了加速比随弯曲刚度和细长比变化的近似 scaling law，并讨论了进一步提升性能的策略。
AI.motivation: MRS 常用于模拟黏性环境中微观物体的流固耦合：它根据分布在该物体上的正则化力计算流体速度，并由此得到 ODE 系统，用于演化物体的运动，以满足 no-slip 条件。为了准确刻画弹性、弯曲刚度等材料属性，所得 ODE 系统往往具有刚性，因此用显式时间积分方法求解的计算成本很高；作者因此希望显著降低这类求解所需的时间。
AI.method: 作者采用线性隐式 Rosenbrock（ROS）时间积分方法求解 MRS 产生的刚性 ODE 系统，并以受 preferred curvature forcing 驱动的柔性 filament 游动这一经典模型问题为对象。作者将 ROS 与显式 Runge-Kutta（ERK）方法进行比较，并针对决定数值刚性的关键模型参数（弯曲刚度和细长比），给出加速比的近似 scaling law；此外还讨论了在基本 ROS 方法之外可进一步提升性能的若干策略。
AI.result: 研究显示，与以往的 MRS 模拟相比，ROS 方法因数值稳定性更高，相对于 ERK 方法可实现约 20 至 2000 倍的加速。作者还给出了加速比随弯曲刚度和细长比变化的近似 scaling law，并指出若干附加策略可进一步改善性能。摘要未提供具体误差精度或网格收敛性数据。
AI.conclusion: ROS 时间积分方法能大幅减少求解 MRS 刚性 ODE 系统所需的计算时间，是加速此类流固耦合模拟的有效途径；其加速效果与弯曲刚度、细长比等导致数值刚性的参数相关，并可通过附加策略进一步提升性能。摘要未给出更广泛的模型验证或精度结论。

title: Single-sided lens terahertz flat-top beam shaping in the Fresnel region
summary: In this paper, a novel, to our knowledge, analytical approach is introduced for the design of a single-sided plano-convex lens (PCL) capable of terahertz (THz) flat-top beam shaping in the Fresnel region. The lens profile, derived from geometrical optics principles, integrates collimating and beam-shaping functions into a single optical surface, thereby simplifying fabrication. The efficiency of the method is demonstrated by designing two PCLs that convert a divergent Gaussian beam from a monochromatic THz source (at 100 and 200 GHz) into flat-top beams with target radii of 400 and 500 mm at distances of 3 and 4 m, respectively. The resulting fields, evaluated through analytical, integral equation, and finite element techniques, are shown to be comparable to those produced by a conventional double-sided concave-convex lens. Furthermore, the sensitivity of the design to frequency and alignment variations is investigated, confirming the robustness of this single-curvature approach for integration into practical THz imaging systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于几何光学的解析方法，设计单面平凸透镜（PCL），在菲涅耳区实现太赫兹平顶光束整形；将准直与整形集成于单一光学面以简化制造，并通过两类频率/尺寸设计及多方法仿真验证其效果与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统太赫兹平顶光束整形可能需要更复杂的光学面形或双面透镜，制造不便；本文旨在用单面平凸透镜和解析设计方法，把准直与光束整形集成到一个光学表面，从而简化加工并便于集成到实际太赫兹成像系统。
AI.method: 依据几何光学原理推导PCL面形；设计两个单面平凸透镜，将单色太赫兹源（100 GHz和200 GHz）的发散高斯光束转换为平顶光束，目标半径分别为400 mm和500 mm、距离分别为3 m和4 m；采用解析方法、积分方程方法和有限元技术评估所得场分布，并研究设计对频率和对准变化的敏感性。

AI.conclusion: 单面平凸透镜的解析设计能够在菲涅耳区实现太赫兹平顶光束整形，并兼顾简化制造与对准/频率变化下的稳健性，适合集成到实际太赫兹成像系统。

title: Dynamics of Vortex Electrons in a Uniform Magnetic Field Across Nonrelativistic and Relativistic Regimes
summary: The dynamics of a vortex electron in a transverse uniform magnetic field involves not only the cyclotron motion of the wave packet center but also the evolution of its internal wavefunction structure. To study this process, we develop a quantum framework and investigate the dynamics of vortex electrons in both the nonrelativistic and relativistic regimes. A discrete Bessel-Gaussian initial wave packet is expanded in the basis of Dirac eigenstates to obtain the time-dependent wavefunction and to analyze its spatiotemporal evolution. In the nonrelativistic regime, the results deviate significantly from the rigid point-dipole model, as the intrinsic kinetic orbital angular momentum exhibits dynamics more complex than simple Larmor precession, owing to the nonstationary internal current distribution of the wave packet. In the relativistic regime, the nonlinear dependence of the energy levels on the quantum numbers destroys the equal spacing of the spectrum. Consequently, the relative phases among the eigenstate components of the wave packet evolve nonuniformly, resulting in wave-packet spreading and deformation, accompanied by modified intrinsic orbital angular momentum dynamics. We introduce a dimensionless parameter to quantify this relativistic dephasing, providing an approximate criterion for selecting physical parameters and evolution times to mitigate the resulting wave-packet distortion. These results clarify the limitations of the rigid point-dipole model, highlight the essential role of internal wavefunction structure, and provide theoretical guidance for understanding and manipulating relativistic vortex electrons.

AI.tldr: 本文建立量子框架研究横向均匀磁场中涡旋电子的非相对论与相对论动力学：以离散Bessel-Gaussian波包在Dirac本征态基中展开，揭示刚体点偶极模型的局限、相对论能级非等间距导致的波包展宽与变形，并引入无量纲参数给出缓解相对论退相位的近似判据。
AI.motivation: 横向均匀磁场中涡旋电子的动力学不仅包括波包中心的回旋运动，还包括其内部波函数结构的演化；需要超越刚体点偶极模型，理解非相对论与相对论情形下的时空演化，为理解和操控相对论涡旋电子提供理论基础。

AI.result: 非相对论结果显著偏离刚体点偶极模型，内禀轨道角动量动力学比简单Larmor进动更复杂，源于波包非定常的内部电流分布；相对论情形下，能级对量子数的非线性依赖破坏谱的等间距，使本征态分量间相对相位非均匀演化，导致波包展宽和变形，并修正内禀轨道角动量动力学。无量纲参数为选择物理参数和演化时间以减轻波包畸变提供近似判据。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果明确了刚体点偶极模型的局限，强调内部波函数结构的关键作用，并为理解和操控相对论涡旋电子提供理论指导。

title: Pump-scheme dependence of few-emitter lasers: exact multilevel correlations and photon statistics
summary: Few-emitter laser models usually replace the excitation cycle of the gain medium by a single Markovian pump jump of a two-level emitter. We test this replacement with the cavity and laser-transition parameters held fixed and the two-level pump rate fitted to the same mean photon number, using an exact damping-basis continued-fraction solution of the cavity--emitter master equation for $N$ identical $d$-level emitters with arbitrary independent incoherent transitions and one cavity-coupled transition, in the known reduced space of level populations and lasing coherences. First, a pump-quantum filtration shows that the inter-emitter coherence of $Λ$ and ladder media starts at second rather than first order in the pump; we evaluate its leading coefficient from the exact finite-system series and map the recycling rate at which its sign changes. Second, at matched photon number, rate-limited steps in the pump cycle push the long-time output-counting Fano factor of two and three emitters well below one: for two emitters it reaches 0.66 at a mean cavity occupation of 0.3 and is still 0.74 at an occupation of one, where $g^{(2)}(0)$ is within 3% of unity, because the anticorrelation sits at delays of about half a cavity lifetime rather than at zero delay. For two and three emitters the fitted two-level model gets both statistics wrong and places the output above the shot-noise level. Against independent single-emitter lasers at the same output, the common cavity erodes rather than enhances this single-emitter effect.

AI.tldr: 该文用精确阻尼基连分式方法求解多能级发射体与单腔模的主方程，检验少发射体激光中将增益介质激发循环简化为二能级Markov泵浦跳跃的常用做法，发现该简化无法再现两、三发射体的相干性和输出统计。
AI.motivation: 少发射体激光模型通常用二能级发射体的单个Markov泵浦跳跃替代增益介质的激发循环；作者希望在腔和激光跃迁参数固定、平均光子数匹配的条件下检验这一替代是否能保持量子相干与输出计数统计。
AI.method: 对N个相同d能级发射体（具有任意独立非相干跃迁和一个腔耦合跃迁）的腔-发射体主方程，在能级布居与激光相干性的已知约化空间中采用精确阻尼基连分式解；通过泵浦量子过滤分析Λ型和梯型介质中发射体间相干对泵浦的阶次，并由精确有限系统级数计算其领头系数及符号改变对应的再循环速率；在匹配平均光子数下比较二能级模型与速率受限多能级泵浦循环的长时间输出计数Fano因子和g^{(2)}(0)。
AI.result: 泵浦量子过滤表明，Λ型和梯型介质的发射体间相干从泵浦的二阶而非一阶开始，并给出其领头系数及符号改变对应的再循环速率。匹配光子数时，速率受限泵浦步骤使两、三发射体的长时间输出计数Fano因子显著低于1：两发射体在平均腔占据0.3时为0.66，在占据为1时仍为0.74；此时g^{(2)}(0)与1相差不超过3%，因为反相关位于约半个腔寿命的延迟而非零延迟。对于两、三发射体，拟合的二能级模型把这两种统计量都算错，并将输出置于散粒噪声水平之上；与相同输出的独立单发射体激光相比，共同腔削弱而不是增强该单发射体效应。
AI.conclusion: 在少发射体情形，用单个Markov泵浦跳跃的二能级模型替代实际泵浦循环不足以描述发射体间相干及速率受限泵浦导致的亚散粒噪声输出统计；多能级泵浦结构和共同腔会显著改变激光的量子统计性质。

title: Structure-Preserving Full Approximation Scheme for Real-Space Hartree-Fock Equations
summary: We develop a structure-preserving full approximation scheme (FAS) for the real-space restricted Hartree-Fock equations. The method treats the orbital equations, Coulomb and exchange pair potentials, and orthonormality constraints as a coupled nonlinear system on a hierarchy of finite-element spaces. Forced Gram targets, occupied-frame alignment, and auxiliary-variable reconstruction provide constraint compatibility and occupied-rotation equivariance under suitable assumptions. Analysis of the full self-consistent response identifies an elliptic kinetic principal part, motivating the multilevel treatment. The resulting solver, FAS-H, combines FAS cycles with a residual-triggered horizontal Newton correction on the finest grid. Numerical experiments on eight closed-shell systems show convergence in 4-11 cycles across three grid levels. Across 24 system-grid comparisons, FAS-H is 1.60-5.02 times faster than SCF and uses 68-91% less weighted FFT work, while standalone horizontal Newton is faster in some cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于实空间受限Hartree-Fock方程的结构保持全近似格式（FAS），将轨道方程、Coulomb与交换对势及正交归一约束作为有限元空间层级上的耦合非线性系统求解，并给出FAS-H求解器；在8个闭壳层体系上实现4-11个循环收敛，较SCF快1.60-5.02倍并显著减少加权FFT工作量。
AI.motivation: 为在实空间求解受限Hartree-Fock方程，需要同时处理轨道方程、Coulomb和交换对势以及正交归一约束构成的耦合非线性系统，并保持约束相容性与占据旋转等变性；摘要据此提出结构保持的多层FAS求解框架。
AI.method: 在有限元空间层级上将轨道方程、Coulomb与交换对势和正交归一约束视为耦合非线性系统；采用强制Gram目标、占据帧对齐和辅助变量重构，在适当假设下实现约束相容与占据旋转等变性；通过全自洽响应分析识别出椭圆动能主部，从而支持多层处理；最终求解器FAS-H将FAS循环与最细网格上由残差触发的水平Newton校正相结合。
AI.result: 在8个闭壳层体系上的数值实验显示，FAS-H在三个网格层级上于4-11个循环内收敛；在24组系统-网格比较中，FAS-H比SCF快1.60-5.02倍，并减少68-91%的加权FFT工作量；单独的水平Newton方法在某些情况下更快。
AI.conclusion: FAS-H是一种结构保持的多层求解器，能够有效求解实空间受限Hartree-Fock耦合系统，并在测试中表现出相对SCF的加速和加权FFT工作量降低；单独水平Newton在部分情形下也具有速度优势。

title: The kinematic Kelvin-Helmholtz instability-driven dynamo: implications for merging compact objects
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures main text. 10 pages supplemental materials. 8k VR visualization here: https://youtu.be/t-6yRoGyFhk. Submitted. Comments welcome
summary: Binary neutron star (BNS) mergers excite a Kelvin--Helmholtz instability (KHI) in the shear layer between them. It is parasitized upon by the magnetic field to form a powerful magnetic dynamo. Using a large ensemble of high-resolution visco-resistive KHI-driven dynamo simulations we construct analytical, asymptotic in Reynolds number ($\rm{Re}$) models for the magnetic field growth rates and mean vertical field dynamo onset times. Our models suggest that in the $\rm{Re} \gg 1$ limit, the mean vertical field is seeded immediately, kinematic growth rates become asymptotic in $\rm{Re}$, and the dynamo moves out of the kinematic stage on $\mathcal{O}(0.1\,\rm{ms})$ timescales, readily attaining magnetar-strength fields during this transition. This suggests that most global BNS merger simulations are not time-resolving the correct KHI-driven dynamo regime.

AI.tldr: 双中子星并合剪切层中的开尔文—亥姆霍兹不稳定性可驱动磁场 dynamo；作者用大样本高分辨率粘性—电阻性模拟建立随雷诺数渐近的解析模型，发现高 Re 下垂直平均场立即被种子化、动理学增长率和退出动理学阶段的时间尺度很快，足以在约 0.1 ms 内达到磁星强度，提示多数全局并合模拟未时间分辨正确的 KHI 驱动 dynamo 区域。
AI.motivation: 双中子星并合会在两者的剪切层中激发开尔文—亥姆霍兹不稳定性，磁场利用该不稳定性形成强 dynamo。论文动机是定量刻画该 dynamo 的磁场增长率和平均垂直场 dynamo 起始时间，并判断现有全局双中子星并合模拟是否时间分辨了正确的 KHI 驱动 dynamo 区域。
AI.method: 采用大样本高分辨率粘性—电阻性 KHI 驱动 dynamo 模拟，并基于这些模拟构造解析的、在雷诺数 Re 上渐近的模型，用于描述磁场增长率和平均垂直场 dynamo 起始时间。
AI.result: 模型表明，在 Re≫1 极限下平均垂直场立即被种子化，动理学增长率在 Re 上趋于渐近，dynamo 在 O(0.1 ms) 时间尺度上退出动理学阶段，并可在该转变期间轻易达到磁星强度磁场；这表明大多数全局双中子星并合模拟没有时间分辨正确的 KHI 驱动 dynamo 区域。
AI.conclusion: KHI 驱动的 dynamo 在高雷诺数下可极快种子化并增长至磁星强度，因此全局双中子星并合模拟需要充分分辨该 KHI 驱动 dynamo 区域，否则可能遗漏正确的磁场放大机制和时标。摘要未提供具体模拟数量、分辨率参数或磁场强度数值。

title: Optical angular momentum and pseudospin-orbit coupling in photonic graphene
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: We investigate the dynamics of structured laser beams carrying angular momentum (AM) as they undergo conical diffraction in photonic graphene. Using a combination of numerical simulations and analytical calculations, we demonstrate a surprising result: the beam's orbital AM tracks the dynamics of the lattice pseudospin rather than the AM of its slowly varying envelope. This finding provides evidence that pseudospin behaves as a genuine form of angular momentum. Furthermore, we explore beam propagation in staggered honeycomb lattices governed by the massive Dirac equation, revealing that the orbital AM is highly sensitive to both the band gap size and the envelope's initial AM. We explain our numerical results by drawing an analogy with the orbital magnetization of electrons.

AI.tldr: 该文研究携带角动量的结构激光束在光子石墨烯中发生锥形衍射时的动力学，发现轨道角动量跟随晶格赝自旋动力学而非慢变包络角动量，并进一步在交错蜂窝晶格中揭示轨道角动量对带隙大小和初始包络角动量的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 研究结构激光束携带的角动量在光子石墨烯锥形衍射中的演化，检验赝自旋是否可视为一种真实的角动量形式，并探索在由大质量狄拉克方程描述的交错蜂窝晶格中轨道角动量的行为。
AI.method: 结合数值模拟与解析计算，分析结构激光束在光子石墨烯中的锥形衍射；进一步研究光束在交错蜂窝晶格中的传播，该传播由大质量狄拉克方程支配，并通过与电子轨道磁化进行类比来解释结果。
AI.result: 结果表明，光束的轨道角动量跟踪晶格赝自旋的动力学，而不是其慢变包络的角动量；在交错蜂窝晶格中，轨道角动量对带隙大小和包络初始角动量均高度敏感。摘要未提供具体数值参数或定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了赝自旋表现为一种真实角动量形式的证据；在大质量狄拉克型光子晶格中，轨道角动量强烈依赖带隙与初始包络角动量，并可通过电子轨道磁化的类比加以理解。

title: Stabilization of kinetic plasma instabilities via instantaneous external field control
summary: We propose an instantaneous control framework for the stabilization of kinetic plasma instabilities using external fields. The control problem is formulated as a PDE-constrained optimization that accounts for nonlinear plasma dynamics, while the control is determined at each time step to avoid global-in-time optimization. The Discretize-then-Optimize (DtO) approach is adopted, with the forward equations first discretized using a particle-in-cell (PIC) method. The subsequent control computation is derived from the discrete particle update, ensuring consistency with the forward solver. The control objective is formulated in terms of electromagnetic field energy and low-order moments rather than the full distribution function, making the optimization more amenable to practical implementation. The framework is applied to both electrostatic and electromagnetic settings and evaluated on several benchmark problems, including the two-stream, bump-on-tail, Dory--Guest--Harris, and Weibel instabilities. Across these tests, the control successfully suppresses field energy growth and keeps the distribution function close to its initial state. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy in suppressing kinetic plasma instabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于外部场的瞬时控制框架，用于抑制动理学等离子体不稳定性；采用PDE约束优化与PIC离散，在多个基准问题上抑制场能增长并保持分布函数接近初始状态。
AI.motivation: 针对动理学等离子体不稳定性，研究利用外部场实现稳定化；通过逐时间步确定控制量，避免全局时间优化，并以电磁场能量和低阶矩而非完整分布函数构造目标，以提高实际可实现性。
AI.method: 将控制问题表述为考虑非线性等离子体动力学的PDE约束优化；采用Discretize-then-Optimize（DtO）方法，先用粒子网格（PIC）方法离散前向方程，再由离散粒子更新推导控制计算以保证与前向求解器一致；控制目标基于电磁场能量和低阶矩，并在静电与电磁设置中应用。
AI.result: 在双流、bump-on-tail、Dory--Guest--Harris和Weibel等基准问题上测试，控制成功抑制场能增长，并使分布函数保持接近初始状态；摘要未提供具体定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该策略能够有效抑制动理学等离子体不稳定性；摘要未提供关于计算成本、稳定性保证或更广泛适用性的进一步结论。

title: Reversibility of Nonequilibrium Dynamics in a Unitary Fermi Gas
summary: We theoretically describe and experimentally observe the reversibility of a nonequilibrium state in a unitary Fermi gas confined in a time-dependent trap. Unlike the equilibrium case, reversibility out of equilibrium imposes a stringent condition: the accumulated dynamical phase must be an integer multiple of $2π$, i.e., $Δφ= 2ω_{0} s(T) = 2nπ$, where $ω_{0}$ is the initial trapping frequency and $s(T)$ is the rescaled time after a total evolution time $T$. We demonstrate the reversibility of an initial nonequilibrium state in an isotropic unitary Fermi gas by driving the optical trap through a round trip. We find two types of reversible pathways, the space-time scaling-invariant and polynomial shortcut-to-adiabaticity (STA) protocols. The phase condition restricts the round-trip time $T$ to discrete values, a distinguishing feature of nonequilibrium dynamics. Our work establishes a clear criterion for the quantum control of nonequilibrium many-body systems beyond linear response and provides practical pathways to reversibility.

AI.tldr: 本文理论提出并实验验证了含时陷阱中幺正费米气体非平衡态的可逆性：非平衡可逆要求累积动力学相位满足 Δφ=2ω0s(T)=2nπ，并据此通过光阱往返驱动实现初态复原，识别出时空标度不变与多项式绝热捷径两类可逆路径。
AI.motivation: 旨在突破平衡态情形和线性响应框架，为量子控制非平衡多体系统建立明确的非平衡可逆性判据，并提供可实际实现的可逆驱动路径；摘要未进一步说明具体应用背景。
AI.method: 理论描述含时陷阱中幺正费米气体的非平衡可逆条件，推导累积动力学相位须为 2π 整数倍的判据 Δφ=2ω0s(T)=2nπ；在各向同性幺正费米气体中驱动光阱完成往返，并分析时空标度不变协议与多项式绝热捷径（STA）协议两类可逆路径。摘要未提供实验参数、系统尺度、温度及协议细节。
AI.result: 实验观测到初始非平衡态在光阱往返驱动下的可逆恢复；发现两类可逆路径，即时空标度不变协议和多项式 STA 协议；相位条件使往返时间 T 只能取离散值，这是非平衡动力学的特征。摘要未给出可逆保真度、误差或定量实验指标。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了超越线性响应的非平衡多体系统量子控制判据，并给出实现可逆性的实用路径；离散往返时间条件体现了非平衡可逆性与平衡情形的本质区别。

title: ROSE: Deep Learning exchange-correlation functional from reduced density-matrix representations
summary: We introduce ROSE, a deep-learning exchange--correlation energy functional built from the occupied-state density matrix. On GMTKN55 and on additional external benchmarks considered in this work, ROSE improves over modern neural network functionals trained under matched protocols and is on average more accurate than, or on par with, most hybrid and range-separated hybrid functionals considered here. On the experimental benchmarks considered here it has leading accuracy across hybrids, range separated hybrids, and neural functionals. These results motivate nonlocal density-matrix representations as a route to systematic improvement of learned XC functionals with low computational cost.

AI.tldr: ROSE 是一种基于占据态密度矩阵构建的深度学习交换-关联能量泛函。在 GMTKN55 及本文考虑的外部基准上，它优于按相同训练协议训练的现代神经网络泛函，平均精度优于或相当于本文涉及的大多数杂化与范围分离杂化泛函；在本文考虑的实验基准上，其精度在杂化泛函、范围分离杂化泛函和神经网络泛函中领先。这表明非局域密度矩阵表示是以较低计算成本系统改进学习型交换-关联泛函的一条途径。
AI.motivation: 为了系统提升学习型交换-关联泛函的精度，并以较低计算成本接近或超越杂化与范围分离杂化泛函的水平；为此，作者提出用非局域密度矩阵表示作为实现路径。摘要未展开说明现有方法的具体缺陷分析或详细问题背景。
AI.method: 以占据态密度矩阵为输入，构建深度学习交换-关联能量泛函 ROSE；在 GMTKN55 及额外外部基准上，与按相同协议训练的神经网络泛函以及多种杂化、范围分离杂化泛函进行对比评估。摘要未给出网络结构、训练数据集、损失函数及实现细节。
AI.result: 在 GMTKN55 及本文考虑的外部基准上，ROSE 优于按相同协议训练的现代神经网络泛函，平均精度优于或相当于本文涉及的大多数杂化与范围分离杂化泛函；在本文考虑的实验基准上，其精度在杂化泛函、范围分离杂化泛函与神经网络泛函中处于领先。摘要未报告具体数值误差或统计量。
AI.conclusion: 非局域密度矩阵表示可作为以较低计算成本系统改进学习型交换-关联泛函的有效路线。

title: Readable Is Not Steerable: Pre-Registered Tests of Physical Structure in Learned Fluid Representations
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures. Code, pre-registrations and checkpoints: https://github.com/2025eb1100268-tech/readable-not-steerable
summary: Self-supervised world models are often said to organize their latents around physical quantities. We test this on 2D decaying Navier-Stokes flow in three pre-registered studies, each tested once on held-out data. In Study 1, a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) trained to predict the flow fails the pre-registered criteria for organizing its latent around fluid quantities better than an untrained network of the same architecture (not supported); a JEPA trained on non-physical linear dynamics and a static invariance model that never sees time do as well or better. In Study 2, plain autoencoders that render the field make enstrophy prominent in their slowest unsupervised latent directions (best r 0.80-0.86 vs 0.38 untrained; fresh seeds, sealed data). Adding VICReg lowers this prominence in every comparison, though not by the pre-registered margin for vorticity, while raising the autoencoders' linear decodability (partially supported). In Study 3, we build steerable directions ("dials") by routing: the decoder gets overall scale only through a small conditioning code, while its other pathway carries a degraded copy of spectral shape. Label-free rules find a loudness dial in all 8 trained models and a shape dial in 3 of 5 fresh seeds on sealed data, against a pre-registered bar of 4; neither control shows a shape dial (partially supported). Across the studies, what a latent contains and what can be controlled through it come apart. In exploration, a supervised direction reading spectral shape almost perfectly moved nothing when steered. During the build, the loudness dial had to be found by its effect on the output (closest to a pure rescaling), not by data variance; for shape, a variance rule and an effect-constrained rule each worked in 3 of 5 seeds. The program used about 70 logged hours on one consumer GPU; all pre-registrations, deviations, code and outputs are public.

AI.tldr: 该文以二维衰减Navier–Stokes流为测试平台，通过三项预注册研究（每项仅在留出数据上测试一次），检验自监督世界模型的潜变量是否围绕物理量组织，并区分潜变量“包含什么”与“能控制什么”。结果总体混合：JEPA未优于未训练网络；自编码器对拟能较敏感，但VICReg的影响不完全符合预注册；路由得到的响度/形状可调方向仅部分达标；表征内容与可控性出现分离。
AI.motivation: 检验“自监督世界模型会围绕物理量组织潜变量”这一常见主张，并用预注册标准和适当基线避免事后解释；同时考察潜表征所包含的信息是否等同于可通过该表征控制或操控的信息。
AI.method: 使用二维衰减Navier–Stokes流。研究1比较JEPA与同架构未训练网络，并加入非物理线性动力学JEPA和不见时间的静态不变性模型；研究2用普通自编码器及加入VICReg的模型，检查最慢无监督潜方向对拟能/涡度的突出性和线性可解码性；研究3通过路由构造可操控方向：解码器仅经小条件码获得整体尺度，另一通路携带退化频谱形状，并用无标签规则寻找响度与形状“拨盘”，设置对照、使用新种子和封存数据，按预注册阈值判定；另做监督方向探索。
AI.result: 研究1未获支持：JEPA未达到“比未训练网络更好地围绕流体量组织潜变量”的预注册标准，非物理线性动力学JEPA和静态不变性模型表现相当或更好。研究2部分支持：普通自编码器最慢无监督潜方向中拟能突出，最佳r为0.80–0.86，未训练网络为0.38；加入VICReg在每项比较中降低该突出性，但涡度未达预注册幅度，同时提高线性可解码性。研究3部分支持：8个训练模型均找到响度拨盘，形状拨盘在5个新种子中的3个出现，低于预注册要求的4个，两个对照均无形状拨盘；探索中，能近乎完美读出频谱形状的监督方向在被操控时几乎不改变输出；构建时响度拨盘需按输出效应（最接近纯重缩放）而非数据方差寻找，形状拨盘则方差规则和效应约束规则各在3/5种子奏效。摘要未给出完整效应量、置信区间和模型规模等细节。
AI.conclusion: 在这组二维衰减Navier–Stokes任务及预注册判据下，自监督世界模型潜变量围绕物理量组织的说法未获一致支持；简单自编码器、非物理动力学模型或静态模型可表现相当甚至更好。潜变量包含的信息与其可被控制的方向并不一致，因此不能仅凭线性可解码性或数据方差推断可控性。全部预注册、偏离、代码和输出公开，实验约在一张消费级GPU上记录70小时。

title: Time-resolved infrared spectroscopy with entangled photons and visible-light detection
summary: Time-resolved infrared (TR-IR) spectroscopy reveals molecular structural changes and charge-carrier dynamics on their intrinsic timescales, in photosynthesis, catalysis and optoelectronic materials, but requires complex sources of ultrashort infrared pulses, cryogenically cooled detectors to overcome thermal background, and intense probes that can perturb the sample. Quantum infrared spectroscopy avoids these constraints: harnessing quantum interference between the generation processes of frequency-entangled photon pairs, it reads out the infrared response of a sample by detecting only the visible partner photon, for which efficient detectors exist. To date, it has been limited to steady-state measurements. Here we demonstrate its ultrafast, time-resolved form with a picosecond visible pump pulse and a silicon detector. Each visible pulse generates photon pairs within a picosecond window; the infrared photon of a pair probes the excited sample at a set delay after excitation, and the transient response is read out from the count rate of its visible partner. We resolve picosecond carrier dynamics in a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror near 1529 nm with a picowatt-level probe, unaffected by thermal background and by sample IR photoluminescence 50 times stronger than the probe. The approach is applicable to the mid-infrared, fingerprint region, where infrared detection is hardest, and to the terahertz region.

AI.tldr: 该文首次实现超快时间分辨量子红外光谱：用皮秒可见泵浦和硅探测器，通过探测与红外探针光子纠缠的可见伴生光子，读出样品瞬态红外响应，并在1529 nm附近半导体可饱和吸收镜中解析皮秒载流子动力学。
AI.motivation: 传统时间分辨红外光谱可研究光合作用、催化及光电子材料中的结构变化和载流子动力学，但需要复杂超短红外脉冲源、低温冷却探测器以抑制热背景，且强探针可能扰动样品。量子红外光谱利用频率纠缠光子对的量子干涉，仅探测高效的可见伴生光子即可读出红外响应，从而规避这些限制；但此前仅限于稳态测量。
AI.method: 采用皮秒可见泵浦脉冲激发样品，并利用每个可见脉冲在皮秒时间窗口内产生频率纠缠光子对；每对中的红外光子作为探针，在激发后设定延迟探测激发态样品，其瞬态响应由可见伴生光子的计数率读出。实验使用硅探测器，在约1529 nm处测量半导体可饱和吸收镜的载流子动力学，探针功率为皮瓦级。
AI.result: 实现了超快时间分辨量子红外光谱，并解析出半导体可饱和吸收镜在约1529 nm附近的皮秒载流子动力学；测量使用皮瓦级探针，未受热背景影响，也未受比探针强50倍的样品红外光致发光干扰。摘要未给出具体时间分辨率数值或载流子寿命等定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将量子红外光谱从稳态扩展到超快时间分辨测量，展示出低探针功率、无需红外探测器冷却且抗热背景和红外光致发光干扰的优势；该方法可推广至红外探测最困难的中红外指纹区和太赫兹区。

title: From Forecasting to Feedback: Evaluating Learned Dynamics for Tokamak Control
summary: Learned temporal models are moving beyond offline forecasting toward interactive environments for decision making, yet logged-trajectory accuracy need not predict closed-loop behavior under policies optimized in the learned model. This forecasting-control gap matters in tokamak magnetic control, where coupled plasma-circuit dynamics and actuator constraints can amplify errors through feedback. Using a calibrated free-boundary Grad-Shafranov solver, we collect four datasets in a 2x2 design over physics-parameter and current-reference coverage. At matched budgets of 500, 1k, 3k, and 5k rollouts, we train 16 action-conditioned Transformers; PPO policies optimized in the 5k surrogates are then evaluated without adaptation on six reference-solver conditions. Only joint-coverage D4 shows monotonically decreasing cross-condition mean error, whereas D1 improves in distribution but degrades out of distribution. Binary completion masks substantial closed-loop differences: D2-D4 each complete 83.3% of conditions, but reach on average 99.0%, 94.7%, and 90.5% of the evaluation horizon, while their worst conditions reach 94.2%, 68.2%, and 43.2%. Policies trained with action noise complete 5/24 matched conditions, compared with 19/24 under nominal training, and have a lower mean horizon-capped episode length. Based on one trained policy per configuration and one evaluation realization per condition, the results support combining prediction error, episode completion, condition-level duration, and tracking quality.

AI.tldr: 论文研究学习型时序模型用于托卡马克磁控制时，离线轨迹预测精度不能代表闭环策略表现，并通过四类数据覆盖、16个动作条件Transformer和PPO策略的跨条件评估，主张联合使用预测误差、回合完成、条件级持续时间和跟踪质量进行评价。
AI.motivation: 学习型时序模型正从离线预测走向交互式决策，但日志轨迹精度未必能预测在学习模型中优化后的策略的闭环行为；托卡马克磁控制中耦合的等离子体—电路动力学和执行器约束会通过反馈放大误差，因此存在需要关注的预测—控制差距。
AI.method: 使用校准的自由边界Grad-Shafranov求解器，按物理参数和电流参考覆盖度以2x2设计收集四个数据集；在500、1k、3k、5k次rollout的匹配预算下训练16个动作条件Transformer；在5k代理模型中以PPO优化策略，并在六个参考求解器条件下不做自适应地评估；比较不同数据覆盖、动作噪声、二元完成掩码、条件级持续时间和跟踪质量。摘要未提供求解器、Transformer和PPO的更多结构及超参数细节。
AI.result: 仅联合覆盖的D4显示跨条件平均误差单调下降，D1在分布内改善但在分布外退化。二元完成掩码掩盖了实质闭环差异：D2—D4均完成83.3%的条件，但平均分别达到评估时域的99.0%、94.7%和90.5%，最差条件分别达到94.2%、68.2%和43.2%。动作噪声训练的策略完成5/24个匹配条件，名义训练为19/24，且平均时域截断回合长度更低。
AI.conclusion: 基于每个配置仅训练一个策略、每个条件仅做一次评估实现，结果支持将预测误差、回合完成情况、条件级持续时间和跟踪质量结合起来评价学习型模型中的控制策略；摘要未提供多种子、统计显著性或多策略重复实验的细节。

title: The Valence and Inner Shell Ionization Properties of Sr I - III by Non-Thermal Electrons in Kilonovae
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to Journal of Quantitative Spectroscopy and Radiative Transfer
summary: The presence of strontium (Z = 38) was identified from spectra of the first multi-messenger kilonova transient, AT2017gfo, with the evolution of its spectral signature indicating a rapidly changing ionization balance. Interpretation of spectra at later times requires a more detailed understanding of recombination and ionization processes, including ionization by `non-thermal' electrons produced by beta decay. Published measurements of the ionization cross sections of Sr I and Sr II show complex structures likely arising from excitation autoionization. Using the Flexible Atomic Code we report calculations of the valence and inner shell ionization cross sections for Sr I, Sr II, and Sr III, and recover similar structures in the ionization cross sections. Though no measurements exist for Sr III, the calculations suggest negligible contributions from excitation autoionization. These new data are incorporated into Spencer-Fano models of non-thermal electron degradation and coupled to an ionization balance solver. The effects of excitation autoionization, treated as excitation with the additional production of an Auger electron, on the degradation spectra of non-thermal are explored. Calculations at both level- and configuration-average resolution return ion fractions that agree within 5-20%. The calculations probe the impact of including final-charge-state-resolved branching ratios for inner shell ionization which result in multi-ionization events from successive Auger cascades. Omission of these branching ratios is shown to have large impacts on the ionization balance. The calculated cross sections will be provided on Zenodo.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AT2017gfo中锶谱线所反映的快速电离平衡，计算Sr I、Sr II和Sr III的价壳层与内壳层电离截面，并将激发自电离、β衰变产生的非热电子降解及电离平衡耦合建模，评估末态分辨分支比对电离平衡的影响。
AI.motivation: 解释AT2017gfo晚期光谱需要更详细地理解复合与电离过程，包括β衰变产生的非热电子所致电离；已发表的Sr I和Sr II电离截面测量显示可能源于激发自电离的复杂结构，而Sr III尚无测量数据，因此需要理论截面并纳入非热电子降解与电离平衡模型。
AI.method: 使用Flexible Atomic Code计算Sr I、Sr II和Sr III的价壳层及内壳层电离截面；将激发自电离处理为激发并额外产生Auger电子；把新截面纳入Spencer-Fano非热电子降解模型并耦合电离平衡求解器；比较能级平均与组态平均结果，并考察内壳层电离的末态电荷态分辨分支比及连续Auger级联导致的多重电离。
AI.result: 计算在电离截面中恢复了与测量相似的复杂结构；尽管Sr III无测量，计算表明其激发自电离贡献可忽略。能级平均与组态平均给出的离子 fractions 在5–20%内一致。省略内壳层电离的末态电荷态分辨分支比会对电离平衡产生很大影响。计算截面将发布在Zenodo。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了Sr I、Sr II和Sr III的价壳层与内壳层电离截面数据，并表明激发自电离处理、非热电子降解耦合以及内壳层电离的多重电离分支比对于电离平衡建模具有重要性；能级平均与组态平均的离子分数差异较小。摘要未给出激发自电离对降解谱影响的具体定量结果，也未给出与观测光谱直接拟合的结论。

title: Transient subtraction method: An alternative approach for variance reduction in dissipative particle dynamics
summary: The efficient and accurate computation of transport coefficients remains a numerical challenge in dissipative particle dynamics (DPD), which can require substantial sampling to control statistical uncertainty. We extend recent results obtained in Langevin dynamics to consider the transient subtraction method for reducing the variance of transport coefficient estimations in DPD. The system is initialised by perturbing equilibrium samples, and its relaxation towards equilibrium is monitored under the reference dynamics. A reference trajectory, initialised at equilibrium and driven by the same Brownian noise, provides a control variate for the transient response. We apply the transient subtraction method to the computation of the mobility and the shear viscosity in a Lennard-Jones fluid in DPD. The shear viscosity is obtained from the time-integrated response of a Fourier observable associated with the longitudinal velocity. Numerical comparisons with the naive transient estimator show that the transient subtraction method reduces the variance at various integration times, and the reduction is more pronounced with a higher friction coefficient. These results indicate that the transient subtraction method is able to improve the statistical precision of transport coefficient estimations in DPD and reduce the number of trajectories needed to attain a prescribed standard error.

AI.tldr: 本文将瞬态减法方法从朗之万动力学推广到耗散粒子动力学，用于降低迁移率和剪切黏度等输运系数估计的方差，并验证其统计精度提升效果。
AI.motivation: 耗散粒子动力学中输运系数的精确高效计算仍是数值挑战，通常需要大量采样来控制统计不确定性；作者希望减少输运系数估计的方差和所需轨迹数。
AI.method: 基于扰动平衡样本初始化系统，在参考动力学下监测其向平衡的松弛；用从平衡态初始化、由相同布朗噪声驱动的参考轨迹作为控制变量，构造瞬态响应估计。作者将该方法用于DPD中Lennard-Jones流体的迁移率和剪切黏度计算，其中剪切黏度由与纵向速度相关的Fourier可观测量的时间积分响应获得，并与朴素瞬态估计器进行数值比较。
AI.result: 数值比较表明，瞬态减法方法在多种积分时间下均降低方差，且摩擦系数越高，方差降低越明显。
AI.conclusion: 瞬态减法方法能够提高DPD中输运系数估计的统计精度，并减少达到给定标准误差所需的轨迹数量。

title: Stroh--Hamiltonian Framework for Modeling Incompressible Poroelastic Materials
summary: The Stroh sextic formalism, developed by Stroh, offers a compelling framework for representing the equilibrium equations in anisotropic elasticity. This approach has proven particularly effective for studying multilayered structures and time-harmonic problems, owing to its ability to seamlessly integrate physical constraints into the analysis. By recognizing that the Stroh formalism aligns with the canonical Hamiltonian structure, this work extends its application to Biot's poroelasticity, focusing on scenarios where the solid material is incompressible and there is no fluid pressure gradient. The study introduces a novel Hamiltonian-based approach to analyze such systems, offering deeper insights into the interplay between solid incompressibility and fluid-solid coupling. A key novelty lies in the derivation of canonical equations under these constraints, enabling clearer interpretations of reversible poroelastic behavior. However, the framework assumes perfectly drained conditions and neglects dissipative effects, which limits its applicability to fully realistic scenarios involving energy loss or complex fluid dynamics. Despite this limitation, the work provides a foundational step toward understanding constrained poroelastic systems and paves the way for future extensions to more general cases, including dissipative and nonlinear regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文把与正则哈密顿结构相契合的 Stroh 六次 formalism 推广到 Biot 多孔弹性，在固体不可压缩且无流体压力梯度的约束下推导正则方程，以分析可逆多孔弹性行为；该框架假设完全排水并忽略耗散，尚不能覆盖含能量损失或复杂流体动力学的现实情形。
AI.motivation: Stroh 六次 formalism 能有效表示各向异性弹性中的平衡方程，并因便于融入物理约束而适用于多层结构和时谐问题；作者希望利用其与正则哈密顿结构的一致性，将应用拓展到固体不可压缩、无流体压力梯度的 Biot 多孔弹性场景，深入理解固体不可压缩性与流固耦合之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 基于 Stroh formalism 与正则哈密顿结构的对应关系，构建面向 Biot 多孔弹性的新型哈密顿方法，并在固体不可压缩且无流体压力梯度的约束下推导正则方程，用于解释可逆多孔弹性行为。
AI.result: 论文给出了约束条件下的正则方程和哈密顿框架，提供对固体不可压缩性与流固耦合相互作用的更深入认识，并使可逆多孔弹性行为的解释更清晰；摘要未提供定量结果或数值验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解受约束的多孔弹性系统提供了基础性一步，并为推广到包含耗散和非线性等更一般情形奠定方向；但其完全排水假设和耗散忽略限制了其对存在能量损失或复杂流体动力学的真实场景的适用性。

title: A closed-form design rule for photonic hopfions of arbitrary order
comment: 45 pages total (15 pages main manuscript, 30 pages supplementary information); 11 figures
summary: Topological textures of light are robust against perturbation and are emerging as carriers of information and probes of light-matter interaction. The most intricate of them, the photonic hopfion, in which the loops of different polarization states are linked, has so far been assembled from chosen superpositions of laser modes, with weights set by hand or found by numerical optimization. Here we replace this search with a design rule. Two scalar beams, an optical vortex of order $\ell$ and a field with n dark rings, propagate in closed form, and their phases on one plane are the two masks of a metasurface that controls two orthogonal polarizations. Although a beam, unlike the closed spaces of topology, extends to infinity, we prove that it is a hopfion of order $n\ell$ whenever three algebraic conditions on the ring coefficients and the vortex order hold, and that the polarization loops of every state that the far field does not reach then link exactly $n\ell$ times; each condition guards against one way in which the topology can escape. The order is thus chosen on paper and the device follows directly, without optimization. In scalar simulation, one terahertz metasurface geometry produces hopfions up to order nine, and a full-wave simulation of the complete first-order device preserves its topology. The rule applies to any platform that shapes the phases of two orthogonal polarizations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需数值优化的光子霍普夫子设计规则：将携带轨道角动量ℓ的光学涡旋与含n个暗环的标量场传播至同一平面，以其相位作为超表面两个正交偏振的掩模；当三个代数条件满足时，可证明所得光束为拓扑荷nℓ的霍普夫子。标量仿真中单一太赫兹超表面几何结构可产生高达九阶的霍普夫子，完整一阶器件的全波仿真保持其拓扑。
AI.motivation: 光子霍普夫子由不同偏振态的环链接构成，拓扑纹理对扰动鲁棒，正成为信息载体和光与物质相互作用的探针；但此前这类结构需从选定的激光模式叠加中组装，其权重依赖手工设定或数值优化，缺乏直接设计规则。
AI.method: 用两束标量光束——ℓ阶光学涡旋和含n个暗环的场——以闭合形式传播，并将它们在某一平面上的相位作为控制两个正交偏振的超表面双掩模；通过解析推导证明，当环系数与涡旋阶数满足三个代数条件时，即使光束延伸至无穷远，仍构成nℓ阶霍普夫子，且远场未到达的每个状态的偏振环精确链接nℓ次，每个条件分别防止一种拓扑逃逸方式；随后采用标量仿真与完整器件的全波仿真验证。
AI.result: 在标量仿真中，一种太赫兹超表面几何结构可产生最高九阶的霍普夫子；对完整一阶器件的全波仿真表明其拓扑得以保持。摘要未提供实验制备或实验测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作用设计规则取代对模式叠加权重的搜索：拓扑阶数可在纸面上选定，器件设计随之直接确定，无需优化；规则适用于任何能够塑造两个正交偏振相位的平台。实验验证未在摘要中提供。

title: Shock wave transmission across solid-water interfaces in underwater electrical foil explosions
summary: The transmission of shock waves generated by underwater electrical foil explosions across solid materials with varying acoustic impedances and thicknesses is investigated. Copper foils with thicknesses of 10 and 18 $μ$m are exploded on planar substrates of aluminum, copper, and 3D-printed PLA with thicknesses up to 5 mm using a multi-gigawatt pulsed-power electrical discharge. The resulting shocks are visualized in water using high-speed shadowgraphy at 5 million frames per second, while high-resolution fiber optic hydrophone measurements provide direct quantitative measurements of shock strength after transmission through the impedance-mismatched materials. One-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic simulations are used to reproduce the foil explosion dynamics and provide insight into the thermodynamic, acoustic, and electrical properties of the foil during the explosion. The results show that shock transmission is governed not only by the impedance mismatch at the solid--water interface but also by the finite thickness and dynamic response of the supporting material. These findings provide a quantitative framework for understanding and controlling shock transmission in underwater electrical foil explosions and establish the feasibility and limitations of using solid substrates as structural supports in complex shock-generating geometries.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过水下电爆炸铜箔实验、高速阴影成像、光纤水听器测量和一维磁流体动力学模拟，研究冲击波经不同声阻抗与厚度的固体材料传播后的强度变化，发现传播受固-水界面阻抗失配及支撑材料有限厚度和动态响应共同控制。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解并控制水下电爆炸箔产生的冲击波在固体支撑材料中的传输规律，并评估将固体基底用作复杂冲击波生成几何结构中结构支撑的可行性与局限。
AI.method: 使用多吉瓦脉冲功率放电，使厚度为10和18 μm的铜箔在铝、铜和3D打印PLA平面基底上爆炸，基底厚度最高达5 mm；以每秒500万帧的高速阴影成像在水中间接可视化冲击波，并用高分辨率光纤水听器直接定量测量经阻抗失配材料传输后的冲击强度；同时采用一维磁流体动力学模拟再现箔爆炸动力学，分析爆炸期间箔的热力学、声学和电学特性。
AI.result: 结果表明，冲击波传输不仅由固体-水界面的阻抗失配决定，还受支撑材料的有限厚度及其动态响应影响；实验与模拟给出了相关定量认识。
AI.conclusion: 研究为理解和控制水下电爆炸箔中的冲击波传输提供了定量框架，并明确了固体基底作为复杂冲击波生成几何结构中结构支撑的可行性与局限性。

title: A $θ$-implicit hybrid particle-in-cell algorithm for kinetic simulations of magnetized plasmas
summary: Hybrid particle-in-cell (PIC) models with kinetic ions and an inertialess electron fluid are widely used to simulate magnetized plasmas at ion scales, but explicit time advances are constrained by the whistler-wave CFL condition $\dt \propto Δx^2$, and the sub-cycling and artificial dissipation used to mitigate it carry accumulating costs. We present a $θ$-implicit hybrid PIC algorithm, implemented in the open-source GPU-capable code WarpX, in which fields and particles are advanced as a single nonlinear system solved by a particle-suppressed Jacobian-free Newton--Krylov method: the particles are nonlinearly eliminated, the electric field of the generalized Ohm's law is the sole unknown, and mass matrices remove all particle operations from the linear iterations. The electron pressure is advanced inside the nonlinear solve, and the scheme satisfies a discrete energy law whose single dissipation term vanishes at $θ= 1/2$ and damps only temporally under-resolved modes for $θ> 1/2$. The advance reproduces parallel and perpendicular wave dispersion including the ion Bernstein modes, conserves total energy to machine roundoff where the explicit advance heats secularly, does not develop the cold-beam finite-grid instability, and reproduces the $m=0$ instability of a Bennett pinch in RZ geometry. We conclude with 3D simulations of a field-reversed configuration initialized from a Grad--Shafranov equilibrium, comparing the explicit and implicit advances on the growth of the tilt instability and the preservation of trapped magnetic flux.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并在 WarpX 中实现了用于动理学离子与无惯性电子流体的 θ 隐式混合 PIC 算法，通过粒子抑制的 JFNK 求解统一非线性系统，克服显式推进受 whistler 波 CFL 条件限制及子循环/人工耗散成本累积的问题，并验证了色散、能量守恒、有限网格不稳定性及三维场反位形中的应用。
AI.motivation: 混合 PIC 模型广泛用于离子尺度磁化等离子体模拟，但显式时间推进受 whistler 波 CFL 条件约束，时间步长与网格尺寸平方成正比；用于缓解该限制的子循环和人工耗散会带来累积成本，因此需要更高效的隐式推进方法。
AI.method: 提出 θ 隐式混合 PIC 算法，并在支持 GPU 的开源代码 WarpX 中实现。场与粒子作为单一非线性系统，由粒子抑制的 Jacobian-free Newton--Krylov 方法求解：非线性消去粒子，以广义欧姆定律中的电场为唯一未知量，并用质量矩阵将粒子操作从线性迭代中移除；电子压力在非线性求解内部推进。该格式满足离散能量定律，其单一耗散项在 θ=1/2 时消失，在 θ>1/2 时仅阻尼时间上欠分辨的模式。
AI.result: 该推进格式再现了平行和垂直波色散，包括离子 Bernstein 模；在显式推进出现长期加热的情形下，总能量守恒达到机器舍入误差；不产生冷束有限网格不稳定性；在 RZ 几何中再现了 Bennett 箍缩的 m=0 不稳定性。最后给出由 Grad--Shafranov 平衡初始化的场反位形三维模拟，比较显式与隐式推进对倾斜不稳定性增长和捕获磁通保持的影响。
AI.conclusion: θ 隐式混合 PIC 算法为离子尺度磁化等离子体提供了一种具有离散能量定律性质的隐式推进方案，并在波色散、能量守恒、有限网格不稳定性和 Bennett 箍缩等问题中得到验证；三维场反位形模拟进一步用于比较显式与隐式推进在倾斜不稳定性及捕获磁通保持方面的表现。

title: A wider state, not wider arithmetic, for single-precision time integration
summary: Single precision (FP32) halves the memory and data movement of double precision (FP64), and on accelerators is often several times faster. Its rounding errors are harmless except in the stored state. A modified equation for Runge-Kutta methods in Shu-Osher form and linear multistep methods separates the rounding of the stored state, a forcing proportional to $1/Δt$, from truncation and from right-hand-side rounding, which sets a $Δt$-independent floor. We bound this forcing for strong-stability-preserving schemes and identify two mechanisms that keep its sign fixed, so it accumulates as a bias: past a turnaround step, refining the step increases the error, in FP64 as in FP32. For a model oscillator the analysis predicts the floor and the FP32-to-FP64 ratios of turnaround step and minimum error within 30%. Our remedy needs no FP64 arithmetic: each state variable is stored as the unevaluated sum of two FP32 numbers, updated with error-free transformations, while every right-hand-side evaluation stays in FP32. Unlike compensated summation, it needs no rewriting of the scheme. In model problems from geophysical flow, mechanical dynamics and celestial mechanics, with five Runge-Kutta and multistep schemes, it restores design-order convergence to the floor. In large-eddy simulations of a high-lift airplane wing on three refined grids, up to 544 million cells, with time steps $Δt$, $Δt/2$ and $Δt/4$, FP32 overpredicts the lift by 2.1, 4.5 and 7.7%, while the two-float lift agrees with FP64 within 0.3% on every grid, and on graphics processing units the production solver runs 1.6 to 2.7 times faster than FP64.

AI.tldr: 论文分析FP32时间积分的舍入误差来源，指出存储状态舍入会形成随1/Δt增长的偏置力并导致细化时间步反而增大误差；提出用两个FP32数表示每个状态量、借助无误差变换更新、右端项仍用FP32计算的无FP64补救方案，在多种模型和GPU大规模LES中恢复设计阶收敛并接近FP64精度与更快速度。
AI.motivation: FP32相比FP64可将内存和数据移动减半，在加速器上常快数倍，且除存储状态外舍入误差通常无害；因此需要理解并控制存储状态舍入造成的误差下限和偏置，以便在不大幅牺牲精度的情况下利用FP32性能。
AI.method: 针对Shu-Osher形式的Runge-Kutta方法和线性多步法建立修改方程，将存储状态舍入产生的、与1/Δt成正比的强迫项与截断误差及右端项舍入分开；对强稳定性保持格式给出该强迫项的界，并识别使其符号固定的两种机制；提出无需FP64算术的补救方案：每个状态变量存为两个FP32数的未求和和，使用无误差变换更新，所有右端项计算仍为FP32，且无需像补偿求和那样改写格式。
AI.result: 分析表明存储状态舍入偏置在越过转折步后会使细化时间步增大误差，FP64和FP32均如此；模型振子预测的误差下限及FP32/FP64的转折步与最小误差比值误差在30%以内。在地球物理流动、机械动力学和天体力学模型问题中，配合五种Runge-Kutta和多步格式，该方法将收敛恢复到设计阶并达到误差下限。高升力飞机机翼LES在三套细化网格、最多5.44亿单元及Δt、Δt/2、Δt/4下，FP32升力分别高估2.1%、4.5%、7.7%，双FP32升力在各网格与FP64相差0.3%以内；GPU上生产求解器比FP64快1.6至2.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 存储状态舍入是FP32时间积分的主要误差偏置来源，会导致细化步长失效；采用双FP32状态表示与无误差变换可在右端项保持FP32的同时恢复设计阶收敛、获得接近FP64的精度，并在GPU大规模应用中显著快于FP64。

title: Mueller Matrix Decomposition for a General Rotating Compensator Ellipsometer
summary: This work develops a Mueller matrix decomposition that factors a nondepolarizing Mueller matrix $M$ into three components $M = T_1 D T_2$, where the elements $D$, which correspond to a diagonal Jones matrix, are separated from rotations and circular diattenuation $T_1, T_2$. This decomposition is employed to calibrate a prototype reflective rotating-compensator ellipsometer designed to operate using extreme ultraviolet (EUV) radiation. This decomposition allows for the measurement of the full Mueller matrix of a sample without full knowledge of the compensators or the source polarization, while allowing for significant diattenuation and retardance for the optics. A generalization of the decomposition is developed for depolarizing Mueller matrices, and the technique is tested on reflection data collected on an Au mirror at $266$ nm.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种将非退偏穆勒矩阵分解为 M=T1DT2 的方法，其中 D 对应对角琼斯矩阵，T1、T2 包含旋转与圆二向衰减；该方法用于校准极紫外反射式旋转补偿器椭偏仪，并推广到退偏穆勒矩阵，且在 266 nm 金镜反射数据上进行了测试。
AI.motivation: 为校准面向极紫外辐射的原型反射式旋转补偿器椭偏仪，并在不完全已知补偿器和光源偏振状态的条件下测量样品完整穆勒矩阵，同时允许光学系统具有显著二向衰减和延迟量。
AI.method: 建立非退偏穆勒矩阵分解 M=T1DT2，将对应对角琼斯矩阵的 D 与旋转及圆二向衰减 T1、T2 分离；将该分解用于椭偏仪校准；进一步发展适用于退偏穆勒矩阵的推广形式，并利用 266 nm 金镜反射数据检验该技术。
AI.result: 提出了所述穆勒矩阵分解及其退偏推广，并将其用于原型极紫外反射式旋转补偿器椭偏仪的校准；该分解支持在不完全了解补偿器或光源偏振的情况下测量样品完整穆勒矩阵，且允许光学元件存在显著二向衰减和延迟；摘要报告在 266 nm 金镜反射数据上进行了测试，但未给出定量性能结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可用于相关椭偏仪校准和完整穆勒矩阵测量的分解框架，并扩展到退偏情形；摘要未提供关于精度、误差或校准成功程度的明确结论。

title: Interstellar and intergalactic medium in the ultraviolet band
summary: This article presents an overview of key scientific challenges in the astrophysics and astrochemistry of the interstellar and intergalactic media. Addressing many of these challenges will become possible with the Russian space observatory Spektr-UF, which is currently being prepared for launch. The ultraviolet (UV) spectral range is critically important for studying the evolution of the Universe, as it contains fundamental absorption and emission lines of most chemical elements and the most important molecules. These lines make it possible to reliably determine the physical conditions and chemical composition of various astrophysical objects, as well as the characteristics of the processes occurring within them. The article examines the prospects for UV observations across a broad range of scientific problems, from investigating the epoch of helium reionization and the thermal history of the Universe to mapping ongoing star formation in galaxies. Dedicated sections address the study of the chemical evolution of galaxies at intermediate redshifts, the distribution of "hidden" baryons and metals, the small-scale structure of interstellar clouds, the physics of photodissociation regions and protoplanetary disks, and the modeling of UV emission from nebulae surrounding fast-moving pulsars. The high sensitivity and spectral resolution of the Spektr-UF instruments are expected to provide fundamentally new data across all these research areas, filling existing gaps in our understanding of the interstellar and intergalactic media.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了星际介质与星系际介质天体物理和天体化学中的关键科学挑战，并评估俄罗斯Spektr-UF紫外空间天文台在应对这些挑战方面的观测前景；该天文台尚在准备发射，摘要未提供实际观测结果。
AI.motivation: 紫外波段包含大多数化学元素和重要分子的关键吸收线、发射线，可用于可靠测定天体物理对象的物理条件、化学组成及其内部过程，因此对研究宇宙演化至关重要；Spektr-UF有望推动解决星际和星系际介质中的多项科学难题。
AI.method: 文章采用科学问题综述方式，梳理从氦再电离时代、宇宙热历史到星系恒星形成制图等广泛紫外观测议题，并分节讨论中等红移星系化学演化、“隐藏”重子和金属分布、星际云小尺度结构、光致离解区和原行星盘物理，以及快速移动脉冲星周围星云紫外辐射建模。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体观测数据或定量结果；作者预期Spektr-UF仪器的高灵敏度和光谱分辨率将在上述研究方向提供全新数据，填补对星际和星系际介质认识上的现有空白。
AI.conclusion: Spektr-UF的紫外观测有望在广泛天体物理和天体化学问题上取得重要进展，但摘要所述为任务科学前景和预期能力，而非已完成的观测成果。

title: Mercury (Hg): a relativistic $N$-body simulation for Horndeski gravity
summary: We present Mercury, a relativistic $N$-body code for cosmological simulations in the $α$-basis formulation of Horndeski gravity. Mercury extends a particle-mesh scheme by incorporating the dynamics of the additional scalar degree of freedom and the corresponding modified Einstein equations, expressed in terms of the time-dependent functions $α_{\rm K}, α_{\rm B}, α_{\rm M}, α_{\rm T}$ and the effective Planck mass $M_*^2$. This generalises our previous implementation of Horndeski subclass models, namely $k$-essence and kinetic gravity braiding (KGB), to the general linear Horndeski $α$-basis. The code evolves the additional scalar degree of freedom and its effective stress--energy tensor alongside the nonlinear matter and metric fields, so that nonlinear structure formation sources the scalar-field evolution and feeds back on the gravitational potentials. Through its interface with hi_class, Mercury supports both phenomenological $α$-function parametrisations and covariant Horndeski theories; we demonstrate the latter using nKGB, the Cubic Galileon, and Brans--Dicke models. We validate the implementation against hi_class in the linear regime and recover the expected nonlinear $k$-essence and KGB limits. For the luminal Horndeski models considered here, we show how a running effective Planck mass generates gravitational slip through the scalar anisotropic stress and modifies the friction terms governing the vector and tensor metric perturbations. The evolution of $M_*^2$ also modifies the normalisation and scale dependence of the effective dark-energy density contrast, leaving a corresponding imprint on its power spectrum. The present framework provides an intermediate step towards nonlinear Horndeski simulations, in which nonlinear scalar self-interactions and screening effects can be incorporated consistently within the same relativistic framework.

AI.tldr: 提出Mercury：一个用于Horndeski引力α-basis宇宙学模拟的相对论N体代码。它把粒子网格方案扩展到包含额外标量自由度及其有效应力能量张量与修正Einstein方程的联合演化，并通过hi_class接口支持现象学α函数和协变Horndeski模型；在线性区与hi_class验证，恢复非线性k-essence与KGB极限，并揭示跑动有效Planck质量对引力滑移、摩擦项及暗能量密度扰动功率谱的影响。
AI.motivation: 将此前仅覆盖k-essence和动能引力编织（KGB）子类的Horndeski实现推广到一般线性Horndeski α-basis，自洽描述非线性结构形成与标量场演化的相互反馈，并为后续在相同相对论框架中纳入非线性标量自相互作用和屏蔽效应提供中间步骤。
AI.method: Mercury在粒子网格方案基础上加入额外标量自由度及对应有效应力能量张量，使其与非线性物质场和度规场共同演化；修正Einstein方程以时间相关函数α_K、α_B、α_M、α_T和有效Planck质量M_*^2表示。代码通过hi_class接口支持现象学α函数参数化和协变Horndeski理论，并用nKGB、Cubic Galileon和Brans-Dicke模型演示；在线性区与hi_class对比验证，并检查非线性k-essence和KGB极限。
AI.result: 实现通过线性区hi_class验证，并恢复预期的非线性k-essence和KGB极限。对于所考虑的luminal Horndeski模型，跑动的有效Planck质量通过标量各向异性应力产生引力滑移，并修改控制矢量与张量度规扰动的摩擦项；M_*^2演化还改变有效暗能量密度对比的归一化和尺度依赖，从而在其功率谱上留下印记。摘要未提供定量精度、模拟分辨率或具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: Mercury提供了一般线性Horndeski α-basis的相对论N体模拟框架，可自洽演化额外标量自由度、度规扰动与非线性物质结构，并捕捉有效Planck质量跑动对引力滑移、摩擦项和暗能量密度扰动功率谱的影响；该工作是迈向包含非线性标量自相互作用与屏蔽效应的非线性Horndeski模拟的中间步骤。

title: Lagrangian Irreversibility in Stratified Turbulence
summary: Stable stratification reorganizes turbulence, suppressing vertical motion and altering the balance between vortical and strain-dominated flow structures. How these changes affect the temporal asymmetry of kinetic-energy exchange along fluid-particle trajectories remains incompletely understood. Using direct numerical simulations of homogeneous Boussinesq turbulence, we investigate Lagrangian power statistics across four local velocity-gradient topology classes and three nonzero stratification strengths, with an unstratified reference case. With increasing stratification, the global power variance decreases while the standardized skewness becomes more negative, indicating enhanced asymmetry despite weaker fluctuations. Conditioning on local topology reveals distinct responses: axial-strain-dominated regions exhibit the most negative total-power skewness at all stratification strengths, whereas biaxial-strain-dominated regions change sign from positive to negative under stratification. Horizontal and vertical component powers also respond differently, revealing directional dependence. Among the dynamical contributions to power, the pressure contribution, nearly symmetric in the unstratified case, becomes more negatively skewed with increasing stratification. Energy-conditioned pressure statistics further indicate altered pressure-mediated energy redistribution. Finally, tracer persistence-time distributions exhibit exponential tails, with time scales that differ across topology classes and respond differently to stratification. Increasing stratification is thus accompanied by three concurrent changes: enhanced asymmetry of Lagrangian power, modified energy redistribution by pressure, and altered temporal sampling of local flow structures by tracers. These co-occurring signatures characterize the response to stratification, though their causal relations remain to be established.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过均匀Boussinesq湍流的直接数值模拟，考察不同局地速度梯度拓扑类别与分层强度下Lagrangian功率统计，发现分层增强会同时带来Lagrangian功率不对称性增强、压力介导的能量再分配改变以及示踪粒子对局地流动结构时间采样的改变。
AI.motivation: 稳定分层会重组湍流、抑制垂向运动并改变涡旋与应变主导结构之间的平衡，但这些变化如何影响沿流体粒子轨迹的动能交换的时间不对称性仍不完全清楚。
AI.method: 采用均匀Boussinesq湍流的直接数值模拟，在四种局地速度梯度拓扑类别、三种非零分层强度及一个未分层参考情形下研究Lagrangian功率统计；分析包括总功率与水平/垂向分量功率、功率的动力学贡献（尤其压力贡献）、能量条件化的压力统计，以及示踪粒子持续时间的分布。
AI.result: 随分层增强，全局功率方差下降，而标准化偏度变得更负，表明波动减弱但不对称性增强。按局地拓扑条件化后响应不同：轴向应变主导区域在所有分层强度下总功率偏度最负；双轴应变主导区域在分层下由正偏度变为负偏度。水平与垂向分量功率响应不同，体现方向依赖性。压力贡献在未分层情形近似对称，随分层增强而更负偏；能量条件化压力统计进一步表明压力介导的能量再分配发生改变。示踪粒子持续时间分布呈指数尾，时间尺度随拓扑类别不同且对分层的响应不同。
AI.conclusion: 分层增强伴随三种并发变化：Lagrangian功率不对称性增强、压力介导的能量再分配改变、示踪粒子对局地流动结构的时间采样改变；这些共同特征刻画了对分层的响应，但其因果关系尚待确立。

title: Neuromorphic Camera for Multi-Target Pointing Acquisition and Tracking in Free Space Optical Communication
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables including 3 appendices. This paper has been accepted for invited presentation at SPIE Sensors + Imaging 2026, Edinburgh, UK. 2026 SPIE
summary: Pointing, Acquisition, and Tracking (PAT) in Free-Space Optical Communication (FSOC) applications must achieve both low jitter and a large Field of View (FoV) to support beacon acquisition and multi-target tracking. While conventional frame-based sensors provide the necessary angular coverage, their performance is limited by latency, available frame-rate, and motion blur.
