This work explores and demonstrates the application of an event-based vision sensor for PAT tasks in FSOC. The system employs a neuromorphic sensor that asynchronously records brightness changes (events) with microsecond-level temporal resolution. The main contribution of this paper is a comparative analysis of event-based tracking algorithms for the simultaneous acquisition and tracking of multiple optical beacons that operate directly on this asynchronous stream. The performance of these strategies is validated on an experimental dataset representing realistic operational conditions for dynamic High-Altitude Platform (HAP) and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) networks. The analysis compares key metrics, such as tracking accuracy and processing latency, under various signal-to-background conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文探索将事件相机用于自由空间光通信的指向、捕获与跟踪（PAT），并比较多种可直接处理异步事件流的跟踪算法，以同时捕获和跟踪多个光信标；在模拟HAP/UAV动态场景的实验数据上验证，并比较跟踪精度与处理时延等指标。
AI.motivation: FSOC中的PAT需同时具备低抖动和大视场，以支持信标捕获与多目标跟踪。传统帧式传感器虽具角度覆盖，但受时延、帧率和运动模糊限制，因此需要探索事件式视觉方案。
AI.method: 采用异步记录亮度变化、具微秒级时间分辨率的神经形态事件传感器；核心贡献是对多种事件式跟踪算法进行比较分析，这些算法直接作用于异步事件流，用于多个光信标的同步捕获与跟踪；并在代表动态HAP和UAV网络真实运行条件的实验数据集上验证，比较不同信号背景条件下的跟踪精度和处理时延等指标。
AI.result: 摘要称这些策略在实验数据集上得到验证，并比较了跟踪精度与处理时延等关键指标；但未提供具体数值结果，也未说明哪种算法最优。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明事件式视觉传感器可用于FSOC的PAT任务探索与演示，并建立了多光信标事件式跟踪算法的比较分析；但未给出明确的最终性能结论或推荐方案。

title: Counterexample-driven autonomous research with application to excess radiated energy in a Z-pinch
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables; code at https://github.com/tomzhu0225/simjecture
summary: Recent breakthroughs in artificial-intelligence-assisted mathematics show that open-ended machine search can outperform human mathematicians, yet transferring this paradigm to physics requires refactoring the research workflow. We introduce Simjecture, an open-source framework in which language-model agents pursue human-defined physical conjectures. The framework tackles two central challenges in this transfer: first, because physics is empirical and no model is final, it structures inquiry around counterexample-driven falsification and prospective hypothesis repair; second, because physical theories must interact with the real world, it uses computational physics as an executable testbed while separating the qualification of numerical instruments from scientific claim review so solvers and diagnostics can be adapted within a recorded investigation. We apply the framework in an 82.6 h investigation to tackle the long-standing problem of radiated energy exceeding the imploding-shell kinetic energy in a Z-pinch. The investigation reveals competing effects of energy conversion, retention, and release timing. Stronger coherent helical deformation increases resistive conversion while reducing radiation and increasing retained energy. A broader trailing-plasma profile delays the later radiation maximum and recovers much of its early bolometric deficit, with a spectral response that changes during the pulse. These results provide new insight into energy conversion in high-energy-density plasma physics and demonstrate a new paradigm for physics research.

AI.tldr: 论文提出开源框架 Simjecture，让语言模型智能体围绕人类定义的物理猜想开展研究，并在 Z-pinch 问题上进行 82.6 小时实证探索，揭示能量转换、保留与释放时序的竞争机制。
AI.motivation: 人工智能辅助数学已显示开放式机器搜索可超越人类数学家，但将这一范式迁移到物理研究需要重构研究流程：物理是经验性的、模型并非终局，且理论必须与真实世界交互。
AI.method: 提出 Simjecture 开源框架，由语言模型智能体追求人类定义的物理猜想；以反例驱动的证伪和前瞻性假设修复组织探究；以计算物理作为可执行测试平台，并将数值工具资格认定与科学主张审查分离，使求解器与诊断可在有记录的调查中调整；随后开展 82.6 小时 Z-pinch 研究。
AI.result: 调查揭示能量转换、能量保留和辐射释放时序之间的竞争效应：更强的相干螺旋形变提高电阻转换、降低辐射并增加保留能量；更宽的尾随等离子体剖面延迟后期辐射峰值并弥补早期辐射热计亏损，且光谱响应在脉冲期间发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果为高能量密度等离子体物理中的能量转换提供新认识，并展示了将人工智能辅助开放式搜索用于物理研究的新范式。

title: Computational performance versus numerical accuracy in the acoustic terms of weakly-compressible SPH
summary: Accurate computation of the acoustic terms in weakly-compressible SPH, including the equation of state, its inverse, and the evaluation of the local speed of sound, is essential to ensure energy conservation, robust solid boundary conditions, and correct open boundary behavior. In the classic Cole's equation of state, using values of the polytropic constant $γ\ne 1$ can lead to significant precision loss, particularly when computations are performed in single precision, as is common in GPU implementations. We extend here our previous results on the optimal choice of state variable by introducing a new higher-precision form for all three acoustic terms, denoted \texttt{explog}, and assess its numerical accuracy and computational performance across a variety of devices and test cases. We find that the new form evaluates the acoustic terms with a maximum ULP of~2 for arguments less than $0.125$, and has higher errors in less than 1\% of the arguments larger than the threshold. Combined with a rewritten expression of the pressure at solid boundary particles in the ``dummy'' model, it provides consistently more accurate results, maintaining deviations from the reference pressure profile to below 2\%, even in presence of a rough bottom terrain. Computationally, the new formulation is also faster than the naive one on GPU, and only marginally slower on CPU.

AI.tldr: 该文针对弱可压缩SPH中声学项计算精度问题，提出高精度\texttt{explog}形式，并评估其数值精度与计算性能。
AI.motivation: 弱可压缩SPH中，状态方程、其逆以及局部声速等声学项的精确计算对能量守恒、稳健的固体边界条件和正确的开放边界行为至关重要；经典Cole状态方程在γ≠1时，尤其GPU常见的单精度计算中，会出现显著精度损失。
AI.method: 在作者此前关于最优状态变量选择结果的基础上，引入一种新的高精度\texttt{explog}形式，用于统一计算三个声学项，并在多种设备和测试案例中评估其数值精度与计算性能；同时结合“dummy”模型中固体边界粒子压力表达式的重写。
AI.result: 新形式在参数小于0.125时最大ULP为2；在大于该阈值的参数中，出现更高误差的比例低于1%。与重写的固体边界压力表达式结合后，结果 consistently 更准确，即使存在粗糙底部地形，相对参考压力剖面的偏差也低于2%。计算上，新形式在GPU上快于朴素形式，在CPU上仅略慢。
AI.conclusion: 新的\texttt{explog}声学项形式在保持较高数值精度的同时具有有竞争力的计算性能，尤其适合GPU实现，并能改善固体边界压力计算精度。

title: The Nonlinear Physics and Statistical Field Theory of Twilight Clouds: Hovering Dynamics and Dynamic Inertia Emergence
summary: Twilight clouds are small, optically faint warm clouds whose droplets fluctuate between haze and activated growth. We develop a nonequilibrium statistical field theory linking this regime to cloud-field organization through Köhler microphysics, supersaturation transport, and turbulent mixing. At parcel level, supersaturation rapidly tracks slow droplet growth with a finite lag. Mixing-induced supersaturation removal drives a saddle-node bifurcation, shifting the activation threshold and supporting intermittent hovering under turbulent fluctuations. Starting from turbulent transport of supersaturation coupled to droplet growth, we derive a droplet-supersaturation field system and formulate it within the Martin-Siggia-Rose framework. A Gurari-type variational reduction inspired by polaron theory eliminates the fast bath. Turbulence dresses the slow droplet field, shrinks the forbidden zone below the equilibrium curve, and raises the mixing threshold required to suppress activation. Each droplet population induces a screened supersaturation halo that couples neighboring cloud elements; its delayed adjustment generates dynamic inertia and temporally correlated noise. The resulting nonlinear, non-Markovian pseudoparabolic stochastic equation has a bounded frozen-background response at short wavelengths. Its long-wave coupling amplifies contrasts where the dressed slow manifold turns downward. Comparisons with the parent two-field system show that a spatially correlated Markovian closure preserves droplet-radius distributions and cloudlet organization. Near the activation fold, restoring residual-bath fluctuation memory improves recurrent-hovering frequency and patch extent without recalibrating the drift or fitting a correlation time. More broadly, the framework identifies how slow fields acquire interactions and inertia through the relaxing, diffusive environments they modify.

AI.tldr: 论文建立非平衡统计场论，将暮光云中水滴在雾霾态与活化增长之间的波动，通过Köhler微物理、过饱和度输运和湍流混合与云场组织联系起来，并导出描述慢水滴场非马尔可夫动力学及空间耦合的约化随机场方程。
AI.motivation: 暮光云是光学薄的小型暖云，其水滴在雾霾与活化增长之间波动；作者希望解释这一微物理区间如何经由过饱和度和湍流组织成云场结构，并建立连接微观Köhler过程与宏观云场组织的理论框架。
AI.method: 包尺度分析表明过饱和度以有限滞后快速跟随慢水滴增长；混合移除过饱和度引发鞍结分岔，改变活化阈值并支持湍流涨落下的间歇悬停。作者由过饱和度湍流输运与水滴增长耦合导出水滴-过饱和度场系统，将其纳入Martin-Siggia-Rose框架，并采用受极化子理论启发的Gurari型变分约化消去快浴。由此得到含屏蔽过饱和度晕、延迟调整所致动态惯性和时间相关噪声的非线性非马尔可夫伪抛物型随机方程，并与母体两场系统及空间相关马尔可夫闭合进行比较。
AI.result: 湍流修饰慢水滴场，使平衡曲线下方禁戒区缩小并提高抑制活化所需混合阈值；每个水滴群产生屏蔽过饱和度晕并耦合邻近云元，其延迟调整产生动态惯性和时间相关噪声。所得方程在冻结背景下短波响应有界，长波耦合在修饰慢流形向下转折处放大对比。与两场母系统比较，空间相关马尔可夫闭合可保持水滴半径分布和云胞组织；在活化折叠附近，保留残余浴涨落记忆可提高循环悬停频率和斑块范围，且无需重新校准漂移或拟合相关时间。摘要未提供定量参数、观测数据或实验验证细节。
AI.conclusion: 该框架表明慢场可通过改变并弛豫其扩散环境获得相互作用与惯性，并将暮光云的Köhler微物理、湍流混合和云场组织统一为可约化的非平衡场论。摘要未给出具体预测数值或外场验证。

title: Perturbation-Based Reconstruction of Depth-Resolved OCT Attenuation without Requiring a Fully Decayed Signal Tail
comment: 26 pages, 10 figures, including 1 supplementary figure. Submitted to Biomedical Optics Express
summary: Depth-resolved attenuation in optical coherence tomography (OCT) can provide quantitative optical contrast beyond structural imaging. However, conventional reconstruction methods can be biased when the OCT signal does not fully decay within the imaging range or when the distal signal tail is dominated by noise or residual reflections from distal sample or support interfaces. Here, we present a perturbation-based Beer-Lambert framework that combines a zeroth-order exponential estimate with a first-order correction, reducing reliance on the unreliable distal signal tail below the current depth. Numerical A-line simulations, Monte Carlo modeling, multilayer silicone-dye-TiO2 phantoms, and ex vivo bovine retina experiments were used to evaluate the method under finite-depth and heterogeneous imaging conditions. The numerical A-line tests showed reduced depth-dependent error against prescribed attenuation profiles; the Monte Carlo comparisons showed less distal drift relative to model-defined benchmarks, while the phantom profiles were compared with separately acquired single-layer OCT calibration values. In a Monte Carlo component test that withheld vessel-mask and vessel-boundary information from reconstruction and used that information only for post hoc evaluation, the first-order correction recovered 61% of the segmentation-informed target vessel contrast and reduced vessel ROI mean absolute error by 65% relative to the fixed zeroth-order baseline. These results suggest that perturbation-based reconstruction may provide a practical approach for depth-resolved reconstruction of effective OCT attenuation when the fully decayed A-line condition is not satisfied.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于微扰的Beer-Lambert框架，将零阶指数估计与一阶校正结合，用于OCT深度分辨衰减重建，以降低对不可靠远端信号尾部的依赖，并通过数值仿真、蒙特卡罗、体模和离体牛视网膜实验验证。
AI.motivation: 传统OCT深度分辨衰减重建在信号未在成像范围内完全衰减，或远端信号尾部受噪声、远端样品/支撑界面残余反射主导时会产生偏差，因此需要一种不依赖可靠远端尾部的重建方法。
AI.method: 提出基于微扰的Beer-Lambert框架，将零阶指数估计与一阶校正结合，以减少对当前深度以下不可靠远端信号尾部的依赖；采用数值A-line仿真、蒙特卡罗建模、多层硅胶-染料-TiO2体模和离体牛视网膜实验进行评估，并将体模结果与单独获取的单层OCT校准值比较。
AI.result: 数值A-line测试显示相对于预设衰减剖面降低了深度相关误差；蒙特卡罗比较显示相对于模型定义基准的远端漂移更小；在未将血管掩膜和血管边界信息用于重建、仅用于事后评估的蒙特卡罗组分测试中，一阶校正恢复了61%的分割信息目标血管对比度，并使血管ROI平均绝对误差相对固定零阶基线降低65%。摘要未提供体模和离体视网膜实验的具体定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当A-line未满足完全衰减条件时，基于微扰的重建可能为OCT有效衰减的深度分辨重建提供一种实用方法。

title: Structure of energy flux densities in Earth's magnetotail reconnection regions: Bridging simulation and observation
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, submitted to Geophysical Research Letters 3rd September 2026, revisions submitted 29th October 2026
summary: Magnetic reconnection is important in both space and laboratory contexts because it changes the topology of magnetic fields and converts magnetic energy into particle energies. Establishing where this energy conversion occurs is critical for understanding how reconnection partitions energy. Using a novel machine learning approach based on simulations that explicitly identifies the separatrix regions for the first time, the partition of energy flux densities within the magnetic reconnection site is evaluated through statistical study of magnetotail reconnection events observed in situ. The separatrices are found to have the largest electron energy flux densities, roughly twice those in the exhaust, and Poynting flux densities about four times those in the inflows, whereas typical ion enthalpy flux densities are largest in the exhaust. The separatrices are therefore sites of intense electron and electromagnetic energy transport, although their small thickness means that the exhaust may still carry most of the total energy flux.

AI.tldr: 该文利用基于模拟的新型机器学习方法首次显式识别磁重联分界线，并对原位观测的磁尾重联事件进行统计研究，评估重联区内能量通量密度的分配；分界线处电子能通量和坡印廷通量显著增强，但排气区可能仍承载大部分总能量通量。
AI.motivation: 磁重联会改变磁场拓扑并将磁能转化为粒子能量，因此确定能量转换发生的位置对于理解重联如何分配能量至关重要。
AI.method: 采用基于模拟的新型机器学习方法，首次显式识别分界线区域；在此基础上，对原位观测的磁尾重联事件开展统计研究，评估磁重联区内能量通量密度的分配。摘要未提供具体机器学习算法、事件样本量及观测任务等细节。
AI.result: 分界线处的电子能通量密度最大，约为排气区的两倍；其坡印廷通量密度约为入流区的四倍；典型离子焓通量密度则在排气区最大。分界线是电子和电磁能量输运强烈的区域，但其厚度较小，排气区可能仍承载总能量通量的大部分。
AI.conclusion: 分界线在磁重联能量输运中具有强烈但局域的特征：电子能通量和电磁能通量在其处显著增强；由于分界线较薄，排气区仍可能主导总能量通量。摘要未给出各区域总能量通量份额的定量结果。

title: Learning the Entropic Relaxation: Stable Coarse-Grid Emulation with Neural Discrete Equilibrium
summary: The ability to emulate complicated and computationally-expensive physical systems in an efficient and stable manner is a popular motivation for scientific machine learning (SciML). Stable numerical solvers tend to be computationally expensive, as they attempt to resolve small (spatial and temporal) scales that receive and dissipate spectral energy. Learned coarse-grid forecasters remove the dissipative channel, allowing unresolved frequencies to re-emerge as grid-scale noise (aliasing). In this paper, we use the Neural Discrete Equilibrium (NeurDE) method to explore stable emulation at extremely coarse grids, demonstrating physically-principled control over entropy dynamics that reinforces the physical system's dissipative mechanism. Entropically-stabilized NeurDE produces stable long-time rollouts for thousands of forecasting steps on large Reynolds number turbulent flows ($\mathrm{Re}=100{,}000$) with very coarse grids (down to $\mathbb{R}^{16\times16}$). At these very coarse grid scales, entropically-stabilized NeurDE can be more stable than even our stabilized data-generation numerical method.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并验证熵稳定化的 NeurDE 方法，可在极粗网格上对高雷诺数湍流进行长期稳定预测。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习希望高效、稳定地模拟复杂且计算昂贵的物理系统；稳定数值求解器因需解析耗散谱能量的小尺度而昂贵，而学习到的粗网格预测器会移除耗散通道，使未解析频率以网格尺度噪声形式重现（混叠）。
AI.method: 采用 Neural Discrete Equilibrium（NeurDE）方法探索极粗网格上的稳定模拟，并通过熵动力学施加物理原理引导的控制，以强化物理系统的耗散机制，即使用熵稳定化的 NeurDE。
AI.result: 熵稳定化 NeurDE 在雷诺数 $\mathrm{Re}=100{,}000$ 的大尺度湍流上、网格粗至 $16\times16$ 时，仍能稳定完成数千个预测步的长期滚动预测；在极粗网格尺度下，其稳定性甚至优于作者用于生成数据的稳定化数值方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于熵动力学的稳定化控制可支持极粗网格上的稳定长期湍流模拟，并能在极粗尺度下超过稳定化数值数据生成方法的稳定性；摘要未提供更多定量误差或泛化细节。

title: Reconstructing Rayleigh--Bénard flows from temperature-only measurements using the Ensemble Kalman Filter
summary: Reconstructing the full state of a multiscale chaotic system from observations of only a subset of its degrees of freedom is a central problem in data assimilation. Turbulent Rayleigh--Bénard convection offers a paradigmatic example, for which Charney conjectured that temperature measurements alone should suffice to determine the velocity field. Synchronization-based methods such as nudging and direct replacement nonetheless fail in chaotic regimes, because they require the measurement of the determining modes of the system, a set to which the velocity belongs but the temperature does not. Here we show that the Ensemble Kalman Filter (EnKF), equipped with a proper inflation scheme, removes this asymmetry by exploiting the flow-dependent cross-covariances between temperature and vorticity, and recovers the velocity from noisy and spatio-temporally sparse temperature data alone. We assess the filter in two chaotic regimes of two-dimensional bulk convection by means of a scale-by-scale spectral analysis. When the whole temperature field is observed, both fields synchronize with the true state at all resolved scales, with the temperature estimate becoming even more accurate than the measurements themselves for sufficiently frequent observations. Equispaced observation networks preserve this full-spectrum synchronization down to a threshold density, below which only the largest scales remain synchronized, as also happens when observations are confined to a subdomain. We conclude that Charney's conjecture is numerically verified in two-dimensional turbulent convection when the assimilation is performed using a properly calibrated EnKF.

AI.tldr: 在二维湍流瑞利-贝纳德对流中，带适当膨胀方案的集合卡尔曼滤波（EnKF）仅利用含噪且时空稀疏的温度观测即可恢复速度场；完整温度场观测可在所有解析尺度实现同步，稀疏网络和子域观测则存在阈值，低于阈值时仅最大尺度保持同步。
AI.motivation: 从部分自由度观测重建多尺度混沌系统的完整状态是数据同化的核心问题。Charney 猜想温度测量足以确定速度场，但 nudging 和直接替换等基于同步的方法在混沌区制中失败，因为它们需要测量系统的确定模态；速度属于该模态集合，而温度不属于，因而存在不对称性。
AI.method: 采用配备适当 inflation 方案的 EnKF，利用温度与涡度之间随流变化的交叉协方差，从含噪、时空稀疏的温度数据恢复速度场；在二维体对流的两个混沌区制中，通过逐尺度谱分析评估滤波性能，并考察完整温度场、等间距观测网络及子域观测等情形。摘要未提供膨胀参数、噪声水平和阈值密度的具体数值。
AI.result: 观测完整温度场时，温度与速度两场在所有解析尺度均与真实状态同步；当观测足够频繁时，温度估计甚至比测量本身更准确。等间距观测网络在降至某一阈值密度前保持全谱同步，低于该阈值时仅最大尺度保持同步；观测局限于子域时也仅大尺度保持同步。摘要未给出阈值密度、噪声水平及误差指标的具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 在二维湍流对流中，当使用经过适当校准的 EnKF 进行同化时，Charney 猜想得到数值验证：仅凭温度观测即可恢复速度场，但同步范围受观测密度和空间覆盖范围限制。

title: Generalized Lorentz Framework for Active Semiconductor Quantum Surface Plasmonics
summary: Nanostructured semiconductors provide an actively tunable platform for light-matter interactions across a broad spectral range. As feature sizes shrink to the deep nanoscale (~10 nm scale), nonclassical carrier dynamics and surface plasmonic responses become prominent, creating substantial challenges for a rigorous and efficient theoretical treatment. Here we develop a generalized Lorentz framework for quantum surface plasmonics in nanostructured semiconductors with arbitrary energymomentum dispersion relations. The framework enables efficient quantitative treatment of carrier nonlocality, carrier surface accumulation and depletion, and nonlocal damping in three-dimensional semiconductor nanostructures, under electrical tuning and across a wide range of doping densities. Building on this framework, we further establish a rigorous quasinormal-mode analysis that provides transparent physical insight into complex surface plasmonic responses of multiscale semiconductor structures. We demonstrate electrically controlled deep-nanoscale carrier accumulation and depletion in a semiconductor nanoantenna, leading to pronounced plasmonic-response modulation that can be interpreted in terms of eigenmode shifts, creation, and annihilation. By quantifying and linking complex nonclassical carrier dynamics with plasmonic eigenmodes, our work establishes a comprehensive quantitative framework for active semiconductor quantum surface plasmonics and will foster the convergence of electronics and photonics at the deep nanoscale.

AI.tldr: 该文提出面向纳米结构半导体的广义Lorentz框架与准简正模分析方法，用于高效定量描述深纳米尺度下的非经典载流子动力学与量子表面等离激元响应，并展示电调控半导体纳米天线中的显著等离激元调制。
AI.motivation: 纳米结构半导体是宽谱可调的光-物质相互作用平台；当特征尺寸缩小至约10 nm时，非经典载流子动力学和表面等离激元响应变得显著，现有理论难以同时做到严格与高效处理。
AI.method: 建立适用于具有任意能量-动量色散关系的纳米结构半导体的广义Lorentz框架，以处理载流子非局域性、载流子表面积累与耗尽以及非局域阻尼；并在此基础上建立严格的准简正模分析，用于多尺度半导体结构的复杂表面等离激元响应。
AI.result: 该框架可在电调控下、较宽掺杂密度范围内对三维半导体纳米结构进行高效定量处理；作者在半导体纳米天线中演示了电控深纳米尺度载流子积累与耗尽，产生显著的等离激元响应调制，并通过本征模的移动、产生和湮灭加以解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将复杂的非经典载流子动力学与等离激元本征模定量关联，建立了面向主动半导体量子表面等离激元的综合定量框架，有望促进深纳米尺度下电子学与光子学的融合。

title: Comparison of models for dynamical structures of solar plasma
summary: Possible mechanisms of generation of dynamical plasma structures are associated with the Schwarzschild criterion for convective instability and with excess energy (heat, magnetic): due to the superadiabatic temperature gradient, the overheated plasma starts to rise. In the framework of Navier-Stokes MHD equations, the complete system of equations for the full axisymmetric plasma model includes equations for the stream function, the azimuthal velocity component, the density change, the flow function of poloidal magnetic field, and the azimuthal component of the magnetic field. Within the framework of ideal hydrodynamics, the simplest plasma model is applicable to the initial stage of generation of plasma structures. In this case, rigorous analytical solutions are constructed from blocks. Within the framework of ideal hydrodynamics, some intermediate model - the refined model considers rotating plasma at the growth stage. In this case, some unidirectional differential rotation occurs. The full model studies the development of structures as rotating plasma from the very beginning to the highest development stage. The velocity field is adjusted to boundary conditions. Velocity components change in a coordinated manner. The stationary axisymmetric ambient magnetic field and its gradients have little effect on the plasma structure and velocity field. The movement structures for all models are similar. Radial flows converge towards the axis at the bottom, and there is an outflow to the periphery near the top of the plasma structure. The maximum vertical velocity component is reached at the center of the axis. Applications of these models to solar structures, including jets, are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该文在Navier-Stokes MHD框架下构建轴对称等离子体结构生成的完整模型，并给出理想流体力学下的简化模型与细化模型，用于描述从初始阶段到成长阶段的旋转等离子体结构；不同模型得到的流动结构相似，环境轴对称磁场及其梯度影响较小，模型可讨论太阳结构（包括喷流）的应用。
AI.motivation: 解释动态等离子体结构的可能生成机制：基于Schwarzschild对流不稳定判据，以及由于超绝热温度梯度导致过热等离子体上升的热能/磁能过剩；并建立可描述结构从初始生成到高度发展阶段的模型。
AI.method: 在Navier-Stokes MHD方程框架中，完整轴对称等离子体模型包含流函数、方位速度分量、密度变化、极向磁场流函数和磁场方位分量的方程；在理想流体力学框架下采用最简单的分块解析解模型描述初始阶段，采用考虑旋转等离子体与单向差动旋转的细化模型描述成长阶段，采用完整模型描述从开始到最高发展阶段的旋转等离子体结构，并按边界条件调整速度场。
AI.result: 各模型的运动结构相似：底部径向流朝向轴汇聚，结构顶部附近向外围流出；最大垂直速度分量位于轴中心；速度分量协调变化；静止轴对称环境磁场及其梯度对等离子体结构和速度场影响较小。
AI.conclusion: 理想流体力学下最简单模型适用于等离子体结构生成的初始阶段，细化模型考虑成长阶段的旋转与差动旋转，完整模型覆盖整个发展过程；这些模型可用于讨论太阳结构（包括喷流）等应用。摘要未提供定量参数、观测对比或具体应用结果。

title: Machine-Learned Interatomic Potential for the Mo-S-Al-O System
comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables; supplementary material (starts on pg. 30): 38 pages, 23 figures, 11 tables
summary: We develop a machine-learned neuroevolution potential (NEP) for the Mo-S-Al-O system, targeting MoS$_2$ heteroepitaxy on c-plane sapphire, $α$-Al$_2$O$_3$(0001). The potential is trained on 63,611 PBE+D3 structures distilled from about 1.1 million curated density-functional-theory (DFT) configurations, using an energy-difference loss function that directly targets interfacial and orientation-dependent energies. On held-out data, the energy and force errors are 29 meV/atom and 0.23 eV/$\mathring{A}$. Validated against DFT on a suite of physical properties, the NEP reproduces the lattice constants within 0.3 %, the elastic constants within 17 %, the phonon dispersions with mean deviations below 2.5%, and the surface energies within 1.3 %. At the MoS$_2$/sapphire interface, it reproduces the adhesion energy minimum within 0.8 %, the interfacial energy within 2.2 % and the most stable orientation of the monolayer. It preserves the DFT-predicted energetic ordering of edges, point defects (Spearman $ρ$ = 0.995) and mirror-twin boundaries ($ρ$ = 1.0), and reproduces tilt grain-boundary energies within 8 % ($ρ$ = 0.98) and stacking-fault energy barriers within 14 %. The resulting potential enables future studies of the atomic-scale mechanisms of defect formation in two-dimensional heteroepitaxy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了面向 Mo-S-Al-O 体系的机器学习神经演化势（NEP），用于研究 MoS₂ 在 c 面蓝宝石 α-Al₂O₃(0001) 上的异质外延；该势函数在能量、力、晶格与弹性常数、声子、表面/界面能、缺陷与晶界/层错等性质上均与 DFT 结果高度一致，可用于后续原子尺度缺陷形成机制研究。
AI.motivation: 研究目标是开发适用于 Mo-S-Al-O 体系的 NEP，以支持 MoS₂ 在 c 面蓝宝石 α-Al₂O₃(0001) 上的异质外延研究，并最终用于探究二维异质外延中缺陷形成的原子尺度机制。
AI.method: 作者使用约 110 万条经整理的 DFT 构型蒸馏得到的 63,611 个 PBE+D3 结构训练 NEP，并采用直接针对界面与取向依赖能量的能量差损失函数；随后在留出数据、物理性质、MoS₂/蓝宝石界面、边缘与点缺陷、镜孪晶界、倾斜晶界及层错能垒等方面与 DFT 进行验证。
AI.result: 在留出数据上，能量和力误差分别为 29 meV/atom 和 0.23 eV/Å；晶格常数误差在 0.3% 以内，弹性常数误差在 17% 以内，声子色散平均偏差低于 2.5%，表面能误差在 1.3% 以内。MoS₂/蓝宝石界面处，粘附能最小值误差在 0.8% 以内，界面能误差在 2.2% 以内，并复现单层最稳定取向；保持 DFT 预测的边缘、点缺陷（Spearman ρ = 0.995）和镜孪晶界（ρ = 1.0）能量排序，倾斜晶界能误差在 8% 以内（ρ = 0.98），层错能垒误差在 14% 以内。
AI.conclusion: 所得 NEP 在多种物理性质、界面性质及缺陷/晶界能量方面与 DFT 高度一致，能够支持后续对二维异质外延中缺陷形成原子尺度机制的研究。

title: Designing turbulence through hierarchies
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 3 supplementary movies (ancillary files). Interactive simulation: https://andremfreitas.github.io/pendulum-web/
summary: Turbulence is defined by a set of emergent and singular phenomena: a constant-flux energy cascade, intermittency, a dissipation rate that survives the vanishing of viscosity, and the spontaneous loss of determinism of the inviscid limit. Which physical ingredients produce them remains unclear, because in fluids they always come together with incompressibility, spatial structure and vortex dynamics. Here we show that a hierarchy of inertia, coupled by the purely geometric nonlinearity of rigid constraints, is enough. A planar chain of rigid pendula whose lengths and masses decrease geometrically, coupled only through nearest-neighbor constraints, develops a far-from-equilibrium cascade that replaces thermal equipartition, with statistically local and time-irreversible energy transfer despite intrinsically nonlocal coupling. Its fluctuations are intermittent, yet self-similarity is restored by a hidden scale symmetry. As the viscosity vanishes, the dissipation rate saturates at a finite value, and thermal noise consistent with fluctuation-dissipation balance is amplified from the smallest to the largest scales within a fraction of a large-scale period. Because the hierarchy can be tuned and the same dynamics can be realized mechanically or electrically, turbulence becomes a property that can be designed and measured in the laboratory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究一种由几何约束耦合的刚性摆链层级模型，证明仅靠惯性层级与纯几何非线性即可重现多种湍流特征，并使湍流成为可设计、可实验室测量的性质。
AI.motivation: 湍流通常表现为恒定通量能量级联、间歇性、耗散率在黏性趋于零时仍有限，以及无黏极限下确定性的自发丧失；但在流体中这些现象总与不可压缩性、空间结构和涡动力学同时出现，因此难以厘清哪些物理要素真正产生湍流。
AI.method: 构建一个平面刚性摆链：摆的长度和质量按几何级数递减，仅通过最近邻刚性约束耦合；研究其远离平衡的动力学，并考察黏性趋于零及热噪声的作用。摘要未提供具体实验或数值方法细节。
AI.result: 该层级系统出现取代热平衡的能量级联，能量传递在统计上局域且时间不可逆，尽管耦合本质上非局域；涨落具有间歇性，但隐藏的尺度对称性恢复自相似性。黏性趋于零时耗散率饱和至有限值；符合涨落耗散平衡的热噪声在一个大尺度周期的很小部分内由最小尺度放大至最大尺度。
AI.conclusion: 惯性层级加刚性约束的几何非线性足以产生湍流的关键涌现现象；由于层级可调且动力学可由机械或电学方式实现，湍流可作为可设计和实验室测量的性质。

title: Observation of pseudospin-locked chiral edge transport in gyromagnetic photonic crystals
summary: Photonic pseudospins enable selective excitation and routing of light, but perturbations that mix opposite pseudospins can induce backscattering in helical edge channels. Here, we experimentally demonstrate pseudospin-locked chiral edge transport in gyromagnetic photonic crystals, combining pseudospin selectivity with nonreciprocal unidirectional propagation. By jointly engineering lattice deformation and magnetic bias, we control dipolar-quadrupolar band inversions and construct interfaces supporting pseudospin-selective chiral channels. Microwave near-field and transmission measurements reveal a single chiral edge branch that is selectively excited by only one source handedness and exhibits pronounced nonreciprocal transport. Extending this mechanism to multidomain structures, we combine two pseudospin channels into a common waveguide, separate them into distinct outputs, and route them through intersecting interfaces. These configurations realize a nonreciprocal photonic pseudospin multiplexer and demultiplexer, together with a waveguide crossing exhibiting average measured crosstalk of -14.1 and -15.8 dB for its two input channels. Our results present an experimental route to integrating pseudospin-selective channel control with chiral edge transport, providing a foundation for nonreciprocal photonic networks that use pseudospin to organize and route multiple wave channels.

AI.tldr: 该文在旋磁光子晶体中实验实现赝自旋锁定的手性边缘输运，将赝自旋选择性与非互易单向传播结合，并基于多畴结构演示非互易光子赝自旋复用/解复用及低串扰波导交叉。
AI.motivation: 光子赝自旋可用于选择性激发和路由光，但混合相反赝自旋的微扰会在螺旋边缘通道中引起背散射；因此需要把赝自旋选择性与非互易单向传播结合起来。
AI.method: 通过协同调控晶格形变与磁偏置，控制偶极-四极能带反转，构建支持赝自旋选择性手性通道的界面；利用微波近场和透射测量表征单支手性边缘态及其非互易传输，并将机制推广到多畴结构，以实现通道合并、分离和交叉路由。
AI.result: 实验观察到仅由单一源手性选择性激发的单一手性边缘支，并表现出显著非互易传输；多畴结构实现了非互易光子赝自旋复用器和解复用器，波导交叉的两个输入通道平均实测串扰分别为-14.1 dB和-15.8 dB。摘要未提供工作频段、带宽和插入损耗等细节。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可将赝自旋选择性通道控制与手性边缘输运集成，为非互易光子网络利用赝自旋组织和路由多路波通道奠定实验基础。

title: Influence of the Coulomb Interaction on the Radiation of a Few Body System
summary: Understanding energy absorption in laser-plasma interactions is crucial for applications ranging from inertial confinement fusion to particle acceleration. At the most fundamental level, this energy exchange is governed by the motion of individual charged particles in the laser field. However, when multiple particles are present, their mutual Coulomb interaction can modify the dynamics and, consequently, the energy absorption. In this work, we investigate this scenario by solving the classical equations of motion for two coupled charged particles interacting with an intense laser field. Within the plasma approximation, we find that the Coulomb interaction between the electrons does not significantly affect the energy transfer during the laser-matter interaction. Additionally, we explore the role of mass asymmetry by considering the classical electron-proton interaction as a target system. Our results highlight the critical importance of mass: the proton, due to its much slower dynamics, acquires substantially less energy from the field compared to the electron, leading to a pronounced asymmetry in the energy distribution between the two species.

AI.tldr: 本文通过求解强激光场中两个耦合带电粒子的经典运动方程，研究库仑相互作用与质量不对称对激光-物质能量吸收的影响；结果表明电子间库仑相互作用影响不显著，而电子-质子质量差异导致明显的能量分配不对称。
AI.motivation: 激光-等离子体相互作用中的能量吸收对惯性约束聚变和粒子加速等应用十分重要；其基础由带电粒子在激光场中的运动决定，而多粒子存在时相互库仑作用可能改变动力学和能量吸收，因此需要研究该情形。
AI.method: 在等离子体近似下，求解两个耦合带电粒子与强激光场相互作用的经典运动方程；并考虑质量不对称，将经典电子-质子相互作用作为目标体系进行研究。
AI.result: 电子之间的库仑相互作用并未显著影响激光-物质相互作用过程中的能量转移；在电子-质子体系中，质子由于动力学慢得多而从场中获得显著更少的能量，导致两种粒子之间能量分布出现明显不对称。
AI.conclusion: 质量在能量吸收与分配中具有关键作用；多粒子库仑相互作用在本文考虑的等离子体近似下对能量转移影响不显著，而电子与质子的质量差异造成显著的能量分配不对称。

title: Pore-scale mechanisms of capillary imbibition in cement-based materials revealed by direct numerical simulations in a realistic FIB-SEM microstructure
summary:
Moisture transport in cement-based materials involves transient multiphase flow through highly irregular pore networks, where evolving air--water interfaces strongly influence liquid invasion and gas displacement. Here, pore-resolved, image-based direct numerical simulations (DNS) are used to investigate spontaneous imbibition in a FIB--SEM-reconstructed cementitious microstructure, resolving air--water interface dynamics at nanometre-to-micrometre spatial scales and nanosecond-to-microsecond timescales. As these dynamics remain inaccessible to direct experimental observation at such scales, the simulations provide, to the best of our knowledge, the first direct view of transient imbibition within the capillary porosity of a realistic cementitious microstructure.
  The three-dimensional simulations reveal highly heterogeneous wetting-front propagation, continuous interface reconfiguration, and progressive air entrapment, showing that local dynamics depend on evolving interface curvature and capillary-pressure fields rather than on characteristic pore size alone. Significant air entrapment develops even within the capillary pores and under perfectly water-wetting conditions, progressively reducing the saturation rate, while the capillary pressure of trapped-air clusters depends strongly on local interface geometry rather than gas volume alone. Controlled two-dimensional analyses show that the balance between capillary, viscous, inertial, and gravitational effects is strongly scale-dependent. Comparison with the three-dimensional simulations highlights the importance of out-of-plane interface curvature and pore-network connectivity. The framework also resolves moisture conditions at the steel--concrete interface, illustrating its potential for corrosion-relevant pore-scale analysis.

AI.tldr: 采用FIB-SEM重建微结构上的孔隙分辨DNS，直接模拟水泥基毛细孔隙中的瞬态自发渗吸，揭示非均匀湿润前沿、界面重构和空气俘获，并强调界面曲率与孔隙连通性的控制作用。
AI.motivation: 水泥基材料中的水分传输涉及高度不规则孔隙网络内的瞬态多相流，演化中的空气-水界面强烈影响液体侵入和气体驱替；这些纳米至微米空间尺度、纳秒至微秒时间尺度的动力学难以直接实验观测，因此需要孔隙分辨的数值模拟提供直接认识。
AI.method: 基于FIB-SEM重建的水泥基微结构开展孔隙分辨、图像驱动的三维直接数值模拟（DNS），模拟自发渗吸并解析空气-水界面动力学；同时开展受控二维分析，与三维模拟比较，并将框架用于钢-混凝土界面湿度条件分析。
AI.result: 三维模拟显示高度非均匀的湿润前沿传播、持续的界面重构和渐进空气俘获；局部动力学取决于演化界面曲率和毛细压力场，而非仅由特征孔径决定。即使完全水润湿，毛细孔内仍出现显著空气俘获并逐步降低饱和速率；俘获空气簇的毛细压力强烈依赖局部界面几何而非仅气体体积。二维分析表明毛细、黏性、惯性和重力效应的平衡具有强尺度依赖性；三维模拟突出出平面界面曲率和孔隙网络连通性的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，该工作首次直接呈现真实水泥基微结构毛细孔隙中的瞬态渗吸，表明孔隙尺度水分传输需综合考虑界面曲率、孔隙连通性及多效应尺度依赖；该框架具有腐蚀相关孔隙尺度分析潜力，但摘要未提供实验验证或定量预测指标。

title: A flux-balanced diffuse-interface kinetic model for rarefied gas-solid boundaries with arbitrary absorption probability
summary: Rarefied gas--solid interactions determine mechanical loads, heat transfer, and material exchange in microscale devices and low-pressure processings. Modeling these interactions becomes challenging when gas non-equilibrium effect and complex moving boundaries must be resolved together. We develop a diffuse-interface kinetic model (DIKM) that describes rarefied gas transport and gas--solid interactions in one kinetic formulation on a single fixed Eulerian mesh. A smooth order parameter represents solid geometry, while a localized molecular flux operator incorporates boundary interactions directly into the kinetic equation by distinguishing incident and reflected distributions in the interface region and specifying their mass, momentum, and energy exchange, including prescribed surface absorption. Matched asymptotic analysis shows that the diffuse formulation recovers the corresponding partially absorbing diffuse-reflection boundary condition for smooth stationary or moving surfaces in the sharp-interface limit. Discretization uses Strang splitting, combining an order-parameter-weighted discrete unified gas kinetic scheme for the transport substep with a positivity-preserving update of the interfacial source. Benchmarks over planar and curved, stationary and moving boundaries reproduce rarefaction-dependent velocity slip and wall heat transfer, absorption-driven flow, and feedback between gas forces and solid translation and rotation. In final simulations, the order parameter evolves by a Cahn--Hilliard equation with degenerate mobility, and thin-film growth exhibits distinct surface profiles at different vapor incidence angles. By connecting implicit geometry to molecular surface exchange, DIKM provides a basis for coupling rarefied gas dynamics to solid motion and material evolution.

AI.tldr: 该文提出扩散界面动理学模型（DIKM），在单一固定欧拉网格上以同一动理学框架统一描述稀薄气体输运与气固相互作用，并通过理论分析和多类基准算例验证其可处理静止/运动、平面/曲边界及材料演化耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 稀薄气固相互作用决定微尺度器件和低压工艺中的机械载荷、传热与物质交换；当气体非平衡效应与复杂运动边界需同时解析时，传统建模具有挑战性。
AI.method: 建立DIKM：用光滑序参量表示固体几何，在界面区域通过局部分子通量算子区分入射与反射分布，并将质量、动量、能量交换及指定表面吸收直接纳入动理学方程；采用匹配渐近分析证明其锐界面极限可恢复部分吸收的漫反射边界条件；数值上使用Strang分裂，将序参量加权的离散统一气体动理学格式输运子步与保正性界面源更新相结合。
AI.result: 平面/曲面、静止/运动边界基准复现了随稀薄程度变化的滑移速度和壁面传热、吸收驱动流动以及气体力与固体平动/转动之间的反馈；最终模拟中序参量按退化迁移率的Cahn–Hilliard方程演化，薄膜生长在不同蒸气入射角下呈现不同表面轮廓。摘要未提供定量误差或性能数据。
AI.conclusion: DIKM将隐式几何与分子表面交换联系起来，为稀薄气体动力学与固体运动及材料演化的耦合提供了基础。

title: LIPS-PC: Learning Illumination Patterns for Single-Pixel Classification
summary: In single-pixel (ghost) imaging, known illumination patterns probe an object and a detector with no spatial resolution returns one number per pattern. Each measurement costs acquisition time and photons and, for ionizing probes, contributes to delivered dose. Motivated by automated radiographic defect screening, where a class label suffices, we introduce Learning Illumination Patterns for Single-Pixel Classification (LIPS-PC). The patterns are learned end-to-end while the measurement operator remains one fixed linear matrix, identical for every input. We parameterize it as a residual correction to a two-dimensional discrete cosine transform (2D-DCT), $D=D_{\mathrm{base}}+Δ$, and jointly train the correction and a compact classifier using cross-entropy, without a reconstruction objective. This yields a task-driven linear embedding through optimization. We evaluate LIPS-PC numerically on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST under a controlled protocol, then on RIAWELC, a real industrial X-ray weld-radiograph dataset. Across five budgets, $M\in{8,16,32,64,128}$, corresponding to sampling ratios from below 1% to 12.5%, the learned operator outperforms the best tested fixed transform by 9-15 percentage points at $M=8$ on all three datasets. Its eight-measurement accuracy requires roughly 16-32 measurements with the best fixed transform, indicating a $2\times$ to $4\times$ saving at comparable accuracy. The advantage generally shrinks as $M$ increases, with a small reversal on RIAWELC at higher budgets. These results show that learning what to measure is especially valuable when measurements are scarce.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LIPS-PC：在单像素（鬼成像）框架下，端到端学习一个对所有输入固定不变、参数化为二维离散余弦变换（2D-DCT）残差修正的线性测量矩阵，并联合训练紧凑分类器；在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST 和工业 X 射线焊缝射线图像数据集 RIAWELC 上验证了低测量预算下的分类优势。
AI.motivation: 单像素成像中每次测量都消耗采集时间和光子，若使用电离探针还会增加剂量；面向仅需类别标签的自动化射线缺陷筛查，需要减少测量次数并学习“测什么”。
AI.method: 提出 Learning Illumination Patterns for Single-Pixel Classification（LIPS-PC）。测量算子保持为对所有输入相同的固定线性矩阵，并将其参数化为 2D-DCT 的残差修正：D=D_base+Δ；不使用重建目标，而是用交叉熵联合训练该修正项与紧凑分类器，从而通过优化得到任务驱动的线性嵌入。在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST 上按受控协议进行数值评估，并在真实工业 X 射线焊缝射线图像数据集 RIAWELC 上评估。
AI.result: 在 M∈{8,16,32,64,128} 五个测量预算、对应低于 1% 至 12.5% 的采样率下，学习到的算子在三个数据集上于 M=8 时均比最佳固定变换高 9–15 个百分点；其 8 次测量的准确率约需最佳固定变换 16–32 次测量才能达到，表明在可比准确率下有 2×–4× 的节省。优势通常随 M 增大而缩小，并在 RIAWELC 较高预算下出现小幅反转。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在测量稀缺时学习测量方式尤其有价值；学习到的任务驱动线性嵌入可在低采样预算下提升单像素分类性能。

title: First-principles simulation of free-electron lasers with the Galilean electromagnetic particle-in-cell method: even harmonics of planar undulators
summary: Free-electron laser (FEL) codes average the electron motion over the undulator period and add the radiation harmonics through on-axis coupling factors. This is accurate for the fundamental, but the even harmonics of a planar undulator, which vanish on the axis, are not modelled at all. We show that the Galilean electromagnetic particle-in-cell method (GEM-PIC), which resolves the electron motion within the undulator period and the carrier of the forward radiation field without a Courant limit, simulates FELs on two CPU cores at two to three times the cost of a time-dependent run of the averaged code GENESIS. The quasi-cylindrical code GEM-PIC-RZ reproduces the coherent spontaneous emission of a planar undulator in each azimuthal mode $m = 0$--3 to within 2\,\% of the radiation integral, and seeded amplifiers to within a few per cent of GENESIS run with the same physics. For a seeded planar FEL at 10.6\,nm it predicts 12\,MW of second-harmonic power at saturation, $1.1\times10^{-3}$ of the fundamental; this harmonic is absent from the averaged model. The unaveraged code Puffin, which has no space charge, gives a comparable level, 9 to 11\,MW for the space-charge-widened and the initial beam size, and the same transverse structure.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并验证无平均化的GEM-PIC/GEM-PIC-RZ方法，可在解析平面波荡器周期内电子运动的同时模拟FEL，以较低计算代价再现相干自发辐射和种子放大器结果，并预测平均化模型缺失的二阶谐波。
AI.motivation: 传统FEL代码对电子运动作波荡器周期平均，并通过轴上耦合因子加入辐射谐波；这对基频有效，但平面波荡器的偶次谐波在轴上为零，因而完全未被建模。作者希望发展能解析周期内电子运动和前向辐射载波、且不受Courant限制的高效无平均化模拟方法。
AI.method: 采用Galilean电磁粒子模拟方法GEM-PIC，并发展准圆柱坐标版本GEM-PIC-RZ；该方法解析波荡器周期内电子运动与前向辐射场载波，且无Courant限制。将GEM-PIC-RZ的相干自发辐射按方位模m=0–3与辐射积分比较，并将种子放大器结果与相同物理设置的GENESIS及无空间电荷的Puffin比较。
AI.result: GEM-PIC在双CPU核上模拟FEL的代价约为GENESIS含时运行的2–3倍；GEM-PIC-RZ对m=0–3各方位模的相干自发辐射与辐射积分偏差在2%以内，种子放大器与GENESIS偏差为百分之几。对10.6 nm种子平面FEL，它预测饱和时二次谐波功率12 MW，为基频的1.1×10^-3，而平均化模型没有该谐波；Puffin在空间电荷展宽束和初始束尺寸两种情形下给出可比拟的9–11 MW及相同横向结构。
AI.conclusion: 无平均化GEM-PIC/GEM-PIC-RZ能以适中计算成本模拟FEL，并捕捉平均化代码遗漏的平面波荡器偶次谐波；其相干自发辐射和种子放大结果与基准符合，二次谐波预测与Puffin量级一致。摘要未给出实验验证或完整参数细节。

title: Atomistic Insights into MOCVD Growth of GaAs using a Closed Loop Autonomous System Combining Directed Reinforcement Learning and Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures; Supplementary Information (18 pages) appended
summary: Conventional process optimization of the Metal-Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition (MOCVD) growth parameters to achieve high-quality thin films relies on iterative, resource-intensive experimental runs. While predictive modeling can circumvent this cost and effort, simulating thin-film growth is constrained by the vastly different length and time scales of the deposition process. While continuum (e.g., Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)) and first-principles methods (e.g., Molecular Dynamics (MD)) struggle to balance experimental length/time scales and atomistic accuracy, Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) bridges this divide by resolving atomistic events whilst remaining tractable at experimental length and time scales. However, the accuracy of KMC relies on kinetic rate parameters that require costly density functional theory (DFT) calculations. In order to circumvent this, we present a framework that calibrates the rate parameters directly against experimental growth data. A forward KMC growth model is coupled in a closed loop with a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) optimizer that navigates the high-dimensional parameter space, with the search steered by the degree of rate control of each reaction rate parameter. The approach invokes no material-specific assumptions and hence, any deposition process whose forward kinetics can be reduced to a set of rate-controlled events is amenable to the same treatment. We demonstrate it for the MOCVD of GaAs, where the calibrated model captures the characteristic temperature dependence of the measured growth rate. The framework is also able to recover the three well known kinetic regimes characterized by change in the rate determining step from precursor chemisorption to desorption. As a result, the framework converts routinely measured growth data into a mechanistically interpretable model of the deposition process.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种将前向动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）生长模型与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）优化器闭环耦合的框架，利用反应速率参数的速率控制度引导搜索，直接从实验生长数据校准KMC速率参数，并在GaAs的MOCVD中验证了模型对生长速率温度依赖性和三个动力学机制的复现能力。
AI.motivation: 传统MOCVD生长参数优化依赖迭代且资源密集的实验；CFD和MD等模拟方法难以兼顾实验尺度与原子级精度，KMC虽可桥接尺度但依赖需昂贵DFT计算获得的动力学速率参数。因此作者希望绕过DFT成本，直接利用实验生长数据校准KMC速率参数，从而构建可预测且机理解释性强的沉积模型。
AI.method: 构建一个闭环框架：前向KMC生长模型与MCTS优化器耦合，在高维速率参数空间中搜索；搜索由各反应速率参数的速率控制度引导。该方法不引入材料特定假设，适用于前向动力学可归结为一组速率控制事件的沉积过程；文中以GaAs的MOCVD为案例进行演示。
AI.result: 校准后的模型能够捕捉实测生长速率随温度变化的特征温度依赖性，并恢复三个已知动力学区域，这些区域对应速率决定步骤从前驱体化学吸附向脱附的转变。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可将常规测量的生长数据转化为具有机理可解释性的沉积过程模型，为MOCVD生长参数优化和KMC速率参数校准提供了一条减少昂贵DFT与实验迭代依赖的途径。

title: Fluid memory beyond creeping flow: a history kernel for a sphere at finite Reynolds numbers
summary: Predicting the history force on a sphere beyond the creeping-flow limit remains challenging. Existing formulations have been derived or calibrated for selected flow histories, with limited evidence of their predictive accuracy under more general conditions. We develop a systematic approach to extract the history kernel of a fixed sphere in spatially uniform, unsteady flow from axisymmetric Navier-Stokes simulations of finite-duration acceleration and deceleration ramps at initial Reynolds numbers from 0.2 to 200. The resulting kernel surface recovers the Basset limit at short lags and in the creeping-flow limit and is continued beyond the resolved lags using far-wake asymptotics. At higher Reynolds numbers, the kernel develops non-monotonic behaviour at intermediate lags, associated with delayed adjustment of the boundary layer and wake. For the cases tested, the present kernel substantially improves history-force predictions for finite ramps, oscillatory forcing and non-periodic composite velocity histories relative to the literature formulations considered, without case-specific adjustment. These findings indicate that lag and Reynolds number capture the dominant memory response.

AI.tldr: 该文通过轴对称 Navier-Stokes 模拟提取固定球体在空间均匀非定常流中的历史力核，覆盖初始雷诺数 0.2–200，并验证该核在有限斜坡、振荡及非周期复合速度历史下优于现有公式。
AI.motivation: 超越蠕流极限预测球体所受历史力仍然困难；现有公式多针对特定流动历史推导或校准，在更一般条件下的预测精度证据有限，因此需要系统提取并检验历史力核。
AI.method: 对固定球体在空间均匀非定常流中的有限时长加速与减速斜坡进行轴对称 Navier-Stokes 模拟，初始雷诺数取 0.2 至 200，系统提取历史核；所得核曲面在短滞后及蠕流极限恢复 Basset 极限，并用远尾渐近延拓至已解析滞后之外。
AI.result: 较高雷诺数下，核在中间滞后出现非单调行为，与边界层和尾流的延迟调整有关；在所测试情形中，该核无需针对个案调整，即相对文献公式显著改善了有限斜坡、振荡强迫和非周期复合速度历史下的历史力预测。摘要未提供具体定量误差指标。
AI.conclusion: 滞后与雷诺数能够捕捉主导的记忆响应；所提取的历史核在更一般流动历史下具有更好的预测能力。

title: Impedance-controlled Laser Dynamics in Near-Zero Index Media
summary: Near-zero-index (NZI) media have been explored for controlling spontaneous emission, but their impact on stimulated emission and lasing properties remains unexplored within their different classes, i.e., epsilon-near-zero (ENZ), mu-near-zero (MNZ), or epsilon-and-mu-near-zero (EMNZ). Here, we show theoretically that lasing emission depends on the class of NZI medium and can be controlled through its impedance. The major difference, as compared to conventional laser media, arises from the incorporation of dispersive electric and magnetic properties in the derivation of the Maxwell Boch equations. In this framework, the analysis of laser rate equation reveals that the ENZ class, with high impedance, can reduce the lasing threshold through enhanced electric-field interaction. Numerical simulations further show that the NZI class also governs the spectral response: whereas ENZ and MNZ classes suffer from multimode emission, the EMNZ class preserves single-mode emission.

AI.tldr: 该文理论上研究不同近零折射率（NZI）介质类别——介电常数近零（ENZ）、磁导率近零（MNZ）及介电常数与磁导率同时近零（EMNZ）——对受激发射和激光特性的影响，指出激光阈值与光谱模式由NZI类别及阻抗决定。
AI.motivation: 近零折射率介质已被用于控制自发辐射，但其对受激发射及激光发射特性的影响，尤其是在ENZ、MNZ和EMNZ不同类别之间，尚未得到研究。
AI.method: 基于包含色散电学和磁学特性的麦克斯韦-布洛赫方程进行理论推导，分析激光速率方程，并开展数值模拟以研究不同NZI类别下的激光阈值和光谱响应。
AI.result: 激光发射取决于NZI介质类别并可通过其阻抗调控；高阻抗的ENZ类可增强电场相互作用从而降低激光阈值；数值模拟显示ENZ和MNZ类存在多模发射，而EMNZ类保持单模发射。
AI.conclusion: NZI介质的类别会影响受激发射和激光性能，阻抗是调控激光阈值的关键因素；ENZ有利于降低阈值，EMNZ有利于保持单模发射。摘要未提供具体实验验证或定量参数。

title: Implicit-Explicit Methods for the GX Gyrokinetics Code
summary: Gyrokinetic simulations are crucial for understanding turbulent transport in magnetic confinement fusion devices. Unfortunately, these simulations are typically extremely expensive, particularly when kinetically evolving electrons due to their significantly greater thermal speed compared to that of ions. In this work, we present new implicit-explicit timestepping methods for the GX gyrokinetics code to accelerate these simulations where the ion and electron streaming terms as well as the electron mirror terms are treated implicitly, while the remaining terms are treated explicitly. These methods include a lower-order Lie-Trotter splitting method as well as a higher-order additive Runge-Kutta method. Our schemes take advantage of the sparsity of the GX equations, which allows us to efficiently invert the linear operators that arise from the implicit scheme without consuming significant amounts of limited GPU memory. We demonstrate our new integration scheme for both linear (electrostatic and electromagnetic) and nonlinear (electrostatic) simulations in general toroidal geometry, and show that our methods can achieve up to the maximum theoretical linearly stable timestep for these simulations while maintaining a significant improvement in wall-clock time.

AI.tldr: 本文为GX回旋动理学代码提出新的隐式-显式时间推进方法，以加速磁约束聚变装置湍流输运模拟；该方法将离子和电子流项及电子镜项隐式处理、其余项显式处理，并在线性与非线性模拟中验证了可达到理论最大线性稳定时间步且显著缩短实际计算时间。
AI.motivation: 回旋动理学模拟对理解磁约束聚变装置中的湍流输运至关重要，但计算成本极高，尤其是电子需动理学演化时，因为电子热速度显著高于离子；因此需要新的时间推进方法来加速此类模拟。
AI.method: 针对GX代码，将离子流项、电子流项和电子镜项隐式处理，其余项显式处理；采用低阶Lie-Trotter分裂方法和高阶加性Runge-Kutta方法。利用GX方程的稀疏性，高效求逆隐式格式产生的线性算子，同时避免消耗大量有限的GPU内存。
AI.result: 在线性静电、线性电磁以及非线性静电模拟中，于一般环形几何下验证了该积分格式；结果表明方法可达到这些模拟的最大理论线性稳定时间步，同时保持实际墙钟时间的显著改善。摘要未给出具体加速倍数、误差阶数或硬件配置等细节。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的隐式-显式时间推进方法能够加速GX回旋动理学模拟，并在保持稳定性的同时显著减少计算时间；但摘要未提供定量性能数据和更广泛的适用性结论。

title: Optimally Weighted Constrained Shadow Tomography for Reduced Density Matrices
summary: Accurate measurement of reduced density matrices (RDMs) is central to quantum simulations of many-fermion systems, but the required measurement resources remain a significant challenge. Constrained shadow tomography (CST) combines randomized measurements with $N$-representability conditions to reconstruct physically valid RDMs from limited measurement data. Here we improve CST by orthogonalizing the measurement constraints and using the resulting singular values to determine the relative weight of each independent measurement direction according to how strongly it is sampled by the quantum computer. These optimally weighted constraints are incorporated into the semidefinite program through a least-squares objective implemented with a Schur-complement relaxation. We demonstrate the approach for hydrogen chains on a quantum simulator and for azobenzene on a quantum processor. In both cases, optimally weighted CST systematically improves the accuracy of the reconstructed 2-RDM without increasing the measurement budget, providing a more measurement-efficient approach to partial tomography for quantum simulations of correlated fermions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种改进的约束影子层析方法：对测量约束做正交化，并依据各独立测量方向被量子计算机采样的强弱，用奇异值确定其相对权重，再通过带 Schur 补松弛的最小二乘目标将最优加权约束纳入半正定规划，从而在不增加测量预算的情况下提高 2-RDM 重建精度。
AI.motivation: 精确测量约化密度矩阵（RDM）对多费米子体系的量子模拟至关重要，但所需测量资源仍是显著挑战；约束影子层析（CST）虽能结合随机测量与 N-可表示性条件，从有限测量数据重建物理有效的 RDM，本文旨在进一步改善其测量效率与重建精度。
AI.method: 对测量约束进行正交化，利用所得奇异值按各独立测量方向被量子计算机采样的强弱确定相对权重；将最优加权约束通过最小二乘目标纳入半正定规划，并采用 Schur 补松弛实现。
AI.result: 在量子模拟器上对氢链、在量子处理器上对偶氮苯进行演示；两种情况下，最优加权 CST 均在不增加测量预算的前提下系统性提高重建 2-RDM 的精度。摘要未提供具体数值或误差指标。
AI.conclusion: 最优加权 CST 为关联费米子量子模拟中的部分层析提供了一种更测量有效的方法，可在有限测量资源下改善物理有效 RDM 的重建精度。

title: Transitional Fluid-Ablation Interactions on a Compression Ramp at Mach 8
summary: Direct numerical simulations (DNS) are performed for a Mach 8 flow over a 15 degree compression ramp undergoing ablation to analyze fluid-ablation interaction (FAI) effects on instability growth and transition of the high-speed boundary layer. Wind-tunnel experiments at these conditions show characteristic heating streaks which are first replicated for laminar flow over an inert ramp. Perturbations superimposed on the laminar baseflow are informed by stability calculations. The ramp is then replaced by a low-temperature ablator in our DNS and the interaction of the streaks with the ablating surface is examined. Ablation models implemented in two independently-developed fluid dynamics solvers are used to study this problem. Overall, both solvers have shown an excellent agreement regarding heat fluxes, mass blowing rates, and recession patterns. Numerical experiments are performed to assess the impact of accelerating recession and of higher amplitude perturbations. We demonstrate accurate predictions of ablative recession and present novel findings regarding its influence on the perturbation evolution for this configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文对马赫8、15度压缩拐角流动开展直接数值模拟，先复现惰性壁面层流加热条带，再引入低温烧蚀材料，研究流体-烧蚀相互作用对边界层不稳定性和转捩的影响；两套独立求解器的烧蚀模型在热流、质量喷流率和退蚀形貌上高度一致，并给出烧蚀退蚀预测及烧蚀对扰动演化影响的新发现。
AI.motivation: 研究高速边界层中流体-烧蚀相互作用对不稳定增长和转捩的影响，并解释风洞实验中观察到的特征加热条带；在复现惰性壁面层流条带的基础上，进一步考察烧蚀壁面与条带的相互作用。
AI.method: 采用直接数值模拟研究马赫8、15度压缩拐角流动；先在惰性拐角上复现层流加热条带，扰动由稳定性计算提供；随后将拐角替换为低温烧蚀材料，并使用两套独立开发的流体求解器中的烧蚀模型进行模拟；对比热流、质量喷流率和退蚀形貌，并开展加速退蚀和更高幅值扰动的数值实验。
AI.result: 惰性壁面层流条件下的特征加热条带得到复现；两套求解器在热流、质量喷流率和退蚀形貌方面高度一致；研究实现了对烧蚀退蚀的准确预测，并发现烧蚀对该构型下扰动演化具有影响。摘要未给出转捩位置、增长率或热流等定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，所采用的烧蚀模型能够较准确地预测烧蚀退蚀，且烧蚀会显著影响该压缩拐角构型中的扰动演化；两套独立求解器的一致性增强了结果可信度。摘要未明确给出转捩最终是否提前或推迟的具体结论。

title: Reference-Beam-Assisted Perturbation-Resistant Imaging Through A Single Multimode Fiber
summary: Multimode fiber (MMF) imaging is highly sensitive to mechanical perturbations, which alter modal coupling and disrupt the speckle-to-target mapping. Here, we propose a reference-beam-assisted method for image reconstruction across multiple fiber configurations. An independent reference beam propagates through the same MMF as the imaging signal without target modulation, providing target-independent transmission-state information through its speckle patterns without requiring a separate configuration-sensing structure. A neural network jointly processes the signal and reference speckles to reconstruct target images. Experiments with MNIST and Fashion-MNIST across 10 fiber configurations demonstrate improved reconstruction quality, faster training convergence, and more accurate configuration identification. Further evaluation across 40 configurations confirms the reconstruction benefit of reference-beam assistance over a larger set of perturbed fiber states. These results provide a foundation for developing perturbation-adaptive MMF imaging systems for flexible endoscopy and minimally invasive optical diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种参考光束辅助的多模光纤图像重建方法：独立参考光束与成像信号经同一多模光纤传输且不受目标调制，其散斑提供与目标无关的传输状态信息；神经网络联合处理信号与参考散斑以重建目标图像。
AI.motivation: 多模光纤成像对机械扰动高度敏感，扰动会改变模式耦合并破坏散斑到目标的映射，因此需要在多种光纤配置下实现图像重建，且希望无需单独的配置传感结构。
AI.method: 独立参考光束与成像信号通过同一多模光纤传输，但参考光束不经过目标调制；利用参考散斑提供与目标无关的传输状态信息，并由神经网络联合处理信号散斑和参考散斑来重建目标图像。实验使用MNIST和Fashion-MNIST，在10种光纤配置下评估，并在40种配置下进一步验证。
AI.result: 在10种光纤配置下，该方法提升了重建质量、加快了训练收敛，并提高了配置识别准确率；在40种配置下的进一步评估确认了参考光束辅助带来的重建收益。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 结果为开发面向柔性内窥镜和微创光学诊断的扰动自适应多模光纤成像系统提供了基础。

title: Towards reactor-relevant electromagnetic turbulence in the MAST-U spherical tokamak
summary: We investigate electromagnetic ion-scale turbulence in a high-performing H-mode plasma of the Mega Ampere Spherical Tokamak Upgrade (MAST-U) with local gyrokinetic simulations, asking whether it approaches the non-zonal transition: the nonlinear transition to a high-flux state above a critical value of $q^{2}β_{e}$ found in simulations of STEP, where $q$ is the safety factor and $β_{e}$ the ratio of electron thermal pressure to magnetic pressure. We examine two flux surfaces: one at $t = 531\,\mathrm{ms}$, close to peak normalised pressure $β_N$, at normalised poloidal flux $ψ_N = 0.50$; and one at $t = 591\,\mathrm{ms}$ and $ψ_N = 0.60$, the ideal-ballooning-stable surface of largest $q^{2}β_e$ inside $ψ_N = 0.8$ at that time. On both surfaces the dominant ion-scale instabilities are microtearing and electromagnetic ballooning-like modes, as in STEP. Without equilibrium flow shear, at least one of the surfaces lies above the large flux threshold with every set of kinetic species we simulate, with ion-scale heat fluxes far exceeding power balance, in turbulence characterised by a highly stochastic magnetic field. Strong flow shear driven by neutral-beam injection in the real experiment suppresses this turbulence and holds the plasma below the transition. When the carbon impurity is included in the simulation, the ion-scale flux is then close to power balance on both surfaces. Without rotation, gyrokinetics suggests the transition would limit the accessible profiles. This could degrade MAST-U plasma performance using heating schemes that lack a momentum source, and this will be tested in forthcoming electron Bernstein wave heating experiments.

AI.tldr: 该文利用局部回旋动理学模拟研究MAST-U高性能H模中的离子尺度电磁湍流，检验其是否接近STEP模拟发现的非带状跃迁（q²βe超过临界值后的高通量态），并评估流剪切与碳杂质的影响。
AI.motivation: 探究MAST-U等离子体是否接近STEP模拟中由q²βe临界值控制的非带状跃迁；若接近，缺乏动量源的加热方案可能受该跃迁限制而降低等离子体性能。
AI.method: 对MAST-U两个通量面进行局部回旋动理学模拟：t=531 ms、ψN=0.50（接近峰值βN）和t=591 ms、ψN=0.60（该时刻ψN=0.8内q²βe最大的理想气球模稳定面）；比较有无平衡流剪切及不同动理学组分（含碳杂质）时的离子尺度不稳定性与热通量。摘要未给出具体q²βe临界值。
AI.result: 两个面上的主导不稳定性均为微撕裂模和电磁气球模类模式，与STEP类似。无平衡流剪切时，在所模拟的每组动理学组分下至少一个面超过高通量阈值，离子尺度热通量远超功率平衡，湍流具有高度随机磁场；实际实验中中性束注入驱动的强流剪切抑制该湍流并使等离子体低于跃迁。加入碳杂质后，两个面上的离子尺度通量接近功率平衡。
AI.conclusion: 无旋转时回旋动理学表明非带状跃迁会限制可达到的剖面，可能削弱采用缺乏动量源加热方案时的MAST-U性能；该预测将由后续电子伯恩斯坦波加热实验检验。

title: Efficient Interpolation of the Bethe-Salpeter Hamiltonian at Arbitrary Momenta
summary: We develop an efficient reciprocal-space method to reconstruct the static Bethe-Salpeter (BSE) Hamiltonian at arbitrary crystal momenta from coarse first-principles grids. Bloch states are interpolated within an optimally smooth Wannier subspace, while the screened Coulomb interaction is reconstructed from the dielectric response. This decouples the electron-hole transition momenta and transferred momentum from the underlying ab initio sampling. We benchmark the method on monolayer hBN, monolayer MoS$_2$, and bulk GaAs against explicit ab initio calculations, finding excellent agreement for dense-grid Bloch states, dielectric screening, and BSE optical spectra. Furthermore, our cost analysis estimates speedups of up to $22\times$ on the grids considered here. Arbitrary transferred-momentum sampling gives direct access to the long-wavelength exciton dispersion: in hBN and MoS$_2$, we resolve the nonanalytic behaviour induced by long-range electron-hole exchange at momenta well below the spacing of practical uniform grids. For bulk GaAs, locally refined transition-momentum sampling yields a converged binding energy for the threefold-degenerate lowest exciton, in close agreement with experiment and reference calculations, using far fewer BSE points than conventional uniform meshes. As the present framework provides exciton energies and amplitudes at arbitrary crystal momenta, it opens the way to incorporating ab initio excitonic effects into nonlocal electron-phonon vertices and to extensions towards exciton-phonon interactions and nonequilibrium exciton dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种倒空间方法，可从粗第一性原理网格重构任意晶体动量下的静态 Bethe-Salpeter 哈密顿量，并在 hBN、MoS2 和 GaAs 上验证其精度与最高约 22 倍的加速效果。
AI.motivation: 传统 BSE 计算受限于第一性原理采样的均匀网格，难以在任意晶体动量、特别是长波长和转移动量处高效获得激子性质；作者希望将电子-空穴跃迁动量与转移动量从底层 ab initio 采样中解耦，以低成本访问激子色散并扩展至更复杂的激子-声子问题。
AI.method: 在最优平滑的 Wannier 子空间内插 Bloch 态，并利用介电响应重构屏蔽库仑相互作用，从而在任意晶体动量下重建静态 BSE 哈密顿量；方法在单层 hBN、单层 MoS2 和体相 GaAs 上与显式 ab initio 计算基准对比，并采用任意转移动量采样及局部细化的跃迁动量采样。
AI.result: 对密集网格 Bloch 态、介电屏蔽和 BSE 光学谱均与显式计算高度一致；成本分析显示在所考虑网格上最高约 22 倍加速。hBN 和 MoS2 中可在远小于实际均匀网格间距的动量处分辨长程电子-空穴交换导致的非解析行为；GaAs 中局部细化跃迁动量采样以更少 BSE 点获得三重简并最低激子的收敛结合能，并与实验和参考计算接近。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在任意晶体动量给出激子能量和振幅，为将 ab initio 激子效应纳入非局域电子-声子顶点、以及扩展到激子-声子相互作用和非平衡激子动力学提供了途径。

title: Flow and transport characteristics of hydrogen in a square-spiral Knudsen pump with coupled thermal transpiration and Poiseuille flow
summary: Gas transport driven by thermal transpiration under temperature gradients, known as a Knudsen pump, has shown strong potential in gas separation and delivery applications. However, its performance and operational stability are strongly affected by structural design, system integration, and manufacturing complexity, highlighting the need for efficient and manufacturable multi-stage configurations. In this study, a novel spiral-structured Knudsen pump is proposed. Within the microchannels, a temperature gradient drives gas from the low- to high-temperature region, inducing pressure rise and thermal transpiration. In the main channel, a pressure gradient drives gas from the high- to low-temperature region, forming Poiseuille flow. Numerical methods are employed to investigate the flow mechanisms, and the effects of varying the numbers of series and parallel microchannels on gas transmission behavior are evaluated. The results indicate that bends of the main channel lead to nonlinear variations in pressure and temperature, as well as flow deceleration in the curved regions. Increasing the number of serial channels reduces the pressure load across the microchannel, thereby enhancing the overall transport performance. For instance, a ten-stage serial configuration improves performance by 3.35% compared with the four-stage case, reaching 3.10E10-7 kg/(m*s). In contrast, increasing the number of parallel microchannels reduces pressure loading while enhancing gas rarefaction, thereby strengthening thermal transpiration. A five-stage parallel configuration yields an 70.80% improvement over the two-stage case, reaching 3.07E10-7 kg/(m*s). These results provide valuable guidance for the design and fabrication of high-performance Knudsen pumps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新型螺旋结构Knudsen泵，采用数值方法研究其流动机理，并评估串联与并联微通道数量对气体输运性能的影响。结果表明，增加串联级数可降低微通道压力载荷并提升总体输运性能，十级串联较四级提升3.35%；增加并联通道数可降低压力加载并增强气体稀薄化，从而强化热爬流，五级并联较两级提升70.80%。
AI.motivation: Knudsen泵在气体分离与输送方面具有较强应用潜力，但其性能和运行稳定性受结构设计、系统集成及制造复杂度显著影响，因此需要高效且可制造的多级配置。
AI.method: 提出新型螺旋结构Knudsen泵；在微通道内，温度梯度驱动气体从低温区流向高温区，产生压升和热爬流；在主通道内，压力梯度驱动气体从高温区流向低温区，形成Poiseuille流。采用数值方法研究流动机理，并评估串联和并联微通道数量变化对气体传输行为的影响。
AI.result: 主通道弯折会导致压力和温度呈非线性变化，并使弯曲区域流动减速。增加串联通道数可降低微通道两侧压力载荷，从而提升总体输运性能；十级串联配置较四级配置性能提升3.35%，达到3.10E10-7 kg/(m*s)。增加并联微通道数可降低压力加载并增强气体稀薄化，从而强化热爬流；五级并联配置较两级配置提升70.80%，达到3.07E10-7 kg/(m*s)。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果可为高性能Knudsen泵的设计与制造提供指导；摘要未提供更具体的制造工艺、实验验证或长期运行稳定性结论。

title: Asymptotic electromagnetic transition conditions for thin layers: the arithmetic-mean field and susceptibility hybridization
summary: Effective transition conditions that replace a thin polarizable layer by a zero-thickness sheet are commonly applied in electromagnetic models of two-dimensional (2D) materials and metasurfaces. These conditions usually take the arithmetic mean of the fields on either side as the polarizing field at the boundary, and characterize the layer by the $0^\mathrm{th}$ moment of its susceptibility, but both choices are typically imposed rather than derived. We derive transition conditions for a finite-thickness, in-plane homogeneous, in-plane isotropic layer with a general nonlocal susceptibility, using a single-scale asymptotic expansion in $η= l\max(k_0,q)$, where $l$ is the layer thickness, $k_0$ the free-space wavenumber and $q$ the in-plane wavenumber. The sheet limit must be taken after resumming the out-of-plane depolarizing field, as this ensures that the resulting sheet susceptibility is independent of the material thickness. The arithmetic mean then emerges as the leading-order polarizing field for general susceptibility profiles. Asymmetries in the layer profile modify the effective susceptibility appearing in the transition conditions, rather than altering the arithmetic-mean field prescription. If the spatial profile is not even in both out-of-plane coordinates, in-plane and out-of-plane response hybridize, turning the diagonal volumetric susceptibility into a $q$-dependent effective tensor surface susceptibility with off-diagonal components. Mirror symmetry alone does not remove this hybridization. Comparison with exact solutions for local and separable layers shows that the derived conditions remain accurate to $O(η)$ across propagating and evanescent excitations, whereas the standard sheet conditions fail once hybridization becomes appreciable.

AI.tldr: 论文针对将有限厚度极化层等效为零厚度面的跃变条件，采用单尺度渐近展开推导一般非局域极化率薄层的条件，并分析算术平均场、有效表面极化率及面内/面外杂化对精度的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有二维材料和超表面电磁模型常把薄极化层替换为零厚度面，并直接采用两侧场算术平均及极化率零阶矩，但这些选择多为人为设定而非推导得到，因而需要严格的渐近推导并明确其适用条件。
AI.method: 设层厚为 l、自由空间波数和面内波数分别为 k0 与 q，以 η=l max(k0,q) 为小参数做单尺度渐近展开；先对层外去极化场重求和再取薄片极限，推导一般非局域极化率、有限厚度、面内均匀且面内各向同性层的跃变条件，并与局域层和可分离层的精确解比较。
AI.result: 推导表明薄片极限须在去极化场重求和后取得，以保证表面极化率不依赖材料厚度；算术平均场作为一般极化率分布下的领头阶极化场自然出现。层分布的不对称性改变跃变条件中的有效极化率，但不改变算术平均场的规定；若空间分布在两个面外坐标方向上均非偶，则面内与面外响应杂化，对角体极化率变为含非对角分量的 q 依赖有效张量表面极化率，且仅靠镜像对称不能消除该杂化。与精确解比较，所得条件对传播和倏逝激发均精确到 O(η)，而标准薄片条件在杂化显著时失效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从渐近展开导出了薄极化层的零厚度跃变条件，解释了算术平均场和有效表面极化率的来源及不对称/杂化的影响；所得条件在 O(η) 精度内适用于传播与倏逝情形，标准薄片条件仅在杂化可忽略时可靠。

title: Solar Wind Turbulence Spectra and Correlation Scale from 4 to 50 $r_\odot$: STEREO and PUNCH Observations
summary: We investigate the radial evolution of solar wind turbulence using remote-sensing brightness observations from the Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory (STEREO) and the first science-ready images from the Polarimeter to Unify the Corona and Heliosphere (PUNCH) mission. Exploiting the combined wide fields of view of STEREO's COR2 coronagraph (4-9 r_sun) and PUNCH's Wide Field Imager (WFI, 21-50 r_sun), we track the radial evolution of the power spectral density and correlation scale of density fluctuations from 4 to 50 r_sun. Line-of-sight integration systematically steepens the "usual" turbulence scaling laws by a constant offset of about -0.5 across all resolved scales, so that the energy-containing range (nominally k^-1) and the inertial range (nominally k^-5/3) appear as k^-1.5 and k^-2.1, respectively -- consistent with previous synthetic-image simulations. The correlation scale increases with heliocentric distance across the full range of heliodistances probed, in accordance with previous theoretical models and observations at closer distances from the Sun.

AI.tldr: 该文利用STEREO/COR2与PUNCH/WFI的遥感亮度观测，追踪4—50个太阳半径内太阳风湍流密度涨落功率谱密度和相关尺度的径向演化。
AI.motivation: 研究太阳风湍流从近日冕到更远日球层的径向演化，并利用STEREO与PUNCH联合的宽视场观测扩展可探测的日心距离范围。
AI.method: 结合STEREO COR2日冕仪（4—9 r_sun）和PUNCH宽视场成像仪WFI（21—50 r_sun）的遥感亮度观测，跟踪密度涨落的功率谱密度和相关尺度随日心距离的变化。
AI.result: 视线积分会使通常的湍流标度律在所有可分辨尺度上系统性陡化约-0.5的常量偏移，使能量含能区（名义k^-1）和惯性区（名义k^-5/3）分别呈现为k^-1.5和k^-2.1，这与既往合成图像模拟一致；相关尺度在所探测的整个日心距离范围内随日心距离增加。
AI.conclusion: 观测支持相关尺度随日心距离增大的趋势，与既往理论模型及更靠近太阳处的观测一致；同时表明视线积分效应对遥感功率谱标度指数有系统性影响。

title: A geometry-aware framework for electromagnetic fields in GATE 10
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to Physics in Medicine & Biology
summary:
Objective. An increasing number of medical-physics applications require the modelling of charged-particle transport in electromagnetic (EM) fields. We aim to provide GATE 10 users with a flexible mechanism for defining such fields in Monte Carlo simulations while preserving the native Geant4 particle-transport machinery.
  Approach. Our framework separates the handling of coordinates from EM field evaluation. Fields are attached to geometry volumes, defined in their local frame, and represented by analytic expressions, field maps, or arbitrary Python functions. They automatically follow the position and orientation of these volumes, including in nested and dynamic geometries. We validated the framework against native Geant4 transport and tested coordinate transformations, nested volumes, and dynamic geometry. We also compared the computational cost of the three field representations.
  Main results. The framework reproduced the native Geant4 trajectories exactly for all tested field types with direct Geant4 counterparts. Coordinate transformations introduced only floating-point-level differences, while simulations with dynamically changing geometry reproduced the equivalent static configurations exactly. All three representations produced equivalent transport. Mapped fields added at most 18% to the single-threaded runtime of analytic fields, while Python functions required 6.9 times as much. The compiled representations scaled with the number of threads, whereas Python functions became slower as threads were added.
  Significance. The framework adds flexible, geometry-aware EM field definitions to GATE 10 without modifying the underlying Geant4 transport machinery, and is part of the open-source GATE 10 codebase. It also provides a basis for extending GATE 10 with additional field representations in the future.

AI.tldr: GATE 10 提出一种几何感知的电磁场定义框架，将坐标处理与场求值分离，支持解析表达式、场图和 Python 函数，并验证其与 Geant4 原生输运一致，同时评估计算成本。
AI.motivation: 越来越多的医学物理应用需要在电磁场中模拟带电粒子输运；作者希望为 GATE 10 用户提供灵活的场定义机制，同时保留 Geant4 原生的粒子输运机制。
AI.method: 框架将坐标处理与电磁场求值分离；场附着于几何体积并在其局部坐标系中定义，可用解析表达式、场图或任意 Python 函数表示，并自动跟随体积的位置和朝向，包括嵌套与动态几何。作者对照原生 Geant4 输运进行验证，测试坐标变换、嵌套体积和动态几何，并比较三种场表示的计算成本。
AI.result: 对于具有直接 Geant4 对应物的场类型，框架精确复现原生 Geant4 轨迹；坐标变换仅引入浮点级差异；动态几何模拟精确复现等效静态配置；三种表示产生等价输运。映射场使单线程运行时间较解析场最多增加 18%，Python 函数则需 6.9 倍；编译表示可随线程数扩展，而 Python 函数随线程增加而变慢。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在不修改底层 Geant4 输运机制的情况下，为 GATE 10 增加了灵活且几何感知的电磁场定义，并已纳入开源 GATE 10 代码库，为未来扩展更多场表示提供基础。

title: High-order compact ALE gas-kinetic scheme on three-dimensional unstructured meshes
summary: In this paper, a compact high-order gas-kinetic scheme (HGKS) is developed for compressible arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE) computations on three-dimensional unstructured meshes. To achieve high-order spatial accuracy, a large number of matrix inversions are required for spatial reconstruction. In ALE computations, the mesh moves and the geometric information must be recalculated at each time step, which reduces computational efficiency. To improve efficiency, a memory-reduction reconstruction strategy is employed to construct a quadratic polynomial on unstructured meshes. By differentiating the candidate polynomial, the quadratic terms are obtained by the least-squares method using the average gradient values of the cell itself and its neighboring cells. The linear terms of the polynomial are also determined by the least-squares method. On three-dimensional unstructured meshes, a $3\times3$ coefficient matrix must be stored, and four least-squares procedures are required to construct a quadratic polynomial. To suppress numerical oscillations in flows with discontinuities, generalized essentially non-oscillatory (GENO) reconstruction and a gradient compression factor are adopted. To accelerate the computation, a multi-GPU accelerated code is implemented using Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) and Message Passing Interface (MPI). The current scheme is fully explicit, and the acceleration framework can be developed based on cell-level parallelism. Numerical examples are presented to evaluate the accuracy and robustness of the scheme, including flows with strong discontinuities, pitching wings, and helicopter rotors. Numerical results confirm the excellent performance of the compact ALE scheme on unstructured meshes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于三维非结构网格上可压缩任意拉格朗日-欧拉（ALE）计算的紧凑高阶气体动理学格式（HGKS），采用减少内存的重建策略、GENO重构与梯度压缩因子抑制振荡，并基于CUDA和MPI实现多GPU加速；数值算例验证了其在强间断流动、俯仰翼和直升机旋翼等问题中的精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 针对三维非结构网格上可压缩ALE计算中，高阶空间重构需要大量矩阵求逆，且网格运动导致几何信息每步重算、计算效率下降的问题，发展紧凑高阶HGKS并提升计算效率；同时需要抑制间断流动中的数值振荡并加速大规模计算。
AI.method: 采用减少内存的重建策略在非结构网格上构造二次多项式：通过对候选多项式求导，利用单元自身及相邻单元的平均梯度值以最小二乘获得二次项，线性项也由最小二乘确定；三维非结构网格上需存储3×3系数矩阵并执行四次最小二乘过程。采用广义基本非振荡（GENO）重构和梯度压缩因子抑制间断处数值振荡。格式完全显式，基于单元级并行，使用CUDA和MPI实现多GPU加速代码。
AI.result: 摘要给出强间断流动、俯仰翼和直升机旋翼等数值算例，用于评估格式的精度与鲁棒性；数值结果确认该紧凑ALE格式在非结构网格上具有优异性能。摘要未提供具体误差、加速比或效率提升的定量数据。
AI.conclusion: 所发展的紧凑高阶HGKS适用于三维非结构网格上的可压缩ALE计算，结合减少内存重建、GENO重构、梯度压缩因子和多GPU加速，在强间断及运动边界类问题中表现出良好的精度、鲁棒性和应用性能。

title: Reconfigurable multi-tone mmWave/THz generation powered by high-efficiency Kerr parametric oscillation
summary: Broadband and simultaneously accessible multi-tone millimeter-wave (mmWave) and terahertz (THz) signals are attractive for multi-band wireless communication and spectroscopy applications, yet their generation remains constrained by electronic bandwidth limitations and inefficient optical frequency conversion. Here, we demonstrate reconfigurable photonic generation of multi-tone mmWave/THz signals with comb spacings of 100, 200, 300, and 400 GHz, using a strongly asymmetric dual-ring silicon-nitride (SiN) microresonator and a broadband spiral plasmonic photomixer. A localized avoided-mode crossing (AMX) introduced by an auxiliary ring supports a fixed optical parametric oscillation (OPO) mode pair over an extended pump-detuning range, consistent with passive compensation of detuning-dependent phase mismatch. This enables a maximum pump-to-generated-line conversion efficiency of 67.3 % with 25.06 dB of pump depletion across different pump wavelength selections. Direct photomixing of these optical states produces simultaneous multi-frequency tones spanning 100 to 900 GHz without intermediate optical amplification. The generated carriers are further characterized through down-converted spectra, frequency-noise power spectral density (PSD), and Allan deviation measurements, yielding a \b{eta}-separation linewidth of 26 kHz at an observation time of 0.1 s. Optical modulation offers high radiated power levels exceeding 2 mW at 100 GHz at a duty cycle of 1 %, while mitigating thermal breakdown in the photomixer. High optical conversion efficiency, reconfigurable and selectable comb spacings, and broadband multi-tone generation on a chip-scale platform provide a compact route toward reconfigurable multi-band mmWave/THz sources for wireless communication, spectroscopy, and sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文利用强非对称双环氮化硅微谐振器和宽带螺旋等离子体光电混频器，实现梳间距可重构（100/200/300/400 GHz）的多音毫米波/太赫兹光子生成；通过局域避免模式交叉维持固定OPO模式对，获得最高67.3%泵浦至生成线转换效率和25.06 dB泵浦耗尽，并直接混频产生100–900 GHz多频音。
AI.motivation: 宽带且可同时访问的多音毫米波/太赫兹信号对多频段无线通信和光谱学具有吸引力，但其生成受电子带宽限制和光学频率转换效率低下的制约，因此需要可重构、宽带且高效的片上光子生成方案。
AI.method: 采用强非对称双环硅氮化物微谐振器，由辅助环引入局域避免模式交叉（AMX），在扩展的泵浦失谐范围内支持固定的光学参量振荡（OPO）模式对；结合宽带螺旋等离子体光电混频器，对这些光学态直接进行光电混频，无需中间光放大，并在不同泵浦波长选择下评估转换效率、泵浦耗尽、下变频光谱、频率噪声PSD和Allan偏差。
AI.result: 实现了梳间距为100、200、300和400 GHz的可重构多音毫米波/太赫兹生成；最大泵浦至生成线转换效率为67.3%，泵浦耗尽为25.06 dB；直接光电混频产生覆盖100至900 GHz的同时多频音，无需中间光放大；表征得到0.1 s观察时间下β分离线宽26 kHz；光学调制下100 GHz处辐射功率超过2 mW（占空比1%），并减轻光电混频器热击穿。
AI.conclusion: 高光学转换效率、可重构且可选择的梳间距以及芯片级宽带多音生成，为面向无线通信、光谱学和传感的可重构多频段毫米波/太赫兹源提供了紧凑路径。

title: The Birth of Plasmoids: Weibel-Driven Secondary Tearing and its Suppression in Relativistic Reconnection
summary: Plasmoids, or magnetic islands, dominate relativistic reconnection layers in kinetic simulations, yet the instability that creates them remains poorly understood. By tracking newborn islands in 2D particle-in-cell simulations of pair-plasma reconnection with magnetizations $0.1\leσ_0\le1000$, we show that plasmoids are seeded by a current-filamentation/Weibel instability driven by counter-streaming out-of-plane current carriers near primary x-lines. Measured growth rates are $\sim0.1$ times the background plasma frequency and agree with linear theory evaluated on the simulated distributions. As inflowing plasma loads the sheet away from the x-line, the current is carried by more particles and their out-of-plane drift slows. The filamentation instability shuts off once this drift becomes comparable to the momentum spread in the outflow direction, which occurs at a distance $\ell_{\rm iso}\proptoσ_0$ from the x-line. Because the unstable region extends farther at higher $σ_0$, our results account for the onset of plasmoid-dominated reconnection in the relativistic regime but predict that plasmoid formation is suppressed beyond $\sim\ell_{\rm iso}$ from primary x-lines, even in ultra-relativistic reconnection. Particle acceleration, variability, and coherent radio emission attributed to plasmoid-dominated reconnection may therefore be confined to smaller regions than previously assumed.

AI.tldr: 该文通过二维配对等离子体粒子模拟追踪新生磁岛，指出相对论重联中的等离子体团由靠近主X线的反向流外平面电流载体所驱动的电流成丝/Weibel不稳定性产生，并给出其增长率、关闭条件及对等离子体团主导重联发生区域的限制。
AI.motivation: 等离子体团（磁岛）在动理学模拟的相对论重联层中占主导，但产生这些磁岛的不稳定性仍缺乏清晰理解。
AI.method: 在磁化参数0.1≤σ0≤1000的二维配对等离子体重联粒子模拟中追踪新生磁岛，测量不稳定性增长率，并将结果与基于模拟分布函数的线性理论比较。
AI.result: 磁岛由主X线附近反向流的外平面电流载体驱动的电流成丝/Weibel不稳定性播种；测得增长率约为背景等离子体频率的0.1倍，并与线性理论一致。随着入流等离子体远离X线加载电流片，电流由更多粒子承载且外平面漂移减慢；当该漂移与出流方向动量展宽相当时不稳定性关闭，对应距X线距离ℓiso∝σ0。σ0越高不稳定区域延伸越远，因此可解释相对论区间等离子体团主导重联的起始，但预测即使在超相对论重联中，主X线约ℓiso之外等离子体团形成仍被抑制。
AI.conclusion: 归因于等离子体团主导重联的粒子加速、变异性和相干射电辐射可能被限制在比此前假设更小的区域内。

title: From Sea Surface Height to Velocity - A Machine Learning Approach
summary: Inferring upper-ocean velocity from altimetric sea surface height (SSH) remains challenging below 50~km, scales now resolved by the Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) mission. Conventional methods rely on geostrophic or cyclogeostrophic balance. Here, we demonstrate that deep learning can predict the full velocity vector from SSH and environmental data and recover derivative-based diagnostics, including spectral energy flux. We trained a U-Net encoder--decoder on hourly fields from the pre-SWOT Cape Basin extraction of the LLC4320 ocean simulation, with 1.5-km grid spacing ($11.8$--$15.8^\circ$E, $41$--$45^\circ$S). Inputs were SSH, sea surface temperature (SST), and wind stress; targets were horizontal velocities at the surface and 50~m, where wind influence is weaker. At 50~m, the best model achieves a speed RMSE of $0.049\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$, 29% lower than the geostrophic approximation. Predicted relative vorticity has a correlation of 0.93, compared with 0.75 for the geostrophic approximation. The model also recovers divergence with a correlation of 0.66, whereas geostrophic velocity is nondivergent by definition. Tests of training strategies yield four findings: SSH gradients outperform raw SSH as inputs; wind stress is the most useful covariate for total velocity prediction; SST benefits vary seasonally; and including vorticity and divergence in the loss improves accuracy. These results offer a path for transferring high-fidelity simulation physics to SWOT applications, where kilometer-scale SSH snapshots contain superposed balanced and unbalanced signals.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用U-Net从海表高度（SSH）、海表温度和风应力预测表层及50 m水平速度矢量，并在Cape Basin的LLC4320高分辨率模拟上验证；结果表明其优于地转近似，并能恢复涡度、散度及谱能量通量等派生诊断量。
AI.motivation: 50 km以下从高度计SSH推断上层海洋速度仍然困难，而SWOT任务已可解析该尺度；传统方法依赖地转或旋地转平衡，难以处理公里级SSH中叠加的平衡与非平衡信号，因此需要将高保真模拟中的物理关系迁移到SWOT应用。
AI.method: 研究使用SWOT发射前Cape Basin区域的LLC4320海洋模拟小时场，网格间距1.5 km，范围11.8–15.8°E、41–45°S；训练U-Net编码器—解码器，输入为SSH、海表温度和风应力，目标为表层及50 m水平速度。研究还测试了训练策略，包括以SSH梯度替代原始SSH、加入风应力协变量、海表温度收益的季节变化，以及在损失函数中加入涡度和散度。摘要未提供网络层数、样本量等更多实现细节。
AI.result: 在50 m深度，最佳模型速度RMSE为0.049 m s⁻¹，比地转近似低29%；预测相对涡度与真值相关系数为0.93，地转近似为0.75；散度相关系数为0.66，而地转速度按定义无散度。训练策略测试得到四点：SSH梯度优于原始SSH；风应力是总速度预测中最有用的协变量；海表温度收益随季节变化；在损失中加入涡度和散度可提高精度。模型还可恢复包括谱能量通量在内的基于导数的诊断量。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习可从SSH和环境数据预测全速度矢量及派生诊断量，为将高保真模拟物理迁移到SWOT应用提供了路径，有助于处理公里级SSH快照中叠加的平衡与非平衡信号。

title: Contrast-Enhanced Nonlinear Imaging with Moiré Flatband Superlattices
summary: Nonlinear metasurfaces offer a compact platform for infrared-to-visible conversion and imaging, yet resonant enhancement is often accompanied by restricted angular acceptance, limiting the range of transverse spatial frequencies that can interact efficiently with the nonlinear modes. Here, we address this challenge using a one-dimensional photonic moiré superlattice supporting multiple quasi-flat bands in the near-infrared. These moiré modes combine strong near-field enhancement with broad momentum-space accessibility, enabling efficient third-harmonic generation (THG) while maintaining stable excitation over a large angular range. Experimentally, we observe strong THG emission near $467~\mathrm{nm}$ under broadband excitation from $ 1180$ to $ 2000~\mathrm {nm} $. We further employ the nonlinear moiré superlattice for infrared imaging by converting an infrared target into visible through the THG process. By encoding image information into displacement-dependent THG signals and decoding their spatial variations, we experimentally resolve weak features and internal textures with improved contrast compared with THG imaging using nonlinear films or conventional nonlinear metasurfaces. These results establish photonic moiré superlattices as a versatile platform combining efficient frequency conversion, broad angular acceptance, and mode-sensitive spatial encoding for high-contrast, label-free nonlinear imaging with enhanced feature discrimination.

AI.tldr: 本文利用支持近红外多准平坦带的一维光子莫尔超晶格，在宽角度范围内增强非线性相互作用并实现高效三次谐波产生，进而将红外目标转换为可见图像，获得优于常规非线性薄膜/超表面的成像对比度。
AI.motivation: 传统非线性超表面虽可实现红外到可见转换与成像，但共振增强往往伴随受限的角度接受度，限制了可高效耦合的横向空间频率范围；作者希望兼顾强近场增强与宽动量空间可及性。
AI.method: 采用一维光子莫尔超晶格，在近红外支持多个准平坦带；利用莫尔模式兼具强近场增强和宽动量空间可及性的特点，在1180至2000 nm宽带激发下实现三次谐波产生（THG），并将红外目标图像信息编码为位移相关的THG信号，通过解码其空间变化实现红外到可见成像。
AI.result: 实验在约467 nm处观察到强THG发射，并保持大角度范围内的稳定激发；用于红外成像时可分辨弱特征和内部纹理，相比非线性薄膜或常规非线性超表面的THG成像具有更高对比度。摘要未提供具体转换效率、角接受范围数值及成像分辨率等定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 光子莫尔超晶格可作为集高效频率转换、宽角度接受度和模式敏感空间编码于一体的平台，用于高对比度、免标记且特征区分能力增强的非线性成像。

title: Learned Surrogates of Three-Dimensional Magnetohydrodynamic Turbulence
summary: Three-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence, the flow of astrophysical and fusion plasmas, is costly to simulate. We present, to our knowledge, the first learned surrogates of three-dimensional resistive MHD turbulence, and compare three standard backbones in that role: a convolutional UNet, a shifted-window transformer and a Fourier neural operator. They are trained as autoregressive emulators of decaying MHD turbulence at a resolution of $128^3$ and Reynolds numbers of 1000, 3000 and 6000, on 500 simulations per Reynolds number, each with one two-stage procedure, single steps and then short rollouts, and stopped by one rule. Over a window of about one large-eddy turnover time, the UNet and the transformer reach relative velocity errors of 0.018 to 0.053 and keep the current sheets, the enstrophy, the current density and the energy spectra of the simulation; which of the two is the more accurate depends on the Reynolds number, the UNet leading at 3000 and 6000 and the transformer at 1000.
