AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向RANS求解器的学习式热启动方法：在原生CFD网格上直接预测平均流与湍流场，再由RANS求解器校正；在SuperWing、NASA CRM和DLR-F6的百万网格三维算例上，未见名义工况取得约2–4倍几何平均迭代加速，计入数据生成与训练后估计整体加速2.1–2.3倍。
AI.motivation: 神经代理模型可加速大量查询的气动分析，但其独立预测可能精度或鲁棒性不足，难以支撑可靠的设计评估，因此需要一种能与CFD求解器结合、提升后续求解效率的学习式初始化方法。
AI.method: 开发学习式热启动公式，直接在原生CFD网格上预测平均流与湍流场，供RANS求解器后续校正；采用条件调制的Transolver，融合Fourier特征与壁面特征，并结合目标门控正则化、Sobolev型损失、自适应损失加权和采样训练。预测无需初步流场解，训练无需求解器残差评估。在亚临界与跨声速流动（包括激波诱导分离）上使用统一架构与目标结构；通过SuperWing、NASA CRM和DLR-F6的三维CFD评估几何与工况泛化，包括插值、外推和跨网格部署，并使用Spalart-Allmaras与k-ω SST封闭模型及百万单元网格。
AI.result: 在未见名义工况上，以冷启动气动系数定义的共同收敛准则计，几何平均迭代加速约2–4倍；在CRM上，学习式初始化相较使用同一解库的最近工况重启具有更大的总体加速。分辨率不变性使粗网格模型可直接部署到细网格，无需再训练、解插值或目标工况粗网格求解。计入数据生成与训练，估计整体加速为2.1–2.3倍；没有热启动运行发散，少于2%未满足冷启动参考收敛准则。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将学习式初始化用于重复气动分析，同时指出分离附近对初始化敏感仍是剩余局限。

title: Edge photocurrent distribution in luminescent solar concentrators: analytical treatment and solar cell arrangement
summary: In luminescent solar concentrators (LSCs), the light flux along the edges is non-uniform, which causes current mismatch between series-connected edge solar cells. Here, the optical path distribution of photons arriving at an edge point was derived analytically for a rectangular LSC and generalized to convex polygons, with reabsorption and scattering included as a geometric series. The model agrees with Monte Carlo simulations and reproduces measured edge cell currents of a $60\times60$ cm$^2$ LSC within 2-3%. In a square LSC, the series mismatch reduces the current by 8-12% for four cells per edge. Rules for edge solar cell arrangement are formulated.

AI.tldr: 针对LSC边缘光通量非均匀导致串联电池电流失配的问题，本文建立解析光程分布模型，经蒙特卡洛模拟与实测验证，并给出方形LSC的失配幅度及边缘电池布置规则。
AI.motivation: LSC边缘光通量沿边缘分布不均匀，会使串联连接的边缘太阳能电池之间产生电流失配，因此需要量化光子到达边缘点的光程分布，并据此指导边缘电池布置。
AI.method: 对矩形LSC解析推导到达边缘点的光子光程分布，并推广到凸多边形；将再吸收和散射以几何级数形式纳入模型；利用蒙特卡洛模拟和60×60 cm² LSC的实测边缘电池电流进行验证。
AI.result: 模型与蒙特卡洛模拟一致，并在60×60 cm² LSC上以2–3%的误差复现实测边缘电池电流；在方形LSC中，每边4片电池时串联失配使电流降低8–12%；提出了边缘太阳能电池布置规则，但摘要未给出规则的具体内容。
AI.conclusion: 该解析模型能够描述LSC边缘光程分布及串联电流失配，并可用于指导边缘电池布置；摘要未提供布置规则的具体条款及更广泛实验验证的细节。

title: Impact of Surface Preparation on the Propulsion of Catalytic Janus Colloids and Implications for Reproducibility
comment: 31 pages: main text (19 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables) and Supporting Information (12 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables)
summary: Platinum-coated polystyrene (PS) Janus particles (JPs) propelled by the catalytic decomposition of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) are a widely used model system for active matter, yet reported speeds for similar particles and fuel concentrations differ by more than an order of magnitude. Broad adoption of these materials requires increasing consistency in the preparation and achieving improved repeatability in their behavior. Herein, we focused on two routine, but rarely reported, preparation steps that we found to alter the particle speed. First, we found that pre-exposing the platinum cap to H2O2 before cell assembly increased the mean speed by a factor of 2.4. The size of this effect depended on batch history, where an aged batch responded strongly, while a freshly prepared batch sped up by only 16%. Second, we found that plasma cleaning of the glass substrate decreased the speed 2.7 times. In a 120 $μ$m cell the suppression was the same at both walls even when only one wall was treated. The suppression grew with the treated glass area per unit fluid volume, which pointed to species released into the bulk solution rather than to a change at the wall. Plasma-cleaned glass released more ions into water than untreated glass, and XPS detected an ionic metal fluoride on the plasma-cleaned surface. A model in which the released ions lower the speed through the solution conductivity reproduced the measured speeds in all four cell geometries. Of the 17 published studies compared here, pre-activation is reported in only four studies and substrate cleaning in only six studies. We propose a minimum reporting standard for the preparation and associated speed measurements of catalytic Janus particles.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，铂包覆聚苯乙烯Janus粒子的两个常规但少被报告的制备步骤会显著改变其自驱动速度：H2O2预暴露可提速，等离子清洗玻璃基底可降速；文章用离子释放导致溶液电导率变化解释降速，并呼吁建立最低报告标准。
AI.motivation: 同类铂包覆聚苯乙烯Janus粒子在相近燃料浓度下的报道速度相差超过一个数量级，阻碍材料广泛应用；因此需要提高制备一致性和颗粒行为的可重复性。
AI.method: 聚焦两个常规但少被报告的制备步骤：一是将铂帽预先暴露于H2O2后再组装细胞，并考察批次历史影响；二是对玻璃基底进行等离子清洗，并在不同细胞几何和不同处理玻璃面积下测量速度。结合水中离子释放测量、XPS表面表征，建立释放离子通过溶液电导率降低速度的模型，并比较17项已发表研究。
AI.result: H2O2预暴露使平均速度提高2.4倍，效应依赖批次历史：老化批次响应强，新鲜批次仅提高16%。等离子清洗玻璃使速度降低2.7倍；在120 μm细胞中，即使仅处理一侧壁，两侧壁处抑制相同。抑制随单位液体体积的处理玻璃面积增加而增强，指向释放到本体溶液中的物种而非壁面变化。等离子清洗玻璃向水中释放更多离子，XPS检测到等离子清洗表面的离子型金属氟化物；基于释放离子降低速度的模型可重现四种细胞几何下的实测速度。17项已发表研究中，仅4项报告预激活，仅6项报告基底清洗。
AI.conclusion: 制备中的预暴露和基底清洗步骤会显著影响催化Janus粒子速度，且当前文献报告不足；作者提出催化Janus粒子制备及相应速度测量的最低报告标准，以提升一致性和可重复性。

title: Physics-Informed Surrogate for Sb2S3 Dispersion Trimming in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
summary: A film-thickness error of 8 nm, within the tolerance of commercial thin-film lithium niobate wafers, shifts the group-velocity dispersion $β_2$ at 1550 nm by about 28 ps$^2$ km$^{-1}$. We study numerically whether a segmented, non-volatile phase-change cladding can correct this error after fabrication. In mode solves of 3012 geometries, Sb$_2$S$_3$ switches $β_2$ by a median of 181 ps$^2$ km$^{-1}$ at a 40 nm strip thickness with no material absorption under the adopted optical constants, whereas Sb$_2$Se$_3$ reaches a comparable contrast at a median modal loss of 5.6 dB cm$^{-1}$. Because phase adds along the guide, four independently switched binary segments reach a two-dimensional region of the $(β_2,β_3)$ plane; eigenmode expansion supports this description at the junctions. Full-wave solves at 65 die geometries show that the segment states move with the die error, so the bit pattern is chosen from a per-die model: a spectral surrogate constrained by exact identities of the lossless Maxwell problem. Its accuracy within the training domain is similar to that of unconstrained baselines; it keeps $β_2$ and $β_3$ consistent, and its error at an unseen film thickness is 8.3 rather than 13.0 ps$^2$ km$^{-1}$. With a bare test ring and a second ring carrying a crystalline strip already on the mask, 96.8% of the dies are trimmed into $\pm25$ ps$^2$ km$^{-1}$, scored on full-wave solutions. A thermal model gives a candidate write window for a 532 nm beam.

AI.tldr: 该文数值研究在薄膜铌酸锂 fabricated 后，用分段、非易失相变包层校正由 8 nm 膜厚误差引起的色散偏差；通过大量模式求解、全波仿真和按 die 建模的谱代理模型选择段位图案，使多数测试 die 的 β2 落入 ±25 ps² km⁻¹，并给出 532 nm 写入窗口的热学候选。
AI.motivation: 商用薄膜铌酸锂晶圆允许的膜厚误差可达 8 nm，而该误差在 1550 nm 处会使群速度色散 β2 偏移约 28 ps² km⁻¹。作者希望研究 fabricated 后能否用分段、非易失相变包层纠正这一误差。
AI.method: 对 3012 个几何做模式求解，比较 Sb₂S₃ 与 Sb₂Se₃ 相变包层的 β2 调控和损耗；利用相位沿波导累积的特性，用四个独立切换的二元段覆盖 (β2,β3) 平面的二维区域，并用本征模展开验证结区描述。对 65 个 die 几何做全波求解，显示段状态随 die 误差移动，因此从按 die 的模型选择位图案；该模型为受无损 Maxwell 问题精确恒等式约束的谱代理模型。还用裸测试环和掩模上已带晶体条的第二环进行评分，并建立热模型评估 532 nm 光束写入窗口。
AI.result: 在采用的 Optical constants 下，40 nm 条厚时 Sb₂S₃ 使 β2 中位变化 181 ps² km⁻¹ 且无材料吸收；Sb₂Se₃ 达到相近对比度但中位模损耗为 5.6 dB cm⁻¹。四段二元切换可到达 (β2,β3) 的二维区域。受约束谱代理模型在训练域内精度与无约束基线相近，保持 β2 与 β3 一致；在未见膜厚处误差为 8.3 而非 13.0 ps² km⁻¹。以全波解评分，96.8% 的 die 被 trimming 到 ±25 ps² km⁻¹ 内。热模型给出 532 nm 光束的候选写入窗口。
AI.conclusion: 数值结果表明，分段非易失相变包层结合按 die 选择的段位图案，可在 fabricated 后 trimming 薄膜铌酸锂的色散误差，使绝大多数测试 die 满足 ±25 ps² km⁻¹ 指标；Sb₂S₃ 在假定光学常数下兼具无材料吸收和足够 β2 对比度。摘要未提供实验制备或测量验证，也未给出 532 nm 写入窗口的具体数值。

title: Computational assessment of incremental pyriform aperture enlargement in plastic surgery: effect on inhaled nasal airflow
summary: Background. The pyriform aperture is a critical anterior bony constriction governing nasal airflow and is clinically relevant to both functional and aesthetic nasal surgery, yet the degree of pyriform aperture enlargement (PAE) needed to capture its aerodynamic benefit is undefined. This study employs high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to quantify the aerodynamic effects of progressive PAE and identify a threshold beyond which further enlargement yields minimal benefit. Methods. A CT-derived three-dimensional nasal airway model was digitally modified to produce baseline, 5%, 10%, 15%, and 20% increases in pyriform aperture cross-sectional area. Pressure-driven large-eddy simulations (LES) were performed at a fixed transnasal pressure difference of 11.25 Pa to quantify changes in inspiratory flow rate, total airway resistance, and local airflow characteristics. Results. Progressive PAE monotonically increased inspiratory flow from 15.063 to 15.252 L/min (approximately 1.25%) and reduced airway resistance from 0.6138 to 0.6028 Pa.min/L (approximately 1.80%). The aerodynamic response was strongly nonlinear, with the greatest improvement occurring between 10% and 15% enlargement. Increasing the aperture from 15% to 20% produced negligible additional improvement. Conclusions. PAE improves nasal airflow by reducing the resistance imposed by the anterior bony constriction. In the anatomical model investigated, approximately 15% area enlargement represented an efficient aerodynamic threshold, after which the dominant resistance shifted toward downstream nasal structures and further enlargement produced little additional benefit. These findings support a conservative, anatomy-dependent approach to PAE and warrant validation across a broader range of patient-specific geometries.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于CT三维鼻腔模型，用高保真计算流体力学模拟梨状孔面积逐步扩大5%–20%，发现鼻气流改善呈强非线性，约15%扩大为有效气动阈值，继续扩大至20%收益甚微。
AI.motivation: 梨状孔是决定鼻气流的骨性狭窄，与功能性及美学鼻手术均相关，但需要扩大多少梨状孔面积（PAE）才能获得气动收益尚不明确；本研究旨在量化渐进性PAE的气动效应并识别收益趋于饱和的阈值。
AI.method: 基于CT重建三维鼻腔气道模型，将其数字修改为基线及梨状孔横截面积增加5%、10%、15%、20%的模型；在固定经鼻压差11.25 Pa下进行压力驱动大涡模拟（LES），量化吸气流量、总气道阻力及局部气流特征的变化。
AI.result: 随PAE递增，吸气流量由15.063单调升至15.252 L/min（约1.25%），总气道阻力由0.6138降至0.6028 Pa·min/L（约1.80%）；气动响应呈强非线性，10%–15%扩大带来的改善最大，15%–20%的额外改善可忽略。
AI.conclusion: PAE通过降低前部骨性狭窄所致阻力改善鼻气流；在所研究的解剖模型中，约15%面积扩大为高效气动阈值，此后主导阻力转向下游鼻结构，进一步扩大收益很小；结果支持保守、依赖解剖的PAE策略，并需在更广泛的患者特异性几何中验证。

title: Chiral phonon magnetism from localized Raman excitation
summary: Optically driven chiral phonons can induce transient magnetism in non-magnetic crystals, yet the microscopic relationship between phonon angular momentum and the resulting magnetic response remains unresolved. Here we distinguish the roles of pseudo-angular momentum and mechanical angular momentum in tetragonal α-TeO2. Combining phase-resolved terahertz spectroscopy with magneto-optical Kerr measurements (MOKE), we reconstruct the motion of a doubly degenerate phonon and continuously control its angular momentum. The MOKE response follows the sign and magnitude of phonon angular momentum as well as its dynamics, whereas non-rotating phonons, including those with finite pseudo-angular momentum, produce no detectable magnetic signal. The MOKE rotation corresponds to an effective magnetic field of approximately 14 mT, nearly seven orders of magnitude above the estimate for spatially uniform ionic currents. Moreover, the Kerr response scales linearly with the emitted terahertz field, rather than quadratically as predicted by the uniform-current model. A localized Raman-excitation model involving Te lone-pair states accounts for this scaling and yields a comparable field magnitude with the MOKE data when electronic enhancement is included. These findings identify mechanical lattice rotation as the dominant dynamical variable for the observed magnetic response and suggest that localized Raman coupling contributes to its unexpectedly large magnitude.

AI.tldr: 该文区分了四方α-TeO2中声子赝角动量与机械角动量的作用，并通过太赫兹光谱与磁光克尔测量表明：只有机械晶格旋转对应的声子角动量会随其符号、大小和动力学产生可测磁响应，而非旋转声子（包括具有有限赝角动量的声子）没有可检测磁信号。
AI.motivation: 光驱动手性声子可在非磁性晶体中诱导瞬态磁性，但声子角动量与磁响应之间的微观关系尚未解决，因此需要区分赝角动量和机械角动量的角色。
AI.method: 在四方α-TeO2中结合相位分辨太赫兹光谱与磁光克尔测量（MOKE），重建二重简并声子的运动并连续调控其角动量；比较非旋转声子（包括具有有限赝角动量的声子）的磁响应，并用涉及Te孤对电子态的局域拉曼激发模型解释结果。
AI.result: MOKE响应随声子角动量的符号、大小及其动力学变化，而非旋转声子无可检测磁信号；MOKE旋转对应约14 mT的有效磁场，比空间均匀离子电流估计高近七个数量级；克尔响应随发射的太赫兹场线性缩放，而非均匀电流模型预测的二次缩放；局域拉曼激发模型可解释该缩放，并在包含电子增强时给出与MOKE数据相当的场强。
AI.conclusion: 机械晶格旋转是观测到的磁响应的主导动力学变量，局域拉曼耦合有助于解释其异常大的幅度。

title: Inhalation-exhalation asymmetry in pressure-driven airflow through a population-derived median unilateral human nasal cavity
summary: This study investigates inhalation-exhalation asymmetry in population-derived median unilateral human nasal cavity under pressure-driven breathing using time-resolved computational fluid dynamics (CFD). A standardized geometry reconstructed from averaged CT data of 30 adults was subjected to a sinusoidal nasopharyngeal pressure waveform over a complete breathing cycle. Low, intermediate, and high pressure amplitudes were considered to quantify breathing-phase-dependent changes in flow rate, Reynolds number, wall shear stress, nasal resistance, and olfactory-region airflow. For identical imposed pressure magnitudes, inhalation produced a consistently larger flow rate and lower aerodynamic resistance than exhalation, demonstrating a direction-dependent pressure-flow response. Increasing breathing intensity increased Reynolds number and nasal resistance while largely preserving the spatial pattern of the flow. During inhalation, stronger airflow penetrated further into the superior nasal cavity and produced higher and more localized wall shear stress, whereas exhalation exhibited smoother airflow redistribution. The breathing-phase asymmetry also affected regional ventilation: the fraction of total airflow reaching the olfactory region increased with inspiratory intensity and reached approximately 6% under the high-pressure condition, while the expiratory fraction remained comparatively insensitive to breathing intensity. These results demonstrate that pressure-driven transient simulations naturally capture geometry-dependent inhalation-exhalation differences that are suppressed when identical flow rates are prescribed for the two breathing phases, with consequences for both global nasal resistance and regional airflow delivery.

AI.tldr: 该研究用时间分辨CFD在30名成人CT重建的标准化单侧鼻腔模型中施加正弦鼻咽压力波形，比较低压、中压、高压下的吸气与呼气流动差异。结果显示相同压力幅度下吸气流量更大、鼻阻力更低；吸气增强时雷诺数和鼻阻力升高但流场空间模式基本保持，且嗅区流量占比随吸气强度增加，高压下达约6%，呼气侧则不明显。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探讨压力驱动呼吸条件下，基于人群平均几何的单侧人鼻腔内吸气-呼气不对称性，并说明若对吸气和呼气规定相同流量会抑制由几何结构决定的方向性差异。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨计算流体动力学（CFD），基于30名成人平均CT数据重建标准化单侧鼻腔几何，施加覆盖完整呼吸周期的正弦鼻咽压力波形，设置低、中、高三种压力幅度，量化流量、雷诺数、壁面剪切应力、鼻阻力和嗅区气流随呼吸相位的变化。
AI.result: 相同 imposed pressure magnitudes 下，吸气流量持续大于呼气且气动阻力更低，体现方向依赖的压力-流量响应；呼吸强度增加使雷诺数和鼻阻力升高，但流场空间模式大体保持。吸气时更强气流深入上鼻道并产生更高、更局部的壁面剪切应力，呼气时气流再分布更平滑；嗅区占总流量比例随吸气强度增加，高压条件约6%，而呼气比例对呼吸强度相对不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 压力驱动的瞬态模拟能够自然捕捉由鼻腔几何决定、但在吸气和呼气设定相同流量时被抑制的吸气-呼气差异，这些差异同时影响整体鼻阻力和区域气流输送。

title: Deterministic and dynamic synthesis of optical skyrmions through an ultrathin multimode fibre
summary: Topological light fields offer powerful opportunities for information encoding, transport, and manipulation, yet their deterministic generation in complex scattering media remains an outstanding challenge. In highly multimode fibres, strong mode coupling and polarisation mixing can obscure the precise control required to synthesise structured vectorial states, including optical skyrmions. Here, we demonstrate the deterministic generation and dynamic reconfiguration of arbitrary optical skyrmions through an ultrathin multimode fibre. By combining vectorial transmission-matrix control with a phase-retrieval optimisation framework, we exploit the full polarisation-resolved modal space of the fibre to reconstruct user-defined vector fields with high fidelity at the distal facet. This approach enables the synthesis of Néel, Bloch, anti- and higher-order skyrmions, and bimerons. Their topological properties are confirmed through polarisation-resolved Stokes-vector measurements and quantitative determination of the skyrmion number. Wavefront reprogramming further provides dynamic control over polarisation textures, enabling reversible transitions between distinct skyrmionic states. Our results establish multimode fibres as programmable platforms for the generation of topological light and introduce a scalable route towards minimally invasive topological photonics, with potential applications in imaging, sensing, optical communications, and information processing in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 该文利用超薄多模光纤，将矢量传输矩阵控制与相位恢复优化框架结合，在强模式耦合和偏振混合条件下确定性生成并动态重构任意光学斯格明子，包括Néel型、Bloch型、反斯格明子、高阶斯格明子和bimerons，并通过偏振分辨斯托克斯矢量测量与斯格明子数定量测定验证其拓扑性质。
AI.motivation: 拓扑光场在信息编码、传输和操控方面具有潜力，但复杂散射介质中的确定性生成仍是难题；高多模光纤中的强模式耦合和偏振混合会妨碍对结构化矢量态（包括光学斯格明子）的精确合成与控制。
AI.method: 采用超薄多模光纤，结合矢量传输矩阵控制与相位恢复优化框架，利用光纤完整的偏振分辨模态空间，在光纤远端面重建用户定义的矢量场；通过偏振分辨斯托克斯矢量测量和斯格明子数定量确定拓扑性质，并利用波前重编程动态控制偏振纹理。
AI.result: 实现了高保真度的确定性生成与动态重构，可合成Néel型、Bloch型、反斯格明子、高阶斯格明子和bimerons；斯托克斯矢量测量与斯格明子数定量结果确认了其拓扑性质；波前重编程可实现不同斯格明子态之间的可逆转换。光纤长度、损耗等具体参数未在摘要中提供。
AI.conclusion: 多模光纤可作为生成拓扑光的可编程平台，并提供面向微创拓扑光子学的可扩展路径，潜在应用于复杂环境中的成像、传感、光通信和信息处理。

title: Conditional stopping guarantees for a folded parametrization of reduced Stokes vectors
summary: Stopping decisions made in parametrization coordinates need not certify physically accurate estimates. We establish conditional stopping guarantees for a folded parametrization of reduced Stokes vectors, including partial linear polarization. For strongly convex physical objectives on the bounded-intensity inner sheet, normalized first derivatives and one radial lower-curvature test give an explicit objective-gap bound with sharp tolerance orders $\varepsilon^{4/3}+ν^2$. The guarantee requires neither prior localization near an optimum nor a positive-semidefinite head Hessian. Its information basis is an exact recovery identity: one signed radial curvature restores the physical-gradient component lost at the fully linearly polarized fold, without stationarity or knowledge of the physical Hessian. For a nominal quadratic model, an outward-rounded implementation certifies a gap of at most $10^{-6}$ for 8,861 of 9,284 stored endpoints; it rejects all 295 historical false successes and 128 accurate endpoints. The full 128-fractional-bit pass takes 7.32 seconds and includes 52 scalar curvature evaluations. Controlled fits and released observations distinguish stopping certification from local fold diagnosis and subsequent coordinate repair. Twenty shared-network fits contain no saved near-fold negative-curvature candidates, and direct physical solvers are cheaper on the tested quadratics.

AI.tldr: 该文针对约化 Stokes 矢量（含部分线偏振）的折叠参数化，建立条件性停止保证：在强凸物理目标与有界强度内层上，用归一化一阶导数和一次径向下曲率检验给出显式目标间隙界，并以精确恢复恒等式补回全线性偏振折叠处丢失的物理梯度分量；标称二次模型上的向外舍入实现可认证多数端点，但会拒绝部分准确端点，且直接物理求解器在测试中更便宜。
AI.motivation: 参数化坐标中的停止决策不一定能证明所得估计在物理上准确，因此需要为折叠参数化下的停止判据提供可认证的条件性保证，并区分停止认证、局部折叠诊断与后续坐标修复。
AI.method: 针对有界强度内层上的强凸物理目标，使用归一化一阶导数和一次径向下曲率检验，推导显式目标间隙界，其尖锐容差阶为 ε^{4/3}+ν^2；该保证不要求事先定位到最优附近，也不要求头 Hessian 半正定。其信息基础是精确恢复恒等式：一次带符号径向曲率可在全线性偏振折叠处恢复丢失的物理梯度分量，而无需平稳性或已知物理 Hessian。随后在标称二次模型上采用向外舍入实现进行认证。
AI.result: 在 9,284 个存储端点中，该实现为 8,861 个端点认证目标间隙至多 10^{-6}；拒绝全部 295 个历史假成功和 128 个准确端点。完整 128 位小数位精度的一轮耗时 7.32 秒，包含 52 次标量曲率评估。二十个共享网络拟合中未保存到近折叠负曲率候选；在所测试的二次型上，直接物理求解器更便宜。
AI.conclusion: 参数化坐标中的停止并不自动保证物理准确；本文给出条件性停止认证框架，并用精确恢复恒等式支持折叠处的梯度恢复。实验表明认证与局部折叠诊断及坐标修复是不同任务，且该实现会保守地拒绝部分准确端点；在测试二次型上直接物理求解器成本更低。摘要未提供更广泛非二次目标上的认证率或运行时间。

title: Nondestructive 3D Metrology of Through-Glass Via Geometry and Internal Wall Texture Using Holotomography
summary: Through-glass vias (TGVs) are increasingly important for semiconductor packaging, yet their internal geometry and wall texture remain difficult to characterize nondestructively. Here, we use holotomography (HT) to inspect the three-dimensional (3D) geometry and internal wall texture of intact, unfilled TGVs before metallization. HT reconstructs the refractive index (RI) distribution of the glass and via. Maps of RI and spatially filtered RI then localize the internal boundary. Geometric fitting quantifies via dimensions and taper, while spatial filtering separates slowly varying wall form from finer texture. The reconstructed surface supports volumetric visualization, dimensional measurements and spatial characterization of wall texture within one optical inspection workflow. These measurements reveal internal features inaccessible from surface views and provide quantitative descriptors to evaluate TGVs

AI.tldr: 该文利用全息层析（HT）对金属化前完整、未填充的玻璃通孔（TGV）进行无损三维几何与内壁形貌检测，通过折射率分布重建、边界定位、几何拟合和空间滤波，实现尺寸、锥度及壁面纹理的定量表征。
AI.motivation: TGV在半导体封装中日益重要，但其内部几何结构和壁面纹理难以无损表征，因此需要一种可在金属化前检查完整TGV内部特征的方法。
AI.method: 采用全息层析（HT）重建玻璃与通孔的折射率（RI）分布；利用RI图及空间滤波后的RI图定位内部边界；通过几何拟合量化通孔尺寸与锥度；通过空间滤波分离缓慢变化的壁面形状与更精细的壁面纹理，并在同一光学检测流程中实现体可视化、尺寸测量和壁面纹理空间表征。
AI.result: 研究实现了对完整、未填充TGV的三维几何和内壁纹理的无损测量，可揭示表面视图无法获得的内部特征，并提供用于评估TGV的定量描述符；摘要未给出具体尺寸、精度或统计数值。
AI.conclusion: 全息层析可作为一种面向TGV的无损光学检测流程，在同一工作流中完成内部几何测量与壁面纹理定量表征，为TGV评估提供定量描述符；其具体性能指标在摘要中未提供。

title: Optical spectral asymmetry enables differential refractive-index sensing under near-perfect common-mode suppression in a single-cavity dual-comb fiber laser
summary: Single-cavity dual-comb fiber lasers offer near-perfect common-mode suppression, but such suppression is generally expected to eliminate differential sensing signals. Here we show that optical spectral asymmetry enables differential refractive-index (RI) sensing despite near-perfect common-mode suppression. By integrating an intracavity multimode interference (MMI) fiber sensor into a shared cavity, two counter-propagating combs are simultaneously generated and interrogated, enabling differential RI sensing based on the repetition-frequency difference (Δfrep). This architecture achieves near-perfect common-mode suppression, reducing temperature-induced drift by more than two orders of magnitude compared with a conventional dual-cavity dual-comb system. Spectral analysis reveals that optical spectral asymmetry gives rise to asymmetric repetition-frequency responses through cavity dispersion, thereby providing the physical origin of the differential sensing signal. A trade-off between sensitivity and noise suppression is identified: while the sensitivity is reduced due to the shared sensor, the improved frequency stability enhances robustness against environmental perturbations. These results demonstrate that near-perfect common-mode suppression does not preclude differential sensing, but instead reveals a new sensing mechanism governed by optical spectral asymmetry. These findings establish optical spectral asymmetry as a design principle for differential sensing in single-cavity dual-comb systems and provide a framework for highly stable long-term photonic sensing.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并验证了一种基于光学光谱不对称性的单腔双梳差分折射率传感机制：在共享腔中集成腔内多模干涉光纤传感器，同时产生并 interrogate 两束反向传播光梳，以重复频率差 Δfrep 实现差分 RI 传感；该系统获得近完美共模抑制，温度漂移较传统双腔双梳系统降低两个数量级以上，并揭示灵敏度与噪声抑制之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 单腔双梳光纤激光器具有近完美的共模抑制，但通常被认为会消除差分传感信号；作者希望证明近完美共模抑制并不排除差分传感，并利用光学光谱不对称性实现差分折射率传感，同时提升长期稳定性。
AI.method: 将腔内多模干涉（MMI）光纤传感器集成到共享腔中，同时产生并 interrogate 两束反向传播的光梳，基于重复频率差（Δfrep）进行差分折射率传感；通过光谱分析结合腔色散解释光学光谱不对称性导致的非对称重复频率响应。
AI.result: 该架构实现近完美共模抑制，使温度引起的漂移相比传统双腔双梳系统降低两个数量级以上；光谱分析表明光学光谱不对称性通过腔色散产生非对称重复频率响应，从而给出差分传感信号的物理来源；同时识别出灵敏度与噪声抑制之间的权衡：共享传感器使灵敏度降低，但频率稳定性提高增强了对环境扰动的鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体灵敏度、噪声或漂移数值。
AI.conclusion: 近完美共模抑制并不妨碍差分传感，而是揭示了一种由光学光谱不对称性主导的新传感机制；光学光谱不对称性可作为单腔双梳系统差分传感的设计原则，并为高稳定长期光子传感提供框架。

title: Scan-less Hyperspectral Polarimetric Imaging Using Dual-Comb Single-Pixel Imaging
summary: Spectroscopic polarimetry enables detailed characterization of light-matter interactions by combining spectral and polarization information, yet conventional implementations rely on mechanical polarization modulation and are difficult to extend to fast, broadband imaging. Dual-comb spectroscopic polarimetry (DCSP) addresses these limitations by providing rapid, modulation-free access to polarization-resolved amplitude and phase spectra, but has so far been limited to point-based measurements. In this work, we introduce dual-comb spectro-polarimetric single-pixel imaging (DCSP-SPI), a new framework that combines DCSP with structured illumination and single-pixel detection to achieve scan-less hyperspectral polarimetric imaging without a camera. By exploiting the intrinsic amplitude and phase sensitivity of dual-comb interferometry, spectrally resolved images of the amplitude ratio psi and phase difference delta are reconstructed across a broad optical spectrum. The performance of DCSP-SPI is demonstrated through imaging experiments using a birefringent resolution target and a Fabry-Perot etalon, where frequency-dependent psi and delta images are obtained and shown to follow the expected spectral and polarization characteristics. Furthermore, the approach is extended to hyperspectral reconstruction of full Jones matrix elements by using multiple incident polarization states. The proposed DCSP-SPI framework provides a new pathway toward scan-less, hyperspectral polarization imaging, offering a flexible platform for applications requiring quantitative spatial, spectral, and polarization analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双梳光谱偏振单像素成像（DCSP-SPI），将双梳光谱偏振测量与结构照明、单像素探测结合，实现无需相机和扫描的高光谱偏振成像，并可扩展到全琼斯矩阵元素的高光谱重构。
AI.motivation: 传统光谱偏振测量依赖机械偏振调制，难以实现快速、宽带成像；双梳光谱偏振测量虽能快速、免调制地获取偏振分辨的振幅和相位光谱，但此前仅限于点测量。因此需要一种无需扫描的高光谱偏振成像框架。
AI.method: 将DCSP与结构照明和单像素探测相结合，利用双梳干涉术固有的振幅与相位敏感性，在宽光谱范围内重构振幅比ψ和相位差δ的光谱分辨图像；并通过多个入射偏振态将方法扩展到全琼斯矩阵元素的高光谱重构。实验使用双折射分辨率靶和Fabry-Perot标准具进行验证。
AI.result: 实验获得了随频率变化的ψ和δ图像，并显示其符合预期的光谱与偏振特性；进一步实现了全琼斯矩阵元素的高光谱重构。摘要未提供分辨率、成像速度或定量误差等具体性能指标。
AI.conclusion: DCSP-SPI为无需扫描的高光谱偏振成像提供了新途径，可作为面向定量空间、光谱和偏振分析的灵活平台。

title: Controlling the Sign and Magnitude of the Thermoreflectance Coefficient of Gold-MoS$_2$ Metamaterials
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures (main text) + 18 pages, 12 figures (Supporting Information). Submitted to Advanced Materials
summary: Heating a material changes how much light it reflects. This effect, quantified by the thermoreflectance coefficient $C_\mathrm{TR}$, enables temperature sensing, while it is a nuisance for situations where constant reflection is crucial. Whereas temperature detection requires a large $C_\mathrm{TR}$, the latter situation demands it to be as close to zero as possible. Controlling the $C_\mathrm{TR}$ has so far relied on the selection of materials and wavelengths, rather than engineering the coefficient itself. This work demonstrates that the $C_\mathrm{TR}$ of a 50 nm thin gold film on SiO$_2$/Si can be controlled in sign and magnitude by an ultrathin ($<$8 nm) MoS$_2$ film underneath it. Time-resolved thermoreflectance measurements reveal suppression, sign inversion, and revival of the thermoreflectance signal, controlled by three knobs: ($i$) the buried MoS$_2$ thickness, ($ii$) probe wavelength, and ($iii$) ambient temperature. Transfer-matrix simulations using temperature-dependent dielectric functions of gold and MoS$_2$ reproduce all experimental observations, demonstrating an optothermal metamaterial platform with controllable properties. In particular, these (anti-)thermoreflective metamaterial mirrors bring $C_\mathrm{TR}$ under the same interference design rules previously applied to the optical response itself, opening ways to maximize or minimize the temperature dependence of the optical reflectance, tailored to the specific application.

AI.tldr: 该文利用金薄膜下方的超薄 MoS2 层，通过厚度、探测波长和环境温度三个调控参量，实现热反射系数 C_TR 的抑制、符号反转与恢复，并用温度相关介电函数的传输矩阵模拟复现实验。
AI.motivation: 加热会改变材料反射率，该效应由热反射系数 C_TR 量化；温度传感需要较大的 C_TR，而要求反射率稳定的场景则希望 C_TR 接近零。此前控制 C_TR 主要依赖材料与波长选择，而非对系数本身进行工程调控。
AI.method: 在 SiO2/Si 上制备 50 nm 金薄膜，并在其下方引入小于 8 nm 的超薄 MoS2 层；采用时间分辨热反射测量，考察埋入 MoS2 厚度、探测波长和环境温度三个调控参量；并使用金与 MoS2 的温度相关介电函数进行传输矩阵模拟。
AI.result: 实验观察到热反射信号的抑制、符号反转和恢复；基于温度相关介电函数的传输矩阵模拟复现了全部实验观测，表明该体系是一种光学-热学超材料平台，其性质可控。
AI.conclusion: 这种（反）热反射超材料反射镜使 C_TR 遵循此前用于光学响应本身的干涉设计规则，从而可按具体应用需求最大化或最小化光学反射率的温度依赖性。

title: Experimental demonstration of phase-conjugated twin-wave coherent reception over 100 km with injection locking assisted phase stabilization
summary: Recovering complex optical signals with high sensitivity is central to coherent communication and sensing. Beyond conventional homodyne and heterodyne reception, phase-conjugate twin-wave encoding and phase-sensitive joint detection offer an alternative strategy with enhanced sensitivity. Extending this approach to long-distance transmission of high-order-modulated signals is challenging because optical phase coherence must be maintained at the receiver. Here we experimentally demonstrate injection-locking-assisted phase-conjugated twin-wave reception of 200-MBaud signals with modulation formats up to 256-QAM over 100 km of optical fiber. Optical injection locking regenerates the local oscillator (LO) from a reference transmitted through the 16 dB-loss link, while pilot-assisted optical feedback stabilizes the relative signal-LO phase, enabling coherent combining of the phase-conjugated twin waves at a single balanced photodetector. At equal received signal-photon number per quadrature in each data-carrying optical mode, the measured PCTW signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) exceeds the ideal single-mode homodyne standard quantum limit (SQL) benchmark. The SNR gains over the measured homodyne and conventional heterodyne results are about 3 dB and 6 dB, respectively. Constellation and bit-error-rate measurements show that this gain improves high-order data recovery relative to heterodyne reception. An ideal Gaussian-noise model predicts a photon information efficiency of 1.54 bits per received signal photon for uniform 16-QAM. These results establish an injection-locking-assisted coherent receiver architecture that implements joint detection of phase-conjugated twin waves over 100 km of fiber with enhanced sensitivity, providing a practical route for photon-efficient coherent communication.

AI.tldr: 本文实验演示了注入锁定辅助的相位共轭孪波（PCTW）接收：在100 km光纤、16 dB链路损耗下传输200-MBaud、最高256-QAM信号，利用光注入锁定从传输参考光再生本振，并用导频辅助光反馈稳定信号-本振相对相位，在单个平衡光电探测器上实现相干合并；测得PCTW信噪比超过理想单模零差SQL基准，较零差和常规外差分别约高3 dB和6 dB，并改善高阶信号恢复。
AI.motivation: 高灵敏度恢复复杂光信号对相干通信与传感至关重要；相位共轭孪波编码与相位敏感联合检测相比常规零差/外差接收可提升灵敏度，但将这一方法扩展到长距离高阶调制信号传输时，接收端光相位相干性难以维持，本文旨在解决该问题并探索光子高效相干通信的实用接收架构。
AI.method: 实验采用注入锁定辅助的PCTW接收架构，传输200-MBaud、调制格式最高达256-QAM的信号，链路为100 km光纤、16 dB损耗。光注入锁定从经链路传输的参考光再生本振；导频辅助光反馈稳定信号与本振的相对相位；随后在单个平衡光电探测器上实现相位共轭孪波的相干合并，并与零差、常规外差接收结果进行比较。
AI.result: 在每一数据承载光模中每正交分量接收信号光子数相等的条件下，测得PCTW信噪比超过理想单模零差SQL基准；相较实测零差和常规外差结果，SNR增益分别约为3 dB和6 dB。星座图与误码率测量表明该增益相对外差接收改善了高阶数据恢复；理想高斯噪声模型预测，对均匀16-QAM，光子信息效率为每接收信号光子1.54 bit。摘要未提供具体误码率数值。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一种注入锁定辅助的相干接收机架构，在100 km光纤上实现相位共轭孪波联合检测并获得增强灵敏度，为光子高效相干通信提供了实用路径。

title: Propagation invariant one-dimensional flat-top vector beam with conserved topology
summary: We report the generation and control of a propagation invariant one-dimensional flat-top vector beam through the digitally controlled superposition of a first-order petal- and Gaussian- mode each marked with orthogonal polarizations. We present a detailed analysis of the spatial and polarization profiles and unveil their intricate topological features, showing that they have properties that are invariant to the propagation dynamics, in addition to their preserved intensity. The differential Gouy phase between the spatial components is shown to rotate the great circle traced by the polarisation distribution on the Poincaré sphere. Finally, we assess the beams for laser cutting and optical trapping, highlighting the relevance of topological structured light to these applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数字控制叠加分别携带正交偏振的一阶花瓣模与高斯模，生成并控制传播不变的一维平顶矢量光束；分析其空间与偏振拓扑特性，揭示差分古伊相位使庞加莱球上偏振分布所描绘的大圆发生旋转，并评估其在激光切割与光镊中的应用相关性。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确给出研究动机；仅指出拓扑结构光与激光切割、光学捕获等应用相关，并对这些光束进行应用评估。
AI.method: 采用数字控制的正交偏振一阶花瓣模与高斯模叠加，生成一维平顶矢量光束；详细分析其空间分布与偏振分布，并评估其在激光切割和光学捕获中的表现。
AI.result: 所得光束具有传播不变的强度及拓扑特征；空间分量间的差分古伊相位会使偏振分布在庞加莱球上所描绘的大圆发生旋转。摘要未提供激光切割与光学捕获的定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了传播不变一维平顶矢量光束的生成、控制及其拓扑偏振特性，并强调拓扑结构光在激光切割和光学捕获等相关应用中的相关性。

title: Learned optical compression for single-pixel quantitative phase imaging
summary: Quantitative phase imaging (QPI) reveals optical path-length variations in transparent objects but typically relies on spatially resolved intensity measurements. Here we numerically and experimentally demonstrate learned optical compression for single-pixel QPI, jointly optimizing a diffractive encoder and a digital neural decoder to concentrate reconstruction-relevant phase information into a compact measurement vector. A single reconfigurable phase-modulation plane sequentially displays the learned encoding patterns, which are independent of the input object, each yielding one scalar intensity measurement. Operating at a visible wavelength, the experimental system reconstructs quantitative phase images of unknown objects with ~40-fold dimensional compression, using only 2.55% as many intensity measurements as reconstructed pixels. Experimental blind testing on handwritten digits and grating-like phase objects achieves mean Pearson correlation coefficients of 0.945 and 0.848, respectively. Benchmarking under the same measurement budget demonstrates substantially higher reconstruction fidelity than other encoding strategies, highlighting the advantages of learned optical compression. With the optical encoder fixed, decoder-only neural adaptation enables experimental transfer to previously unseen data distributions, extending the utility of the learned measurement representation. These results establish learned optical compression as a measurement-efficient and reusable framework for QPI, integrating phase-information compression into single-pixel intensity measurements while retaining adaptability to new data. This approach paves the way for low-data-rate phase imaging and sensing, with the potential to extend QPI to spectral regions where high-quality detector arrays are costly or unavailable.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并实验验证了一种面向单像素定量相位成像的学习型光学压缩框架：联合优化衍射编码器与数字神经解码器，把重建相关相位信息集中到紧凑测量向量中，实现约40倍维度压缩，仅用相当于重建像素2.55%的强度测量数，并在盲测与数据分布迁移中验证了重建保真度和可复用性。
AI.motivation: 定量相位成像通常依赖空间分辨的强度测量；为降低测量数据量，并潜在拓展到高质量探测器阵列昂贵或不可用的光谱区域，需要一种测量高效、可复用的单像素相位成像与传感框架，将相位信息压缩进少量强度测量。
AI.method: 数值与实验演示单像素定量相位成像的学习型光学压缩：联合优化衍射编码器与数字神经解码器，使重建相关相位信息集中于紧凑测量向量；单个可重构相位调制平面依次显示与输入物体无关的学习编码图案，每个图案产生一个标量强度测量；系统工作在可见波长。光学编码器固定后，仅通过解码器神经适配实现向未见数据分布实验迁移。摘要未提供网络结构、训练细节和编码图案具体形式。
AI.result: 实验系统对未知物体重建定量相位图像，实现约40倍维度压缩，强度测量数仅为重建像素数的2.55%；对手写数字和类光栅相位物体的盲测平均Pearson相关系数分别为0.945和0.848；在相同测量预算下，重建保真度显著高于其他编码策略；固定光学编码器后，仅解码器适配即可实验迁移到先前未见的数据分布。
AI.conclusion: 学习型光学压缩是一种测量高效且可复用的定量相位成像框架，将相位信息压缩融入单像素强度测量并保持对新数据的适应性；有望推动低数据率相位成像与传感，并潜在将定量相位成像拓展到高质量探测器阵列昂贵或不可用的光谱区域。

title: PETE: A Hybrid Photonic and Electronic Thermoelectric Device for Direct Heat-to-Electricity Conversion
summary: Photonic heat engines can achieve high conversion efficiencies, but their far-field power density is constrained by the blackbody limit. Near-field devices overcome this limitation through photon tunneling across a nanoscale vacuum gap; however, the mechanical spacers required to maintain this gap introduce parasitic heat conduction. We propose PETE (Photonic and Electronic Thermoelectric), a hybrid solid-state architecture in which thermoelectric generator (TEG) legs replace passive spacers. The legs simultaneously maintain the near-field gap and convert conducted heat into electricity. We evaluate PETE using an indium tin oxide emitter, an indium arsenide photovoltaic cell, and TaFeSb- and ZrNiSn-based Half-Heusler thermoelectric materials. At a hot-side temperature of 977K, the device achieves a power density of 18.6 W$\cdot$cm$^{-2}$ at 19.76% efficiency. This power density is approximately twice that of either the standalone near-field thermophotovoltaic device or the standalone TEG, while the efficiency is 44% higher than that of the standalone TEG. The performance can be tuned through thermoelectric geometry and material selection, and its adaptability is demonstrated for a broad range of thermoelectric materials and operating temperatures. PETE provides a general strategy for recovering spacer-mediated heat leakage in near-field photonic heat engines.

AI.tldr: 提出PETE混合固态架构，用热电腿替代近场光子热机的被动间隔物，在维持纳米真空间隙的同时回收寄生导热，并在977 K下实现18.6 W·cm⁻²功率密度和19.76%效率。
AI.motivation: 光子热机效率高，但远场功率密度受黑体极限限制；近场器件可通过纳米真空间隙中的光子隧穿突破该限制，然而维持间隙所需的机械间隔物会引入寄生热传导。
AI.method: 提出PETE（Photonic and Electronic Thermoelectric）混合固态架构，以热电发电机（TEG）腿替代被动间隔物，使其同时维持近场间隙并将传导热转化为电能；采用氧化铟锡发射器、砷化铟光伏电池以及TaFeSb和ZrNiSn基Half-Heusler热电材料进行评估，并考察热电几何与材料选择的可调性。
AI.result: 在热侧温度977 K时，器件实现18.6 W·cm⁻²的功率密度和19.76%的效率；该功率密度约为单独近场热光伏器件或单独TEG的两倍，效率比单独TEG高44%。性能可通过热电几何和材料选择调节，并在多种热电材料和工作温度下展示了适应性。
AI.conclusion: PETE为回收近场光子热机中间隔物介导的热泄漏提供了通用策略。

title: Relaxation characteristics and spectral compression in the system of coupled radiating oscillators
summary: The electromagnetic response of two identical coupled oscillators to an ultrashort pulse is investigated. Due to interference between the radiation emitted by the constituent oscillators, the temporal dynamics of the dipole radiation from the system are governed by a nontrivial relationship between their dipole moment amplitudes and differ markedly from those of an isolated oscillator. An analysis based on coupled-mode theory demonstrates that, under appropriate conditions, the energy of an incident ultrashort pulse can be converted into quasi-monochromatic radiation with high efficiency. The theoretical results are supported by qualitative numerical simulations of thin conductive rods resonant in the terahertz frequency range and separated by a deeply subwavelength distance, providing a physical realization of the coupled radiating-oscillator system.

AI.tldr: 研究了两个相同耦合振子对超短脉冲的电磁响应，发现辐射干涉使偶极辐射时间动力学显著不同于孤立振子，并可通过耦合模理论在合适条件下高效转化为准单色辐射，且用太赫兹薄导电棒数值模拟定性支持。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在分析两个相同耦合振子受超短脉冲激发后的电磁响应，重点理解各振子辐射相互干涉如何改变系统偶极辐射的时间动力学，并探索将入射超短脉冲能量高效转化为准单色辐射的可能性。
AI.method: 采用基于耦合模理论的理论分析，研究两个相同耦合振子的辐射干涉与偶极矩振幅关系；并通过共振于太赫兹频段、间距为深亚波长尺度的薄导电棒的定性数值模拟，构建耦合辐射振子系统的物理实现并进行支持性验证。
AI.result: 由于组成振子所发辐射之间的干涉，系统偶极辐射的时间动力学由其偶极矩振幅之间的非平凡关系决定，并明显不同于孤立振子；耦合模理论分析表明，在适当条件下入射超短脉冲的能量可被高效转换为准单色辐射；薄导电棒的定性数值模拟支持上述理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 两个相同耦合振子构成了一类具有非平凡辐射动力学的耦合辐射振子体系，辐射干涉是其区别于孤立振子的关键因素；在适当条件下该体系可实现超短脉冲能量向准单色辐射的高效转换，且深亚波长间距的太赫兹薄导电棒提供了可行的物理实现。摘要未给出定量效率、具体条件参数及更广泛的实验验证。

title: Optical Magnetic-Field Gating of Photon Avalanching Quantum Processes
summary: Highly nonlinear phenomena, where macroscopic changes are triggered by microscopic perturbations, are ubiquitous in complex systems ranging from epidemic spreading to neural networks. In optics, photon avalanching represents a prime manifestation of such highly nonlinear behavior, characterized by a steep nonlinear response (s) following an avalanche threshold. However, this nonlinearity is typically determined by material composition, making this behavior challenging to tune for adaptive sensing, imaging, and neuromorphic applications. Here, we demonstrate giant optical magnetic field gated threshold and nonlinearity in lanthanide doped nanoparticles. We exploit the distinct quantum selection rules of the avalanche process: while the energy looping cycles of excited state absorption and cross relaxation are primarily electrically driven, the seed excitation, ground state absorption, is a mixed transition permitting magnetic dipole interaction. By positioning the emitters within an optical standing wave to spatially partition the electromagnetic field, we tune the local magnetic to electric field balance to selectively regulate the seeding and amplification probabilities. This allows us to demonstrate an unprecedented dynamic range of control over the power threshold and nonlinearity, tuning the order from s = 15 to s = 62. Furthermore, we harness this spatial separation of electric and magnetic fields using tightly focused cylindrical vector beams to locally sculpt the nonlinearity of a single nanocluster, achieving sub wavelength super resolution imaging that substantially surpasses conventional photon avalanche imaging under Gaussian illumination. These findings establish the magnetic component of light as a practical knob to actively program nonlinear optical dynamics, sub diffraction nanoscopy, and critical quantum dynamics at the nanoscale.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用光场的磁场分量门控镧系掺杂纳米颗粒中的光子雪崩，实现雪崩阈值和非线性阶数的大范围调控，并将其用于亚波长超分辨成像。
AI.motivation: 光子雪崩具有高度非线性，但其非线性通常由材料组成决定，难以针对自适应传感、成像和神经形态应用进行调节，因此需要一种可主动调控雪崩阈值和非线性的机制。
AI.method: 研究采用镧系掺杂纳米颗粒，利用雪崩过程中不同的量子选择定则：激发态吸收与交叉弛豫构成的能量循环主要电驱动，而作为种子激发的基态吸收是允许磁偶极相互作用的混合跃迁。将发光体置于光学驻波中以空间分割电磁场，调节局部磁场与电场平衡，从而选择性调控种子激发和放大概率；并利用紧聚焦柱矢量光束空间分离电场与磁场，对单个纳米团簇的非线性进行局域调控。
AI.result: 实现了巨大的光磁场门控阈值与非线性调控，动态调控范围覆盖雪崩阈值及非线性阶数从 s=15 到 s=62；利用电场与磁场的空间分离对单个纳米团簇进行局域非线性调控，实现了亚波长超分辨成像，并显著优于高斯照明下的传统光子雪崩成像。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明光的磁场分量可作为主动编程非线性光学动力学、亚衍射纳米显微成像和纳米尺度临界量子动力学的实用调控手段；摘要未提供具体成像分辨率数值及器件参数。

title: Nonlinear Dynamics in Periodically Distributed Fibre Amplification Systems
comment: To be published in Physics Letters A
summary: We investigate effects of longitudinally varying nonlinearity on periodically distributed amplification systems in optical fibres. Emphasis is made on configurations in which the nonlinear coefficient exponentially grows or decays along the propagation distance, while the group-velocity-dispersion (GVD) coefficient is held constant. Such systems are of practical relevance to the design of highly efficient nonlinear devices, including broadband light sources and advanced amplification schemes, where precise management of the interplay between the GVD, nonlinearity, and gain is essential. Adopting the known generic integrability condition, we derive exact analytical expressions for the evolution of the optical field in the presence of the tailored nonlinearity profiles and periodically distributed gain. The resulting periodic wavetrain solutions and their long-wave limit in the form of bright and dark solitons provide insight into the controlled enhancement or suppression of nonlinear effects under realistic amplification conditions. The robustness of these solutions is examined by introducing finite perturbations and directly evaluating their effects on the corresponding intensity profiles. The structural stability of solutions against deviations from the integrability condition is demonstrated too. Outcomes of this study contribute to a deeper understanding of the nonlinear pulse dynamics in engineered gain-managed fibres and offer guidance for the development of novel optical systems, where the spatial distribution of the nonlinearity is exploited to optimise the performance.

AI.tldr: 该文研究光纤中周期性分布式放大系统在纵向变化非线性系数下的光场演化，重点分析非线性系数沿传播距离指数增长或衰减、而群速度色散（GVD）系数保持恒定的情形；基于已知的普适可积条件推导精确解析解，得到周期波列及亮、暗孤子长波极限，并考察有限扰动和偏离可积条件时的结构稳定性。
AI.motivation: 此类系统与高效非线性器件设计密切相关，包括宽带光源和先进放大方案；在这些应用中，需要精确管理GVD、非线性与增益之间的相互作用，并理解工程化增益管理光纤中的非线性脉冲动力学。
AI.method: 采用理论解析方法：在GVD恒定、增益周期分布且非线性系数沿传播距离指数增长或衰减的配置下，引入已知的普适可积条件，推导光场演化的精确解析表达式；进一步通过引入有限扰动并直接评估其对强度分布的影响来检验解的稳健性，同时分析解在偏离可积条件时的结构稳定性。
AI.result: 获得了在定制非线性分布和周期增益下的光场演化精确解析表达式，以及周期波列解及其亮孤子和暗孤子形式的长波极限；有限扰动分析给出了扰动对相应强度分布的影响，并证明了解在偏离可积条件时具有结构稳定性。摘要未提供具体的定量性能指标或实验数据。
AI.conclusion: 研究有助于深入理解工程化增益管理光纤中的非线性脉冲动力学，并为利用非线性空间分布优化性能的新型光学系统设计提供指导；结果可用于理解实际放大条件下非线性效应的受控增强或抑制，但摘要未给出具体器件性能提升数值。

title: Chiral Unidirectional Resonances Enabled by Complete Coherent Radiation Control
summary: Optical resonances are commonly characterized by their quality factors, while their radiation exhibits richer properties associated with polarization and directional selectivity. Chiral and unidirectional guided resonances exploit complementary aspects of radiation, motivating a unified framework for controlling polarization and directionality together. Here we develop such a framework and introduce chiral unidirectional resonances (CURs) with arbitrarily high radiative quality factors and near-unity single-channel selectivity. We further extend this theory to guide the geometric design of arbitrary coherent emission states with prescribed radiative lifetimes. In addition, we establish scaling laws for the lifetime and radiation-state fidelity, and demonstrate robust chiral unidirectional emission over a finite momentum region. Our demonstrations provide a basis for single-sided circularly polarized light sources and polarization-matched optical coupling.

AI.tldr: 提出手性单向共振（CUR）的统一理论框架，实现任意高辐射品质因子、近单位单通道选择性和按需设计的相干发射态，并给出寿命与辐射态保真度的标度律。
AI.motivation: 传统光学共振主要以品质因子表征，但其辐射还包含偏振与方向选择性；手性共振和单向导模共振分别利用辐射的互补特性，因此需要统一框架同时控制偏振与方向性。
AI.method: 建立统一理论框架并引入手性单向共振（CUR）；将理论扩展至任意相干发射态的几何设计，以指定辐射寿命为目标；推导寿命和辐射态保真度的标度律，并在有限动量区域内设计稳健的手性单向发射。
AI.result: CUR具有任意高辐射品质因子和接近1的单通道选择性；该框架可指导具有指定辐射寿命的任意相干发射态设计；获得寿命与辐射态保真度的标度律，并展示有限动量区域内的稳健手性单向发射。摘要未给出具体实验平台和定量参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为单侧圆偏振光源和偏振匹配的光耦合提供了基础。

title: Quantitative Analytical Spheroid Model for Scattering-Type Scanning Near-Field Optical Spectroscopy of Layered Samples
summary: Scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) is a versatile tool for probing optical properties at deeply subwavelength scales. Its theoretical modeling, however, typically relies on computationally intensive numerical simulations or phenomenological analytical models, limiting quantitative spectral interpretation. In our previous work, we introduced an exact analytical solution for the quasi-electrostatic prolate spheroid model of s-SNOM for homogeneous bulk samples, combining the accuracy of numerical simulations with the efficiency of analytical approaches. Here, we generalize this framework to multilayer samples using two equivalent methods: a generalized image charge method and a Fourier integral method. The resulting exact spheroid model reproduces finite-element simulations within numerical precision while retaining the computational efficiency of an analytical model. We validate the model experimentally for poly (methyl methacrylate) layers of different thicknesses, showing that a single set of geometrical parameters simultaneously reproduces multiple demodulation harmonics and all measured thicknesses, unlike the finite dipole model. We further demonstrate its applicability to strongly resonant SiC layers on dielectric and photoexcited InAs substrates, where existing analytical approaches fail. The model provides an efficient quantitative framework for interpreting multilayer s-SNOM spectra and extracting local optical properties.

AI.tldr: 该文将 s-SNOM 的精确解析准静电长椭球模型从均质体样品推广到多层样品，提出两种等价建模方法，并用有限元模拟及 PMMA、SiC/InAs 等实验验证其准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: s-SNOM 的定量光谱解释通常依赖计算量大的数值模拟或现象学解析模型；作者此前的精确解析长椭球模型仅适用于均质体样品，因此需要推广到多层样品。
AI.method: 采用两种等价方法构建多层样品的精确椭球模型：广义镜像电荷法和傅里叶积分法；将模型与有限元模拟比较，并对不同厚度 PMMA 层进行实验验证，同时应用于介电基底及光激发 InAs 基底上的强共振 SiC 层。
AI.result: 该精确椭球模型在数值精度范围内复现有限元模拟，并保持解析模型的计算效率；实验表明单组几何参数可同时复现多个解调谐波和所有测量厚度，而有限偶极模型做不到；在现有解析方法失效的强共振 SiC 层/InAs 基底情形中仍适用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多层 s-SNOM 光谱的定量解释和局域光学性质提取提供了高效、精确的解析框架。

title: Unlocking Low-Frequency Laser Doppler Holography Spectra for Functional Retinal and Choroidal Microvascular Phenotyping
summary: The low-frequency part of optical fluctuation spectra recorded by laser Doppler holography at a frame rate of 37~kHz is typically filtered out to reveal functional blood-flow waveforms in major retinal and choroidal vessels. We construct a time-varying spectral-excess (SE) distribution in capillary-associated territories by selecting complete cardiac cycles and applying successive spatial and beat medians in regions where vessels are unresolved and intermittent eye motion can dominate the signal. At each phase, spectral excess compares the integrated Doppler spectral area between two fixed low-frequency peaks near $\pm2$~kHz with a reference area defined by the high-frequency tail near $\pm18.5$~kHz. The resulting waveform, displayed against normalized cardiac phase, retains variation throughout the cardiac cycle and provides a basis for exploring its temporal organization. We summarize spectral-excess strength by the spectral excess index (SEI), defined as the temporal median of SE, and also describe an alternative evaluation after spectral pooling. A representative recording illustrates the construction. Physiological specificity and repeatability remain to be quantified.

AI.tldr: 该研究在激光多普勒全息术中利用通常被滤除的低频光谱成分，构建毛细血管相关区域的时变光谱超额（SE）分布，并以光谱超额指数（SEI）总结其强度；目前仅用代表性记录展示方法构建，生理特异性和可重复性尚待量化。
AI.motivation: 激光多普勒全息术以37 kHz帧率记录的光学波动谱中，低频部分通常被滤除以突出视网膜和脉络膜大血管的功能性血流波形；作者希望利用该低频信息，在血管无法分辨且间歇性眼动可能主导信号的毛细血管相关区域中刻画光谱超额及其随心动周期的组织。
AI.method: 选取完整心动周期，在血管未分辨且间歇性眼动可能主导信号的区域依次施加空间中值和搏动中值，构建时变光谱超额（SE）分布；在每个相位，将±2 kHz附近两个固定低频峰之间的积分多普勒光谱面积，与±18.5 kHz附近高频尾部定义的参考面积进行比较。以SE的时间中位数定义光谱超额指数（SEI），并描述光谱池化后的替代评估方法。
AI.result: 代表性记录展示了SE分布的构建过程；相对于归一化心动相位显示的波形在整个心动周期内保留变化，为探索其时间组织提供基础。摘要未提供生理特异性、可重复性或定量性能结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可利用通常被滤除的低频光谱信息构建毛细血管相关区域的时变SE波形并提供SEI总结指标，但生理特异性和可重复性仍需进一步量化验证。

title: Semi-classical analysis of noise squeezing in Kerr microresonators
summary: Kerr microresonators are integrated nonlinear devices widely used to generate classical optical frequency combs and nonclassical states of light. In particular, they provide a promising platform for squeezed light sources, which are important elements of emerging quantum sensing, communication, and computing technologies. Designing such sources requires numerical tools that efficiently incorporate realistic device physics and noise processes. Here, we show that established semi-classical frameworks based on the Lugiato-Lefever equation and the Ikeda map, instrumental in the development of classical light sources, can also predict the quadrature-noise properties of squeezed light when vacuum fluctuations are properly included. We consider three canonical configurations producing two-mode quadrature squeezing, single-mode quadrature squeezing, and intensity difference squeezing. In each case, the semi-classical simulations produce quadrature variances and noise spectra in close agreement with the quantum theoretical predictions. These frameworks therefore provide practical tools for designing squeezed light sources, with the capability to incorporate additional noise mechanisms, nonlinear effects, and complex resonator arrangements. More fundamentally, our results show that key experimental signatures of squeezing can be modeled as phase-sensitive amplification of properly normalized vacuum fluctuations within stochastic semi-classical field equations. This observation helps distinguish squeezing properties accessible through semi-classical field evolution from those intrinsically requiring a full quantum description.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，基于Lugiato-Lefever方程和Ikeda映射的半经典框架在正确纳入真空涨落后，可预测Kerr微谐振器中压缩光的正交噪声性质，并在三种典型构型下与量子理论预测高度一致。
AI.motivation: Kerr微谐振器是产生压缩光的重要平台，而设计此类量子光源需要能高效纳入真实器件物理与噪声过程的数值工具；作者希望检验常用半经典模型能否用于压缩光设计。
AI.method: 在基于Lugiato-Lefever方程和Ikeda映射的半经典框架中正确引入真空涨落，针对双模正交压缩、单模正交压缩和强度差压缩三种典型构型开展随机半经典场演化，并将模拟得到的正交方差和噪声谱与量子理论预测比较。
AI.result: 三种构型下半经典模拟给出的正交方差和噪声谱均与量子理论预测接近一致；压缩的关键实验特征可被描述为随机半经典场方程中对适当归一化真空涨落的相位敏感放大。
AI.conclusion: 这些半经典框架可作为设计压缩光源的实用工具，并能纳入额外噪声机制、非线性效应和复杂谐振器结构；结果也有助于区分可由半经典场演化描述的压缩性质与必须依赖完整量子描述的性质。

title: Energy-Centroid Trembling near Exceptional Points in Photonic Time Crystals
summary: In a photonic time crystal with a modulated Lorentz restoring coefficient, modulation reweights the potential energy of the polarization and loss drains its kinetic energy; when these sectors are offset within a pulse, the energy centroid trembles in every cycle while the Poynting-flux velocity stays bounded. Near the gap-edge exceptional point the mode geometry amplifies these offsets, and for a narrow-band pulse on one passband Floquet branch the trembling-velocity amplitude generically grows as the inverse square root of the momentum detuning, rounded by finite bandwidth. Loss modulated in phase or in antiphase with the restoring coefficient can change the trembling coefficient while the band-slope and Petermann coefficients barely move. In the lossy example studied, a forward field pulse launched with the polarization at rest exhibits delayed bursts near the beat recurrence after substantial energy loss, with monochromatic amplitudes following the inverse three-halves power of the detuning over the computed range. Intracycle energy exchange and preparation thus shape the centroid motion beyond what the band slope and the Floquet Petermann factor determine.

AI.tldr: 本文分析恢复系数受调制的光子时间晶体中能量质心的循环内抖动：极化势能与损耗耗散造成能量偏移，近带隙边缘例外点的模式几何放大该偏移，使窄带脉冲的抖动速度随动量失谐呈逆平方根增长；损耗相位可改变抖动系数，而能带斜率与Floquet Petermann因子变化很小。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确陈述研究动机；其关注的问题是：在具有调制洛伦兹恢复系数的光子时间晶体中，极化势能重加权、损耗耗散、带隙边缘例外点模式几何及脉冲制备如何共同影响能量质心运动，并区分这些效应与能带斜率和Floquet Petermann因子的作用。
AI.method: 采用具有调制洛伦兹恢复系数的光子时间晶体模型，分析极化势能与动能、能量质心及坡印廷通量速度；在带隙边缘例外点附近考察模式几何对能量偏移的放大，并研究单一通带Floquet分支上的窄带脉冲及有限带宽平滑效应；比较损耗与恢复系数同相和反相调制对抖动系数、能带斜率和Petermann系数的影响，并计算有损情形下初态极化为静止的向前场脉冲演化。
AI.result: 调制对极化势能进行重加权，损耗耗散其动能；当两部分在脉冲内存在偏移时，能量质心逐周期抖动，而坡印廷通量速度保持有界。近带隙边缘例外点时，模式几何放大这些偏移；单一通带Floquet分支上的窄带脉冲，其抖动速度幅度通常按动量失谐的逆平方根增长，并由有限带宽圆滑。损耗与恢复系数同相或反相调制可改变抖动系数，而能带斜率和Petermann系数几乎不变。在所研究的有损示例中，初态极化为静止的向前场脉冲在显著能量损失后、接近拍频复现处出现延迟爆发，单色振幅在计算范围内按失谐的负二分之三次方变化。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲内能量交换与初始制备会塑造能量质心运动，其影响超出能带斜率和Floquet Petermann因子所能决定的范围。

title: Non-Hermitian Theory of Surface Emitting Jackiw-Rebbi States
summary: Topological interface states in open photonic systems combine spatial localization at domain walls with temporal confinement characterized by a radiative quality factor. Here, we develop a non-Hermitian Dirac formalism for surface-emitting Jackiw-Rebbi states in dielectric metagratings. We show how varying the local amplitude of the lattice perturbation shapes the complex Dirac mass profile, enabling control over the quality factors and far-field radiation patterns of the interface states, while preserving their topological character. Applying this framework to a metagrating with second-order Brillouin-zone folding, we design a spatially graded superlattice perturbation that supports interface states with quality factors exceeding 10$^4$ and Hermite-Gaussian beam emission. These results establish superlattice perturbations as a strategy for topological beam shaping and offer a route toward high-Q topological surface emitters.

AI.tldr: 本文将开放光子系统中的拓扑界面态与表面发射Jackiw-Rebbi态结合，建立非厄米狄拉克形式，通过调控复狄拉克质量分布控制界面态的品质因子与远场辐射，并在二阶布里渊区折叠超光栅中实现品质因子超过10^4的厄米-高斯光束发射。
AI.motivation: 开放光子系统中的拓扑界面态同时具有空间局域和由辐射品质因子表征的时间约束；本文旨在建立理论框架，在保持拓扑特性的同时调控界面态的辐射品质因子和远场辐射图案，并探索高Q拓扑表面发射器。
AI.method: 建立非厄米狄拉克形式以描述介电超光栅中的表面发射Jackiw-Rebbi态；通过改变晶格微扰的局域幅度来塑造复狄拉克质量剖面；将该框架应用于具有二阶布里渊区折叠的超光栅，并设计空间渐变的超晶格微扰。
AI.result: 复狄拉克质量剖面的调控可在保持拓扑特性的同时改变界面态的品質因子和远场辐射图案；所设计的超晶格微扰支持品质因子超过10^4的界面态，并产生厄米-高斯光束发射。摘要未提供具体结构参数和实验验证细节。
AI.conclusion: 超晶格微扰可作为拓扑光束整形的一种策略，并为高Q拓扑表面发射器提供实现途径。

title: Experimental demonstration of response-enhanced fiber Sagnac gyroscopy via imaginary weak-value amplification
summary: We experimentally demonstrate a 100-m long fiber Sagnac gyroscope employing imaginary weak-value amplification (IWVA) to enhance the optical readout response to rotation. A Sagnac-induced polarization phase is converted into a measurable spectral response through polarization post-selection and spectrally resolved detection. By varying the post-selection angle, we characterize the gyroscope response over the experimentally accessible rotation-rate range. The response increases systematically toward orthogonal post-selection, yielding a maximum experimental enhancement of approximately 13 times relative to a fixed reference configuration without postselection. Fast Fourier transform and Allan-deviation measurements further characterize the noise and stability of the gyroscope. Near-orthogonal post-selection reduces the equivalent rotation-rate fluctuations, with the minimum Allan deviation decreasing from $0.06~\mathrm{rad/s}$ for the reference configuration to $0.0091~\mathrm{rad/s}$ for the configuration exhibiting the maximum response enhancement, corresponding to an approximately 6.6-fold reduction. Low-frequency fluctuations of the broadband superluminescent diode source limit the long-term stability. These results demonstrate that IWVA provides a practical approach for response-enhanced fiber-based Sagnac gyroscopy and precision rotation sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文实验演示了一台100 m长光纤Sagnac陀螺仪，采用虚弱值放大（IWVA）增强对旋转的光学读出响应：通过偏振后选择和光谱分辨探测，将Sagnac感生的偏振相位转换为可测量的光谱响应。实验最大响应增强约为无后选择参考配置的13倍；近正交后选择使最小Allan偏差由0.06 rad/s降至0.0091 rad/s，约降低6.6倍，但宽带超辐射发光二极管光源的低频波动限制长期稳定性。
AI.motivation: 动机是增强光纤Sagnac陀螺仪对旋转的光学读出响应，并探索IWVA在响应增强型光纤Sagnac陀螺与精密旋转传感中的实用性。
AI.method: 采用100 m光纤Sagnac陀螺仪，利用IWVA，通过偏振后选择与光谱分辨探测把Sagnac感生偏振相位转换为可测光谱响应；改变后选择角度，在实验可访问的转速范围内表征陀螺响应；用快速傅里叶变换和Allan偏差表征噪声与稳定性，并与无后选择的固定参考配置比较。摘要未给出具体转速范围及FFT的数值细节。
AI.result: 响应随后选择趋近正交而系统性增大，最大实验增强约为无后选择固定参考配置的13倍。近正交后选择降低等效转速波动，最小Allan偏差从参考配置的0.06 rad/s降至最大响应增强配置的0.0091 rad/s，约降低6.6倍。宽带超辐射发光二极管光源的低频波动限制长期稳定性；摘要未提供FFT具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，IWVA为响应增强型光纤Sagnac陀螺和精密旋转传感提供了一种实用方法；同时，光源低频波动是限制长期稳定性的因素。

title: Nonperturbative theory of thin-vapor-layer linear optical properties: towards the optimal design of alkali-metal vapor nanocells
summary: Hot alkali-metal vapors confined inside nanometer-thick spectroscopic cells are highly suitable media for miniature and cheap frequency standards, magnetometers and atomic sensors. Yet, their linear optical properties in case of low to moderate atomic densities are not fully understood. The primary reason for that is the complex, strongly nonlocal optical response of such systems to the incident resonant radiation arising as the result of the free motion of atoms and their collisions with the walls. To date, calculations of reflection and transmission spectra of these cells has been restricted to perturbation theory in atomic density for the case of quenching atom-wall collisions, which substantially limited the scope of their practical applications. Here we introduce the rigorous numerical approach for computing thin-vapor-layer spectra with an accurate account for the nonlocal optical response at arbitrary optical density and layer thickness. Our model predicts a density-dependent blue shift of the resonance that is absent in the first-order perturbative description. We show that its values are comparable to the natural linewidth of an atomic transition and, therefore, too large to be neglected in most use cases. Inspired by recent experiments, we then explore a wide range of vapor layer thicknesses and study how the reflectivity and its derivative with respect to the laser detuning depend on the layer thickness. Finally, we derive an approximate expression for the thickness at which the first derivative of the reflectivity reaches its maximum that agrees closely with the rigorous numerical model and reduces to the first-order analytical result. These results provide a practical design tool for nanometer-thick spectroscopic cells in different applications as well as a starting point for further development of the theory.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种严格数值方法，用于计算纳米厚碱金属蒸气层在任意光学密度和厚度下的非局域光学响应及反射/透射光谱，并预测了密度相关的共振蓝移，给出了反射率导数最大时厚度的近似设计公式。
AI.motivation: 纳米厚碱金属蒸气池可用于微型低成本频率标准、磁强计和原子传感器，但其低至中等原子密度下的线性光学性质尚未被充分理解；主要原因在于原子自由运动及与壁碰撞导致复杂且强非局域的光学响应。现有反射和透射谱计算多局限于原子密度微扰理论，且仅针对淬灭型原子—壁碰撞，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 作者建立了严格的数值方法，在任意光学密度和蒸气层厚度下精确计入非局域光学响应，计算薄蒸气层光谱；随后受近期实验启发，扫描较宽的蒸气层厚度范围，研究反射率及其对激光失谐的一阶导数随厚度的变化，并推导反射率一阶导数达到最大值时厚度的近似表达式。
AI.result: 模型预测出第一阶微扰描述中不存在的密度相关共振蓝移，其大小可与原子跃迁的自然线宽相比，因此在多数使用场景中不可忽略。所推导的厚度近似表达式与严格数值模型高度吻合，并可退化为第一阶解析结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为不同应用中的纳米厚光谱池提供了实用设计工具，同时为进一步发展相关理论提供了起点。

title: BEEF: A Hybrid Integrated Photonic Simulation Framework
summary: A Python framework is presented that retains first-principles electromagnetic modeling while extending simulation to devices whose length and geometric complexity place them beyond the practical reach of either method alone. The Bridged Engine for eigenmode expansion (EME) and finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) (BEEF) partitions a device into sections which are simulated using either EME or FDTD independently developed Maxwell solvers depending on what best suits each section's geometry, and cascades the resulting responses. BEEF calibrates the EME propagation constants against FDTD-measured phase accumulation, providing a mode identity verification diagnostic across solver interfaces. For a 2x2 multimode-interference splitter, the hybrid result agrees with full-device FDTD to within 0.59% (bar) and 0.76% (cross) across the C-band; a tapered variant agrees to within 0.87% and 2.01%, respectively. For a directional coupler, effective-index calibration reduces cut-position dependence 167-fold. A circuit-level cascade reproduces the measured Fabry-Perot resonance lineshape and free spectral range while exploring the coupler-length and arm-length design plane through post-processing of four cached simulations. Finally, we use BEEF to simulate a 167.3 um-long 4x4 MMI-based 90-degree optical hybrid that is computationally impractical for full-device FDTD, with a reduced-length variant confirming close agreement in transmission and relative phase.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BEEF：一个在保留第一性原理电磁建模的同时，将 EME 与 FDTD 分区混合并级联的 Python 框架；在 MMI 分束器、定向耦合器及 4x4 90 度光学混频器上验证了精度、校准与计算可行性。
AI.motivation: 克服单独使用 EME 或 FDTD 时，在器件长度和几何复杂度上受到的实用范围限制，同时保持第一性原理电磁建模，并解决跨求解器接口的模式一致性验证问题。
AI.method: BEEF 将器件划分为多个区段，根据各区段几何特征分别采用独立开发的 EME 或 FDTD Maxwell 求解器仿真，并级联各段响应；利用 FDTD 测得的相位累积校准 EME 传播常数，并提供跨求解器接口的模式身份验证诊断；还采用电路级级联及对四个缓存仿真进行后处理以探索设计空间。
AI.result: 对 2x2 多模干涉分束器，混合结果在 C 波段与全器件 FDTD 的差异在 bar 端口为 0.59%、cross 端口为 0.76%；锥形变体分别为 0.87% 和 2.01%。对定向耦合器，有效折射率校准将切割位置依赖性降低 167 倍。电路级级联复现了测量的 Fabry-Perot 谐振线型和自由光谱范围，并通过四个缓存仿真的后处理探索耦合器长度与臂长设计平面。BEEF 还仿真了长 167.3 um 的 4x4 基于 MMI 的 90 度光学混频器，该器件对全器件 FDTD 计算不切实际；缩短长度变体在透射率和相对相位上证实了接近一致。
AI.conclusion: BEEF 能够将 EME 与 FDTD 分区混合并级联，在保持第一性原理建模的同时获得与全器件 FDTD 接近的精度，支持高效设计空间探索，并可扩展到全器件 FDTD 计算不切实际的长且复杂器件；摘要未提供更广泛的适用性结论。

title: Coherent transduction and dynamical back-action between light and millimeter waves
summary: Electro-optic transduction can bypass the loss and noise of electronic frequency conversion at millimeter-wave frequencies by parametrically converting signals onto low-loss, low-noise optical carriers, with coupling rates that grow with frequency. Exploiting this growth, however, requires shrinking both the millimeter-wave and optical resonators while preserving their quality factors and spatial overlap, which has not yet been achieved. Here, we demonstrate a triply resonant transducer whose optical and millimeter-wave resonators have comparable dimensions and minimal mode volumes. Coupled lithium niobate Fabry-Pérot cavities, with free spectral ranges above 650 GHz and quality factors up to $10^6$, form a photonic molecule integrated with a quarter-wave gold resonator at 263 GHz. The device reaches a vacuum electro-optic coupling rate $g_0/2π\approx 60$ kHz, six times larger than previous millimeter-wave transducers and sixty times larger than at microwave frequencies. The device optically detects room-temperature thermal millimeter-wave photons at effective occupancies below one, which also serve as a calibration tone for transduction efficiency. Coherent transduction reaches cooperativities approaching 0.3, corresponding to internal efficiencies around 67%, accompanied by electro-optic dynamical back-action that broadens or narrows the optical resonances. These results demonstrate the advantage and feasibility of the frequency scaling of electro-optic coupling, establishing an architecture for weak-signal sensing and quantum and classical networking.

AI.tldr: 本文演示了一种三共振电光换能器：将自由光谱范围超过650 GHz、品质因子最高达10^6的耦合铌酸锂法布里-珀罗腔构成的光子分子，与263 GHz四分之一波长金谐振器集成，实现真空电光耦合率约60 kHz，并观测到室温热毫米波光子探测、约67%的内转换效率及电光动力学反作用。
AI.motivation: 利用电光参量转换把毫米波信号转换到低损耗、低噪声的光载波上，可规避电子频率转换的损耗与噪声，且电光耦合率随频率提高而增大；但要利用这一增长，需要同时缩小毫米波与光谐振器，并保持品质因子和空间模式重叠，此前尚未实现。
AI.method: 采用三共振换能器架构，使光与毫米波谐振器尺寸相当且模式体积最小；具体由耦合铌酸锂法布里-珀罗腔形成光子分子（自由光谱范围高于650 GHz、品质因子最高10^6），并与263 GHz四分之一波长金谐振器集成；测量真空电光耦合率、室温热毫米波光子、转导效率与协同性，并观察电光动力学反作用。
AI.result: 器件达到真空电光耦合率g0/2π约60 kHz，分别约为先前毫米波换能器的6倍和微波频率下的60倍；可在有效占据数低于1时光学探测室温热毫米波光子，并用作转导效率校准；相干转导协同性接近0.3，对应内效率约67%，同时伴随使光学谐振展宽或窄化的电光动力学反作用。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了电光耦合频率缩放的优势与可行性，并建立了一种可用于弱信号传感以及量子与经典网络的器件架构。

title: Animated Ultraviolet Holography via Programmable Nonlinear Phase Transfer
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures; 7 pages of Supporting Information with 5 supplementary figures; three Supplementary Movies
summary: Dynamic and programmable control of ultraviolet (UV) light remains challenging because of conventional high material absorption and the limited functionality of optics such as lenses, mirrors or filters, and optoelectronic devices, such as spatial phase modulators, over the UV range. Here, by employing the concept of virtual metasurfaces based on arrays of programmable optical patterns on a 600-nm-thick lithium niobate film as the nonlinear medium, we demonstrate nonlinear phase transfer, generating programmable holography in the UV range. This arrangement provides a unique platform for generating animated holograms. A spatial light modulator encodes a computer-generated phase distribution onto a longer-wavelength pump beam, while second-harmonic generation transfers the programmed spatial phase to the UV field through the quadratic nonlinear interaction. Importantly, the nonlinear film serves as a simple frequency-conversion interface, eliminating the need for nanostructure patterning or direct UV spatial modulation. By incorporating the nonlinear phase relationship into the hologram design, we experimentally reconstruct six distinct UV holographic patterns, with normalised cross-correlation values ranging from 0.68 to 0.83, demonstrating reliable UV holographic image reconstruction. As a result, the dynamic updating of the SLM enables animated UV holograms at 10 Hz, demonstrating reconfigurable UV holography using the same nonlinear film. The system also supports tunable SHG emission from 350 to 390 nm and dynamic beam steering at approximately 20 Hz. The results demonstrate the potential of virtual metasurfaces to realise software-defined UV holography by transferring spatial programming across optical frequencies. This opens new opportunities for reconfigurable short-wavelength UV beam shaping and structured illumination, without the need for UV-compatible optics or optoelectronics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于600 nm厚铌酸锂薄膜上可编程光学图案阵列的“虚拟超表面”，利用空间光调制器编码泵浦光相位，并通过二次谐波产生将空间相位转移至紫外场，实现可编程、动态紫外全息与光束控制。
AI.motivation: 传统紫外光学元件和光电子器件存在材料吸收高、功能有限等问题，紫外光的动态可编程控制仍具挑战。
AI.method: 在600 nm厚铌酸锂非线性薄膜上构建基于可编程光学图案阵列的虚拟超表面；由空间光调制器将计算机生成相位分布编码到较长波长泵浦光束，再通过二次谐波产生的二次非线性相互作用把编程空间相位传递到紫外场；将非线性相位关系纳入全息图设计，无需纳米结构图案化或直接紫外空间调制。
AI.result: 实验重建了6种不同的紫外全息图案，归一化互相关值为0.68至0.83；通过动态更新空间光调制器实现10 Hz动画紫外全息；系统还支持350至390 nm可调二次谐波发射及约20 Hz动态光束偏转。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明虚拟超表面可通过跨光学频率传递空间编程实现软件定义的紫外全息，为无需紫外兼容光学或光电器件的可重构短波长紫外光束整形和结构照明提供了新途径。

title: Aberration stabilized light bullets in normal dispersion injected Kerr resonators
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, submitted to the special issue "Tribute to A. Vladimirov" of Chaos, Solitons and Fractals
summary: We investigate three-dimensional light bullets (LBs) in an optically injected, vertically emitting Kerr-Gires-Tournois interferometer operating in the normal dispersion regime. In the uniform field limit, the dynamics is governed by a generalized Lugiato-Lefever equation with third-order dispersion, paraxial diffraction, and fourth-order diffraction, stemming from lens and mirror aberrations close to the self-imaging condition. Using direct numerical simulations, we show that without aberration only transversely drifting, tilted multi-peak localized states (LSs) are stable in two dimensions, whereas no stable LBs exist in three dimensions. However, a small negative spherical aberration stabilizes a rich multistable family of two-dimensional LSs, including straight and tilted multi-peak LSs, oscillating states, and complex bound states, which persist even for negative paraxial diffraction. We identify an Andronov-Hopf bifurcation followed by a homoclinic transition toward tilted states, accompanied by hysteresis. Finally, we demonstrate that stable straight and tilted LBs exist in three dimensions in the presence of aberration, the latter forming a continuous family parametrized by the transverse tilt direction.

AI.tldr: 该文研究正色散区光注入垂直发射Kerr-Gires-Tournois干涉仪中的三维光弹，基于含三阶色散、傍轴衍射和四阶衍射的广义Lugiato-Lefever方程进行直接数值模拟，发现无像差时三维光弹不稳定，而小负球差可稳定丰富的二维局域态及直/倾斜三维光弹。
AI.motivation: 探究三维光弹在光注入垂直发射Kerr-Gires-Tournois干涉仪正色散区中的稳定性，并明确透镜和反射镜像差（尤其四阶衍射）对二维局域态和三维光弹稳定性的作用。
AI.method: 在均匀场极限下采用广义Lugiato-Lefever方程建模，方程包含三阶色散、傍轴衍射以及由接近自成像条件的透镜和反射镜像差产生的四阶衍射；通过直接数值模拟研究二维和三维局域态，并识别Andronov-Hopf分岔、同宿转变及迟滞行为。
AI.result: 无像差时，二维中仅横向漂移的倾斜多峰局域态稳定，三维中不存在稳定光弹；小负球差可稳定丰富的多稳态二维局域态家族，包括直和倾斜多峰态、振荡态及复杂束缚态，且在负傍轴衍射下仍可存在；还发现Andronov-Hopf分岔后经同宿转变趋向倾斜态并伴随迟滞；存在像差时，三维中可形成稳定的直光弹和倾斜光弹，后者构成由横向倾斜方向参数化的连续家族。
AI.conclusion: 像差是稳定三维光弹的关键因素；小负球差不仅稳定多种二维局域态，还支持稳定的直和倾斜三维光弹，并伴随多稳态、分岔、同宿转变和迟滞等非线性动力学。

title: Coupled Soft-Clamped Polygon Resonators with Tunable Mechanical Coupling
summary: Coupler geometry controls both the frequency splitting and the dissipation of coupled polygon resonators. We develop a continuum model for two identical square-shaped resonators coupled by a shared tether and compare the analytical predictions with finite element simulations. The model relates the coupler length and width to the frequency splitting and dissipation dilution of the two coupled modes. In the short-coupler limit, $k_cl_c\ll1$, the symmetric-mode coupler undergoes nearly uniform rotation, and its torsional strain energy vanishes asymptotically. The remaining loss contributions arise from polygon-side bending and supporting-tether torsion. The reduced supporting-tether contribution allows the symmetric-mode dissipation dilution to exceed that of an isolated polygon with the same side and supporting-tether dimensions. The antisymmetric mode retains torsional strain in the coupler and has an additional loss contribution. We also derive an expression for $Q\cdot f$ in the short-coupler and short-tether limits, where $Q$ is the mechanical quality factor and $f$ is the resonance frequency. This expression gives the dependence of $Q\cdot f$ on tensile stress, film thickness, and supporting-tether geometry. For a coupler length of $100~μ\mathrm{m}$ and width of $2~μ\mathrm{m}$, finite element calculations give a frequency splitting of $17.7~\mathrm{Hz}$ and a symmetric-mode dilution factor approximately $13\%$ above the analytical isolated-polygon value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个连续体模型，用于描述由共享系梁耦合的两个相同方形谐振器，分析耦合梁长度和宽度如何同时决定频率分裂与耗散稀释，并用有限元模拟验证。短耦合梁极限下，对称模的耦合梁扭转应变能渐近消失，其耗散稀释可高于同尺寸孤立多边形；反对称模仍保留耦合梁扭转应变并引入额外损耗。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确给出研究动机；其研究关注通过耦合梁几何调控耦合多边形谐振器的频率分裂和耗散，并建立可预测的解析模型。
AI.method: 建立两个相同方形谐振器经共享系梁耦合的连续体模型，将耦合梁长度和宽度与两个耦合模式的频率分裂及耗散稀释联系起来；将解析预测与有限元模拟比较，并在短耦合梁极限 $k_c l_c\ll1$ 及短系梁极限下推导 $Q\cdot f$ 表达式。
AI.result: 模型给出耦合梁几何对频率分裂和耗散稀释的关系。短耦合梁极限下，对称模的耦合梁近似均匀旋转，扭转应变能渐近消失，剩余损耗来自多边形侧边弯曲和支撑系梁扭转；支撑系梁贡献降低使对称模耗散稀释超过同侧边和支撑系梁尺寸的孤立多边形。反对称模保留耦合梁扭转应变并有额外损耗。$Q\cdot f$ 表达式给出其对张应力、薄膜厚度和支撑系梁几何的依赖。耦合梁长 $100~\mu\mathrm{m}$、宽 $2~\mu\mathrm{m}$ 时，有限元计算得到频率分裂 $17.7~\mathrm{Hz}$，对称模稀释因子比解析孤立多边形值高约 $13\%$。
AI.conclusion: 耦合梁几何是调控耦合多边形谐振器频率分裂与耗散的关键设计参数；短耦合梁可显著降低对称模的耦合梁扭转损耗，使其耗散稀释优于孤立多边形，而反对称模因保留耦合梁扭转应变而具有额外损耗。摘要报告了解析模型和有限元结果，未提供实验验证信息。

title: Nearly Transform-Limited Pulse-Like Temporal and Narrowband Spectral Responses in Sum-Frequency Generation from Bright Twin Beams
summary: We simultaneously characterize the temporal and spectral responses of the coherent component in bright twin beams using a spectrally resolved, delay-dependent sum-frequency generation (SFG) measurement. The measured temporal-correlation width is 0.138 ps, close to the transform-limited value of 0.126 ps estimated from the measured twin-beam spectrum.The observed spectral-correlation width is 0.176 rad/ps and is limited by the spectrometer resolution. The corresponding time-frequency width product is 0.0243, far below the value of 1 for SFG between two independent transform-limited Gaussian pulses.

AI.tldr: 该文利用光谱分辨且延迟依赖的和频产生（SFG）测量，同时表征明亮双光束中相干成分的时间与光谱响应；测得时间相关宽度为0.138 ps，光谱相关宽度为0.176 rad/ps，时间-频率宽度积为0.0243。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确说明研究动机，只说明需要同时表征明亮双光束中相干成分的时间响应与光谱响应。
AI.method: 采用光谱分辨、延迟依赖的和频产生（SFG）测量，对明亮双光束中的相干成分进行时间与光谱响应的同时表征。
AI.result: 测得时间相关宽度为0.138 ps，接近由实测双光束光谱估算的变换极限值0.126 ps；光谱相关宽度为0.176 rad/ps，且受光谱仪分辨率限制；对应时间-频率宽度积为0.0243，远低于两个独立变换极限高斯脉冲间SFG的1。
AI.conclusion: 该测量同时给出了明亮双光束相干成分的时间与光谱相关特性；其时间相关宽度接近变换极限，时间-频率宽度积远低于独立变换极限高斯脉冲SFG的情形，而光谱相关宽度受光谱仪分辨率限制。

title: Optical Detection of Coefficient of Thermal Expansion via Frequency Tracking at Cryogenic Temperatures
summary: Accurate characterization of the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) in nanoscale thin films is critical for predicting residual stress and ensuring the reliability of modern micro-electromechanical systems and advanced semiconductor architectures. The primary limitation is that traditional methods depend on precise thickness measurements or are restricted to crystalline materials. In this work, we present an in-situ, non-destructive optical methodology to determine the CTE of suspended nanofilms by tracking the temperature-dependence of their vibrational frequency. This approach eliminates thickness measurements entirely and works for amorphous films where X-ray diffraction (XRD) fails. We experimentally validate this technique across a broad temperature range, evaluating membranes in their native microstructure state without requiring additional destructive patterning or complex sample preparation. This non-contact optical method achieves uncertainty below 5.3 * 10-8 K-1, substantially improving upon conventional thin-film CTE metrology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种原位、无损、非接触的光学方法，通过跟踪悬浮纳米薄膜振动频率随温度的变化来测定热膨胀系数（CTE），无需测量厚度，也适用于X射线衍射（XRD）失效的非晶薄膜；实验验证的不确定度低于5.3×10^-8 K^-1。
AI.motivation: 准确表征纳米尺度薄膜的CTE对于预测残余应力、保障微机电系统和先进半导体架构可靠性至关重要。传统方法主要受限于依赖精确厚度测量，或仅适用于晶体材料，因此需要一种免测厚且可用于非晶薄膜的表征手段。
AI.method: 采用原位、非破坏性光学方法，以悬浮纳米薄膜为对象，通过测量其振动频率的温度依赖性反演CTE；该方法完全不需要厚度测量，可在薄膜原生微结构状态下评估，无需额外破坏性图案化或复杂样品制备，并在较宽温度范围内进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 实验在较宽温度范围内验证了该技术，可评估原生微结构状态的薄膜且无需额外破坏性图案化或复杂制样；该方法对非晶薄膜有效，而XRD在此类材料上失效；CTE测量不确定度低于5.3×10^-8 K^-1，较传统薄膜CTE计量有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种原位、无损、非接触且免测厚的悬浮纳米薄膜CTE光学表征方法，适用于非晶薄膜并达到低于5.3×10^-8 K^-1的不确定度；摘要未提供具体温度范围、测试材料体系及更广泛的普适性定量数据。

title: Seeing Why: Exact Evidence Maps for Quantum and Optical Image Classifiers
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Code, trained models and the IBM job records: https://github.com/stein-research/seeing-why (archived: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23906357). v2: abstract and introduction clarified (known identity vs. new measurement; Caltech-10 results marked exploratory), corresponding author, authors' ORCIDs, Zenodo DOI, clearer Figs. 9 and 12; results unchanged
summary: When an image classifier decides, we can usually only estimate why. For quantum and all-optical classifiers that act linearly on amplitude-encoded pictures up to the measurement, with no trained classical network before or after them, each class's Born probability above its no-information share, $P_g - b_g$, splits exactly into contributions of the encoded amplitudes, shown as Born evidence maps (BEM) over the picture. The split itself follows from known results on quadratic forms: with the transmitted light held fixed, it is what Integrated Gradients from a zero baseline and the Shapley value give. What we add is a way to measure it on the hardware that classifies, from class probabilities on a quantum chip or from camera frames on a lens bench, with no gradient circuit and no light sent backwards; a $g\times g$ map takes $1 + 2g^2$ runs. Deleting the 5% of pixels with the highest evidence drops accuracy from 73% to 9%, as occlusion does with 1,024 extra runs per picture, whereas gradient saliency removes much less. The classifiers share one architecture, a Fourier-plane mask followed by a brickwall circuit on qubits or by phase plates on a lens bench, read by a fixed Born headroom readout with no trained parameter; centring each picture on its own mean lets dark features count as much as bright ones. In simulation, four phase plates at a single wavelength reach 72.3% on Caltech-10 colour photographs. On IBM's ibm_kingston, with the mask applied before approximate loading, 300 test pictures were classified at 37.7% against 10% by chance (56.3% in exact simulation), and $2\times2$ maps of ten correctly classified pictures, one per class chosen by a stated rule, measured on the chip, agreed with the exact ones ($r = 0.77$). The maps also revealed a shortcut in the data; as the trim that removed it was chosen on test pictures, the Caltech-10 results are exploratory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可在量子或全光线性分类硬件上直接测量的 Born evidence maps（BEM），把类别 Born 概率超出无信息份额的部分精确分解为像素振幅贡献；该方法仅需 1+2g² 次运行即可得到 g×g 证据图，实验表明其能高效定位关键像素并揭示数据捷径，但分类精度有限且 Caltech-10 结果属探索性。
AI.motivation: 图像分类器的决策通常只能推测原因。针对在测量前对幅度编码图像作线性作用、前后均无训练经典网络的量子与全光分类器，需要一种无需梯度电路、无需反向传光、可直接在实际分类硬件上测量的逐类像素证据归因方法，并降低解释所需运行次数。
AI.method: 对每个类别，将 Born 概率高于无信息份额的部分 P_g-b_g 按二次型精确拆分到编码振幅，形成覆盖图像的证据图；在透射光固定时，该拆分等价于零基线 Integrated Gradients 和 Shapley 值。BEM 可从量子芯片的类概率或透镜台的相机帧测得，g×g 图需 1+2g² 次运行。分类器共用架构：Fourier 平面掩模后接 qubit brickwall 电路或透镜台相位板，采用无训练参数的固定 Born headroom 读出；图像按自身均值中心化，使暗特征与亮特征同等计入。验证包括删除证据最高 5% 像素、与遮挡和梯度显著性比较，并在模拟及 IBM ibm_kingston 上测试；芯片上将掩模置于近似加载之前。
AI.result: 删除证据最高的 5% 像素使准确率从 73% 降至 9%；遮挡达到类似效果需每图额外 1,024 次运行，而梯度显著性删除的像素影响小得多。模拟中四块相位板、单一波长在 Caltech-10 彩色照片上达到 72.3%。在 ibm_kingston 上，300 张测试图片取得 37.7% 准确率，随机为 10%，精确模拟为 56.3%；对每类按文中所述规则选取一张正确分类图片共十张，在芯片上测得 2×2 图与精确图一致，r=0.77。证据图还揭示了数据中的捷径；摘要未给出该选取规则的具体内容。
AI.conclusion: BEM 为无训练经典前后处理的线性量子与全光分类器提供了一种可在分类硬件上直接、低成本测量的精确像素级解释方法，并可暴露数据捷径。当前分类精度仍有限；由于去除数据捷径的修剪方案是在测试图片上选择的，Caltech-10 结果被作者定性为探索性，其他数据集或硬件上的泛化性摘要未提供。

title: Spin-induced lateral acoustic forces on chiral and achiral particles
summary: Acoustic spin enables intriguing chiral sound-matter interactions, yet its mechanical consequences remain much less explored. Here, we demonstrate spin-induced lateral acoustic forces on chiral and achiral particles coupled to a substrate. Under plane-wave incidence, left- and right-handed chiral particles scatter fields with opposite acoustic spin that selectively couple to counterpropagating guided waves, generating lateral forces of opposite signs on the enantiomers. The lateral forces can also be realized for achiral particles by employing acoustic vortex-beam illumination. We experimentally validate the spin-dependent excitation of guided waves and lateral forces. Our results provide a route to spin-controlled acoustic manipulation and chirality-selective particle transport.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究耦合于基底的手性与非手性颗粒在声自旋作用下受到的横向声力：平面波入射时，手性对映体散射出相反声自旋并选择性耦合反向传播导波，产生相反方向的横向力；非手性颗粒则可通过声涡旋束照明获得横向力，并得到实验验证。
AI.motivation: 声自旋可产生新奇的声-物质手性相互作用，但其力学后果，尤其是对颗粒的力学操控，研究仍较少；作者希望利用声自旋实现横向声力与手性选择性颗粒输运。
AI.method: 构建颗粒与基底耦合的声学体系：在平面波入射下分析左手性和右手性手性颗粒的散射场声自旋及其与反向传播导波的选择性耦合，比较对映体所受横向力；对非手性颗粒采用声涡旋束照明；并通过实验验证自旋依赖的导波激发与横向力。
AI.result: 平面波入射时，左手性和右手性手性颗粒散射出相反声自旋，分别选择性耦合到反向传播的导波，使对映体受到符号相反的横向力；声涡旋束照明也可使非手性颗粒产生横向力；实验验证了自旋依赖的导波激发和横向力。摘要未提供力的大小、颗粒尺寸与材料、频率及定量实验参数。
AI.conclusion: 声自旋可驱动并调控横向声力，实现手性选择性颗粒输运，为基于自旋的声学操控提供了途径。

title: Self-driven beta-radiation detection through a graphene/water/silicon heterostructure
summary: Large-volume neutrino observatories, exemplified by IceCube, exploit Cherenkov light generated by neutrino-induced charged particles in Antarctic ice, highlighting the potential of water-based media for high-energy particle detection. In $β$-decay, a neutron converts into a proton via the weak interaction, emitting an electron and an electron antineutrino. The electron constitutes the beta radiation detected in this work, while the accompanying antineutrino motivates future extensions toward neutrino detection. Here we demonstrate a complementary electrical transduction strategy using a graphene/water/silicon heterostructure that generates reversible current transients under beta irradiation at zero applied bias. Energetic electrons deposit energy in silicon, producing nonequilibrium carriers that perturb the semiconductor surface potential and electric displacement across the adjacent aqueous interface. The resulting redistribution of interfacial water polarization drives a transient compensation current, whereas carrier relaxation restores the initial polarization state and generates an opposite-polarity recovery signal. The complete irradiation-detector-electrometer system exhibits exponential rise and recovery time constants of approximately 1.0 and 3.6 ms, respectively. The response is strongly regulated by water-layer thickness and ionic composition, and the 17 beam pulses of a programmed 1 s sequence at 17 Hz are resolved individually. Integration with Ce:YAG further introduces a scintillation-mediated excitation pathway.
