These findings establish interfacial water polarization as a tunable, zero-bias electrical transduction mechanism for time-resolved beta-radiation monitoring and motivate future investigations of higher-energy charged particles and secondary particles relevant to neutrino detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种基于石墨烯/水/硅异质结的零偏压电学换能策略：β辐照下产生可逆电流瞬态，上升与恢复时间常数约1.0 ms和3.6 ms，可分辨17 Hz的17个脉冲序列，并可通过Ce:YAG引入闪烁介导激发；该机制面向时间分辨β辐射监测，并为未来中微子探测相关的高能带电粒子研究提供动机。
AI.motivation: 大型中微子天文台（如IceCube）利用中微子诱导带电粒子在南极冰中产生的切伦科夫光，显示水基介质用于高能粒子探测的潜力。β衰变中中子经弱相互作用变为质子并释放电子和电子反中微子；电子对应本工作探测的β辐射，反中微子则启发未来扩展至中微子探测。因此作者希望发展一种互补的电学换能策略。
AI.method: 构建石墨烯/水/硅异质结，在零外加偏压下进行β辐照并测量电流瞬态。高能电子在硅中沉积能量，产生非平衡载流子，扰动半导体表面势及邻近水界面的电位移；界面水极化重新分布驱动瞬态补偿电流，载流子弛豫恢复初始极化并产生反极性恢复信号。实验表征上升/恢复时间常数，考察水层厚度和离子组成的影响，用1 s内17 Hz的17个束流脉冲测试时间分辨，并集成Ce:YAG引入闪烁介导激发路径。
AI.result: 辐照-探测器-静电计系统呈现指数上升和恢复时间常数分别约1.0 ms和3.6 ms；响应受水层厚度和离子组成强烈调控；1 s序列中17 Hz的17个束流脉冲可被逐一分辨；集成Ce:YAG进一步提供闪烁介导的激发路径。摘要未提供探测效率、灵敏度、能量分辨率或实际中微子探测结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了界面水极化作为一种可调、零偏压的电学换能机制，可用于时间分辨β辐射监测，并支持未来研究更高能带电粒子及与中微子探测相关的次级粒子。摘要未证明已实现中微子探测。

title: From Rock Tumbling to Telescope Mirror Grinding: How Optical Perfection Emerges from Random Motion
comment: Conditionally accepted in American Journal of Physics; comments welcome
summary: When two glass disks are rubbed together by hand with an abrasive between them, their surfaces spontaneously converge to perfectly matching spherical curves, accurate to tens of nanometers. How does such optical precision emerge from an essentially random manual process? Starting from Preston's law of material removal, we derive a first-principles explanation. Symmetries of the grinding stroke imply that planes and spheres are the generic equilibria of the process. Their stability is governed by a hierarchy of timescales: small-scale irregularities decay exponentially on the grinding timescale $T_\text{grind}$, while large-scale deviations from a sphere diffuse away on the longer spherizing timescale $T_\text{sphere} \propto (R_\text{mirror}/R_\text{stroke})^2\, T_\text{grind}$. Gravity and finite disk size destabilize planar surfaces, but for sufficiently short strokes spheres remain stable ($T_\text{deform} \gg T_\text{sphere}$), with only their radius of curvature varying adiabatically. The same framework unifies telescope mirror grinding with everyday phenomena: rock tumbling (explaining why rotary tumbling rounds edges more than vibratory, and why neither produce spheres) and sanding (explaining why small flat surfaces inevitably round). These examples offer an accessible classroom context for stable and unstable equilibria, exponential relaxation, diffusion, multi-timescale analysis, and the emergence of the Laplacian operator from averaging over a local area.

AI.tldr: 该文从Preston材料去除定律出发，建立玻璃盘手工研磨自发形成纳米级匹配球面的第一性原理解释：平面和球面是研磨运动的对称平衡态，其稳定性由多时间尺度层级决定，并可将望远镜镜面研磨、摇滚打磨和砂纸打磨统一起来。
AI.motivation: 解释两个玻璃盘在随机手工研磨下，表面为何能自发收敛到精度达数十纳米的完美匹配球面，即光学精度如何从本质上随机的过程中涌现。
AI.method: 以Preston材料去除定律为起点进行理论推导，分析研磨行程的对称性，建立小尺度不规则性与大尺度球面偏差的稳定性及时间尺度层级，并分析重力与有限圆盘尺寸对平面稳定性的影响；随后将该框架应用于望远镜镜面研磨、旋转/振动摇滚打磨和砂纸打磨等现象。
AI.result: 推导表明：平面和球面是过程的通用平衡态；小尺度不规则性按研磨时间尺度T_grind指数衰减，大尺度偏离球面的偏差以更长的球化时间尺度T_sphere ∝ (R_mirror/R_stroke)^2 T_grind扩散消除；重力和有限圆盘尺寸会使平面失稳，而足够短的行程可使球面保持稳定（T_deform ≫ T_sphere），仅曲率半径发生绝热变化。该框架还解释了旋转摇滚打磨比振动打磨更易磨圆边缘、两者均不产生球面，以及小平面砂磨必然变圆等现象。摘要未提供具体实验数据或定量验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 该文提出一个统一的第一性原理框架，说明随机手工研磨形成光学球面源于对称性决定的平衡态与多时间尺度稳定性机制，并为稳定/不稳定平衡、指数弛豫、扩散、多时间尺度分析和由局部平均导出Laplacian算子提供了可进入课堂的教学案例。

title: Optimal Fan-Out and Break-Even Routing Loss in Waveguide-Integrated Ge-on-Si SPAD Arrays
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Extended version of a two-page paper submitted to the 2027 IEEE Silicon Photonics Conference
summary: Splitting a waveguide mode over several Ge-on-Si single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) relieves dead-time saturation but multiplies dark counts. We quantify this trade-off with the asymptotic count-based information rate, which prices dark counts and dead time in one unit and is attained by an optimally weighted moment estimator. For a non-paralyzable pixel, the information per pre-dead-time signal event peaks at a signal rate $y^*=\sqrt{D(D+1/τ)}$ with exact efficiency $(\sqrt{1+Dτ}-\sqrt{Dτ})^2$, which sets the optimal fan-out and a critical flux above which equal splitting is optimal. We then compare four routing architectures on 64 simulated 16-pixel arrays: an equal passive tree, static trees (uncalibrated, and an idealized calibration-informed benchmark), an ideal programmable tree, and a thermo-optic Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) tree with 1.32 dB excess loss. Ideal programmability gains up to 15.9 dB over equal splitting at low flux. At one known flux, however, the calibrated static splitter beats the MZI tree by 0.14-2.7 dB, and the penalty tends to twice the excess loss when dark counts dominate. In ensemble-median worst-case regret, the MZI tree breaks even only for flux windows wider than 2.55 decades, and not within six decades above about 3.4 dB excess loss. Event-level Monte Carlo simulations reproduce the count statistics and the predicted estimator variances within bootstrap confidence intervals. Sensitivity analyses cover dark-count level, heterogeneity, detector model and random seed. All results are simulations with representative literature parameters.

AI.tldr: 论文用渐近计数信息率统一权衡Ge-on-Si单光子雪崩二极管阵列中波导模式分束带来的死时间缓解与暗计数倍增，推导最优扇出与临界通量，并在64个模拟16像素阵列上比较四类路由架构。
AI.motivation: 将波导模式分到多个Ge-on-Si SPAD上可缓解死时间饱和，但会增加暗计数；论文旨在用一个同时计入暗计数和死时间的指标量化该权衡，并据此确定最优分束扇出和路由架构。
AI.method: 采用渐近计数信息率作为指标，并证明其可由最优加权矩估计器达到；针对非瘫痪型像素推导每个死时间前信号事件的信息量峰值条件及效率。随后在64个模拟16像素阵列上比较无源等分树、静态树（未校准及理想校准基准）、理想可编程树和具有1.32 dB超额损耗的热光MZI树，并用事件级蒙特卡洛、bootstrap置信区间及多因素敏感性分析验证。
AI.result: 非瘫痪型像素的信息量在信号率 y*=√(D(D+1/τ)) 处达到峰值，精确效率为(√(1+Dτ)-√(Dτ))²，并据此给出最优扇出及等分更优的临界通量。低通量下理想可编程性相对等分最多增益15.9 dB；在单一已知通量下，校准静态分束器比MZI树优0.14-2.7 dB，暗计数主导时惩罚趋近两倍超额损耗。按集成中位最坏情况遗憾，MZI树仅在通量窗口宽于2.55个数量级时打平，且在约3.4 dB超额损耗以上、六个数量级范围内无法打平。蒙特卡洛复现了计数统计和预测估计器方差，敏感性分析覆盖暗计数水平、异质性、探测器模型和随机种子。
AI.conclusion: 分束存在死时间缓解与暗计数增加的明确权衡，最优扇出由信号率、暗计数和死时间共同决定，超过临界通量后等分更优；理想可编程路由在低通量占优，但有损耗的MZI树在已知通量下可能不如校准静态分束器，架构选择取决于通量窗口、暗计数和超额损耗。所有结果均为基于代表性文献参数的模拟，未报告实验验证。

title: Discovering Models for Experimental Quantum Systems with Agentic AI
summary: A central obstacle in realizing color center cavity-QED-based quantum technologies is inhomogeneity, or disorder, among individual emitters. As the number of emitters increases, so does the complexity of the experimental data, making it difficult to quantify the present physical mechanisms of disorder. Here we introduce an artificial intelligence-driven model discovery framework in which a large language model (LLM)-based agent, equipped with tools and a structured workflow, proposes candidate Hamiltonian and Lindbladian models, generates computational tools, and quantitatively evaluates competing physical hypotheses. We apply the workflow to three previously published experimental cavity-QED datasets collected from color centers in diamond and silicon carbide. Across the experiments, the agent successfully identifies physical models for the system and characterizes the disorder. In assessing reproducibility, we find that run-to-run variability is concentrated primarily in the research plan generation step, while the computational analysis itself is substantially more consistent. Our results suggest that structured LLM agent workflows can support model discovery from quantum optical experimental data while simultaneously allowing for human expert supervision and collaboration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由LLM智能体驱动的结构化模型发现框架，用于从色心腔QED实验数据中识别物理模型并表征发射器无序；在三组已发表数据集上成功识别模型，且计算分析步骤的重复性高于研究计划生成步骤。
AI.motivation: 色心腔QED量子技术面临个体发射器不均匀性（无序）的核心障碍；随着发射器数量增加，实验数据复杂性上升，难以量化当前无序的物理机制。
AI.method: 构建人工智能驱动的模型发现框架：基于大语言模型的智能体配备工具和结构化工作流，提出候选哈密顿量与林布拉德模型，生成计算工具，并定量评估相互竞争物理假设；将该工作流应用于三组已发表的、来自金刚石和碳化硅色心的腔QED实验数据集。
AI.result: 智能体在各实验中成功识别系统物理模型并表征无序；在可重复性评估中，运行间差异主要集中于研究计划生成步骤，计算分析本身一致性显著更高。具体模型形式、数据集规模及定量性能指标未在摘要中提供。
AI.conclusion: 结构化LLM智能体工作流可支持从量子光学实验数据进行模型发现，同时保留人类专家监督与协作的空间。

title: Ultra-broadband quantum infrared spectroscopy extending to 20 {\textmu}m
comment: Submitted to Optica Quantum on 6 July 2026
summary: Quantum infrared spectroscopy (QIRS), which exploits quantum interference between photon-pair generation processes, enables infrared spectroscopy using only visible and near-infrared (VNIR) light sources and detectors. Extending the spectral coverage of QIRS into the long-wavelength infrared region up to 20 {\textmu}m is crucial for the identification and characterization of a broad range of materials. However, implementing QIRS beyond 10 {\textmu}m has been challenging because the nonlinear materials used to date do not provide suitable photon-pair sources in this spectral region. Here, we design a wavelength-tunable photon-pair source based on a gallium selenide crystal and develop a QIRS system covering a broad spectral range from 8.6 to 20 {\textmu}m. Using this system, we measure the transmittance spectrum of a polystyrene film and observe characteristic absorption bands beyond 10 {\textmu}m relevant to identifying polystyrene and to probing local chain conformation. These results demonstrate that QIRS is capable of covering the entire molecular fingerprint region.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于硒化镓晶体的波长可调谐光子对源，构建了覆盖8.6至20微米的中远红外量子红外光谱系统，并测量聚苯乙烯薄膜透过率光谱，证明QIRS可覆盖整个分子指纹区。
AI.motivation: 量子红外光谱QIRS可利用可见光和近红外光源与探测器实现红外光谱，但此前受限于非线性材料，难以扩展到10微米以上直至20微米的长波红外区域；该区域对多种材料的识别与表征很重要。
AI.method: 设计基于硒化镓晶体的波长可调谐光子对源，并据此搭建QIRS系统，使其光谱覆盖8.6至20微米；用该系统测量聚苯乙烯薄膜的透过率光谱。
AI.result: 系统覆盖8.6至20微米；聚苯乙烯薄膜测量中观察到10微米以上的特征吸收带，这些吸收带与识别聚苯乙烯及探测局部链构象相关。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明QIRS能够覆盖整个分子指纹区，展示了将QIRS扩展至20微米长波红外区域的可行性。

title: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/zwang-devv/spectra-decision-audit
summary: A spectrum can be given to a model as a table in nanometers or as a plot in photon energy, and the decision should not depend on which one it sees. When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so. We test representation invariance and abstention on measured optical spectra of silicon metasurfaces (MOCLIP) and gold nanoparticles, with labels computed from the data. Each spectrum is shown as four tables (nm, $μ$m, scientific notation, eV) and two plots (nm, eV), and partial spectra remove data inside or outside the queried range. We evaluate the decision models d3-nano and Jev 1.13, three GPT-6 Luna configurations and the Qwen3.5-2B base model. Changing only the representation moves accuracy by up to 41 percentage points within one model, mostly on photon-energy tables and plots. With the same evidence, asking in photon energy instead of wavelength helps some model-view pairs by 16-50 points and hurts others by up to 25. When the relevant extremum is removed, unadapted models rarely answer "undetermined". LoRA fine-tuning of d3-nano improves comparisons on the trained table formats, but much of its gain on unanswerable questions comes from a shortcut: it abstains whenever the input is truncated. Training with answerable truncations avoids the shortcut in all six seeds, with a 90-100 point gap between abstention after inside and outside cuts on held-out structures; with the same amount of extra original-task data, five of six seeds keep the shortcut. On gold spectra the two training sets perform similarly. Multimodal language models used for scientific decisions should be tested on equivalent representations and on missing evidence, not only on average accuracy. We release the tasks, per-response results and analysis code.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试多模态模型在光谱任务中的表示不变性与缺失证据弃答能力，发现仅改变表示即可使同一模型准确率变化高达41个百分点，且微调可能利用“输入被截断就弃答”的捷径；因此科学决策模型应接受等价表示与缺失证据测试，而不能只看平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 模型应能以纳米表、光子能量图等等价形式一致地处理光谱，并在回答所需数据缺失时明确表示无法确定；仅评估平均准确率不足以检验这些能力。
AI.method: 使用硅超表面（MOCLIP）和金纳米颗粒的实测光谱，标签由数据计算。每条光谱以四种表（nm、μm、科学计数法、eV）和两种图（nm、eV）呈现，并通过部分光谱删除查询范围内或外的数据。评估d3-nano、Jev 1.13、三种GPT-6 Luna配置和Qwen3.5-2B基础模型；对d3-nano进行LoRA微调，比较使用可回答截断训练与增加等量原始任务数据训练，并在六个随机种子和留出结构上测试，另在金光谱上比较两种训练集。
AI.result: 仅改变表示可使同一模型准确率变化最多41个百分点，主要出现在光子能量表和图上；相同证据下改用光子能量而非波长提问，可使部分模型-视图组合提升16-50个百分点，也会使其他组合下降最多25个百分点。移除相关极值后，未适配模型很少回答“无法确定”。LoRA微调改善了训练表格式上的比较，但其在不可回答问题上的增益很大程度来自捷径：输入被截断即弃答。使用可回答截断训练后，六个种子均避免该捷径，留出结构上截断内/外切除后的弃答率差距为90-100个百分点；使用等量额外原始任务数据时，六个种子中有五个仍保留捷径。金光谱上两种训练集表现相似。
AI.conclusion: 用于科学决策的多模态语言模型应在等价表示和缺失证据条件下接受测试，而不仅是平均准确率；作者发布了任务、逐响应结果和分析代码。

title: Detectability of an orbital-angular-momentum-based gravitational wave detector
summary: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) of light provides a new approach to probing gravitational waves (GWs) through transitions between OAM states. Here, we assess the detectability of an OAM-based GW detector by developing a readout scheme and evaluating its noise budget over the frequency range from $1~\mathrm{mHz}$ to $100~\mathrm{Hz}$, including laser-intensity noise, laser-phase noise, mode-impurity noise, and shot noise. For a symmetric superposition OAM state, the GW-induced transition amplitudes satisfy $α_+=-α_-^*$, whereas the noise-induced mode-crosstalk coefficients obey $n_+=n_-^*$. Hence, the GW-induced signal forms a differential-mode contribution, while laser-intensity and mode-impurity noises enter as common-mode contributions, enabling their suppression by the balanced detection. Under a fixed beam-waist constraint, a shorter arm permits a larger paraxial parameter, reducing the equivalent angular-noise strain sensitivity. We adopt an arm length of $L=4\,\mathrm{m}$, $N=160$ round trips, a paraxial parameter of $γ=0.1$, a laser power incident on the beam splitter of $P_{\mathrm{BS}}=10\,\mathrm{kW}$, and a wavelength of $λ_{\mathrm{opt}}=1064\,\mathrm{nm}$. Using representative noise spectra, we find that, for GWs from an equal-mass binary black hole with source-frame component masses of $M_{\mathrm{src}}=10^{4}\,M_{\odot}$ at redshift $z=1$, balanced detection yields an SNR of $24.7$ for an imbalance parameter of $ε=10^{-3}$ and $239$ for $ε=10^{-5}$, with the sensitivity approaching the shot-noise limit in the latter case. These results highlight the importance of a compact optical configuration and strong common-mode rejection for realizing an OAM-based GW detector.

AI.tldr: 本文面向基于轨道角动量（OAM）态跃迁的引力波探测方案，建立读出方案并评估1 mHz至100 Hz的噪声预算；利用对称OAM叠加态下信号为差分模、激光强度与模杂质噪声为共模的特性，通过平衡探测抑制噪声。在L=4 m、N=160、γ=0.1、P_BS=10 kW、λ_opt=1064 nm参数下，对z=1、源帧分量质量10^4 M_⊙的等质量双黑洞，ε=10^-3和10^-5时分别获得SNR 24.7和239。
AI.motivation: 光的轨道角动量（OAM）通过OAM态间跃迁为引力波探测提供了新途径；本文旨在通过发展读出方案并评估1 mHz至100 Hz范围内的噪声预算，考察OAM型引力波探测器的可探测性。
AI.method: 建立OAM型引力波探测器的读出方案，并评估激光强度噪声、激光相位噪声、模杂质噪声和散粒噪声等噪声预算。对于对称叠加OAM态，引力波诱导跃迁振幅满足α_+=-α_-^*，噪声诱导模串扰系数满足n_+=n_-^*，使引力波信号成为差分模贡献，而激光强度噪声和模杂质噪声成为共模贡献，从而可由平衡探测抑制。在固定束腰约束下采用较短臂长以获得更大傍轴参数，降低等效角噪声应变灵敏度。采用L=4 m、N=160次往返、傍轴参数γ=0.1、入射分束器激光功率P_BS=10 kW、波长λ_opt=1064 nm，并使用代表性噪声谱进行评估。
AI.result: 对于红移z=1、源帧分量质量为10^4 M_⊙的等质量双黑洞引力波，平衡探测在失配参数ε=10^-3时给出SNR 24.7，在ε=10^-5时给出SNR 239；后一情况下灵敏度接近散粒噪声极限。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，紧凑的光学配置和强共模抑制对于实现基于OAM的引力波探测器十分重要。
